summary.핵심플레이: 스파이더 솔리테어와 그 변형 게임을 플레이하며 카드를 규칙에 따라 정리한다. 난이도 수준을 선택해 진행할 수 있다.
summary.특징: Beeswax, Black Widow, Scorpion, Simple Simon 등 20종의 스파이더 계열 게임을 수록했으며, 무제한 되돌리기, 자동 완성, 통계, 각 게임별 규칙 안내 기능을 제공한다.

name: Click on spanners together
input:
Search an incredibly detailed hand-drawn environment for spanners. When you find one, click it to mark it as yours. The game is won once everything has been found, and a scoreboard will be displayed showing who found what. No time limit, just you and your friends. Singleplayer is available too!
Full level preview
The colours can be customised ingame to be less harsh on the eyes.

Difficulty: Medium
Ways to play together:
🖱️ Mouse (Default)
⌨️ Keyboard (WASD, TFGH, IJKL, or arrow keys)
🎮 Gamepads (Click here for detailed gamepad info)
▶️ Steam remote play
📶 LAN (Over the same wifi)
🌐 Online (Experimental, connectionless, no port forwarding needed)
And any combination of the above! Or play by yourself in singleplayer too!
What’s in the box?
🌄 1 hand drawn panoramic level
🔎 100+ hidden objects to find
💬 Ingame chat
💡 Unlimited hints
🏆 Paced achievements
🎨 Different colour theme options for tired eyes
🎵 Relaxing music (can be disabled)
Scoring modes:
- Incremental score: Each object is worth 1 point
- Multiplier scoring: Objects progressively get more valuable towards the end of the game
Online multiplayer
This game uses an experimental form of P2P, so both host and player must enter each other’s IP addresses to connect (these settings are remembered between games). This means that you won't need to port forward, and also means that the game isn't reliant on a matchmaking server. But it also might not work at all in some circumstances. It will work best on home modems, but may not work on large wifi networks with extenders. In this case, you'll either have to port forward, use a VLAN service, or use steam remote play.
Seamless binging experience
Settings and recently connected players will be remembered across all the games in the series, so you won't need to keep entering IP addresses unless they've changed. In just a few clicks, you can all be reconnected in the next game.
Streamer friendly
Once you've set it up, IP addresses will never be shown in-game by the UI.
Coop or versus?
It’s up to you! Each player selects a colour, and then what they found glows that colour. But you could just use the same colour for everyone. When playing online, all your local players become one team/colour anyway.
Controls
Search the image by clicking and dragging with the mouse. Click objects to mark them as found. Alternatively you can use any set of arrow keys (e.g. WASD + E to 'click') or gamepads.
A balance of achievements
Achievements are granted for the important milestones of the level, such as the first object, half way through, and the last few.
Credits:
Scene drawn by @septian3alfandi (instagram)

summary.핵심플레이: 손으로 그린 파노라마 배경에서 100개 이상의 스패너 등 숨은 물체를 찾아 클릭해 표시하고, 모든 물체를 찾으면 누가 무엇을 찾았는지 점수판이 표시되며 게임이 끝난다. 싱글플레이와 멀티플레이 모두 가능하다.
summary.특징: 시간 제한이 없으며, 마우스·키보드·게임패드·Steam 리모트 플레이·LAN·실험적 P2P 온라인 등 다양한 방식으로 함께 즐길 수 있다. 협동 또는 경쟁 방식을 선택할 수 있고, 색상 테마 변경, 인게임 채팅, 무제한 힌트, 두 가지 점수 방식을 제공한다.

name: Bubble With Djealy
input:
About Game:

Bubble With Djealy is based on a character named Djealy. You’re Djealy and you need to shoot the same colored bubbles to get the highest score.

In this bubble shooting game, you’ll have five lives, so whenever you lose alive you can start again with a new life. When you use your five lives, then you need to wait or buy five new lives with 100 coins.

The game has 1150 levels. If the level is too challenging and hard to complete, you can use your coins to buy extra balls. There is an exchange bubble tab that is used to exchange the current bubble with upcoming for the smarter move.





Free Locked Booster:



There are four free locked booster tools which will be unlocked only by coins.

Super aim: This booster is used for, to aim at the exact target on the level.



Rainbow Bomb: This booster is a multiple color bubble that gets attached once you throw it, to any colored bubble and destroys chain.



Horizontal Bomb: This booster is used to destroy all the bubbles in a horizontal chain.



Circle Bomb: This is used to destroy all the bubbles in one circular chain.

Spend 100 coins to buy 5 moves & complete your mission. Fill up your level bar, See your performance. Hit the targets on time or level will revert to the top & you might skip your move.

summary.핵심플레이: 캐릭터 Djealy를 조작해 같은 색의 버블을 조준하여 발사하고, 버블 체인을 없애 점수를 얻는다. 다음에 나올 버블과 현재 버블을 교환해 수를 조정할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 1150개의 레벨과 다섯 개의 생명 시스템이 있으며, 생명을 모두 소진하면 대기하거나 100코인으로 재구매한다. 코인으로 해제하는 부스터(Super aim, Rainbow Bomb, Horizontal Bomb, Circle Bomb)와 추가 볼 구매 기능을 제공한다.

name: Mad Father
input:
In this horror adventure game, play as 11-year-old girl Aya Drevis and uncover the secrets of a bizarre incident that befalls the Drevis residence, where maniacal experiments are conducted night after night.
To arrive at the truth, you'll need to make use of chainsaws, knives, hammers, even bottles of eyeballs to explore every inch of the terrifyingly mad mansion.
This is a remade version of the original Mad Father. In addition to updates such as a total revamping of the in-game graphics, this remake adds brand new scenes and Blood Mode: a new second playthrough which alters the story.

summary.핵심플레이: 11세 소녀 Aya Drevis를 조작해 저택 곳곳을 탐색하며 사건의 진실을 파헤친다. 전기톱, 칼, 망치, 눈알이 든 병 등 다양한 도구를 활용해 저택을 조사한다.
summary.특징: 밤마다 실험이 벌어지는 Drevis 저택을 배경으로 한 원작의 리메이크판으로, 게임 내 그래픽을 전면 개편하고 새로운 장면과 이야기를 변형시키는 2회차 모드인 Blood Mode를 추가했다.

name: Metal March: Beginner Experience
input:
Metal March: Beginner Experience is a free playable preview game of Metal March.
This version game is includes 1 race and 1 region, a total of 2-3 hours of playable time. You'll see the overall flow of the game, the initial strategy, etc.

The full game includes the following!

- CHESS-inspired turn-based strategy game mixed with card collection genres.

- (Based on our current updates) Select your troops from 5 races

- Race-themed areas

- 7 types of unique troops and 10 types of unique magic powers per race

- More than 10 types of troops and 20 types of magic shared among troops

- More than 40 kinds of relics

The world has turned into complete chaos. The fragile peace between races has shattered and trust is in short supply. As tensions rise and old alliances crumble, all the races are now preparing for an expedition to the World's Roof. Which one of the races will be the first to reach the Roof? Only YOU will be the one to know.

Get ready for an epic adventure to claim the powerful relics atop the World's Roof!
Remember, you must be the first to take over the relics at the World's Roof before others. But beware, time is running out. You must be the first to reach the relics before others.

With the help of the Wandering Wizard, you can briefly monitor the battlefield and control your troops.
You can identify each of your troops with tin dolls with different appearances.

All troops have their own movement / attack patterns.
In addition to the attributes and characteristics of the troop's powers, these movement and attack patterns are also essential factors that you need to consider in strategy.

Thoroughly plan your strategy and win. Effectively win the battle by moving troops where the enemy can't counter-attack and quickly retreating to a position the enemy cannot follow. Strategies like this will matter.

MAGIC can be a key that completes your strategy.

With Magic, you can either protect or strengthen your team. You can also choose a strategy that destroys enemies with magic attacks.

Your magic combination also plays a vital role in the battle. Even within the same collaboration of troops, strategies vary depending on which magic spells you cast and in what order.

There are 4 races that you can select for your troops. Each race has its own strengths and weaknesses.
You can overcome the weaknesses of your race with the skills and magics of other races.

To succeed at the beginning of the expedition, some races need to focus on using their unique strengths while others need to work on overcoming their weaknesses.

There is another way to strengthen your troops and magic skills... RELICS!
RELICS provide special effects and synergies in ways that can't be obtained from other sources.

With relics, you can increase your income during the expedition, add beneficial effects before starting a battle, strengthen certain types of troops & magic powers, and weaken your enemies.

You can only activate a limited number of relics, but you can replace them at any time except during battle.

Choose and use relics according to your needs and circumstances!

summary.핵심플레이: 체스에서 영감을 받은 턴제 전략으로, 각기 다른 이동·공격 패턴을 가진 병력을 배치·이동시키고 마법을 조합해 전투에서 승리한다. World's Roof 정상의 유물을 다른 종족보다 먼저 차지하는 원정을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 종족마다 고유한 병력과 마법을 갖추며, 다른 종족의 기술과 마법으로 약점을 보완할 수 있다. 유물을 장착해 수입 증가, 전투 전 효과 부여, 특정 병력·마법 강화, 적 약화 등의 효과를 얻으며 전투 외에는 언제든 교체할 수 있다. 이 버전은 종족 1개와 지역 1개, 2~3시간 분량을 제공하는 무료 체험판이다.

name: Disco Simulator
input:
Select a manager
At the beginning of the game, you will be able to choose your manager. Each of them has their own unique skills to manage different aspects of the club. Decide in which direction you want to develop your club. The skills of the manager you choose will bear fruit in further gameplay, for example: bonuses for bartenders, organizing concerts, or taking care of customer satisfaction. The choice is yours!

Choose your club
There is a wide selection of clubs waiting for you in the game and each of them poses different challenges and has unique victory conditions. Clubs are located in various places: a village, a small town, the center of a big city. Choose wisely and enter the club legend scene!

Care for your customers
Your success depends on customer satisfaction. Every guest has their own individual needs, which you must meet in order to keep them in the club. Do they prefer elegant drinks in stylish cocktail glasses? Or maybe they want to dance to the best hits until dawn? Your job will be to make sure that the music, atmosphere and service meet their expectations. Take care of your customers and thanks to this they will recommend your club to others, thus increasing your reputation. React to unexpected events - spilled alcohol, a clogged toilet or a drunk customer, you will have your hands full!

Organize events
We already have the club ready, the best staff, so it's time to party! Organizing spectacular concerts of bands and DJs is the key to increasing the recognition of your club. Invite stars to the stage, who will not only attract crowds of fans, but also allow you to earn a lot of money. Experience the thrill of making your parties the talk of the town!

summary.핵심플레이: 매니저와 클럽을 선택한 뒤 손님들의 개별적인 요구를 충족시키고, 음악·분위기·서비스를 관리하며 클럽을 운영한다. 술을 흘리거나 화장실이 막히는 등 돌발 상황에도 대응한다.
summary.특징: 각기 다른 능력을 가진 매니저 중 하나를 골라 클럽 운영 방향을 정하고, 마을·소도시·대도시 등 다양한 위치의 클럽마다 고유한 승리 조건이 주어진다. 밴드와 DJ의 공연 같은 이벤트를 열어 클럽의 인지도와 평판을 높인다.

name: Clothing Supermarket Store Simulator
input:
Step into the spotlight and become the ultimate fashion mogul in Clothing Supermarket Store Simulator! This isn’t just any management game - it’s your ticket to crafting a world-class clothing empire. From the sparkle of the runway to the hustle of daily operations, you’ll experience the excitement, challenges, and triumphs of running your very own fashion retail business.Why You’ll Love It:Build Your Dream Store

Create a shopping paradise that wows customers the moment they walk in. Design stunning layouts, choose chic décor, and curate an irresistible selection of clothing and accessories that cater to every style and trend.Stay Ahead of the Curve

Fashion waits for no one! Predict customer demands, stock the latest trends, and launch jaw-dropping promotions to keep your store buzzing with excitement. Will your instincts make you a trendsetter or a has-been?Expand, Innovate, Dominate

Start small, think big. Open new locations, experiment with bold product lines, and grow your business into a thriving fashion empire. Your vision will shape the future of retail!Outsmart the Competition

Other stores want to steal your thunder - don’t let them! Use clever marketing, strategic pricing, and top-notch service to stay ahead. Prove you’ve got what it takes to crush the competition in style.Master the Details

From hiring the perfect team to stopping shoplifters in their tracks, you’ll manage every aspect of your business. Keep your customers happy, your shelves stocked, and your profits soaring.Whether you’re obsessed with the latest fashion or a business mastermind in the making, Clothing Supermarket Store Simulator will challenge your creativity and strategy. Can you create a fashion empire that defines the trends, dazzles the customers, and stands the test of time?Your journey to retail royalty starts now!

summary.핵심플레이: 의류 매장의 레이아웃과 인테리어를 설계하고, 상품과 액세서리를 진열하며, 고객 수요 예측·가격 책정·프로모션·직원 고용 등 매장 운영 전반을 관리한다. 새로운 매장을 열고 제품 라인을 확장해 사업을 키운다.
summary.특징: 패션 소매업을 소재로 하며, 트렌드에 맞춘 상품 구성, 마케팅과 서비스로 경쟁 매장에 대응, 좀도둑 방지 등 세부 운영 요소를 다룬다.

name: SWARMED: Nuts & Bolts
input:
In deep space, your robot transport vehicle crash-landed on a barren asteroid. The sentient robots have escaped and are hungry for both revenge and crunchy humans. Your passengers are panicked and running in all directions.

You are their only hope.

Race across the crash site to save the passengers, while you blast apart the ungrateful robots. Avoid the landmines planted by the nasty droids. Dodge the dreaded auto-tracking laser cannons. Keep your eye out for the flying saucer and its painful destructo-beam. And, oh, sometimes your ray guns don't quite shoot straight. But you'll figure it out -- right?

And whatever you do, don't forget to have fun.

Battle your way through multiple waves of rouge robots to avoid being SWARMED in this retro, heart pounding game.

Play in Virtual Reality.

summary.핵심플레이: 추락한 소행성에서 승객을 구출하며 로봇들을 총으로 처치한다. 여러 웨이브의 로봇을 상대로 지뢰, 자동 추적 레이저포, 비행 접시의 광선을 피하며 싸운다.
summary.특징: 심우주 소행성에 불시착한 로봇 수송선을 배경으로 하며, 광선총의 조준이 항상 정확하지 않은 요소가 있다. 레트로 스타일이며 가상현실 플레이를 지원한다.

name: Formilion
input:
Kill till you get through. In Formilion, you will have to unravel the cause of a missing person and go through a challenging journey uncovering the mysteries of a small planet.

In this game you will have to kill enemies with 4 types of weapons, get into different situations and adapt to the battle conditions. To pass through the crowds of enemies, you will have to be attentive and show high reaction speed.

Advance through residential neighbourhoods, dangerous manufactories, frightening dungeons and secret laboratories. In each of these places you will have to prepare tactics to overcome the obstacles in your way.

Make your own playlist and enter the battle. You will have to pass easy levels that do not require special skills, as well as overcome challenges where you will show your high skill. And all this to the original musical accompaniment!
Features:

- Unusual gaming experience

- Original soundtrack

- Mysterious plot

- One interesting puzzle

- Made with love

Play time ~1-2 hours

summary.핵심플레이: 4종의 무기를 사용해 적을 처치하며 레벨을 진행하고, 다양한 전투 상황에 적응해 밀려오는 적들을 빠른 반응 속도로 돌파한다.
summary.특징: 실종 사건의 원인을 밝히며 작은 행성의 미스터리를 풀어가는 구성으로, 주거 지역, 공장, 던전, 비밀 연구소 등 여러 장소와 오리지널 사운드트랙, 퍼즐 요소를 포함한다. 플레이 시간은 약 1~2시간이다.

name: The Lancaster Leak - O'Brien State Park
input:
Episode 1 - O'Brien State Park
Missing persons happen at state parks all the time, with most never receiving closure. However, after an FBI investigation tape was leaked, new light is shined on a missing person case all the way back from 1985.
You Control the Found Footage

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 발견된 영상(파운드 푸티지) 형식으로 진행되며, 플레이어가 해당 영상을 조작하며 사건을 따라간다.
summary.특징: 1985년의 실종 사건을 다루며, 유출된 FBI 수사 테이프를 소재로 O'Brien State Park에서 벌어진 실종 사건을 조명한다.

name: Birdcakes
input:
Birds + cupcakes = Birdcakes!!!

Step into a world of state-of-the-art cupcake-and-bird weaponry! After a picnic went horribly wrong, Pancake the Cupcake desperately tries to fend off hungry flies away from his girlfriend Cherry! Featuring colorful 2D art; tight shooting controls; and fluid aerial movement mechanics; you’ll be set for a wacky, zero-calorie romp through the kitchen and beyond.

Fly through 6 fly-infested worlds and destroy them with Pancake’s powerful candy bullets. This will be no walk in the park however! Die once, and it’s all the way back to the beginning; so make sure to buy power-ups from the bakery store and get ready to save the (cupcake) world!

Features

- Single Player game.

- Featuring 2 playing modes: Story & Infinite.

- No saving! You can keep the powerups though.

- Fast-paced levels with tight flight controls.

- Compete in online leaderboards for the highest scores.

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: Okay... So, what do I get?
A: Some flying cupcakes shooting against some nasty flies!

Q: Flying cupcakes? So... half bird and half cupcake? How did that happen?
A: Imagine American Pie, but made by bird people or something.

Q: Interesting... How do I play it?
A: You ‘ptooey!’ the heck outta the flies with candy bullets.

Q: How’s the random part of the game work?
A: The levels generate randomly to make the layouts different everytime.

Q: Will I be able to conquer my crush after playing this game?
A: Shucks, you can do that with Mr. Massagy. But if this game does something, we’ll take full credit!

Q: Which controllers does the game support?
A: Steam controller, Dualshock 4 and Xbox Controller... you pick your poison!

Q: Who came up with the idea for this game?
A: ... … Desperation probably...

Q: What would “Birdcakes” taste like?
A: Heck if I know, who asks things like this??

summary.핵심플레이: 컵케이크 캐릭터 Pancake를 조종해 파리들을 캔디 총알로 쏘아 처치하며 스테이지를 진행한다. 한 번 죽으면 처음부터 다시 시작하며, 베이커리 상점에서 파워업을 구매해 대비한다.
summary.특징: 파리가 들끓는 6개의 월드를 무대로 하며, 레벨이 매번 무작위로 생성되어 배치가 달라진다. 스토리 모드와 무한 모드, 온라인 리더보드를 제공하고 저장 기능은 없으나 파워업은 유지된다.

name: Chess Club Valley
input:
Chess Club Valley is a 2D Open-World Chess RPG.

Experience this epic chess adventure for the first time across an action-packed overworld filled with character’s, monsters and hidden secrets. Explore the dangerous underworld dungeon’s where you must battle the Super Bosses in chess. Talk to engaging character’s with unique personalities and play chess against them to level up your XP. A total of 20+ hours of gameplay!

FEATURES

- The first 2D Open-World Chess RPG.
- Journey through an action-packed overworld.
- Explore dungeon’s to battle Super Bosses in chess.
- Level up by interacting with personality-filled characters.
- Charming pixel art along with 8/16-bit inspired music.
- A total of 20+ hours of gameplay.
- Gamepad Support.

summary.핵심플레이: 2D 오픈월드를 탐험하며 다양한 캐릭터 및 던전의 슈퍼 보스와 체스로 대결한다. 캐릭터와 상호작용하고 체스를 두어 경험치를 올려 레벨업한다.
summary.특징: 오픈월드 지상과 지하 던전을 오가며 진행되며, 픽셀 아트 그래픽과 8/16비트 스타일 음악, 게임패드 지원, 20시간 이상의 플레이 분량을 제공한다.

name: Panoptia
input:
In a small peaceful town, there is a mysterious building called Panoptia by the townsfolk. No one knows what it is for, but it is heavily protected for some unknown reason. But when a girl gets past the security, she finds herself in an ever-expanding subterranean world, where thoughts and desires, both good and bad, come to life.

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 소녀가 지하 세계를 탐험하며, 생각과 욕망이 형상화된 공간을 나아간다.
summary.특징: 평화로운 마을에 있는 정체불명의 건물 Panoptia와, 그 아래로 끝없이 확장되는 지하 세계를 배경으로 하며, 선악의 생각과 욕망이 실체화되는 설정을 담았다.

name: Touchly Volumetric VR Video Player
input:
Touchly is the next evolution of the VR video player. Turn videos into volumetric, immersive experiences.

It features:

- Virtual hands that react to the video environment.

- Six-degrees-of-freedom playback: Reduce eye strain and move freely with position tracking.

- Real-time conversion. Play your VR or 2D videos as volumetric with no previous conversion (high-end GPU required).

- Play in most of the common layouts (180/360/Flat in Stereo/Mono) and formats (mp4, avi, mkv, mov, webm).

- Mix videos with your environment with pass-through (Oculus version only).

- Hand tracking and haptic glove support (Oculus version only).
Other features include:

- Spatial audio.

- Advanced settings: Rotation, position, color adjustment, depth adjustments, etc.

- Depth and Color matting.

- Watch local or remote files with streaming.

- Customizable hands.

- 12 bit color and depth.
To watch videos in volumetric mode, it is recommended to convert them first with Touchly Renderer. Only a couple of demo videos are included in the app.

summary.핵심플레이: VR 또는 2D 영상을 볼류메트릭 형식으로 재생하며, 위치 추적을 통한 6자유도 재생과 가상 손 조작으로 영상 환경과 상호작용한다.
summary.특징: 180/360/평면, 스테레오/모노 등 여러 레이아웃과 mp4, avi, mkv, mov, webm 포맷을 지원하고, 실시간 볼류메트릭 변환, 공간 음향, 깊이·색상 조정, 로컬 및 원격 스트리밍 재생을 제공한다. Oculus 버전에서는 패스스루, 핸드 트래킹, 햅틱 장갑을 지원한다.

name: Catch the Thief, If you can!
input:
Inspired by the classics like Atari’s Keystone Kapers, chase thieves around the town and THROUGH TIME!

Crime is on the loose and you’re the only one who can stop it. Show no mercy to this vile thief that’s terrorizing the town, and chase him and his gang through different time eras.

Use different weapons and tactics in different eras. Customize your character and find unexpected ways to fight crime.

Tired of always playing the good guy? Well, look no further. It’s time to become the thief! In this game mode, you’ll have to come up with the craziest plans to escape the jail and get back to your life of crimes. I mean, look at all that money and jewels just sitting there, someone’s got to do something about this!

Classic Split Screen action, gather your friends for frantic 4 Player fun!
Initially, 4 Types of game mode, Battle (Cops vs Thieves), Catch the Money, Find the Exit, Deathmatch.
OBS: Need a gamepad

summary.핵심플레이: 도둑과 그 일당을 여러 시대에 걸쳐 쫓거나, 도둑이 되어 감옥을 탈출하고 돈과 보석을 훔친다. 시대마다 다른 무기와 전술을 사용한다.
summary.특징: Atari의 Keystone Kapers 등 고전 게임에서 영감을 받았으며, 캐릭터 커스터마이징을 지원한다. 분할 화면 기반 최대 4인 플레이와 Battle, Catch the Money, Find the Exit, Deathmatch 등의 게임 모드를 제공하며 게임패드가 필요하다.

name: Alchemy in Dungeon
input:
Introduction:

Roguelike auto chess, delve into dungeons to slay monsters, collect materials, and craft the ultimate potion combinations!



About this game:

Alchemist's Maze is a roguelike auto chess game where you play as a frail but brilliant alchemist. Use potions to aid your chosen adventurers as they explore dungeons. Slay monsters, gather materials, and throw them all into your beloved cauldron. Let's create the most powerful potion combinations together!

summary.핵심플레이: 연금술사가 되어 던전을 탐험하는 모험가들을 물약으로 지원하며, 몬스터를 처치하고 재료를 수집한다. 모은 재료를 가마솥에 넣어 물약 조합을 만들어낸다.
summary.특징: 몸은 약하지만 뛰어난 연금술사를 조작하는 설정으로, 재료를 활용한 물약 조합을 통해 모험가를 돕는 방식이 결합되어 있다.

name: Mutant
input:
You are the product of human and non-terrestrial technology. You have 4 arms,

that can aim at multiple targets at once. Your skin is implanted, giving it enhanced resistance. Your body has steel plates around primary centres, aiming systems, extension motorics, and as many as 9 special abilities.



The main hero is able to use several special abilities where the most significant one is the presence of two extra arms. Mutant can hold different guns in different hands and he can fire at different targets at once. The player can control one of the hands or several hands at once while they aim at a common target. Other hands are automatically seeking space around Mutant for any enemies.



He was born as a quite an ordinary boy in a tiny Czech village. After the death of his parents he was raised by his grandmother, a very kind though a bit muddle-headed woman. She would make anything for the boy! So when the gentlemen in well-fitting suits came around one day, she didn’t hesitate for a moment. Face to face with her own reflection in their black sunglasses, she let the boy go with them to a holiday camp. Then she arranged the money into neat packets and hid it in a straw mattress. She knew the value of things of this kind. The summer came over. Leaves fell off the trees. The snow covered the ground, and the boy never came to the old woman`s mind again.



The lad wasn’t satisfied with the camp from the very first day. He could get over the loss of direct contact with other children, and he could accept the communication with them only by rapping out on the wall of cell. He could acquiesce with the camp guiders who were dressed in white gowns instead of scout uniforms. On the other hand the attractions disgusted him. They promised him sun, water, merry-go-round and lots of fun. It is hard to say what kind of source it was but they surely shone something on him. Anyway he grew one meter up and he became much stronger. It was exactly what he had always wanted to happen. On the other hand there was lots of pain in it. More than he expected.



And then, one day after many years, he woke up and unplugged himself from all those beeping-in-panic devices. Because he didn’t find anyone in the laboratory he came finally to light. Prague is nice but too deserted. The city is almost empty except hordes of strange creatures driven by very simple killing philosophy. There are enough enemies for each hand!

summary.핵심플레이: 네 개의 팔을 가진 주인공을 조종해 각 손에 서로 다른 총기를 들고 여러 적을 동시에 조준·사격한다. 플레이어는 한 손 또는 여러 손을 함께 제어하고, 나머지 손은 주변의 적을 자동으로 탐색한다.
summary.특징: 인간과 비지구 기술로 만들어진 변이 주인공이 실험실에서 깨어나 텅 빈 프라하를 배경으로 괴생명체들과 싸운다. 팔 두 개 추가를 포함해 최대 9가지 특수 능력을 사용할 수 있다.

name: A Small Robot Story
input:
A Small Robot Story is an adventure-platformer where you play as Rae, a small robot who activates and has no idea why. So you need to set out and find out what's up!

With a heavy emphasis on story, A Small Robot Story will take you through forests, factories, caves, laboratories, and more as you track down and find the source of your sudden activation.

- Power-ups

- NES-styled challenging gameplay

- Detailed story delivered through rpg-style dialogues and cut scenes

- Gamepad support

- Original chiptune soundtrack

summary.핵심플레이: 작은 로봇 Rae를 조작해 자신이 활성화된 이유를 찾아 나서며, 숲·공장·동굴·연구소 등 여러 지역을 탐험하고 플랫포머 구간을 진행한다. 파워업을 획득하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: NES 스타일의 도전적인 게임플레이와 RPG식 대화 및 컷신으로 전달되는 스토리 중심 구성을 갖추고 있으며, 오리지널 칩튠 사운드트랙과 게임패드 지원을 제공한다.

name: GunZ 2: The Second Duel
input:
GunZ 2: the Second Duel
Rediscovery of action shooting! We present to you GunZ 2: the Second Duel. GunZ 2 is an online action shooting game. GunZ 2 provides a whole new user experience that players have never seen from other games.
Key Features
Completely unique action gameplay
In this game, there is no limit on how players move. In GunZ 2: the Second Duel, a wall is not an obstacle yet another path that provide tactical advantages. You no longer have to hide behind walls when you encounter your enemies. You can rather climb up the walls around you to take higher ground or move into enemies’ blind spot to launch vigorous assault.

Unique classes with various tactics and strategies
It’s absolutely up to players to choose which class to play. Unique classes are fitted with its own Passive and Active skills. Become a silent assassin wielding a long katana, roam around in the battle ground freely with a giant shield, or burn enemies with flame-thrower. The choice is completely up to you. (3 classes will be available at launch, more classes will be continuously be added)

Weapons… More Weapons!
In GunZ 2: the Second Duel, you can choose from 200 different weapons sorted into 13 different categories. Especially unlike conventional FPS games, GunZ 2 provides unique melee weapons which bring maximum strategic variety. Each class has its own ultimate skill that can dramatically rescue a friendly unit from danger.

Save the day with friends!
Play Campaign Mode to fight against the notorious mega corporation with super-national power. Fight against the enemies with action you can experience only in GunZ 2: the Second Duel.

Yet, it’s available for beginners!
Even though it is fitted with such powerful action, maneuvering your character in GunZ 2: the Second Duel is extremely easy. To run on walls, simply point your cross-hair to the desired direction and tap on the jump key rhythmically. Such simply control makes up incredible fast-paced stylish action.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 벽을 타고 오르거나 이동 경로로 활용하는 이동 시스템을 이용해 총격과 근접 전투를 벌인다. 클래스를 선택하고 200종의 무기를 활용하며, 캠페인 모드에서 협동 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 벽을 장애물이 아닌 이동 경로로 사용하는 이동 시스템과, 고유한 패시브·액티브 스킬을 가진 클래스 시스템을 갖췄다. 카타나 등 근접 무기를 포함해 13개 분류의 무기가 제공되며, 출시 시점에 3개 클래스가 제공되고 추후 추가된다.

name: Fragments of Tyranny

Confront Evil. Embrace the Darkness.

Step into the darkness of Tolyatti, a Soviet city haunted by corruption and despair. In *Fragments Of Tyranny*, you are Esmer Diakov—a man driven to madness by injustice, exacting revenge on those who prey on the helpless. With the guidance of his mentor and the backing of his stepbrothers, Esmer Diakov faces off against his deepest fears and darkest enemies.

Unique Inventory System

-

-

summary.특징: 부패와 절망이 만연한 소련 도시 Tolyatti를 배경으로 하며, 멘토와 의붓형제들의 도움 속에 진행되는 에피소드 구성과 인벤토리 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: Silver Tale
input:
Take a fantastical journey across the kingdom. Solve quests, collect rare artifacts, build upgrades, and even craft new items! Traverse huge levels in search of the items needed to overcome obstacles. Find keys to unlock treasure chests, use mighty power-ups, and solve mind-bending puzzle challenges in this innovative new match-3 experience!
Delve into the deepest caves of the kingdom to collect the rare silver holly plants to save the King's life!
Silver Tale takes the match-3 genre to the next level!

Features:

- Explore huge levels.

- Build dozens of upgrades across the kingdom.

- Discover hundreds of items and solve quests.

- Craft your own items at the local blacksmith!

- Earn tokens to spend at the casino for bonus items.

- Daily login rewards!

- Beautiful orchestral soundtrack.

- Fully-voiced characters!

summary.핵심플레이: 넓은 레벨을 탐험하며 매치 3 퍼즐을 풀고, 퀘스트를 수행하며 아이템과 열쇠를 모아 장애물을 극복한다. 수집한 재료로 대장간에서 아이템을 제작하고 왕국 곳곳에서 업그레이드를 건설한다.
summary.특징: 왕의 목숨을 구할 은빛 호랑가시나무를 찾아 왕국 동굴을 탐험하는 판타지 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 카지노에서 토큰으로 보너스 아이템 획득, 일일 로그인 보상, 오케스트라 사운드트랙과 음성이 지원되는 캐릭터를 포함한다.

name: Beastie Bay DX
input:
Next Kairogames

Coming soon

About the Game
Develop a deserted island and collect rare monsters!

Washed ashore a desolate island and surrounded by savage beasts, can you thrive...or merely survive?

Blaze trails into unknown territory...and then make it your own! Plant crops, build housing and power sources, and transform the island into your own personal paradise. As you progress, you'll be able to develop new gear and technology to take your adventure to the next level, including ways to travel to unexplored islands nearby!

The native fauna eyeing you as their next meal? Capture the critters, trade them with friends, and train them to fight for you! Most have elemental strengths and weaknesses, so use these to your advantage in battle.

Venture far enough afield and you may find signs of civilization. If you make the right friends, your humble isle could grow into an economic powerhouse, complete with hot springs, hotels, and heliport. The possibilities are as limitless as the horizon!

Survival of the fittest was never so fun! You call the shots as you develop your primitive isle into a luxurious slice of paradise!

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

summary.핵심플레이: 무인도에 표류한 상태에서 작물을 심고 주거지와 전력원을 지으며 섬을 개발하고, 야생 몬스터를 포획해 훈련시키고 교환하며 전투에 활용한다. 장비와 기술을 개발해 인근 미개척 섬으로 이동할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 몬스터는 속성별 강점과 약점을 가지며 이를 전투에 이용한다. 섬을 개발하면 온천, 호텔, 헬리포트 등을 갖춘 경제 거점으로 성장시킬 수 있다.

name: Home Designer - Living Room
input:
In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment. Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams! Offering tons of Hidden Object modes: Picture, Word, Silhouette, Spot the Difference, and many more! Play a variety of great minigames like Match-3, Card Memory, Jigsaw Puzzles, or skip them if you're not in the mood.



- A classic HO game with tons of objects to find

- More than 150 choices of furniture to decorate

- Hidden Objects scenes in more than 15 different ways

- 5 different mini-game typs, including Match-3

summary.핵심플레이: 장면 속에서 숨겨진 물건을 찾고, 오래된 물건을 팔아 얻은 것으로 빈 거실을 가구로 꾸민다. Match-3, 카드 메모리, 직소 퍼즐 등의 미니게임을 플레이하거나 건너뛸 수 있다.
summary.특징: Hazel이 이모의 집 리모델링을 돕는다는 설정으로, 150종 이상의 가구 선택지와 그림·단어·실루엣·틀린 그림 찾기 등 15가지 이상의 히든 오브젝트 모드를 제공한다.

name: I HUMAN MACHINE
input:
This war, against machine, we know we are losing.



They are much more powerful, can make much better choices than we do, more important， they have much more quantity.



So, we had to make a tough decision: use machine to against machine



To have more power, I machined my right arm; to capture the least motion of enemy, I machined my right eye; to make the fastest, best solution to against machine, I machined my left brain; to keep all machine in my body run long enough, I even machined left half of my heart .



To survive, half of me machined to a robot.



But as the war went on, I realize what I give to machine, not only my body at all…



Points you may interested about



The varied topography, and beautiful scenery

We use pure hand-painted to design the whole game to avoid inflexible movement of character designed by DragonBones;

Each weapon has its own normal attack movement，and its own charge attack

Each monster has its own attack

If you run into a store and find out there is not even a penny in your pocket，what would you do? In real life, it gonna be running away. But in this game…

More important, what you choose to do in the game will change the game in several ways, even the endings, but it requires players find out themselves.



In the future



There still lots of idea about this game we didn’t add to this game.

More rooms, more games , more diffcult levels;

Unique power to each weapon will be added, such as use your hammel weapon in specified situation will change or update your other weapon or use Meteor hammer to pull over your enemies;

The units you choose in game will cause resonance and update at the same time, but it will cause some trouble also.

The number of weapon will increased to at least 20, more weapon more fun, and we definitely will add some intersting type of weapon, too

The amount of units you can get in game will increased 3 or 4 times.

The game level will rise to 6 and the number of BOSS will increase to at least 6 also(without DLC, if we had one after)

Game Difficultise of game will be 4, and we will change the game mechanism at high difficulty level.

We came out lots of interesting ideas of this game everyday and delete those parts make people bored, and what we trying to do is provide a interesting game to every player.

summary.핵심플레이: 기계와의 전쟁을 배경으로, 무기별로 다른 일반 공격과 차지 공격을 사용해 각기 다른 공격 패턴을 가진 적과 몬스터를 상대한다. 플레이어의 선택에 따라 게임 진행과 엔딩이 여러 방향으로 달라진다.
summary.특징: 기계에 맞서기 위해 신체 일부를 기계화한 캐릭터의 이야기를 다루며, DragonBones 대신 손으로 그린 방식으로 지형과 배경을 제작했다. 상점에서 돈이 없을 때의 대응 등 상황별 선택 요소를 포함한다.

name: Natural Selection 2
input:
Natural Selection 2 pits alien against human in an action-packed struggle for survival. Wield devastating weaponry as a Frontiersman marine, or become the xenomorph as a deadly Kharaa lifeform.

Strategy Meets Shooter

Natural Selection 2 is a First Person Shooter and Real Time Stategy game rolled into one! Each team, alien and human, has a Commander. The Commander looks down on the battlefield and issues orders, places structures, collects resources, researches technology, and deploys abilities.

Here are some gameplay examples: A human Commander could drop health packs and ammunition to a trapped marine squad, and deploy sentry guns to help them defend their position. Or an alien Commander could grow a new Hive to spread infestation throughout newly captured territory, allowing more alien eggs to spawn...

Two Unique Sides

Aliens players choose to evolve into one of five lifeforms: The fast, fearsome Skulk can run on walls and deliver massive damage with its jaws. Lerks fly and deploy gasses to support their teammates in battle. Gorges heal other lifeforms and build tunnels, hydra turrets, walls, and other tactical structures. Fades blink in and out of battle, picking off marines with giant scythes. Finally, the giant Onos is so massive and so tough, that even entire marine squads can't take it down.

Marines wield rifles, shotguns, grenade launchers, pistols, and other weapons. Cluster grenades can clear ventilation shafts of sneaky Skulks, flamethrowers make short work of alien structures and infestation, and boosts dropped by the Commander increase combat effectiveness.

When attacking on foot doesn't cut it, marines can construct hulking Exosuits wielding miniguns and railguns, and equip jetpacks for high speed assaults on alien Hives.

Long Term Development

Natural Selection 2 receives constant updates. This year, 2019, Unknown Worlds continues to develop new features, content, and improvements.

Mod Tools Come Standard

Natural Selection 2 comes with all the tools we used to make the game. All game code is open source. That means you can create, and play, an endless variety of mods. Publish, share, and download mods from the Steam Workshop, and automatically download mods when you join modded games.

Digital Deluxe Edition

Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

- Official Soundtrack - 1 hour of tribal, industrial music composed by David John and Simon Chylinski

- Digital Art Book - 40+ pages of art by Cory Strader, including environments, creatures, weapons and more

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 인간 진영 또는 외계 종족으로 나뉘어 총기나 근접 공격으로 전투하며, 각 팀의 커맨더는 전장을 내려다보며 명령을 내리고 구조물 배치, 자원 수집, 기술 연구, 능력 배치를 수행한다.
summary.특징: 인간과 외계 두 진영이 서로 다른 무기와 다섯 종의 진화 생명체를 사용하며, 게임 제작에 쓰인 도구와 오픈소스 코드가 제공되어 Steam 창작마당을 통해 모드를 제작·공유·다운로드할 수 있다.

name: Out of the Fog
input:
Driven by curiosity and a refusal to believe in the myth of the mysterious faceless creature, you venture into eerie, abandoned locations to uncover the truth. But what starts as a thrill-seeking adventure soon spirals into a nightmare as the legend proves horrifyingly real.

Team up with a friend or face the horrors alone. Work together to explore dark environments, find the drawings, burn them, and evade the mysterious faceless creature as he hunts you in real time. Will you make it out alive together, or will fear tear you apart?

Explore hauntingly detailed locations, from a overgrown forest to a derelict factory. Each area is filled with eerie sounds, unsettling visuals, and environmental storytelling that will send shivers down your spine.

The mysterious faceless creature isn’t just a passive observer — he adapts to your actions. Stay too long in one place, and he’ll find you. Keep moving, but don’t lose track of your objectives, or you’ll fall prey to his relentless pursuit.

Piece together the dark mystery behind the legend. Collect notes scattered throughout the world to learn why the mysterious faceless creature exists — and why you might be his next victim.

Tension builds as resources are scarce, and hiding spots are never guaranteed. Every decision matters, and one wrong move could mean the difference between life and death.

Are you ready to put your skepticism to the test? The truth lies within the darkness, but so does the danger. Gather your courage, grab your flashlight, and prepare to face your fears.

summary.핵심플레이: 버려진 장소를 탐색하며 흩어진 그림을 찾아 태우고, 실시간으로 플레이어를 추격하는 얼굴 없는 존재를 피한다. 흩어진 메모를 모아 전설의 배경을 파악한다.
summary.특징: 싱글 또는 협동 플레이를 지원하며, 추격자는 플레이어의 행동에 반응해 한곳에 오래 머물면 찾아온다. 자원과 은신처가 제한되어 있으며, 숲과 폐공장 등 여러 장소를 배경으로 환경을 통한 스토리텔링을 사용한다.

name: RaceRoom Racing Experience
input:
RaceRoom is the premier free-to-play racing simulation on PC and home to official race series like DTM, WTCR, the WTCC and ADAC GT Masters. Enter RaceRoom and enter the world of a professional race car driver.

A selection of free-to-play race cars and tracks are yours to drive with unlimited wheel time in multiplayer and single player games modes. Sponsored competitions and other free-to-play events allow you to enjoy premium game content at no cost.

Additional cars, tracks, and liveries can be bought individually or as packs inside the game store using an in-game currency called vRP, which is purchased using your Steam Wallet.
Key Features

- Free to play - Eat, Sleep, Race, Repeat
A premium racing simulator is yours free-to-play on the PC. Race endlessly alongside the world’s most talented drivers in online multiplayer and single player game modes.

- Your dream car is here - Grab your pick
BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Chevrolet, Ford, McLaren, Pagani, RUF, Radical, Volvo, Saleen, and more to come. These manufacturers bring the best minds in racing together to dominate the world of motorsport and the machines they create are precision instruments of power, perfection, and speed. We are proud to present them in the digital form for your enjoyment.

- Speed is a universal language - Hit the road
Going fast is a worldwide pastime and many of the most beautiful points on the globe are home to miles of thrilling blacktop. Start racing and conquer these places for yourself.

- Up Close and Personal - Stand among the giants of racing
No game gets you closer to professional racing and the drivers that make a racing series great. RaceRoom is home to WTCC, DTM, and ADAC GT Masters, with more to come.

- Realism - Every sense touched
You will see, hear, and feel what a race car driver does behind the wheel. You’ll grow smelly from intense focus and the resulting perspiration, and all you control is the taste at the end of the race. Will it be that of sweet victory... or bitter defeat? The experience of racing is yours and it’s unforgettable.

- Accessibility - Racing is a family sport
Novice, Amateur, and Get Real game modes cater to drivers of all ability. This game is fit for the entire family, so start driving today with your Steering wheel, keyboard, or gamepad.

- The pursuit of perfection - Single Player
Refine your skills against intelligent and challenging computer driven opponents. Use the Adaptive A.I., which automatically adjusts opponent difficulty based on your performance, or customize opponent difficulty to your liking.

- Defeat the competition - Online Multiplayer
Line up with a grid of twenty-four players as you battle new friends and rivals in online multiplayer races.

- Competitions - Capture glory
Compete against the world’s greatest drivers in sponsored competitions from Mercedes-Benz, EURONICS, DTM, ADAC GT Masters, and more. These competitions also allow free players access to premium content throughout the duration of most events.

- Fast paced gameplay
Be ready to break a sweat! Racing is the ultimate in twitch gameplay. No time for breaks, no room for mistakes. You are on point or you are into the weeds. Push harder, go faster, and reap the rewards of an adrenalin induced smile.
Important Info/DLC Purchasing Policy

R3E user accounts are associated with the user’s Steam account for security and transactions through Steam Wallet.

summary.핵심플레이: 공식 라이선스 차량과 트랙으로 싱글플레이와 최대 24인 온라인 멀티플레이 레이스를 진행한다. 무료로 제공되는 차량·트랙을 이용하며, vRP라는 게임 내 화폐로 추가 차량·트랙·리버리를 개별 또는 팩 단위로 구매할 수 있다.
summary.특징: DTM, WTCR, WTCC, ADAC GT Masters 등 실제 레이스 시리즈를 다루며 BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi 등 다양한 제조사 차량이 등장한다. Novice, Amateur, Get Real 등 난이도별 모드와 성능에 따라 난이도를 조정하는 어댑티브 AI, 스폰서 대회를 제공한다.

name: Alone: Recode
input:
"You are dragged into a house in the middle of nowhere. The last few hours? Days? Are all a blur. Who is this person who won't show their face? Why won't they answer any of your questions? Your friends... you have to find your friends..."

"When making Alone I really wanted to challenge old-school RPG stereotypes of level and encounter design. Like others who enjoy RPGs I had played many of the old classics and spamming the same abilities through menus with key memory on felt like holding down the 'A' button leads to assured victory. With Alone I wanted to put a little more into the combat and gameplay sides and less into the narrative fiction of the world."
-Fengraf Games

These are some of the ways Alone changes the game on what a classic RPG can be.

- Story - Alone is somewhat light on the narrative front. Most of the game's story is optional and much of it can be completed in or out of order and without speaking to the characters you find throughout the game. Though it drives your actions for much of your play, the way you engage with the story is up to you.

- Exploration - There are no maps here. No overworld where you grow to enormous proportions and can travel to the next area in a few steps. The path forward is sometimes hidden, sometimes blocked, and sometimes back the way you came. Your only hope in Alone is to continue exploring and working your way in around and back through the numerous environments.

- Character Growth - Your characters in Alone do not acquire skills naturally. Instead, points will be earned from levels that can be spent in two unique skill books to each character. Don't like your current skills? Visit the pub to reset them. Great control is given to the player to determine how they want each party member to feel. Your weapons will also provide you special abilities, so the customization does not stop at the skill books. Your gear can be upgraded in a few ways to further augment your preferred strategies.

- Combat - If you have a love for classic turn-based RPG games, you'll know many of the older installments spare no expense building hype for that final boss – only to have them fall to your bottomless supply of potions. Alone wants to throw that out the window and introduce more punishing and difficult bosses as a result. Potions may heal you for a substantial amount, but that health is then lost again over time. The turn order can also be manipulated by clever players who take advantage of the ACCEL system. Spells / items / actions will have an ACCEL value to them that causes that characters next turn to come up quicker by that amount. Your enemies will target the strongest among you and do everything they can to throw a wrench in your plans. Alone tries to create a more engaging combat experience by requiring pattern recognition and thoughtful choices about the order in which attacks occur.

summary.핵심플레이: 턴제 전투로 적과 싸우고 여러 환경을 탐험하며 흩어진 동료들을 찾아 나간다. 레벨업으로 얻은 포인트를 두 종류의 스킬북에 투자하고 무기와 장비를 강화해 캐릭터를 성장시킨다.
summary.특징: 지도나 오버월드 없이 숨겨지거나 막힌 경로를 탐색하며 진행하고, 스토리는 대부분 선택적이라 순서와 진행 방식이 자유롭다. 물약 회복량이 시간이 지나면 다시 감소하고, 행동마다 ACCEL 수치로 턴 순서를 조작할 수 있어 패턴 파악과 행동 순서 판단이 요구된다.

name: Fatal Grounds

Gameplay showcase:

summary.핵심플레이: 5개 챕터로 나뉜 100개의 레벨을 정밀한 조작으로 통과하며, 각 챕터마다 보스 레벨을 공략한다.
summary.특징: 실루엣 아트 스타일을 사용하며, 즉시 리스폰, 레벨 시작 시 자동 저장, 사망 횟수 카운터, 보너스 콘텐츠를 제공한다.

name: Hypersensitive Bob
input:
Features

- Roguelike gameplay with 50 + items to make every run different

- Tear allergies apart with InhaGun 2000

- Loot vaccine and boost Bob to epic proportions

- Discover overpowered item combos

- Various enemy types, nasty minibosses & fierce boss fights!

- Low-poly graphics with Cel-Shading elements

Meet Bob

Bob has an allergy of everything. Bob also has friends that share the same unfortunate destiny.

Bob’s madly insane engineering skills combined to his frustration to his isolated lifestyle have bred a weapon never seen before; InhaGun2000

Bob & his friends have had enough - It’s time for some serious desensitization.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 InhaGun 2000를 사용해 알레르기 유발 요소와 적들을 처치하며, 백신을 획득해 캐릭터를 강화하고 각 플레이마다 달라지는 로그라이크 진행을 반복한다.
summary.특징: 50개 이상의 아이템과 조합을 통해 캐릭터를 강화할 수 있으며, 다양한 적과 중간 보스, 보스전이 등장한다. 셀 셰이딩 요소가 적용된 로우폴리 그래픽을 사용하며, 알레르기를 가진 Bob과 친구들을 소재로 한다.

A walking simulator inspired by “Exit 8” and Liminal Space.

Video Distribution and Monetization

summary.특징: 'Exit 8'과 리미널 스페이스에서 영감을 받은 워킹 시뮬레이터로, 플레이 시간은 약 15~60분이다.
