summary.특징: osu!mania 스타일의 1인 제작 인디 게임으로, 스트리머 모드, 난이도를 조절하는 모드, Logitech G Hub 연동을 통한 RGB 연출을 지원한다.

name: Hunt and Snare
input:
Funding of Development

We have a good base funding that will allow us to work on the game from this point on, to finishing it, with the four person team we have now. We are hoping to offer extra options for players and expanding the reach of the game by launching on Steam Early Access. All funding from Early Access will be used to development of Hunt and Snare.

Based on sales on Steam, we're planning on expanding our team with additional full-time content creators like artists and writers, dedicated testers and a community manager. Some of the funding will be used for contracting additional assets for Hunt and Snare, such as unique, game specific, music.

Developers and Development

Rough bar showing our development plan a few full releases ahead.

Our team consists of three core members; Ruffleneck (designer), Hareress (animator), and Drathek (programmer). There is also four other people working on the project as part time contractors with varying about of work.

Prototyping (initial tests) of Hunt and Snare was started late 2016 by Ruffleneck, and full development began early 2017 with Hareress joining the team. Later that same year, Drathek joined and took over the programming of the game.

About the Game
Hunt and Snare is an open world adults-only furry hunting game with strong focus on sexual content and interaction between characters and the world. While there are heavier topics and darker tone to the lore (such as lands ruled by a ruthless dragon and it's oppressive regime, sickness stricken islands, and crippling poverty) the approach to sex, sexual themes, and love is very warm-hearted, open, and passionate.

This game only features consensual acts between adult anthropomorphic characters.
Hunt

Grab your trusty rifle, load up some tranquilizer ammo, and start your hunt; The islands of Skiir and its beautiful and exotic wild prey await!

Recruit your favorite captures to your ship crew, trade away the rest, and use your well earned crowns to buy new equipment, upgrades to your ship, clothes for your crew and yourself, or spent it on precious gifts for your favorites. (This describes upcoming features.)
Sexplore

Lead your favorite crew on sexploration trips, explore mystical islands, discover weird and rare things to spice up your interaction with your crew members and the citizens of the cities and towns of island archipelago of Skiir.
Sail

Travel between islands with your frigate, The Unnamed, and engage in ship-to-ship combat against pirates or in duels against the pesky Dragonfire Fleet captains with your ship and your sword for fame and glory! (Upcoming feature.)

Discover uncharted islands, visit major cities, choose to be free!
Customize

Huge options to customize your character with; From micro details like nipple shapes and sizes to macro details like body shapes, tails, and breast sizes, to colors from patterns, to genitalia, to eyes. Create characters of your dreams, and either play the game with your creations, or use them in Showroom to just experience raw sex with no strings attached.

Customize your preferred hunting weapon; Change parts of the rifle to specialize in shorter range, or even longer range than normally, mod ammo capacity with different kind of clips and magazines, customize visuals of your rifle, or just use a bow or crossbow instead! (Upcoming feature.)

Your ship is your template. If you want to specialize in combat for ship-to-ship action, put more cannons on decks! If you prefer crew and cargo space, and a bit more luxorious ship, invest in nicer crew quarters and more impressive mess hall. (Upcoming feature.)
Filter

Don't like a specific fetish? You can disable it and you won't run across any acts containing it! Want to experience only one fetish? Why not!

Adjust your prey spawning and gender combinations to your liking!

summary.핵심플레이: 마취탄을 사용하는 소총으로 섬의 야생 동물을 사냥해 포획하고, 마음에 드는 대상을 배의 선원으로 영입하거나 나머지는 거래한다. 선원과 도시 주민들을 상대로 성적 상호작용과 탐험을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 의인화된 성인 캐릭터 간의 합의된 성적 콘텐츠를 중심으로 하는 성인 전용 게임으로, 신체 세부와 무늬·색·생식기 등 광범위한 캐릭터 커스터마이즈와 특정 페티시를 켜고 끌 수 있는 필터 기능을 제공한다. 잔혹한 용이 지배하는 땅, 질병이 퍼진 섬 등 어두운 세계관을 배경으로 하며 현재 얼리 액세스 단계다.

name: Chunks
input:
Chunks is a block-based sandbox game built for virtual reality.



Build cities and monuments while you're the size of a giant, then shrink yourself to walk inside your creations. Weave elaborate and hair-raising rideable roller-coasters around your world, or tear it apart with a bomb cannon. Share your constructions on the Workshop and download custom tools and game modes for endless fun in an infinite world.



You must own a HTC Vive to play this game.

summary.핵심플레이: 블록을 이용해 도시와 구조물을 짓고, 자신의 크기를 거인만큼 키우거나 축소해 자신이 만든 창작물 안을 걸어 다닐 수 있다. 탈 수 있는 롤러코스터를 세계에 배치하거나 폭탄 대포로 구조물을 부술 수 있다.
summary.특징: 가상현실용 블록 기반 게임으로 HTC Vive가 필요하다. 무한한 세계에서 창작물을 워크숍에 공유하고 커스텀 도구와 게임 모드를 내려받을 수 있다.

name: Project Mnemosyne
input:
College, football, loyal friends, and career plans... All of it vanishes after an unexpected phone call. A new city, new challenges. And only one person remains close and true — the rebellious redhead, Kristina.

Embark on an exciting journey where you'll meet new friends and enemies, uncover mysteries, and thwart the plans of those who threaten you and your family!

Your actions shape the story. There are no wrong choices — sometimes a failed quest is a choice in itself.

summary.핵심플레이: 새로운 도시에서 인물들과 만나고 선택을 통해 이야기를 진행하며 미스터리를 파헤친다. 플레이어의 행동에 따라 스토리가 전개된다.
summary.특징: 예상치 못한 전화 이후 삶이 바뀐 주인공이 Kristina와 함께 겪는 이야기를 다루며, 옳고 그른 선택이 정해져 있지 않고 실패한 퀘스트도 하나의 선택으로 취급된다.

name: Magic and Legend - Time Knights
input:
Story

Magic & Legend are two kids who were playing in the park with their friends when suddenly... Aliens came down to earth, to take over the planet and drain its natural resources. To make it easier and avoid any technologies that humankind could use against them, they open a time portal and go into the past to take over the human race.

Magic & Legend will not stand for this! After telling their Mom, they follow the aliens from the time portal to rid the planet of the aliens and ultimately save the world!

Features

This platform action / adventure game harks back to the days of old, where the Gameboy ruled the world for handheld game play. The game features 5 large sprawling levels over the time periods:

- Level 1: The Journey Begins… (Present Day)

- Level 2: Medieval Times

- Level 3: Sengoku Period

- Level 4: Ancient Rome

- Level 5: The Crown Jewel Heist (60’s London)

Players can switch between Magic or Legend at any point and use their different abilities to progress through the game:

- Magic loves getting up close and person, so uses melee weapons and can stomp on their heads (Super Mario style). He is the older brother.

- Legend prefers long distance attacks. He is younger and lighter than his brother, so can't stomp on alien noggins, but with his projectile weapon, he can take out the aliens from a far.

In each level you must kill all the aliens before stepping into the time portal for the next time period. Magic and Legend have their own costumes and weapons and along the way, you will see other portals to mini bonus levels. These levels are just for fun, where you get to be a dragon, squid, a buster of ghosts and a mole man with a mallet!

Lastly, to ensure the world is safe, the boys go up against a final boss who is hell bent on taking out Magic & Legend.

Will you take up the challenge and save the planet for all humankind?

What's included:

Originally released for the Gameboy Color, Magic & Legend: Time Knights is now coming to Steam, available for Windows, MacOS & Linux. The game includes the rom, packaged with the emulator to be able to play natively on your PC without any configuration or setup required.

The Gameboy, Gameboy Color & Analogue Pocket roms are also included in the package to play on any device of your choosing, including:

- Gameboy, Gameboy Color, Gameboy Advance (in Gameboy mode) via an Everdrive Cartridge.

- Analogue Pocket

- MiSTer FPGA using the Gameboy / Gameboy Color cores

- Any other emulation device capable of playing Gameboy roms with accurate emulation.

summary.핵심플레이: 근접 공격과 밟기 공격을 쓰는 형 Magic과 원거리 투사체 공격을 쓰는 동생 Legend를 자유롭게 전환하며 진행하고, 각 레벨에서 모든 외계인을 처치한 후 시간 포털에 들어가 다음 시대로 이동한다.
summary.특징: 현재, 중세, 센고쿠 시대, 고대 로마, 60년대 런던 등 5개 시대를 배경으로 하며, 용·오징어·유령 사냥꾼·두더지 등을 조작하는 보너스 미니 레벨과 최종 보스전이 포함된다. 원래 게임보이 컬러용으로 출시되었으며 Steam판에는 롬과 에뮬레이터가 함께 제공되어 Everdrive, Analogue Pocket, MiSTer FPGA 등에서도 실행할 수 있다.

name: Farthest Frontier
input:
Protect and guide your small band of settlers to forge a town from untamed wilderness at the edge of the known world. Harvest raw materials, hunt, fish and farm to sustain your advancing town. Produce crafted items for villagers to trade, consume, equip and fight with as you battle for your survival against the elements and outside threats (pacifist mode available for players who do not want to engage in combat).

Key Features

-
Harvest, Grow, Craft - Harvest 16 different raw materials from wood, stone and clay, to metal ores, wild herbs, and honey. Grow 19 types of food, including forage items, fish and game, plus 12 food crops, each with different characteristics. Produce 32 crafted items and materials in a multi-tiered economy.

-
Build and Advance - Construct over 180 different buildings as you grow your town from a fledgling settlement to a bustling city. Your town center and housing will advance through multiple building tiers as the prosperity and desirability of your town increases and advancements are made in a vast 130+ point Tech Tree. Upgrade production buildings to increase efficiency and enable production of more advanced items. Construct a temple and customize your people’s faith with discoverable relics.

-
Most Detailed Farming System Ever - Strategically select from 12 crops with unique growing characteristics and configure crop rotations to maintain soil fertility, avoid heat and frost damage, and prevent the accumulation of diseases. Cultivate your fields over time, removing weeds and rocks, raising fertility and adjusting soil mixture to achieve maximum crop production to keep your growing population fed.

-
Advanced Town Simulation - Villagers actively live their lives and perform their jobs in real time. Watch as villagers carry goods across town from remote work-sites to be processed into materials and crafted into items. See foods and goods delivered to homes, the trade post or stored for later use. Develop roads, transport wagons and improve storage methods to facilitate the efficient movement of goods through your town and prevent spoilage.

-
Randomly Generated Maps - Farthest Frontier is highly replayable and no game is ever quite the same with beautiful, completely randomized terrain generation and resource distribution. Controls allow players to specify the amount of water or mountains they desire, with extreme maps leading to unique challenges.

-
Idyllic to Brutal - Customizable difficulty options allow players to turn off features like invaders and disease, for a more tranquil experience or max out difficulty to truly test their town-builder prowess. Enable custom game options to cater the experience to your desires.

-
Environmental Interaction - Develop your economy based on which resources are locally abundant and produce items for trade to acquire that which you lack. Erect fencing to keep deer away from crop fields and stop bears from raiding food storage. Manage tree cover to prevent underground water supplies from drying up. Balance the need to clear land for agriculture around vital natural resources like wild growing medicinal plants and forage items.

-
All Them Old-Timey Diseases! - Ensure your villagers have clean water to stop outbreaks of dysentery and cholera. Collect berries and plant greens to avoid scurvy and ensure a healthy diet. Make sure villagers are properly shoed and clothed to reduce chances of contracting tetanus, rabies or frostbite. Build a healer’s house to quarantine the infected and provide herbs and medicine for treatment. Manage rodent populations by collecting waste, securely storing food and employing rat catchers to ward off the feared bubonic plague.

-
Fend Off Would-Be Invaders - Choose to play on pacifist and avoid combat altogether or engage with varying levels of raider difficulty to raise the stakes for your town’s survival. Progress from wood palisades to stone walls, build towers and barracks, recruit and equip soldiers in the defense of your town as rising prosperity attracts the attention of raiders and foreign armies seeking plunder.

Crate Entertainment is a fully independent developer and publisher located outside Boston, MA. Crate is best known for the critically-acclaimed action-RPG, Grim Dawn. Join the Crate community and help shape the future of development of our games and be among the first to receive news about Farthest Frontier by participating in polls and discussions on our forum.

summary.핵심플레이: 소수의 정착민으로 시작해 원자재를 채집·수렵·어로·농사로 확보하고, 180종 이상의 건물을 지어 마을을 도시로 성장시킨다. 130개 이상의 기술 트리를 통해 생산 시설을 업그레이드하며 주민의 생활과 물자 운송을 관리한다.
summary.특징: 작물별 특성과 토양 비옥도·윤작을 관리하는 상세한 농경 시스템, 이질·콜레라·괴혈병·페스트 등 질병 관리 요소를 갖추며, 무작위 생성 지형과 침략자·질병 등을 끄고 켤 수 있는 난이도 옵션 및 전투 없는 평화주의 모드를 제공한다.

name: 地下室
input:
关于这款游戏

地下室是XJS studio全新打造的一款含有恐怖、惊悚、悬疑元素的交互式电影游戏，支持PC、MAC、PS4等。



游戏玩家李念一在探索一款新游戏《变态乐园》时，发现这款游戏的界面跟他家里一模一样，而且，通过游戏，他发现自己家里居然有一个地下室，而地下室里，除了面具、铁链、各种奇怪的工具之外，还有一个笼子，而笼子里，囚禁着一个姑娘……



这姑娘是谁？又是谁囚禁了她？囚禁她的人到底想干什么？还有那神秘的死亡预告？是真实，还是玩笑？这些问号推动着李念一做出自己的选择，也发现了囚禁背后的秘密。



玩家将自己主导游戏的走向，随着玩家的选择，主角与其他角色之间的关系也将不断变化，玩家的行为将左右剧情发展，最终实现不同的命运结局。



关系追踪

在整个游戏过程中，玩家通过与游戏角色互动，逐渐改变与其他角色之间的关系，探索着每个人的故事和动机。从游戏的开始到结尾，都将左右人际关系，影响特定剧情线，最终对结局走向产生重大影响。



特点

全真人出演的恐怖、惊悚、悬疑元素的交互式电影游戏。

多条故事线可选，最终走向不同的命运结局。

玩家的选择左右故事发展。

可解锁内容为人物的背景卡。



成人内容描述

此游戏不包含成人内容。

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공 李念一이 되어 게임 속 인물들과 상호작용하며 선택을 내리고, 그 선택에 따라 인물 간 관계와 스토리 전개가 달라진다. 여러 갈래의 이야기를 따라가며 서로 다른 결말에 도달한다.
summary.특징: 공포·스릴러·서스펜스 요소를 담은 실사 배우 출연 작품으로, 새로운 게임을 탐색하던 주인공이 자기 집에 지하실이 있고 그곳에 감금된 여성이 있다는 사실을 발견하며 그 배후의 비밀을 파헤친다. 관계 추적 시스템과 인물 배경 카드 해금 요소가 포함된다.

name: Goppy
input:
Goppy is a cute little fish who loves eating his yummy green treats, but he needs help to avoid the nippy-creepy-crawlies.

"Goppy" is a simple and short casual game, designed to be relaxing and fun.

Easy-to-pick-up gameplay will help you wind down and get immersed quickly, and lovingly drawn graphics give the impression of a tropical paradise.
You can adjust the difficulty from a relaxing "Casual" up to a crazily challenging "FUN" mode.

In "Endless" mode you can compete with players from around the world for the first place on the global leaderboard.

summary.핵심플레이: 물고기 Goppy를 조작해 초록색 먹이를 먹으면서 위협이 되는 생물들을 피한다.
summary.특징: 열대 분위기의 그래픽과 간단한 조작을 갖췄으며, 'Casual'부터 'FUN'까지 난이도를 조절할 수 있고, 'Endless' 모드에서는 글로벌 리더보드를 통해 다른 플레이어와 순위를 겨룰 수 있다.

name: Neon Shot
input:
Roadmap

📅 Roadmap — The Future of Neon Shot (🚀 All updates FREE!)

🔥 Short Term (0–2 Months)

-
🆕 50+ New Levels – Trickier puzzles & fresh physics obstacles

-
📸 Photo Mode – Capture your best neon shots

-
🎨 Gameplay Polish – Smoother controls & juicier effects

⚡ Mid Term (2–4 Months)

-
🌍 3 New Neon Zones – Unique themes & gameplay twists

-
🌀 New Mechanics – Portals, moving platforms, laser traps

-
🎯 Difficulty Options – Chill or hardcore, you choose

🌟 Long Term (4–6 Months)

-
🛠️ Level Editor + Workshop – Build & share your own creations

-
📅 Daily Challenges – A new mini challenge every day

-
🤝 Experimental Co-op Mode – Solve puzzles with a friend

-
🎶 Soundtrack DLC – Standalone synthwave music pack

About the Game

💡 Overview

Neon Shot is a ⚡ fast-paced physics puzzle that challenges both your reflexes and your brain!
In a glowing digital maze, your goal is to pull, aim, and launch a small neon square with perfect precision — reaching the target isn’t easy when every shot 🎯 and every second ⏱️ counts.

Race against time, outsmart tricky layouts, and master each level with skill and strategy. With simple controls, deep mechanics, and a sleek neon aesthetic, Neon Shot blends classic arcade spirit with modern physics gameplay.

🎮 Key Features

-
⚡ Flick & Launch Mechanics – Pull, aim, release. Easy to learn, tough to master.

-
🧩 Physics-Based Puzzles – Gravity, friction, ramps, barriers & more across handcrafted levels.

-
⏱️ Time Trials – Every second matters. Beat levels, then beat your own records.

-
🌌 Neon Glow & Synthwave Vibes – Retro-futuristic visuals + electronic beats.

-
🧠 Skill + Strategy – Limited shots? Unusual solutions? Get creative.

-
🔓 Progressive Unlocking – One win unlocks the next. Difficulty ramps up as you progress.

💬 Why Jump In Now?
By joining today, you’ll enjoy all current content AND get every future update for free 💎.
Your feedback will help shape the game’s journey — be part of the Neon Shot community from day one! 🚀✨

summary.핵심플레이: 네온 사각형을 당겨서 조준하고 발사해 목표 지점에 도달시키며, 제한 시간 안에 각 레벨을 완료하는 것이 목표다. 중력, 마찰, 경사면, 장애물 등 물리 요소를 활용해 퍼즐을 풀며, 타임 트라이얼로 기록 단축에 도전한다.
summary.특징: 네온 발광 비주얼과 신스웨이브 음악을 사용한 레트로 퓨처리즘 연출을 갖추고 있다. 한 레벨을 클리어하면 다음 레벨이 열리는 점진적 잠금 해제 방식으로 난이도가 상승하며, 제한된 발사 횟수 등의 조건이 적용된다.

name: One Dreamer
input:
Help Frank, a burnt out indie game developer, rediscover his love for video games while struggling to release his debut title. Reprogram objects, fix bugs and solve coding puzzles as you journey through the story of One Dreamer.

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 번아웃에 빠진 인디 게임 개발자 Frank의 이야기를 따라가며 사물을 재프로그래밍하고, 버그를 수정하며 코딩 퍼즐을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 데뷔작 출시를 앞두고 고전하는 인디 개발자가 게임에 대한 애정을 다시 찾아가는 과정을 다룬 서사 중심의 게임이다.

name: On The Wind's Breath
input:
Help a single dandelion seed find its place to grow on a journey across the world, in this serene yet precise, hand-crafted platformer from Pink Sakura Studios.

A touching, wordless adventure about finding your place in the world, told through the simple, elegant journey of a single seed. Beneath its gentle surface lies a deeper metaphor, about resilience, healing, and the courage to keep moving forward when the winds of life grow heavy.

A vast and varied world to explore, from frozen caverns to sun-scorched plains, filled with challenging routes and hidden groves. Each environment reflecting struggles and moments of calm familiar to anyone who has faced the weight of mental health challenges.

A beautiful and calming soundtrack, featuring almost half an hour of original music with gentle piano melodies and ethereal soundscapes to lose yourself in.

Bloom.

The controls are minimalist and intuitive - simply drift, float, and harness the breeze - but with layers of expressive depth to master, where every current is an opportunity. Frequent checkpoints let you ride the wind again and again as you learn to navigate the world's beauty and its dangers.

It's time, little seed. Just let go. The wind will carry you - toward growth, toward healing, toward hope.

summary.핵심플레이: 민들레 씨앗 하나를 조작해 바람의 흐름을 이용하여 표류하고 떠다니며 세계를 이동한다. 자주 배치된 체크포인트를 통해 반복적으로 경로를 익히며 성장할 곳을 찾아 나아간다.
summary.특징: 대사 없이 진행되는 씨앗의 여정을 통해 회복과 정신 건강을 은유한다. 얼어붙은 동굴부터 메마른 평원까지 다양한 환경과 숨겨진 경로가 있으며, 피아노 선율과 사운드스케이프로 구성된 약 30분 분량의 오리지널 음악이 수록되어 있다.

name: Solitaire of Stygian Shadows
input:
Our world is being slowly consumed by an ancient evil old gods and only you have the knowledge of the dark forces. Some say the knowledge makes you a madman, yet you can see the cards are everywhere - each chaotic aglomeration a sign of chaos infiltrating our reality. The destiny of the world hinges solely upon your shoulders. Walk the streets of randomly generated city, tread the paths of randomly generated labyrinths, solve randomly generated card layouts to bring order to our world. Maybe you will succeed where the mute violist from H. P. Lovecraft's "The Music of Erich Zann" failed...

Solitaire of Stygian Shadows is a solitaire card game where each playthrough is unique. Card layouts are randomly generated, as well as the environment through which you move. The goal of the game is to discover, one by one, numbers of the cypher to open the gates to the den of the ancient evil.

Experienced solitaire players will find themselves comfortable with the rules of the game. The cards have numerical values from 0 to 9, instead of traditional playing card ranks with aces, kings and queens. Gameplay difficulty can be described as relaxed, despite the theme of the game.

summary.핵심플레이: 무작위로 생성되는 카드 배치를 풀어 나가며, 무작위 생성된 도시와 미로를 이동한다. 고대의 악이 있는 곳으로 향하는 문을 여는 암호 숫자를 하나씩 알아내는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: H. P. 러브크래프트의 작품에서 영감을 받은 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 카드는 전통적인 계급 대신 0에서 9까지의 숫자 값을 가진다. 카드 배치와 이동 환경이 매 플레이마다 무작위로 생성되며, 난이도는 여유로운 편이다.

name: Ninja: ShadowBlade
input:
Ninja: ShadowBlade Fury

The Maze is Alive. Can You Survive?

Two powerful sorcerers control the maze and move the very walls around you. As they reshape the maze, not only new paths open but also new dangers emerge. Every wall that disappears can give way to Fire spirits and zombie ninjas. They roam the maze pathways, hunting. Armed with the an ancient relic - the “Shadow Blade”, your mission is to find and kill the sorcerers who control this moving maze.

The Moving Maze

Every few seconds, the maze shift—some walls disappear, new ones emerge. Enemies may spawn where the walls once stood. The maze may even try to trap you within itself.

Enemies in the Dark

-
Fire Spirits – Fast and unpredictable, they will harm you if they touch you.

-
Zombie Ninjas – These ninjas are controlled by the sorcerers, they patrol the maze’s narrow corridors and prey on all living things.

-
The Sorcerers – Your ultimate targets.

The Shadow Blade

Can you wield the Shadow Blade, an ancient powerful sword forged in the void from pure darkness, to defeat the sorcerers.

The game Features:

Dynamic Maze Gameplay – Each maze unique and constant shifting of the walls means you have to keep searching different paths to reach the sorcerers.
Fighting Mechanics – Hack and Slash past your enemies with the help of your Shadow Blade or try to sneak past them.
Random Enemy Spawns – Enemies appear anywhere randomly as the maze walls keep changing.

Do you have what it takes to outsmart and defeat the sorcerers while staying alive or will you become lost in the maze’s shifting walls?

Wishlist now to take on this ninja challenge!

summary.핵심플레이: 수시로 벽이 이동하며 변하는 미로를 탐색해 미로를 조종하는 소서러들을 찾아 처치하는 것이 목표다. Shadow Blade로 적을 공격하거나 몰래 지나치면서 진행한다.
summary.특징: 두 소서러가 벽을 움직여 미로 구조를 바꾸며 새로운 경로와 위험이 생겨나고, 사라진 벽 자리에서 Fire Spirits와 좀비 닌자 등 적이 무작위로 등장한다.

name: Unreal Physics
input: Dive into the dynamic world of physics with Unreal Physics an immersive 3D physics sandbox and demo collection that pushes the boundaries of Unreal Engine. This unique experience combines the cutting-edge FluidNinja and Chaos physics systems to deliver a mesmerizing showcase of fluid dynamics, destruction, and realistic simulations.

summary.핵심플레이: 3D 물리 샌드박스 환경에서 유체 역학, 파괴, 시뮬레이션 등 다양한 물리 데모를 실행하고 조작한다.
summary.특징: Unreal Engine을 기반으로 FluidNinja와 Chaos 물리 시스템을 결합해 유체 시뮬레이션과 파괴 연출을 데모 형식으로 제공한다.

name: Gefragt Gejagt - Das Spiel
input:
Chaser or chased - who will ultimately emerge victorious from the studio? It's up to you! Experience the show up close. Finally, you can compete as a contestant against one of the chasers or take on the role of the chaser yourself and show the contestants that you have what it takes to be a real chaser. Play with up to three friends and decide completely freely how you want to split up. All four of you want to compete against the chaser just like in the real show and beat Sebastian Klussmann, Sebastian Jacoby or Klaus Otto Nagorsnik? No problem! You want to prove to your friends that you are the real chaser? Then take their place and play against them. For this purpose, we have prepared a special chaser that you can take over to make the candidates really sweat. THE CHASER BEGINS!

The show is hosted by Alexander Bommes, just like in the original. The original voices of the chasers Klussmann, Jacoby and Nagorsnik are also present and give the game a real show feeling.

- Everything is possible: play as a candidate or chaser

- General knowledge: Over 4,500 questions from 25 categories: There really is something for everyone here.

- Pure adrenaline: Prove what you really know under time pressure. Here you feel like you're on the real show!

- All together: Play with up to three friends. Who takes on which role is up to you.

- "Mr. Klussmann, you're wearing an interesting shirt again today": The little teasing between the host and the chaser is also part of the game, of course.

- Original voices: Alexander Bommes as well as Sebastian Klussmann, Sebastian Jacoby and Klaus Otto Nagorsnik speak their characters personally.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 출연자 또는 체이서 역할을 맡아 제한 시간 안에 일반 상식 퀴즈에 답한다. 25개 카테고리에서 4,500개 이상의 문제가 제공된다.
summary.특징: 독일 TV 퀴즈쇼 'Gefragt Gejagt'를 기반으로 하며, 진행자 Alexander Bommes와 체이서 Sebastian Klussmann, Sebastian Jacoby, Klaus Otto Nagorsnik가 실제 목소리로 참여한다. 최대 3명의 친구와 함께 역할을 자유롭게 나누어 플레이할 수 있다.

name: Vega
input:
Humans exploited the earth to a point of no return. For centuries people overlooked the effects of their inconsiderate behavior and what is now left of their lively and nurturing world is a barren wasteland. Humanity is on the verge of extinction. You are part of an army of androids equipped with highly intelligent and sensible AI, designed to travel through space in search of a potential exoplanet that humans can populate in order to save themselves. Your job is to build your arsenal and train at zero gravity during this galactic journey to face and fight the possible threats that could be found once landed.
Build your arsenal
Get access to an armory and use resources to choose your weapons before each fight. Each weapon have different abilities and characteristics, upgrade them as you progress and level up your stats. Create your strategy and fight for the victory
Training
Improve your skills by training your aim accuracy and reflexes. Choose the difficulty level and compete for the first place on the leaderboard.

summary.핵심플레이: 무기고에서 자원을 사용해 전투 전 무기를 선택하고, 무기의 능력치와 스탯을 업그레이드하며 전투를 준비한다. 조준 정확도와 반사신경을 훈련하고 난이도를 선택해 순위를 겨룬다.
summary.특징: 인류가 지구를 황폐화시킨 뒤 멸종 위기에 처한 세계관에서, 플레이어는 거주 가능한 외계 행성을 찾아 우주를 여행하는 안드로이드 부대의 일원이 된다. 무중력 환경에서의 훈련과 리더보드 경쟁 요소가 포함된다.

name: City Bus Simulator 2024
input: Embark on the ultimate urban adventure in City Bus Simulator 2024, where the bustling streets are your playground and the city's pulse beats through every road. Get ready to take the wheel of intricately detailed buses, transporting passengers through a dynamic metropolis teeming with life, energy, and endless possibilities!

summary.핵심플레이: 버스를 운전해 도시의 도로를 다니며 승객을 목적지까지 운송한다.
summary.특징: 세밀하게 묘사된 버스와 활기 있는 도시 환경에서 대중교통 운행을 재현한다.

name: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
input:
Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada.
Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics at the stake. Spare the innocent — or condemn them, if doubt gnaws at your faith. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

Confront over forty demons, each with their own cunning and malice. Read the signs they leave behind and match them with the right prayer or sacred relic — before they claim your soul.

Pass judgment on heretics. In the eyes of the Inquisition, there is but one guilty sentence: the flames.

Defend the innocent from false accusations, show mercy and grace… or choose the stake, should certainty demand it.
Uncover the deepest confessions of your flock and wield their secrets to guide your investigations.

Strengthen your monastery, rise through the ranks, and one day claim the seat of the Grand Inquisitor.

Mercy… or fire?
Your judgment, Inquisitor.

summary.핵심플레이: 중세 스페인의 이단심문관이 되어 빙의된 자에게서 악마를 쫓아내고, 이단자를 심판하며, 무고한 자를 사면하거나 화형에 처한다. 악마가 남긴 징후를 읽고 알맞은 기도나 성물로 대응한다.
summary.특징: 토마스 데 토르케마다 시대를 배경으로 40종 이상의 악마와 대면하며, 신도들의 고해와 비밀을 조사에 활용한다. 수도원을 강화하고 계급을 올려 대심문관의 자리를 노릴 수 있으며, 잘못된 선택은 교회나 군중의 분노로 이어진다.

name: Under the Sea
input:
Under the Sea

"All that glistens are not gold." by this phrase we mean watch out!

In the deep sea where any light is gold for survival, we need to be quick and know how to differentiate what is food and what is the enemy!

Under the Sea is a 3D survival mini game based on time attack, race against time to survive, collect the lights and gain time to live in a world full of enemies.

Steam version:

- Time Attack Mode

- Achievments

It's a brazilian indie game created thinking about a easy under water game simulator.
To move use the WASD keys, to move up and down use the Arrows Keys Up and Down.

Thanks for playing!
Follow us:
Rodrigo Antunes - @roddykan (Twitter)
Pedro Zisman - @pedro_zisman (Instagram)

summary.핵심플레이: 심해를 이동하며 빛을 모아 생존 시간을 확보하고, 적을 피해 시간 제한 안에서 살아남는다. WASD로 이동하고 방향키 위아래로 상하 이동한다.
summary.특징: 타임어택 모드와 도전 과제를 갖춘 3D 수중 생존 미니 게임으로, 먹이와 적을 구분하며 진행하는 방식을 다룬다.

name: Last Respects
input:
Last Respects is a short, single player indie horror game where players assume the role of a detective, haunted by a recent murder case that defies explanation.



- Investigate the crime scene, collect evidence, and unravel the victim’s tragic story. The more you uncover, the stronger the malevolent presence becomes.



- To save your sanity and cleanse the house, perform rituals by burning items found throughout the mansion

summary.핵심플레이: 형사가 되어 범죄 현장을 조사하고 증거를 수집하며 피해자의 이야기를 풀어나간다. 단서를 밝힐수록 악의적 존재가 강해진다.
summary.특징: 싱글 플레이어용 단편 호러 게임으로, 저택 곳곳에서 찾은 물건을 태우는 의식을 수행해 정신을 유지하고 집을 정화한다.

name: Furry Necromancer 💀
input:
Furry Necromancer is a story about a young paladin who has just been killed along with his troop. The "witch" they were trying to hunt and eliminate turned out to be extremely powerful, she just brutally murdered everyone in less than a minute.



Because our hero was a virgin, this witch named Tamira was able to resurrect him and turn him into her slave, and now our hero has to travel with her and her minions - two skulls named Sorgath and Alvir. Despite his hatred for all things related to dark magic, our paladin begins to reevaluate his worldview and his feelings for Tamira.



Furry Necromancer is a fantasy story mixed with a bit of comedy and drama. Discover the true motive behind Tamira's actions and learn something unexpected about our hero's past in this short, wonderful story!



FEATURES:



• ≈2 hours of content.

• HD fully original artworks.

• Relaxing atmosphere.

• Some personal drama.

summary.핵심플레이: 부활한 팔라딘 주인공이 되어 마녀 Tamira와 두 해골 미니언과 함께 여정을 진행하며 스토리를 읽어 나간다.
summary.특징: 판타지 배경에 코미디와 드라마 요소를 섞은 약 2시간 분량의 단편 이야기로, Tamira의 동기와 주인공의 과거를 밝혀 나가며 오리지널 HD 아트워크를 담고 있다.

name: Sprite Sequence Chapter 1
input:
This is the first Chapter of the Sprite Sequence saga! A delightfully wacky story about the process of creation and being human.



Follow our little hero as he tries to make sense of the strange and sometimes frightening world he's been thrown in.



Key Features :

- Story oriented

- Light puzzle and platforming

- About 10 to 20 minutes long

- Hand-drawn and animated

- The adventure continues in Sprite Sequence Chapter 2!



This project started in 2016 as a way to try and make games like a webcomic is done : by releasing a small bit of the story every week. This improvisation based process gave rise to a game I wouldn't have wrote otherwise and I'm quite excited to share this first Chapter with you, that compiles the 10 first entries of the project.



(Note that the weekly creation has halted after Chapter 2 but may resume in some not so near future)

summary.핵심플레이: 작은 주인공을 조작해 낯선 세계를 탐험하며 가벼운 퍼즐과 플랫포밍을 진행하고 이야기를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 창작과 인간됨을 다루는 스토리 중심의 게임으로, 손으로 그리고 애니메이션한 그래픽이 특징이다. 2016년 웹툰처럼 매주 조금씩 이야기를 공개하는 방식으로 제작되었으며, 초기 10개 에피소드를 모은 약 10~20분 분량의 1챕터다.

name: Loren The Amazon Princess
input:
Loren The Amazon Princess is a fantasy epic combining intricate turn-based battles with a heroic tale of overcoming evil -- with a twist! In this tale, you play as a loyal servant of the hero rather than the hero herself.

Travel by Princess Loren's side as she searches for her lost mother, the Queen of the Amazons. Guide her choices and act as her valiant defender, meeting many colorful characters along the way. As the journey progresses, everyone will grow and change -- character development in games isn't dead! It's also impossible to see all the content in just one playthrough, with so many ways to customize the characters.

Hardcore role-playing games with replay value are becoming rarer in today's age of simplification for the masses. The developers of the hit title Planet Stronghold have dedicated themselves to keeping old-school RPGs alive through this new adventure.
Game Features

Customize Your Hero: Play as a male or female warrior or thief. Decide their backstory, initial stats, and personality. Help them rise from humble servant to legendary hero!

Train Your Characters: Select everyone's skills, weapons, and armor. Over 500 items can be used in 13 armor slots. Class-based skill trees combine with unique character-specific skill trees such as "Gladiator" or "Assassin".

Battles Demand Strategy: Your tactics will be challenged by over 100 enemies: take advantage of weaknesses and achieve combos with your characters by inflicting and then exploiting status effects. All that character customization has a major effect on how each battle plays out. But never fear: choose between two different modes of play when you start the game, as well as your desired difficulty level.

Story-based Gameplay: Over two novels' worth of in-game text depict vivid characters and flesh out a strong plot that reflects your decisions. Optional interactions abound, such as talking with your party members at camp to learn more about them -- or even to uncover a romance.

Inclusive to all demographics. A wide range of romantic interests are provided.

summary.핵심플레이: 영웅인 아마존 공주 Loren이 아니라 그녀를 섬기는 종자를 조작하며, 이야기 선택을 이끌고 그녀를 지키면서 여정을 진행한다. 턴제 전투에서 100종 이상의 적을 상대로 약점 공략과 상태 이상을 활용한 콤보 전략을 구사한다.
summary.특징: 남녀 전사·도적 캐릭터를 만들어 배경·초기 스탯·성격을 정하고, 13개 방어구 슬롯과 500개 이상의 아이템, 클래스별·캐릭터별 스킬 트리로 육성한다. 두 편의 소설 분량 텍스트로 진행되는 스토리 중심 게임플레이와 선택에 따른 전개, 파티원과의 대화 및 로맨스 요소를 제공하며 두 가지 플레이 모드와 난이도를 선택할 수 있다.

name: Scrap Collector
input: Scrap Collector is a game where you stack cards to craft new items, make new buildings, and fight the enemies. An example is if you have a "Bot" and place it on to a "Scrap Pile", it will spawn material cards that you can use.

summary.핵심플레이: 카드를 쌓아 아이템을 제작하고 건물을 짓고 적과 전투한다. 예를 들어 'Bot' 카드를 'Scrap Pile' 위에 놓으면 사용할 수 있는 재료 카드가 생성된다.
summary.특징: 카드를 겹쳐 놓는 조합 방식으로 자원 생산과 제작, 건설, 전투를 진행하는 시스템을 사용한다.

name: Quake 4
input:
Developed in 2005 by Raven Software in collaboration with id Software, Quake 4 is a narrative-driven, sci-fi, military-style first-person shooter and direct sequel to Quake II that also includes arena-style multiplayer modes.
Story

After the successful assassination of the Strogg’s leader, Earth’s military reignited its attack on the hostile aliens’ homeworld of Stroggos. As Marine Corporal Matthew Kane of the elite Rhino Squad, your mission is to spearhead the invasion. But, in this desperate war for humanity’s survival against an unrelenting enemy, you may discover that the only way to defeat them...is to become one of them.
Features

- Experience the direct sequel to Quake II in this narrative-driven campaign.

- Upgrade and wield an arsenal of advanced weaponry as you battle the Strogg army.

- Tear through the Strogg ranks with mechanized walkers and hover tanks.

- Compete in online multiplayer as a Strogg or Marine in Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag.

summary.핵심플레이: 해병 Matthew Kane으로서 외계 종족 Strogg의 본거지를 침공하며, 다양한 무기를 사용해 적과 전투를 벌인다. 보행 병기와 호버 탱크 같은 기계 유닛을 조종해 진행한다.
summary.특징: Quake II의 직접적 후속작으로 스토리 중심 캠페인을 제공하며, Strogg에 맞선 인류의 전쟁을 다룬다. Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag 등 온라인 멀티플레이 모드를 포함한다.

name: Welcome to Camp Blue Lake
input:
Welcome To Camp Blue Lake is a first-person retro horror game set in the mid 1980s. You Play as an unnamed protagonist who is dealing with multiple mental illnesses, most prominently severe schizophrenia. You see a therapist every day, but it doesn't seem work, nothing you try makes the voices and hallucinations stop, and they never will.

One night as you sit on your couch in your old, crappy apartment, the only thing you could afford, the voices in your head seem louder, more demanding, telling you to go to an old camp that was abandoned a few years ago due to a shocking story that took place a few years back where a group of 10 campers and their 2 counselors went missing with no explanation to this day.

But as you walk upon these old campgrounds you discover something strange past the old abandoned cabins, lone watchtower, and the long burnt out campfire. In the basement of a lone home on the far edge of the camp site. Is this really what the voices were leading you too? What does it mean?

As you step closer to the thing you found in the basement, an urge overtakes you. An urge to kill. To feed. Could this link to those disappearances those few years back? You're not sure, but as if something infiltrated your brain and started piloting your thoughts, the urge to kill and feed only gets stronger. You're mind berating you with demanding thoughts, thoughts that go far beyond your morals. But deep inside you, your body responds with the need to fulfill the demands.

Now, when you stare into the hallucinations, they seem to stare back much stronger than before.

FEATURES

-
Slaughter Sheep

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 1980년대 중반을 배경으로 조현병을 앓는 이름 없는 주인공이 되어 폐쇄된 캠프장을 탐험하며, 죽이고 먹으려는 충동에 따라 행동한다.
summary.특징: 레트로풍 연출과 함께 정신질환·환각을 소재로 한 이야기를 다루며, 오래전 실종 사건이 남은 캠프장을 무대로 한다. 등장 요소로 양을 도살하는 플레이가 포함된다.

name: Time Barbarian Extreme!!
input:
Time Barbarian Extreme!! is a hectic, fast-paced shooter game like those from the old stand-up arcade machines we used to pump quarters into back in the 1980s.

It runs at 60 fps in a window or full-screen.

Controls
TBE plays best with a gamepad controller, but you can use the keyboard.

You steer around with the left thumbstick and shoot with the right trigger. (Steering is fully analog with a gamepad controller.) Missiles are on the left trigger, and "Time Freeze" is on the top-right face button.

The keyboard controls are completely configurable, so use wasd or arrow keys as you prefer.

Eggs
The gimmick to the game is the eggs. When you kill an enemy, it pops out an egg. The eggs are also your hit points. You have only one life, but you start with 10 egg slots (10 maximum hit points). Catch the eggs to fill your egg slots.

The real trick is what happens if you miss the egg. When an egg hits the lava, it spawns a new enemy, and the new enemy will be tougher than the one the egg originally came from. You've got to kill the enemies, but be sure to catch those eggs, or you'll end up making things worse.

Stages
The enemies come in waves, and you need to clear all the enemies to advance to the next stage. The difficulty quickly escalates as the stages progress.

Upgrades
Between stages you get the opportunity to spend your accumulated points to buy upgrades. There are upgrades for your blaster, multi-target missiles, extra egg slots (hit points), and time freeze.

Missiles
Missiles lock on to several targets near you and are powerful enough to destroy them in one shot creating a cluster of eggs. Missiles automatically recharge after a short delay.

Time Freeze
A bullet-time sort of time-stop effect that freezes all the enemies in their tracks. Use it to get yourself out of sticky situations. Time Freeze recharges over time as you kill enemies.

Wrap-Around
The world wraps around. Keep flying in the same direction, and you'll soon return to where you started.

Mini-map
There's a mini-map or radar screen that's useful for tracking down that last straggler.

summary.핵심플레이: 왼쪽 스틱으로 이동하고 오른쪽 트리거로 사격하며, 웨이브로 등장하는 적을 전부 처치해 다음 스테이지로 진행한다. 적을 죽이면 나오는 알을 받아 체력을 채우고, 스테이지 사이에 쌓은 점수로 업그레이드를 구매한다.
summary.특징: 알이 체력이자 핵심 장치로, 놓친 알이 용암에 닿으면 원래 적보다 강한 적이 생성된다. 여러 대상을 자동 조준해 파괴하는 미사일과 적을 멈추는 타임 프리즈가 있으며, 월드가 상하좌우로 이어지는 랩어라운드 구조와 미니맵을 제공한다.

name: Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked
input:
Assemble your party and embark on epic adventures in the Forgotten Realms, where ancient rivalries, shadowy conspiracies, and the lure of dark power threaten to tear Faerûn apart.

The North teeters on the brink of war, and it’s up to you to unravel hidden secrets, face powerful enemies, forge fragile alliances, and expose the masterminds behind the plot before chaos consumes all.

Dive into fast-paced, turn-based combat that brings the Dungeons & Dragons experience into a new dimension. You’ll need all your cunning, courage, and strategy to survive. Will you lead your allies to victory, or watch as the world burns?

Battle dark forces deep within the wilds of Neverwinter Wood and face powerful enemies. Built with the Demeo Action Roleplaying System and launching with multiple adventures (with more on the way), forge legendary bonds with friends as you confront the shadowy figures that threaten the Forgotten Realms.

Team up in a co-operative multiplayer system that supports up to four players or take on the challenge alone by building the adventuring party that suits your style – no Dungeon Master required. Whether you’re leading your allies on an adventure or embarking on a solo quest, you shape your story.

Engage in dynamic, turn-based combat where every move matters. Your strategy evolves based on the traits of iconic D&D classes, the abilities of your allies, and the strength of your hand. Whether you’re a cunning rogue, a mighty paladin, or a powerful sorcerer, mastery of the battlefield is essential as you battle monsters, overcome traps, and discover legendary treasures!

Coming in late 2025. Wishlist today.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 파티를 구성해 턴제 전투를 진행하며, D&D 클래스의 특성과 동료의 능력, 손에 든 카드를 활용해 몬스터와 싸우고 함정을 극복하며 보물을 찾는다. 최대 4인 협동 멀티플레이 또는 솔로 플레이가 가능하다.
summary.특징: Forgotten Realms의 Neverwinter Wood를 배경으로 하며, Demeo Action Roleplaying System을 기반으로 여러 어드벤처를 제공한다. 던전 마스터 없이 원하는 파티를 구성해 진행할 수 있다.

name: STAR WARS™ Galactic Battlegrounds Saga
input:
The destiny of a galaxy hangs in the balance, and you are in command!

Lead the great armies of the Star Wars™ Episode II: Attack of the Clones saga in intense real-time strategy clashes. Enter the fray as the Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance, Wookies, Trade Federation, Gungans or Royal Naboo to determine the course of the Galactic Civil War.

Expand the battlefield with the Clone Campaigns addon. Choose to play as the breakaway Confederacy of Independent Systems or the Galactic Republic in 14 missions based on characters, vehicles and locations from Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones.

- Execute campaigns over land, sea, and air in single-player campaigns, skirmishes, and multiplayer battles.

- Combat arenas extend from interstellar asteroids to epic ground battles to aquatic realms.

- Deploy vast armies up to 200 units per side - that can include Bounty Hunters, Jedi, Droids™, Wookiee Kat tanks and much more.

- Manage resources and upgradable technology into your strategy, such as Wookie ingenuity, advanced Gungan biotechnology and Jedi stamina.

- Create custom single or multiplayer campaigns featuring virtually any Star Wars units and settings with the Scenario Editor.

summary.핵심플레이: 6개 이상의 진영 중 하나를 선택해 자원과 기술 업그레이드를 관리하며 최대 진영당 200유닛 규모의 군대를 편성하고, 육상·해상·공중에서 실시간 전투를 벌인다. 싱글플레이 캠페인, 스커미시, 멀티플레이 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 스타워즈 에피소드2 세계관을 배경으로 은하 제국, 반란 연합, 우키, 무역 연합, 궁간, 왕립 나부 등의 진영과 Clone Campaigns 확장의 독립계 연합·은하 공화국을 다룬다. 시나리오 에디터로 커스텀 싱글·멀티플레이 캠페인을 제작할 수 있다.

name: NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Reppuden with Power Up Kit
input:
ご注意！

【オンラインユーザー登録について】

「オンラインユーザー登録」とは、専用の「シリアルナンバー」をコーエーテクモゲームスのポータルサイト「GAMECITY」にてご登録されることにより、お客様がサービスを受けられるシステムです。登録は無料です。ぜひご登録ください。
ランチャーの「オンラインユーザー登録」メニューより、本製品のオンラインユーザー登録用のシリアル発行ページを、お客様のご使用のブラウザにより開くことができます。

【製品アンケートについて】

製品アンケート」にご協力いただくと、コーエーテクモゲームスのポータルサイト「GAMECITY」にてご利用いただけるGCコインを、お客様に進呈いたします。
アンケートのご回答は、ランチャーの「アンケート」メニューよりお進みください。

About the Game
To commemorate Kou Shibusawa's 35th anniversary, the "Kou Shibusawa Archives" will be opened in the Steam Store. Here we will revive popular previously released titles.

In this eighth round of releases, we offer "NOBUNAGA’S AMBITION: Reppuden with Power Up Kit" the enhanced version of the 9th release in the series.
Reppuden is a strategy based simulation game in which players delve into the lives of the heroes who roamed the chaotic Warring States period. It features a compact style of domestic affairs where players develop numerous facilities in the various castle towns under their control. The scale of battle changes with the number of units in the fight. The power and influence of each Daimyo is measured by his prestige. Players play as one of the Daimyo and fight to gain control of all the 40 castles scattered across Japan.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 다이묘 중 한 명이 되어 지배하는 성 아래 마을에 여러 시설을 개발하며 내정을 운영하고, 부대를 동원해 전투를 벌인다. 일본 전역에 흩어진 40개의 성을 모두 장악하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 일본 전국시대를 배경으로 하며, 각 다이묘의 힘과 영향력은 위신으로 측정되고 전투 규모는 참여 부대 수에 따라 달라진다. NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION 시리즈 9번째 작품의 파워업 키트 포함 강화판이다.

name: The Way of Life Free Edition
input:
The Way of Life makes the player relive the same life's experiences from the point of view of three characters of different ages: an adult, an old man and a child.

The experiences we want to tell about are very different, they go from a quarrel to a dream, and further to more serious topics like death and love. The main point about the game is that every experience will be told through different gameplay mechanics​.​

Also, every playable character has his own specific mechanics and a way to see the world.

The player throughout the game can explore and live different stories and feel a variety of emotions in an amusing and captivating experience.

summary.핵심플레이: 성인, 노인, 아이라는 서로 다른 나이의 세 인물 시점에서 같은 인생 경험들을 체험하며, 각 경험마다 다른 게임플레이 방식으로 진행한다. 플레이어는 여러 이야기를 탐험하고 살아본다.
summary.특징: 다툼, 꿈, 죽음, 사랑 등 다양한 주제를 다루며, 각 플레이어블 캐릭터마다 고유한 조작 방식과 세계를 보는 방식이 마련되어 있다.

name: Spirit Channel
input:
Trapped

Your life is on the line, survive the entity attempting to murder you in a room where you are nailed down to the bed, unable to walk.

Players will play in a First person point of view, making a more effective jumpscare and experience.

Key features

-
Get the digits

Try your best to stay alive, and get each number for the randomly generated 5 digit code by completing the television's cycle.

-
Controls

The game only requires a keyboard to use the actions of the game with only 6 keys, and a mouse to be able to enter or quit the game.

-
SAFTEY (READ BEFORE PLAYING)

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with Photosensitive epilepsy.

summary.핵심플레이: 침대에 고정되어 움직일 수 없는 방에서 플레이어를 죽이려는 존재로부터 생존하며, 텔레비전의 사이클을 완료해 무작위로 생성된 5자리 코드의 각 숫자를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 1인칭 시점으로 진행되며, 키보드 6개 키와 마우스만으로 조작한다. 광과민성 간질이 있는 사람에게 부적합할 수 있는 번쩍이는 불빛이 포함되어 있다.

name: Feed
input:
After their car breaks down, a group of teens find themselves trapped in the clutches of an ancient evil! They must fight against dark forces and find out the truth before it's too late...



From Rosaceae Games comes a homage to classic survival horror. Battle your way through dangerous enemies in a top down perspective, and put your brain to the test solving puzzles and challenges to progress. All wrapped up in a branching story with multiple choices and endings,



Includes:

-top down shooter gameplay with multiple weapons.

-survival horror elements. Limited resources, confined spaces, and terrifying enemies.

-engaging puzzles and tests of your ingenuity

-branching storyline with multiple choices, and real consequences.

-detailed Pixel art cutscenes to tell a mysterious, and horrifying story

summary.장르: 액션, 어드벤처, 서바이벌 호러, 탑다운 슈터
summary.핵심플레이: 탑다운 시점에서 여러 무기로 적과 전투하며, 퍼즐과 과제를 풀어 진행한다. 제한된 자원과 좁은 공간 속에서 생존한다.
summary.특징: 차량 고장으로 고립된 청소년들이 고대의 악에 맞서는 이야기를 담고 있으며, 선택에 따라 결과와 결말이 달라지는 분기형 스토리와 픽셀 아트 컷신으로 전개된다.

name: Project Grove
input:
Play the Prologue

About the Game
Welcome to Project Grove, a first-person fantasy adventure game about the blazing pursuit of alchemy and friendship.

A plague known as 'The Great Rot' has ravaged all things living and it's up to you, legendary Alchemist Professor Edric Tayte, to discover a cure.

Alongside your side-kick robot, venture through the weird and wonderful world of Dacrima, collect it's fabled flora and fauna and brew a roster of potent Potions. With each new ability gained, explore the deepest depths of the forest, with plenty of secrets to find along the way...

summary.핵심플레이: 연금술사 Edric Tayte로 Dacrima 세계를 탐험하며 동식물을 수집하고 이를 재료로 포션을 제조한다. 새로 얻은 능력을 활용해 숲 깊은 곳으로 나아가며 숨겨진 요소를 찾는다.
summary.특징: 'The Great Rot'이라는 역병이 퍼진 판타지 세계를 배경으로, 로봇 조력자와 함께 치료법을 찾는 여정을 진행한다. 포션 제조로 새로운 능력을 획득해 탐험 범위를 넓히는 구조다.

name: Echoes Of The House
input:
Echoes of the House

А short, linear psychological horror game that plunges the player into a haunting mystery. The story follows Christopher, who arrives at his grandmother's remote countryside home for what should be an ordinary visit. However, strange occurrences quickly reveal that nothing is as it seems, with the eerie atmosphere building as players uncover deeper, unsettling layers to the narrative. The game uses psychological tension to create a chilling and immersive experience. All within a one-hour playthrough.

Gameplay

This game mainly features a first-person narrative experience that involves exploration, conversations, and engaging gameplay elements.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점으로 할머니의 외딴 시골집을 탐험하고 대화를 나누며 이야기를 진행한다. 약 1시간 분량의 선형적 플레이 흐름을 따른다.
summary.특징: 주인공 Christopher가 할머니 집을 방문하며 벌어지는 기이한 사건을 다루는 심리 공포 서사를 중심으로, 서서히 드러나는 이야기의 층위와 긴장감 있는 분위기를 활용한다.

name: In The Middle
input: You newly bought a laundry shop in a peaceful downtown. While everything looks normal in the morning, at night... everything changes. You try to survive in a haunted place while every laundry machine in your laundrette start to get cursed, you put detergant to calm the machines. Will you able to survive?

summary.핵심플레이: 낮에는 세탁소를 운영하고, 밤이 되면 저주받은 세탁기들에 세제를 넣어 진정시키며 생존한다.
summary.특징: 평화로운 시내에서 세탁소를 인수했지만 밤이 되면 공간이 변하고 세탁기들이 저주에 걸리는 공포 설정을 배경으로 한다.

name: PixelQuest - Herb's Adventure
input:
When a hero guild saves the village of Torden from a kobold threat, tavern keeper Herb is inspired to pursue his own heroic journey.

PixelQuest - Herb's Adventure offers a nostalgic experience in the vein of classic 16-bit RPGs. Immerse yourself in a richly crafted world, interact with a wide range of NPCs, engage in tactical battles, and discover powerful new equipment. Whether you follow the main storyline or explore side quests, you'll encounter a host of intriguing characters and stories.

Level up, enhance your attributes, and customize your combat dice with new faces. Develop your skills and spells through an extensive skill tree spanning four key attributes: Strength, Agility, Skill, and Talent. Choose your path to become a melee powerhouse or a versatile battle mage.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: NPC와 상호작용하고 메인 스토리와 사이드 퀘스트를 진행하며, 전투로 레벨을 올리고 새로운 장비를 획득한다. 능력치를 강화하고 스킬 트리를 통해 근접 전투형이나 전투 마법사로 캐릭터를 육성한다.
summary.특징: 16비트 RPG 스타일의 픽셀 그래픽을 사용하며, 마을 Torden의 여관 주인 Herb가 영웅이 되고자 여정을 떠나는 이야기를 다룬다. 힘·민첩·기술·재능 네 가지 능력치 기반 스킬 트리와 전투용 주사위 커스터마이징 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: Sabbuth
input:
You awaken to strange and unformed world, devoid of identity. Before you emerges a being, elder and malformed, it offers you meaning, something you cannot exist without. In return you shall traverse nearby lands that have become corrupted by unimaginable sins. From these lands you must retrieve the few artifact that can illuminate the nature of your being.

Lesser, human artifact will aid you on your journey, but be cautious as these lands are gripped by an insatiable hunger that twists all in its image.

Sabbuth was developed by Angad Matharoo and Gabriel Larocque with audio design by Chris Dang, Pato Flores and Hyeongseob Kim and with music composed by Josh Desjardins.

CW: Jumpscares, body horror and human screams.

summary.핵심플레이: 정체성이 없는 존재로 깨어나, 죄악으로 오염된 인근 지역들을 탐험하며 자신의 본질을 밝혀줄 소수의 아티팩트를 회수한다. 여정 중에는 인간의 하위 아티팩트가 도움을 준다.
summary.특징: 기괴하고 미완성된 세계관을 배경으로 한 호러 어드벤처로, 점프스케어, 바디 호러, 인간의 비명 등의 연출을 포함한다.

name: circloO
input:
circloO is a colorful physics platformer in a growing circle. This game contains all levels from circloO and circloO 2, plus twelve brand-new bonus levels and a level editor! You can also play levels uploaded by other players from the editor! There are already over 4000 levels created by players like you!

You're a small ball rolling around in a round level. Collect circles to grow the level circle. As it grows, everything stays in the level, so you'll have to avoid and use obstacles in everchanging ways. For example, a platform that was first very useful to gain height, may prove to be a challenging obstacle after the level has grown!

You can only move left and right, so you'll want to use features of the level carefully to jump and gain height. You'll discover all sorts of physics features, such as changing gravity, a sea of tiny blocks, strange contraptions and even planets with a gravity field. In challenging parts, you'll find yourself fully immersed, pressing your arrow keys as hard as you can trying to get closer to finally collecting that next circle. But don't worry: you'll never have to start over a level, so you can always try again really quickly! And I can guarantee you'll feel amazing once you finally manage it!

With millions of plays on other platforms, circloO has been enjoyed by many and I hope you'll enjoy it too! Have fun and I'm happy to hear what you think!

circloO Complete features:
- Lots of cool physics features: ropes, pulleys, changing gravity and much more! I've included quite a few mechanics for you to discover!
- 56 fun, growing, ever more challenging levels! Can you complete the six almost-but-not-quite-impossible Hard Mode levels?
- All levels from circloO 2 and the original circloO, plus twelve brand-new levels!
- Unique physics puzzles in each level.
- Great music and sound effects by Stijn Cappetijn.
- The game will take most players two to three hours to complete. Level times are saved, so you can try to beat your own highscores and speedrun levels after that!
- Create your own levels in the level editor! Then share them with the community so everyone can enjoy them!

summary.핵심플레이: 원형 레벨 안에서 공을 좌우로만 움직여 원을 모으며, 원을 모을 때마다 레벨 전체가 커지므로 변화하는 장애물과 지형을 활용해 위로 올라간다. 실패해도 레벨을 처음부터 다시 시작하지 않고 곧바로 재시도할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 레벨이 점점 커지는 원형 구조에서 밧줄, 도르래, 변화하는 중력, 중력장을 가진 행성 등 다양한 물리 요소를 다룬다. circloO와 circloO 2의 전체 레벨과 12개의 신규 보너스 레벨, 하드 모드, 레벨 에디터 및 다른 플레이어가 만든 레벨 플레이 기능을 포함한다.

name: Teabat!
input:
SHOW NO FEAR!

Teabat! is a stylish retro 2D adventure with fast, tight controls, and a large interconnected map full of secrets and beautifully constructed set-pieces!
Inspired by handheld 8-bit hardware, Teabat! features an advanced palette engine for player customization and plenty of vibrant lighting and color effects.
Features

- Alter the world's view through unique lenses and additional color palettes.

- Race against the clock, or compete against your own time in Time Trial mode.

- Test your combo skills, and rack up points for a high-score in Arcade Mode.

- Ghost dog!!!

summary.핵심플레이: 빠르고 정밀한 조작으로 2D 맵을 탐험하며 숨겨진 요소와 세트 피스를 찾아 이동한다. 타임 트라이얼 모드에서 기록에 도전하고, 아케이드 모드에서 콤보를 쌓아 점수를 노린다.
summary.특징: 8비트 휴대용 기기에서 영감을 받은 레트로 2D 그래픽에 색상 팔레트 엔진을 탑재해 렌즈와 팔레트로 화면 색감을 커스터마이징할 수 있다. 서로 연결된 대형 맵과 조명·색상 효과가 사용된다.

name: Froggy's Battle
input: Froggy's battle is a cute and loopy take on the action roguelike genre. Master unique loop movement, build your dream frog with shiny upgrades, and you might be able to survive the ongoing waves of angry enemies and strong bosses!

summary.핵심플레이: 루프 형태의 이동을 활용해 밀려오는 적들의 웨이브와 보스를 상대하며 생존한다. 업그레이드를 획득해 개구리 캐릭터를 강화한다.
summary.특징: 루프 이동 메커니즘과 업그레이드를 통한 캐릭터 빌드 구성을 결합한 로그라이크로, 개구리를 소재로 한 세계관을 사용한다.

name: Answer Knot
input:
A WORD FROM JUNE

"Hey Zach, look up this game I just found. It's about us! It's meant as a narrative experience: super-short and easy, but my, the tension building! I know you're gonna focus on the technical stuff but remember it's a first game, right? Be easy on them ;)

And clean up the couch when you're done napping!"[/I]

THE GAME IN THE GAMEYou know how walking sims don't have that much challenge? So here is a tiny game for you, cultured people.

Answer Knot hides 31 easter eggs and references to other narrative games and game studios. It can be handwritten words, pictures, spoken words, pieces of stories, names, anything. Play in on the hub

[/I] There are exactly

12 quite easy
14 difficult
5 super-hard

summary.핵심플레이: 짧은 분량의 이야기를 진행하며 공간을 탐색하고, 게임 곳곳에 숨겨진 요소를 찾는다.
summary.특징: 다른 내러티브 게임과 게임 스튜디오를 가리키는 31개의 이스터에그가 손글씨, 그림, 음성, 이야기 조각, 이름 등의 형태로 숨겨져 있으며 난이도는 쉬움 12개, 어려움 14개, 매우 어려움 5개로 구분된다.

name: Infestus
input:
The Kingdom of Arngor is in turmoil, mercenaries are frequently attacking villages, dark forces are gathering in the North.
A dark priestess has risen and she will reveal Arngor for what it really is.
Which side will you fall for? Who will you end up serving?
Key Features

- Dozens of quests, items, spells & secrets waiting for you

- Dungeon/Instance system - gather up to 10 friends, claim your loot!

- Party/Group system - up to 10 players, share loot, xp and epic moments!

- Friends & Guild system

- Reputation/Faction system - a faction can offer exclusive items and quests!

- Trading & Banking

- PvP in selected unsafe areas

- Singleplayer & Co-Op for those who would rather play alone or with friends only

- Playable on PC & Linux with multiplayer cross-compatibility

- Dedicated Server Support for PC & Linux

summary.핵심플레이: Arngor 왕국을 배경으로 퀘스트를 수행하고 아이템과 주문, 비밀을 획득하며, 최대 10명이 함께 던전과 파티를 구성해 전투와 전리품 획득을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 세력·평판 시스템으로 특정 팩션의 전용 아이템과 퀘스트를 얻을 수 있고, 거래·은행·길드·친구 시스템과 특정 지역에서의 PvP를 지원한다. 싱글플레이, 협동, 크로스 호환 멀티플레이 및 PC·Linux 전용 서버를 제공한다.

name: Pipkin
input:
-
A Cute and Spooky Creature Collecting Game with a Fall / Halloween Aesthetic

-
An In-Depth Battle System: with ~250 moves, 15 elemental types, and 4 classes.

-
Explore Unique and Colorful Areas: Explore moonlit forests, a witch academy, a fairytale town where people live in giant pumpkins, and more!

-
Create Your Own Character: Set your character's appearance, as well as their class and elemental type, giving every character a unique move-set and role in battles.

-
A Grind-Free RPG Experience: Experience and character progression are designed to minimize grinding and cut bloat content out of the game.

-
10+ Hours of Gameplay: (Demo playtime: ~1 hour)

summary.핵심플레이: 약 250종의 기술, 15가지 속성, 4개 클래스로 구성된 전투 시스템으로 크리처를 수집하고 전투를 진행한다. 캐릭터의 외형과 클래스, 속성을 설정해 각기 다른 기술 구성과 역할을 만든다.
summary.특징: 가을·핼러윈 분위기의 세계관으로 달빛 숲, 마녀 학교, 거대한 호박 속에서 사람들이 사는 동화 마을 등 다양한 지역을 탐험한다. 반복 작업과 불필요한 콘텐츠를 줄인 진행 설계를 지향하며, 플레이 분량은 10시간 이상이다.

name: KAWAII SLIME ARENA
input:
KAWAII SLIME ARENA is an action first person shooter with RPG elements and lots of upgrades.



Help Yui defeat the slimes with powerful weapons!

Choose between lots of upgrades to make her stronger and beat the arenas to unlock all weapons!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 캐릭터 Yui를 조작해 무기로 슬라임을 처치하고, 아레나를 클리어하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 다양한 업그레이드 중 선택해 캐릭터를 강화하고, 아레나를 클리어해 모든 무기를 해금하는 방식이다.

name: Who Must Die
input:
Laureate of the Epic Game Jam of November 2015.





You are a replacement doctor, responsible for finding out which of the three patients is the one that is contaminated. To do this, you can use a range of experiments to perform on the patients. You can also ask the guard to do the dirty work for you. You must choose only one patient to kill or .. Maybe this job is too hard for you and you will take the last option .. to not choose ...





What is Who Must Die?

Who Must Die is a simulation offering an experience similar to an "escape room" in which you play a doctor. The goal is to make the player aware of his choices and the consequences this may have for a human life. Explore, search, make your choice and observe directly the result of your investigation.

We chose to put videos of the team in order to make the game even more fun and convincing.





Why did you create Who Must Die?

The first prototype of Who Must Die was made for the Epic Game Jam in November 2015. The game won the first prize of the jam and received many positive reviews (youtube, specialized press, Epic Games), The team decided to make it an improved version, longer and mostly replayable.





What is White Chamber?

We are 5 French students who are passionate about video games at the end of the course. This small motivated team and full of ambition is composed of 2 Game artists, 2 Game Programmers and 1 Sound designer.

The game is published by Plugin Digital which allows us to propose you today this game on Steam.





Thanks to hard work and an ongoing investment we can now offer you the game in full version.

We hope you will enjoy as much fun as we do this game.

summary.핵심플레이: 교체 근무 의사로서 세 명의 환자 중 오염된 한 명을 찾기 위해 다양한 실험을 수행하고 단서를 탐색한다. 조사 결과를 토대로 한 명을 처형하거나, 경비에게 처리를 맡기거나, 선택을 하지 않는 결말을 고를 수 있다.
summary.특징: 방탈출과 유사한 형태의 조사 기반 시뮬레이션으로, 플레이어의 선택과 그 결과를 직접 확인하게 한다. 실제 팀원이 등장하는 영상 연출을 포함하며, 2015년 Epic Game Jam 프로토타입을 확장해 반복 플레이가 가능하도록 제작되었다.

name: Whiskers & Tail
input:
Scamper and squeak your way through 25 levels, each with a unique challenge.
Take on a wide range of perplexing puzzles, from maze exploration to Sokoban.
Play your way through levels designed to test your navigation, memory and problem-solving skills.
Face timed obstacles and fast-moving enemies to keep you on full alert.
Whiskers and Tail are two special mice, each with their own abilities. Use them together to make it through!

Your adventure begins when you are chosen as a test subject.
Uncover the secret behind Project Gemini and LifeHeart Laboratories' testing programme.
Help lovable fool Josh Whitby from the first day of his internship at LifeHeart,
to the moment when he must decide between right and wrong - should he obey his ambition, or his conscience?
It will take all of your cleverness, cunning and character to help Whiskers and Tail escape their certain doom.
Are you ready?

summary.핵심플레이: 25개 스테이지를 진행하며 미로 탐색과 소코반 등 다양한 퍼즐을 풀고, 시간 제한 장애물과 빠르게 움직이는 적을 피해 이동한다. 각기 다른 능력을 가진 두 마리 쥐 Whiskers와 Tail을 함께 활용해 스테이지를 통과한다.
summary.특징: 플레이어가 실험 대상으로 선택되면서 시작되며, Project Gemini와 LifeHeart Laboratories의 실험 프로그램에 얽힌 비밀을 풀어간다. 인턴 Josh Whitby의 이야기를 따라 야망과 양심 사이의 선택 상황이 전개된다.

name: My Stepmom is a Futanari Chemist
input:
Futa on Male

An unexpected turn of events has you stuck at home with your stepmom on your 21st birthday.
She might be busy woman--being a successful chemist and all--yet still manages to find time for you on your special day.

What would've been an evening packed with fun, soon turns into an awkward situation that goes beyond your wildest dreams...

* This one is a doozy...

Read through some pretty raunchy(erotic) dialogue, accompanied by spicy nude depictions.
Gameplay
Kinetic Visual Novel

H-Scenes
~10K words

Immerse yourself in the story by typing in your own name, then proceeding to read through a raunchy story from the first-person perspective.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 자신의 이름을 입력한 뒤 1인칭 시점에서 진행되는 이야기를 읽어 나간다. 선택지가 없는 키네틱 비주얼 노벨 형식이다.
summary.특징: 21번째 생일에 계모와 집에 머물게 된 상황을 다루며, 약 1만 단어 분량의 성인용 대사와 누드 묘사, H-신을 포함한다.

name: Pincrediball
input:
Pincrediball is a fun twist on the pinball game genre. You design the Pinball machine, and the Automata Pinball Wizard follows a "Playbook" to play your design. Achieve High Scores and earn medals to advance levels.
How to play

Think of a "Machine" as a "World" with stages (or "levels"). At each level you unlock new components to add to the Pinball machine. Place these components in the right spots on the machine, and hit "Run Playbook" to see what score it gets you.

With some tiny spoilers, here's one way to handle the Tutorial Machine's final stage:

-
