summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어가 핀볼 머신을 직접 설계하고 컴포넌트를 배치한 뒤, '플레이북'을 따라 자동으로 플레이하는 오토마타 위저드의 결과를 확인한다. 높은 점수를 내고 메달을 획득해 레벨을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 머신을 여러 스테이지를 가진 하나의 '세계'로 구성하며, 각 레벨에서 새로운 컴포넌트를 잠금 해제해 머신에 추가한다. 플레이어가 직접 조작하는 대신 설계에 초점을 맞춘 핀볼 구조를 취한다.

name: just a game to test your lQ
input:
You applied for a free IQ test on the Internet out of curiosity. On a quiet, dark night, 'World's Best IQ Test Specialist' comes to your house. You just have to solve a simple quiz. If you can.







(This game is a horror game)



Objective

-Solve as many quizzes as you can while avoiding deliverymen, mannequin, and lunatic.

-Compete on the leaderboard by achieving high scores.

summary.핵심플레이: 배달원, 마네킹, 광인 등의 추격자를 피하면서 가능한 많은 퀴즈를 풀어 점수를 획득한다.
summary.특징: 인터넷 IQ 테스트를 신청한 뒤 밤에 찾아온 인물과 얽히는 설정으로 진행되며, 높은 점수로 리더보드에서 경쟁할 수 있다.

name: Changed
input:
Changed-special

Free upgrade and remastered version available for download:

Players who own the Changed game body will be given a Changed-special.
The special version can be seen as an upgraded and remastered version of the original version of Changed, with a lot of changes.
The new version has improved and re-made a lot of aspects of the original story, pictures, game mechanics and so on.
While expanding many new levels and creatures, it also adds a lot of illustrations, photos and animations.
Changed-special installation method:

Once you have the original version of Changed, search for Changed-special in the Steam "Tools" library and install it.
Please note that Changed-special is attached to the player as a "tool", so it will not appear in the "Games" library.
Thank you players for choosing and supporting the game Changed, thank you.

This version is currently under development, only the experience version is currently available, the full version will be updated for free later.
For more information, please visit:

About the Game

Game Synopsis:

"Changed" is a difficult, action puzzle game with a lot of chase.
The protagonist of the game awakened in a strange room and came to an unfamiliar laboratory building.
In the adventure, he will encounter all kinds of unknown creatures, each of which can easily “plunder” his body.
He can only make constant explorations and try to walk out of this dangerous building.
In this deserted world, who is secretly guiding him to go out? Why is he trapped here? What happened to the outside world?
All kinds of mysteries are intricate and the truth will slowly emerge from the interaction and exploration.
Of course, be careful not to get lost in this building...
Features Introduction:

* The protagonist can only use simple movements and sprints because he is the prey of all creatures.
* No props, even tools, all problems must be solved with wisdom and action.
* High game difficulty, Japanese fusion RPG and I WANNA games.
* 8-bit style music evokes childhood memories in a retro style.
* Difficult, suitable for players who are good at watching and daring to try.
* Understand the characteristics of creatures in one failure to escape them.
* Interactive traps, text eggs, CG plots, many investigable items for exploration.
* Multi-line outcomes, triggering different outcome lines based on interactions and investigations.
* Approximately six hours of playable length (if possible).

summary.핵심플레이: 낯선 실험실 건물에서 깨어난 주인공을 조작해 이동과 대시만으로 각종 생물의 추격을 피하며 탈출을 시도한다. 도구나 아이템 없이 관찰과 행동으로 함정과 문제를 해결하며 건물을 탐험한다.
summary.특징: 상호작용과 조사에 따라 여러 결말로 분기되며, 실패를 통해 생물의 특성을 파악하는 높은 난이도의 설계를 갖추었다. 8비트 스타일 음악과 CG 연출, 조사 가능한 아이템 등이 포함되며 약 6시간 분량의 플레이 길이를 제공한다.

name: Zolg
input: Zolg is a minimalist top-down shooter where you explore, fight enemies, collect powerups, and defeat bosses. Move and aim with WASD + mouse or you can use a controller. Controllers can be configured from the main menu. There are 5 powerup types to collect, 6 bosses to fight, and various other enemies and obstacles in your path. This game also has Steam trading cards and 40 achievements of varying difficulty to unlock.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 맵을 탐험하며 적과 싸우고 파워업을 수집하고 보스를 처치한다. WASD와 마우스 또는 컨트롤러로 이동과 조준을 조작한다.
summary.특징: 5종의 파워업, 6명의 보스, 다양한 적과 장애물이 등장한다. 스팀 트레이딩 카드와 난이도별 40개의 도전 과제를 제공한다.

name: Stormborn
input:
A harsh medieval world awaits you, full of natural resources, deadly wildlife, and untrustworthy players. Craft items, build your base, and forage the landscape with the ultimate goal of surviving.



Group up with friends and build a huge impenetrable castle, or roam solo with the goal of taking out other players.

summary.핵심플레이: 자원을 채집하고 아이템을 제작하며 거점을 건설해 생존을 목표로 진행한다. 혼자 다른 플레이어를 공격하거나 친구들과 함께 성을 지을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 중세 세계를 배경으로 하며, 자연 자원과 위험한 야생동물, 다른 플레이어와의 상호작용이 포함된 멀티플레이 생존 환경을 제공한다.

name: House of Alice
input:
The latest release of Indie game House of Alice is now available on Steam! Unlike many VR games, this virtual bunny hunt starts out in a beautiful real-looking house. You can pick up vases and candlesticks and throw them around for an exciting crash or chase after the rabbits to collect points. Like Alice in Wonderland, this family-friendly game explores shifting perspectives of large and small and you can jump through the looking glass for surreal adventures.



Discover a rabbit hole to uncover new scenes and characters both inside and outside the house. This game keeps expanding so if you haven’t been in recently, it is time to go back.



House of Alice is a good family game and a great way to experience Virtual Reality in a relaxed atmosphere. I hope you enjoy it and if you have ideas for things to add, please drop me a line.

summary.핵심플레이: 실제 집처럼 보이는 공간에서 화병이나 촛대 등 물건을 집어 던지거나 토끼를 쫓아 점수를 모은다. 토끼굴을 발견해 집 안팎의 새로운 장면과 캐릭터를 탐색한다.
summary.특징: 이상한 나라의 앨리스에서 착안해 큰 것과 작은 것의 관점 변화를 다루며, 거울을 통과해 초현실적 공간으로 이동할 수 있다. 콘텐츠가 지속적으로 확장되며 가족 친화적으로 구성되어 있다.

name: Year 2245: ZOE
input:
Step into the shattered remnants of a future where humanity’s legacy has all but vanished. In Year 2134: New Era Apocalyptique, experience a gripping sci-fi adventure set in a world now ruled by robots. This captivating story-driven game immerses you in a narrative where survival is only the beginning.



Explore a Futuristic World:

The year is 2134, and the Earth has been transformed into a domain of machines. Venture through diverse, beautifully crafted locations that showcase both the grandeur and decay of a world left in robotic control. Each environment is a piece of history, revealing secrets about the collapse of human civilization.



Uncover the Truth Behind Humanity’s Disappearance:

As you navigate through this dystopian landscape, interact with your surroundings to piece together the story of how humans vanished and what led to the rise of the robots. Your journey will uncover hidden truths, raising questions about whether this new world was shaped by a rogue AI or by other, more enigmatic forces.



Solve Puzzles and Overcome Challenges:

Engage with unique puzzles that challenge your wits and adaptability. Each puzzle is intricately designed to test your problem-solving skills and push the boundaries of your adventure, making every discovery and breakthrough all the more rewarding.



Make Crucial Decisions:

Every choice you make impacts the unfolding story. Your decisions will shape your interactions with the robots and influence the outcome of your quest. Navigate moral dilemmas and plot-driving choices that determine the fate of what remains of humanity’s legacy.



Immerse Yourself in Stunning Visuals and Atmospheric Music:

The game’s striking visual design and evocative soundtrack create an immersive experience that draws you deeper into its world. The music and environments work in harmony to set the mood, enhancing every moment of your exploration and discovery.



Join the Adventure Today:

Dive into Year 2134: New Era Apocalyptique and uncover the mysteries of a world where humanity’s existence is nothing more than a memory. Add to Wishlist and become part of a story where every decision matters and every discovery counts.



Are you ready to unravel the secrets of a future beyond our own? Start your adventure today!

summary.핵심플레이: 로봇이 지배하는 미래 세계를 탐험하며 환경과 상호작용해 인류가 사라진 경위를 밝혀낸다. 퍼즐을 풀고 선택을 통해 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 2134년을 배경으로 기계가 지배하게 된 지구를 무대로 하며, 플레이어의 선택이 로봇과의 상호작용과 이야기 결말에 영향을 준다. 서로 다른 지역을 탐색해 문명 붕괴에 관한 단서를 수집한다.

name: Ewe Shall Not Pass
input:
As Shmandalf the wizard, herd your wayward flock of sheep to safety while fending off the monsters that prey on them with your wizardly prowess! Manage your farm in between adventures to earn gold and acquire unique spells and upgrades on your path to sheep herding supremacy.

---

**A Mystically Magical Shepherd Experience**

- Put your sorcerous skills to the test as you defend your herd from monsters.

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 마법사 Shmandalf가 되어 양 떼를 안전한 곳으로 몰고, 양을 노리는 몬스터들을 마법으로 막아낸다. 모험 사이에는 농장을 관리해 금을 벌고 마법과 업그레이드를 획득한다.
summary.특징: 양치기를 소재로 한 마법사 콘셉트의 게임으로, 양 떼 인도와 몬스터 방어, 농장 경영 요소가 결합되어 있다.

name: FALLEN ANGELS
input:
GAME

This unique casual game seamlessly combines two major elements: "plot" and "match-three strategy." In this game, players not only get to experience the classic match-three gameplay, achieving goals by eliminating identical elements, but also delve deep into various plot sub-stories with the goddesses in each level.

It's not just a game that challenges your strategic thinking and intellect; it's also a journey filled with emotions and stories. Each goddess has her own unique background and story, and every choice the player makes could potentially influence the course of the plot. As the game progresses, players gradually unlock a variety of exquisite CG illustrations. These CG illustrations not only serve as rewards for players but also act as crucial trigger points for the plot. Some hidden storylines or plot developments can only be triggered and unlocked within specific CG illustrations, adding countless mysteries and exploration fun to the entire game.

In summary, this game not only satisfies players' love for match-three strategy but also offers an immersive narrative experience. Players can, during the relaxed gameplay, gain deeper insights into each goddess's personality, emotions, and story, experiencing a dual feast of visuals and emotions.

FEATURES

-
Exquisite CG and illustrations

-
Stunning Live2D visuals

-
Full voice acting for the female protagonists

-
Satisfying and enjoyable match-three gameplay

summary.핵심플레이: 동일한 요소를 제거하는 매치3 방식으로 각 레벨의 목표를 달성하며, 여신 캐릭터들과 관련된 스토리를 진행한다. 게임이 진행되면서 CG 일러스트를 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 각 여신마다 고유한 배경과 이야기가 있으며, 특정 CG 일러스트에서만 열리는 숨겨진 스토리가 존재한다. Live2D 연출과 여성 캐릭터 전체 음성이 포함된다.

name: Friendship Simulator
input:
Friendship simulator is a split-screen, first person shooter where you battle almost-real friends.

-
Experience friendship like you haven’t before

-
Feel the nostalgia of the early 2000s couch-games

-
Battle almost-real friends who dynamically react to any situations thrown at them

-
Fight across 5 distinct maps

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 분할 화면 방식으로 친구 캐릭터들과 총격전을 벌인다.
summary.특징: 2000년대 초반의 소파 게임을 연상시키는 연출을 사용하며, 상황에 동적으로 반응하는 유사 실제 친구 캐릭터와 5개의 맵에서 전투를 진행한다.

name: Dead as Disco
input: Dead as Disco puts you in the shoes of Charlie Disco, a fallen icon with one chance to reclaim the spotlight from the Idols – Charlie’s ex-bandmates and musical legends. Confront the Idols in stylish combat that syncs to every song, and survive a world torn apart by music, fame, and betrayal In this action-packed, literal Beat ‘Em Up.

summary.핵심플레이: Charlie Disco를 조작해 음악에 맞춰 동기화되는 전투를 벌이며, Idols라 불리는 옛 밴드 동료들과 대결한다.
summary.특징: 음악·명성·배신으로 분열된 세계를 배경으로, 곡의 리듬에 맞춰 진행되는 전투를 결합한 비트 뎀 업이다.

name: DARK SUN (黑暗太阳)
input:
[Game Type]
[DARK SUN] is an action game with 2D black and white graphics. It consists of Souls game + Castlevania style scenes.
Explore the world full of danger and malice in the game, collect weapons, magic, skills, and fight against enemies.

[Game Features]
Upgrade to gain skill points and personalize your fighting style. At certain locations, you can reset skill points and change your fighting style.
Some enemies are so powerful that you may experience multiple failures to defeat them. Or look for specific skills or magic which will make the battle easier.
You can carry multiple weapons with different skills and multiple magic spells. Use them in conjunction with each other to deal with various situations. Especially supporting magic and skills are very important.

Weapon skills are powerful attacks that consume magic and stamina and have high attack power.
It is important to use the right weapon skill when fighting powerful enemies.

Guns are handy weapons that have low attack power, but firing them when an enemy attacks will cause a counter effect.
Most enemies can be executed. Guns are great secondary weapons when you don't want to fight with magic.

Some scenarios require specific abilities to get through, look for these abilities to explore more places.
You will meet some NPCs in your exploration and helping them will allow you to learn about their story. At certain times they will also help you to challenge powerful enemies.
Hidden paths will contain idols related to boss abilities, breaking them will reduce the boss's abilities and also seal some of the boss's skills.
This will reduce the difficulty in fighting the bosses, but of course you can also challenge the high difficulty without breaking the idols.

[World Story]
The warm sun disappeared 1000 years ago and King Xena created a new sun, but the new sun was cold and dim.
Now that the world is near destruction, heroes from the past are summoned to the world 1000 years later to find the truth.
Each hero who comes to the end times must fulfill a mission that will change the fate of the world when all missions are completed.
Finding your own mission in the game and helping others fulfill theirs will affect the ending of the game.

summary.핵심플레이: 위험이 도사린 세계를 탐험하며 무기, 마법, 스킬을 수집하고 적과 전투한다. 레벨업으로 스킬 포인트를 얻어 전투 방식을 조정하고, 여러 무기와 마법을 조합해 다양한 상황에 대응한다.
summary.특징: 흑백 2D 그래픽의 소울류와 캐슬바니아 스타일을 결합했다. 특정 능력이 있어야 진행되는 구간과 숨겨진 경로의 우상을 파괴해 보스 능력을 약화시키는 시스템이 있으며, 자신과 NPC의 임무 수행 여부에 따라 엔딩이 달라진다.

name: Built By Force
input:
Built By Force is a carefully orchestrated merging between the gunplay of Titanfall 2, base building of Satisfactory, and exploration of Minecraft, while introducing new elements of its own, like At-Will Transformation and Single Resource Economy.

You and your friends will find a randomized world consisting of a living simulation: randomized events each playthrough, completely malleable environments, and an adaptive AI that uses a novel blend of Goal Oriented Action Planning and Hierarchical Task Network frameworks.

"IT'S A BRAND NEW GAME"

With the amount of random, but curated, content, each run is a refreshing new experience.

"HEY FRIEND. GET IN HERE!"

Enjoy your new world with up to 12 other players!

"CAN YOU JUST MOVE THAT MOUNTAIN A LITTLE TO THE LEFT?"

Terrain is fully destructible and constructible!

"WAIT, DID THAT JUST BREAK WHERE I TOUCHED IT?"

Runtime destruction means structures break WHERE YOU HIT THEM!

"GOTTA GO FASTER! GOTTA GO...SENTRIER?"

Break the sound barrier in flight mode, stand your ground in Sentry mode, or have a familiar stroll in Humanoid mode as you can quickly transform at will to adapt to your situation.

"OUT OF MANY ONE!"

A simplified resource management system where you only have to manage a single resource type! CRYSTAL POWER!

"NOW THAT IS BESPOKE!"

Freely adapt your playstyle with tool and ability customization.

"THIS BASE IS MY BASE. YOUR BASE IS MY BASE."

Base building is a smooth experience with a third person camera to allow you to quickly build that dream without getting caught up in the legwork.

summary.핵심플레이: 총격전을 벌이고, 지형과 구조물을 파괴·건설하며 기지를 짓고, 무작위로 생성된 세계를 탐험한다. 비행, 센트리, 인간형 모드로 자유롭게 변신하며 상황에 대응한다.
summary.특징: 플레이마다 무작위 이벤트가 발생하는 세계와 타격 지점에 따라 부서지는 실시간 파괴 시스템을 갖추며, 크리스탈 파워라는 단일 자원 경제와 최대 12명 멀티플레이, 도구·능력 커스터마이징을 지원한다.

name: Little World Of Creatures
input:
Are you ready?
Are you sure?

In Little World Of Creatures you Dash, You Smash and you Bash your way into other enemy creatures to collect there precious creature essence.
Survive for as long as you can and be the conqueror of the island. Don't let anyone stop you from your dream of domination. The more creatures you eat the more you grow, the more you grow the more your worth. Try to survive as the ruler of the land, or get eaten along the way.

Use your collected essence to purchase a variety of different creatures all with their own strengths and weaknesses. Little World Of Creatures is NOT Pay To Win everything can be earned in-game by just playing!

- 10 Player Rooms

- 4 Regions: AU, US, EU, RU

- Collect Essence By Attacking Other Players

- Use Your Essence To Purchase New Creatures

Some of the in-game creatures include...

summary.핵심플레이: 다른 크리처를 돌진하고 부딪쳐 공격하며 상대의 에센스를 수집하고, 최대한 오래 생존하며 성장한다. 모은 에센스로 새로운 크리처를 구매할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 각기 다른 강점과 약점을 가진 다양한 크리처를 게임 내 플레이만으로 획득할 수 있으며 페이 투 윈 요소가 없다. 최대 10인 방과 AU, US, EU, RU 네 개 지역 서버를 지원한다.

name: Puzzle Tactics
input:
Puzzle Tactics is a turn-based and grid-based tactics game played in various small levels. You play as the blue team with the goal of defeating the red team's units before losing your own. Later levels are more difficult and introduce more unit types in battle. The game is controlled using the mouse.

Units

- Warrior: a powerful melee unit who can also hit multiple targets

- Archer: can shoot at targets 4-6 tiles away but only in 4 directions

- Mage: can attack with a fireball that hits multiple targets and ignores walls

- Defender: has the most health and can shield itself and allies to reduce damage

- Necromancer: summons skeletons to deal and take extra damage

- Skeleton: somewhat like a warrior, but weaker and with only a basic attack

summary.핵심플레이: 마우스로 그리드 기반 소규모 레벨에서 아군인 블루 팀 유닛을 조작해 레드 팀 유닛을 먼저 처치하는 것이 목표다. 후반 레벨일수록 난이도가 올라가고 더 많은 유닛 종류가 등장한다.
summary.특징: 전사, 궁수, 마법사, 방어자, 강령술사, 스켈레톤 등 각기 다른 공격 범위와 능력을 가진 여러 유닛을 활용한다. 궁수는 4방향으로 4~6타일 거리를 공격하고, 마법사는 벽을 무시하는 광역 공격을 하며, 강령술사는 스켈레톤을 소환한다.

name: Jet Set Knights
input:
When the king is not at home, the bad things can be done...

The peaceful tiny kingdom is now under attack from their old enemies, beings from the dark world... The princess Kitty and all people of the kingdom are now in danger!

Don't wait! Take one of four brave knights, face hundreds of evil creatures and protect the princess at all costs!

Jet Set Knights is an old-school arcade action platformer inspired by classics from the golden age such as Mario Bros, Snow Bros or newest Super Crate Box. If You love retro 2D platformers mixed with tower defense and RPG elements, Jet Set Knight is for You!

- Simple controls and pure arcade action

- Choose from 4 Knights, each with their own unique abilities

- Single player and Local multiplayer for 2-4 players

- 2 Players Survival mode. Defeat monsters together with your friend!

- Three local multiplayer modes include Last Man Standing, Domination or famous EGG Tournament

- Secret Characters

- Retro-styled handcrafted pixel graphics created with love

- Over 14 unlockable weapons, spells and special artifacts

- 12 Unique Enemies - Including Ghosts, Slimes, Skeletons, Devils or Giant Snowballs!

- Plenty of hidden secrets, surprises and deadlies traps

- Level Up your heroes and collect many power-ups

- Fight with powerful Bosses!

- 12 in-game Achievements

- Funny mini-games

- Full Xbox 360 controller support

- Steam Achievements and Trading Cards

- Future content updates

- Awesome retro-style game manual

- Excellent Soundtrack

- And of course, there's a princess to save! =)

Note: The multiplay modes for 2-4 players are local only, not online.

summary.핵심플레이: 4명의 기사 중 하나를 선택해 단일 화면에서 몰려오는 적들을 물리치고 공주를 지킨다. 무기와 주문, 파워업을 수집하고 캐릭터를 레벨업하며 보스와 싸운다.
summary.특징: 타워 디펜스와 RPG 요소를 결합한 레트로 2D 아케이드 스타일로, 핸드메이드 픽셀 그래픽과 2~4인 로컬 멀티플레이를 지원한다. Last Man Standing, Domination, EGG Tournament 등 로컬 멀티플레이 모드와 2인 생존 모드, 미니게임, 히든 캐릭터를 포함한다.

name: Shadow Warrior 2
input:
Shadow Warrior 2 Deluxe

Shadow Warrior 2 Deluxe includes the Shadow Warrior 2 soundtrack, Shadow Warrior 2 art book, and the Solid Gold Pack containing an exclusive gold ninja, gold katana, and gold MP7 gun.

About the Game

Shadow Warrior 2 is the stunning evolution of Flying Wild Hog’s offbeat first-person shooter following the further misadventures of former corporate shogun Lo Wang. Now surviving as a reclusive mercenary on the edge of a corrupted world, the formidable warrior must again wield a devastating combination of guns, blades, magic and wit to strike down the demonic legions overwhelming the world. Battle alongside allies online in four-player co-op or go it alone in spectacular procedurally-generated landscapes to complete daring missions and collect powerful new weapons, armor, and arcane relics of legend.

STORY

Five years have passed since Lo Wang shattered the alliance between his deceitful former boss and the ancient gods of the shadow realm. Despite noble intentions, Lo Wang’s efforts to annihilate the darkness corrupted the world, creating a strange and savage new order where humans and demons live side by side.

The once feared warrior now lives in the shifting wildlands outside the reach of his enemies and the neon glow of Zilla’s cybernetic metropolis, scratching out a meager existence as a hired sword for the local Yakuza clans. When a simple mission goes wrong, Lo Wang is drawn into a volatile conflict between a brilliant young scientist, his nemesis Orochi Zilla, and the demonic forces that have become unsettled in our world. The sharp-tongued hero must once again wield lethal blades, staggering firepower, and archaic magic to purge the world of evil.

FEATURES

Blades and Bullets: Lo Wang delivers his own brand full throttle brutality with an expanded array of over 70 lethal blades and explosive firearms to overcome the demonic opposition. Become a whirlwind of steel and blood with razor sharp katana, short swords, crescent blades, and hand claws or unleash a hellish symphony of ornate firearms to decimate your enemies.

Four Player Co-Op: Battle through the expansive campaign alone or team up as a four-player typhoon of destruction online in campaign co-op mode. Tackle challenging primary missions or thrilling side quests while maintaining your own ninja style with customizable armor, items, and valuable loot from your triumphs.

Procedural Environments: The breach between the human and demon realms created an interdimensional hernia resulting in constant shifts to the world of Shadow Warrior 2. Procedurally generated landscapes and paths bring new twists and turns to once familiar terrain and routine missions.

Brutal Damage System: Choose your weapon based on the situation at hand and then dismantle everything that stands in your path with an advanced gore system. Use precision blade strikes to separate limbs and heads or switch to heavy ordinance and blow a hole right through colossal beasts.

Custom Upgrade System: Upgrade weapons in your arsenal with up to three stones at once to improve performance or augment them with devastating elemental effects. Collect karma, amulets, and armor to enhance Lo Wang’s power and shift his death-dealing artistry into overdrive.

Shadow Warrior Series

The Shadow Warrior series started back in the 90s with Shadow Warrior Classic that was remastered and released on Steam by Devolver Digital and 3D Realms as Shadow Warrior Classic Redux. Then in 2013, Flying Wild Hog and Devolver Digital released the bold reimagining of the legend of Lo Wang with the modern classic Shadow Warrior.

summary.핵심플레이: 용병 Lo Wang을 조작해 근접 무기와 총기, 마법을 조합하며 데몬을 처치하고, 미션과 사이드 퀘스트를 수행하며 무기·방어구·유물을 수집한다. 혼자 캠페인을 진행하거나 온라인 4인 협동 플레이가 가능하다.
summary.특징: 인간과 데몬이 공존하는 세계를 배경으로 하며, 절차적으로 생성되는 지형과 경로가 미션마다 변화를 준다. 70종 이상의 무기, 부위 절단이 가능한 고어 시스템, 스톤과 원소 효과를 활용한 무기 강화 및 커스터마이즈 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP VR
input:
"ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP VR" is the ultimate toilet experience, crazier than ever!

This Windows and Mac title released last year on Steam, now has a V.R. version too!

(Thank god the smell is not included... Yet!)



Enjoy the frantic EARLY demo experience, optimized for Oculus Rift S.



"ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP V.R." is a twisted, fast-paced and super addictive single-player game that puts your gamer skills to test!



Different enemies, weapons, unlockables, surprises, a crappy lore and a lot more!



This madness includes:



- Twelve main levels, with different bosses each!

- A lot of bonus levels to make your toilet proud!

- An almost fully destructible environment

- Two difficulty levels for experienced gamers and rookies

- Steam Cloud-Enabled to bring your poop to any computer

- In-game and Steam Achievements

- An in-game store to use your kernel coins to buy sh*t!

- Seven different languages (Poopishese not included)

- Cutscenes and a story included (Believe it or not, it has a plot!)

- Hundred of surprises and low budget gags wherever you look!

- Constant updates with more content and fixes

- And loads more!



“Attack of the Evil Poop” smells foul from a distance, but is as delicious as an almond chocolate cake up close!

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점으로 다양한 적과 보스를 상대하며 무기를 사용해 전투를 진행하는 싱글플레이 게임이다. 인게임 상점에서 커널 코인으로 아이템을 구매하며 레벨을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 화장실을 소재로 한 코믹 세계관을 바탕으로 하며, 12개의 메인 레벨과 각기 다른 보스, 보너스 레벨, 거의 완전히 파괴 가능한 환경, 컷신과 스토리, 두 가지 난이도, 스팀 클라우드 및 업적을 지원한다. Oculus Rift S에 최적화된 VR 버전으로 제공된다.

name: Mage at Stake
input:
Mage at Stake is a fun and exciting roguelite game created by two university students during our final year as part of our research for our bachelor’s thesis. We made this game in just seven weeks, putting all our creativity and hard work into it. We hope you enjoy!

Made By:

Thulfekar Issam Alshreese - Game Programmer and Designer

Tom Ellström Johansson - Game Programmer and Designer

Special thanks to Isac Ala and Alexander Rydgren for the music and Noah Dovholt for the 2d art illustration

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 마법사를 조작하며 로그라이트 방식의 진행을 반복한다.
summary.특징: 두 명의 대학생이 학사 논문 연구의 일환으로 7주 만에 제작한 무료 게임으로, 외부 인원이 음악과 2D 아트 일러스트에 참여했다.

name: Space Explore
input:
Experience how Spacecraft’s lift-off into orbit. Join the crew on space shuttle missions and assist in the servicing of the space station. Take a trip into orbit and experience The Earth from above. Encounter life on board the space station, learn how to move in zero-gravity and participate in space walks. Take control of the shuttle in an accurate physics based landing simulation.



Space Explore is a game as well as an educational simulation. Experience the thrill of viewing

The Earth in orbit which is unparalleled in VR and NON VR mode.



Features:

1. High quality models and textures

2. Smooth Non VR and VR experience without any motion sickness

3. Scientifically accurate simulations and gameplay

4. Physics based landing and takeoff

5. 4 Different missions available in the game (Takeoff, Explore Space Station, Space Walk, Landing)

6. Multi language support

summary.핵심플레이: 우주왕복선의 이륙에 참여하고 우주정거장 정비를 돕는다. 무중력 이동과 우주 유영을 수행하며, 물리 기반 시뮬레이션으로 왕복선의 착륙을 조작한다.
summary.특징: VR과 비VR 모드를 모두 지원하며 궤도에서 지구를 조망할 수 있다. 이륙, 우주정거장 탐험, 우주 유영, 착륙 등 4가지 미션과 다국어 지원을 제공하는 교육용 시뮬레이션을 겸한다.

name: Stacksquatch
input:
A cozy VR action-puzzle game about balancing towering stacks to meet cute cryptids on colourful floating islands. Will you overcome gravity itself to reach new heights and perspectives? Will you find the mythical Stacksquatch and recover the Wayward Islands?

- Explore across locations, seasons, and sizes to build the best stacks

- Chat with the cryptids you find, all with unique dialogue, hopes, and dreams

- Sit down or run around, whatever your space allows

- Enjoy accessible, intuitive gameplay without violence

Sit back and stack with Dogtective!

summary.핵심플레이: 물체를 쌓아 균형을 맞추며 높은 탑을 만들어 새로운 높이와 시야에 도달한다. 여러 위치와 계절, 크기의 환경을 탐험하며 안정적인 스택을 완성한다.
summary.특징: 떠다니는 섬을 배경으로 크립티드 캐릭터들과 대화하며, 각 캐릭터는 고유한 대사와 바람을 가진다. 앉거나 움직이며 플레이할 수 있고 폭력 요소가 없다.

name: Variant 22
input:
Variant 22 is a extraction based zombie survival shooter.

Loot, Shoot, Extract, Base Build, Craft, Upgrade.

A new variant of the virus has spread. All residence of the New American Republic are required to self report to designated quarantine camps. All lifeforms in non contained areas are considered infected and hostile. As the NAR continues it's suppression efforts with airborne chemical agents and ground patrols, safe areas are in short supply and survival is threatened.
Loot Run

- Enter a contaminated zone using the Eastern Railway.

- Search the area for useful gear and resources while navigating uncontained infected and NAR patrols.

- Find the exit ramp and use the highway to return to the safe zone, extracting the gathered loot.

Safe Zones
Safe zones are free of airborne chemical agents and provide an area for base building. Without active suppression, the infected form reoccurring waves and must be defended against to sustain survival

- Base Building

- Crafting

- Weapon Upgrades

Weapons

- Shooting centered core

- Gun performance attributes

- Interchangeable attachments

- Detailed ammunition types

- Weapon maintenance

Contaminated Zones
Each procedural generated run has its own level of contamination and a differing level of patrol presence.

Time in loot run areas are limited by contamination levels. Gas masks and blocker pills help extend exposure.

Armed Patrol Agents are equipped with varying levels of gear and have orders to shoot on sight.

Special points of interest are scattered around the map providing working crafting stations for different kind of upgrades.
Survival Elements

- Food & Drink

- Health

- Contamination exposure

- Temperature

End Game
Gear up for a final push westward out of NAR reach towards freedom.

summary.장르: 익스트랙션 슈터, 좀비 생존, 액션, 인디
summary.핵심플레이: 동부 철도로 오염 구역에 진입해 감염체와 NAR 순찰대를 피하며 장비와 자원을 수집하고, 고속도로 출구로 탈출해 획득한 전리품을 반출한다. 안전지대에서는 기지를 건설하고 제작·무기 강화를 하며 주기적으로 몰려오는 감염체 웨이브를 방어한다.
summary.특징: 새로운 변종 바이러스가 퍼진 New American Republic을 배경으로 하며, 절차적으로 생성되는 구역마다 오염도와 순찰 밀도가 다르다. 오염도에 따라 탐사 시간이 제한되어 방독면과 차단제로 노출을 늘려야 하며, 음식·음료·체력·오염 노출·체온 같은 생존 요소와 무기 부착물·탄약 종류·무기 정비 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: Poker Superstars II
input:
You've been invited back for Season 2! Poker Superstars II raises the stakes with more superstars, a bigger tournament and a brand new poker AI. Import your own photo into the game and become a Poker Superstar. Then get ready to battle through an exciting new tournament structure against 15 of poker's top players powered by a 'first of its kind' artificial intelligence system that has learned to win by playing millions of simulated tournaments! The Superstars are ready to win, are you?
It contains these great features:

- Tougher Challenge! First of its kind artificial intelligence system that has taught itself how to play, and how to win.

- Bigger Tournament! You get to play the dynamic and competitive tournament right from the TV show.

- More Superstars! This time, you are one of 16 Poker Superstars.

- Import Your Photo! Be the Poker Superstar you know you are and see yourself right in the game!

- Interactive Opponent Pictures! Now you get to see the Superstars smile devilishly when they beat you, as well as scowl when you beat them!

- Learn or Master! Game Tips will introduce you to the game while the Game Tip button can help you hone your game.

- Amateur or Superstars! Two different levels of challenge let you tune the game to the play level you want.

- Player Cards! The game will track all your winnings, flops seen %, pots won % and best hands. So you'll be able to see what kind of player you are.

- 3 Exciting Game Modes! Round lets you play a quick round. Season challenges you to win the full tournament. Limit lets you play the set bet amount game found frequently in casinos and online.

- Top Ten Lists! Track your top winnings, top pots and top hands.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 15명의 상대 선수와 포커 토너먼트를 벌이며 카드를 플레이한다. 빠른 한 판을 즐기는 Round, 전체 토너먼트 우승을 목표로 하는 Season, 정해진 베팅 금액으로 진행하는 Limit의 세 가지 모드가 있다.
summary.특징: 수백만 회의 시뮬레이션 토너먼트를 통해 학습한 인공지능 시스템을 상대로 하며, 아마추어와 슈퍼스타 두 난이도를 제공한다. 자신의 사진을 게임에 불러올 수 있고, 상대 선수의 반응이 표정 이미지로 표시되며, 상금·본 플롭 비율·승리 팟 비율·최고 핸드 등의 기록과 상위 10위 목록을 추적한다.

name: Boots Versus Plants
input:
Features

- Explore locations with a variety of traps.

- Fight with dangerous mutant plants.

- Infinite Ammo.

- Open doors and mechanisms.

- Save plants from a dangerous virus and keep the balance of power.

- Lots of funny elements and references to popular characters.

Boots Corporation sends a Colonel named "Daisy" to battle with dangerous plants to destroy them all!

Find out the cause of infection and mutations of domestic cacti that have become intelligent monsters.

summary.핵심플레이: 콜로넬 Daisy를 조작해 다양한 함정이 있는 장소를 탐험하고, 변이된 식물 몬스터와 전투를 벌인다. 문과 기계 장치를 작동시키며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 무한 탄약으로 전투하며, 지적 몬스터로 변한 선인장의 감염과 변이 원인을 추적하는 세계관을 다룬다. 인기 캐릭터에 대한 패러디 요소가 포함되어 있다.

name: qop 2
input:
qop 2 is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space. The difficulty increases due to the unique cubes - angular, teleports and lock cubes.

- FullHD
- 60 levels
- Smooth animation
- Pleasant music
- Intuitive interface
- Night mode
- Steam achievements

Controls: WASD, Arrows, gamepad Xbox 360 and Steam Controller
Restart level: R on keyboard, X on controller

"qop" powered by Clickteam Fusion 2.5
Color scheme borrowed from the beautiful game HOOK
Music by Delone

summary.핵심플레이: 4방향 이동을 이용해 큐브를 목표 지점까지 옮긴다. 총 60개의 레벨로 구성되어 있다.
summary.특징: 각진 큐브, 텔레포트 큐브, 잠금 큐브 등 특수 큐브가 등장해 난이도가 올라간다. 야간 모드, Steam 도전 과제, 키보드·게임패드·Steam 컨트롤러 지원을 제공한다.

name: Riding Seas
input:
Riding Seas is a cartoon-style boat racing game that fits into the arcade racing games of the 2000s (WaveRace, Splashdown, ...). A family friendly game, with varied, colorful and fun decorations in which you will find many references to cinema and / or video games.

Warning !! Its colorful graphics hide a tactical game where the gameplay emphasizes piloting, where other games emphasize random bonuses!

The game offers:
8 Low poly environments in various environments: Green Lake, Pirate Bay, Italian Canal, Asian Spring, Jungle Temple, Tropical Island, Artic Challenge, Golden Valley. Each environment offers, in very large stages, 3 courses of increasing difficulty. Each course can be played in mirror mode and at various times of the day so as not to tire the player.

30 boats with a totally crazy look are available and unlockable according to your exploits!

A simple race mode allows you to train on all the races of the game. A career mode allows you to finish first of a certain number of Grand Prix each made up of 4 races with increasing difficulty.

A local multiplayer game mode, up to 4 in split screen, lets you take on your friends in fun games.

You are a competitor and you want to face players from all over the world, nothing could be easier a ghost / time trial mode awaits you and allows you to record your best times for each race and compare them to the best players in the world !!

At your controls! The race has already started!

summary.핵심플레이: 보트를 조종해 코스를 주행하며, 랜덤 보너스보다 조종 실력에 중점을 둔 레이스를 펼친다. 단순 레이스 모드로 연습하고, 커리어 모드에서 4개 레이스로 구성된 그랑프리를 완주해 1위를 노린다.
summary.특징: Green Lake, Pirate Bay, Italian Canal 등 8개의 로우폴리 환경에 각각 난이도가 다른 3개 코스가 있으며, 미러 모드와 다양한 시간대로 플레이할 수 있다. 30종의 잠금 해제형 보트, 최대 4인 화면 분할 로컬 멀티플레이, 기록을 세계 순위와 비교하는 고스트/타임 트라이얼 모드를 제공한다.

name: Arctic Isolation
input:
Arm your starship with the deadly arsenal of your choice. When your ship is ready, head out into outer space, where you will face fierce battles with the enemies of mankind. Only fearless pilots, skillfully manipulating the power of their ship, will be able to withstand in this war for space domination! And let your starship become an intergalactic legend!

Game Features:

- Unique starships and weapons

- Exciting battles in open space

- Dynamic gameplay

summary.핵심플레이: 우주선에 무기를 장착하고 우주 공간으로 나가 적과 전투를 벌인다.
summary.특징: 다양한 우주선과 무기를 선택할 수 있으며, 개방된 우주 공간에서 전투가 진행된다.

name: Calcul8²
input:
Calcul8² is a quick fire number-crunching puzzle game, based on our old friend the calculator and aptly named Calculate Squared.

Successor to the popular original, Calcul8. It's the perfect quick pick-up puzzler.
Super easy to pick up, hard to put down.

The aim is simple, reach 0 by tapping buttons to deduct from the goal number shown on the display.
Playable via mouse, touch screen, or keys.
Keys: arrow keys / wasd to select buttons. Space or Enter to tap the buttons.
Do you have what it takes to master the Calcul8tor?

How to play:

- Play by mouse, touch screen, or keys.

- Reach 0 by tapping numbers to subtract from your goal number.

- Press the 'C' button to clear your selected buttons, or 'CE' to choose a new goal.

- Save / Load using the Disk / Folder icon in the bottom left.

summary.핵심플레이: 화면에 표시된 목표 숫자에서 버튼을 눌러 숫자를 빼며 0에 도달하는 것이 목표다. 마우스, 터치스크린, 키보드로 조작할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 계산기를 모티브로 한 숫자 계산 퍼즐로, 전작 Calcul8의 후속작이다. 'C' 버튼으로 선택을 초기화하고 'CE'로 새 목표를 고를 수 있으며 좌하단 아이콘으로 저장·불러오기가 가능하다.

name: Cluck Yegger in Escape From The Planet of The Poultroid
input:
As space-faring free ranger, Cluck Yegger, you’ve been shot out of the sky by none other than your old arch nemesis, Colonel Zanderz. Your disabled ship is running on limited auxiliary solar power that charges during the daytime. But at night, confined to the cockpit, you must survive unwelcomed visits from a brood of peckish genetically modified poultroid looking for a late night snack. Can you survive seven nights to ESCAPE PLANET POULTROID?



Gameplay:

- Monitor cameras to keep tabs on the advancing poultroid.

- Listen for signs of unseen intruders.

- Activate bright lights to ward-off the nocturnal creatures.

- Activate infrared night vision to stealthily spot critters lurking in and around your ship.

- Seal cockpit doors and shield as a last line of defense.



This is a Five Nights at Freddy's style parody game with some new mechanics, fun artwork, humor and VO based on characters from the upcoming adventure game, SpaceVenture, being released by the Two Guys From Andromeda(original creators of the Space Quest series)



Genre:

Survival horror with a funny, kid-friendly(playtest with ages 10 and up), sci-fi theme.

summary.핵심플레이: 밤 동안 조종석에 갇힌 채 카메라로 접근하는 적을 감시하고, 소리로 침입 징후를 파악하며, 조명과 적외선 야간투시를 사용해 대응한다. 최후의 방어 수단으로 조종석 문과 실드를 봉쇄하며 7일 밤을 버텨 탈출을 시도한다.
summary.특징: Five Nights at Freddy's 방식의 패러디 게임으로, 우주에서 격추된 캐릭터 Cluck Yegger가 유전자 조작된 poultroid의 야간 습격을 막는 SF 세계관을 다룬다. Space Quest 제작자들의 어드벤처 게임 SpaceVenture 캐릭터를 기반으로 한 아트워크와 음성이 포함되어 있다.

name: Pirates Pinball
input:
Dragon Pinball

Titans Pinball

About the Game
Enjoy Pirates Pinball, prepare for an amazing adventure fighting the kings armada and trying to reach tortuga island, to find the biggest treasure of them all. A perfect reproduction of a pinball machine, with all the graphic details and sounds.

Discover all the secrets, find all the missions to unlock all the trophies.

Become number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard.

- Arcade design.
- More than 8 missions to accomplish!
- Multiball, Extraball, Skillshot, Jackpots...
- Reproduction with all the details, lights and sounds.
- 4 different cameras to choose from.
- Online Leaderboard.

summary.핵심플레이: 핀볼 머신을 조작해 볼을 튕기며 미션을 수행하고 점수를 획득한다. 8가지 이상의 미션을 완료하고 트로피를 잠금 해제하며 온라인 리더보드에 점수를 등록한다.
summary.특징: 해적을 테마로 왕의 함대와 싸우고 토르투가 섬의 보물을 찾는 설정이며, 멀티볼, 엑스트라볼, 스킬샷, 잭팟 등의 요소와 4가지 카메라 시점을 제공한다.

name: МЕМОЛОГИЯ
input:
MEMOLOGY is a comprehensive test that shows how deeply you are immersed in the culture of memes. In the game you will find many international, new or already classic memes, such as: Pepe, Dogi and so on, but MEMOLOGY is still recommended for people who are at least a little familiar with the Russian language, as there are a lot of Russian memes and references in the tests.
Gameplay Features

- Wide Putin, Narrow Putin, Dancing Putin

- Cats and other Internet symbols

- Bouncy soundtrack

summary.핵심플레이: 밈 관련 문제를 풀며 인터넷 밈 문화에 대한 지식을 테스트한다.
summary.특징: Pepe, Dogi 등 국제 밈과 다수의 러시아 밈 및 레퍼런스가 포함되며, 고양이 등 인터넷 상징과 사운드트랙이 등장한다. 러시아어를 어느 정도 아는 사람에게 권장된다.

name: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell
input:
SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell is the world’s only competitive heavy metal first-person platformer.
Slice every last millisecond as you race and blast your way through deadly arenas. Teleport, jump, fly, bounce and drop in a hundred merciless and fast paced maps for the ultimate prize: Your soul!

Marty was having a late morning breakfast and minding his own business. The demon knocking on the door wasn’t part of his morning routine. Before Marty was able to open, the hell breed smashed in the doors. A fierce brawl commenced and Marty lost his right arm – but at least the demon also lost his head. Unfortunately, whilst the brawl erupted more demons entered his garage and stole his last batch of limited edition Walrus Ale (tm). Now Marty has become furious! He ripped off the demon’s arm and did some DIY to re-attach his arm back to himself. This demon is no looker but gee it casts some nasty fireballs. Marty’s (after)life now has a single purpose: Go to hell and get his beer back! \m/

Like a bastard child of Quake 3 and Super Meat Boy, SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell is truly hardcore and focuses on speed and fast reaction. Race and jump over platforms and bounce pads and shoot fireballs to reach an exit portal in the minimal amount of time. Reverse time and gravity. Compete with all players for the top time in the online high scores. Only the toughest players will receive the Uber Skull medals!

If mind blowing speed and pumping adrenaline through your body is too boring, then search for the beer cans deeply hidden in each level. Who knows which secrets can be discovered by finding all of these delicious refreshments?
Features

- Can’t get much more old school than this!

- 100 levels, each more devilish than the last, with secrets around every corner.

- Shoot fireballs, reverse gravity, teleport and dodge obstacles to solve challenges.

- Leaderboards in each level so you can see how you fare against your friends (and enemies).

- An original soundtrack that'll make you rampage through the levels with blazing speed.

- Level editor

- 666

Warning: SEUM has been known to cause leaning disease. Symptoms are irrational leaning forward towards your screen when making difficult jumps. Smashing monitors with your head is not a way to beat the game!

summary.핵심플레이: 플랫폼과 점프대를 넘고 파이어볼을 쏘며 최소 시간 안에 출구 포탈에 도달하는 것을 반복한다. 텔레포트, 중력 반전, 시간 되돌리기 등을 활용해 장애물을 피하며 기록 단축을 노린다.
summary.특징: 악마에게 팔과 맥주를 빼앗긴 Marty가 지옥으로 향한다는 설정으로, 100개의 레벨과 각 레벨에 숨겨진 맥주캔 및 비밀 요소가 있다. 레벨별 온라인 순위표, 헤비메탈 사운드트랙, 레벨 에디터를 제공한다.

name: FatSheep Crisis II
input:
A casual roguelite game featuring a rich variety of classes, a vast array of equipment, and different types of enemies. After defeating a certain number of enemies, your class will randomly switch, with each class having multiple variants, each offering unique skills. You can fight solo, or invite friends to join your game or team up with other players online. Experience different classes, explore numerous skills, uncover hidden content, and find the equipment that best suits your playstyle. Defeat the final boss and enjoy the thrill of cooperative gameplay as you and your team conquer the game together!

------------------------------Class------------------------------

The game offers a wide variety of classes to play, with each class having 15 different variants, and each variant's skills come with different enhancements.

summary.장르: 로그라이트, 액션, 어드벤처, 캐주얼, RPG, 전략
summary.핵심플레이: 적을 처치하며 진행하고, 일정 수의 적을 물리치면 직업이 무작위로 전환된다. 다양한 직업과 스킬, 장비를 활용해 전투를 이어가고 최종 보스를 처치하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 각 직업마다 15가지 변형이 있으며 변형별 스킬에 서로 다른 강화가 적용된다. 솔로 플레이와 함께 친구 초대나 온라인 협동 플레이를 지원한다.

name: Incremental Epic Hero
input:
Japanese Anime Incremental Idle RPG!
We reached one million plays on Kongregate and now release on Steam!
Features
Various Upgrades:
Generate three different resources more efficiently!
Attractive Skills:
The three cute characters have various attractive skills! Spend resources on them to be more strong! You can put any skill in the skill slot and build your own skill set!
Vast Explorable Areas:
Journey through the world and encounter all kinds of monsters that will do all that they can to end you quickly. Overcome the obstacles and you will unlock new areas to explore!
Crafting:
Kill monsters, collect materials and make a lot of equipment! You can also create various potions with alchemy!
Rebirth:
You can rebirth into a new class! Rebirth is a prestige mechanic that provides you access to powerful upgrades that will increase your overall power and how quickly you are able to progress through the game!
Boss Battle:
Powerful monsters stand in your way. You have to develop a plan to defeat them with your skills and equipment!

There are many more Incremental elements in the game. As the game progresses, more and more contents will be unlocked!
Controls
Mouse click to play!
Upgrades unlock as you progress. Make sure to read the tool-tips for more info or refer to the in-game help found in the System menu.
Hotkey
- "Shift-L” to enable/disable Loot Logs
- “Shift-P” to turn on/off Performance Mode
- “Shift-T” to enable/disable all Tool-tips
- “Shift-B” to enable/disable all attack animations in the battle field

We are Japanese game developer team Hapiwaku Project!
Hapiwaku means "Happy and Excited" in Japanese.
We hope you are so happy and excited through playing IEH!
We are very small team. The developers are only 2 university students.
Most of the art work in the game are drawn by my 13-year-old daughter.
We write the stories behind the development on our website :)

- Discord Community
- Twitter
- Wiki
- Website
- Our another game "Incremental Epic Breakers"

summary.핵심플레이: 마우스 클릭으로 자원을 모으고 업그레이드와 스킬을 강화하며, 몬스터를 처치해 새로운 지역을 탐험하고 재료를 수집한다. 장비 제작과 연금술로 아이템을 만들며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 세 명의 캐릭터에게 스킬 슬롯을 자유롭게 구성할 수 있으며, 환생 시스템으로 새로운 클래스와 강력한 업그레이드를 해금한다. 보스전과 다양한 인크리멘탈 요소가 있고, 진행할수록 콘텐츠가 추가로 개방된다.

name: Lesbian Voyeur Simulator 2
input:
Content warning:This game contains lesbian, futanari and shemale explicit sexual content.

All characters depicted are 18 or older.

Unlock collectables

Earn coins to unlock hairstyles, learn new positions and get accessories for your girls.

summary.핵심플레이: 코인을 모아 헤어스타일, 새로운 포즈, 캐릭터용 액세서리 등 수집 요소를 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 레즈비언, 후타나리 등 성적 콘텐츠를 포함하며 등장 캐릭터는 모두 18세 이상으로 설정되어 있다.

name: Under the Table
input:
Your regular workday is about to turn into a giant nightmare.

Experience shrinking horror game in an expansive visual novel.

It’s Monday morning and you’re bored at your desk – until your wicked manager shrinks you. Now, you’re only a few inches tall and discovering your coworkers are very dangerous people.

Trapped in an oversized office, you have to run, fight and talk your way past a cast of enormous giantesses (and a giant!) by making one perilous decision after another.

This long-anticipated fully illustrated adaptation of the popular interactive book by the same name is set to include:

-
8 major characters to encounter + 3 minor appearances!

-
Over 1,000 images

-
Over 60,000 words of dialogue/narrative text

-
20 mini-animation cutscenes

-
Play as male or female

-
An office of environments to explore

-
Ways to shrink every character

-
Ways to get eaten by every major character (and more!)

-
Multiple paths to survival, many more paths to doom, but only one route to success!

Get ready for a fast-paced, immersive literary maze packed with chills. Every chapter presents a choice where the slightest wrong move could spell your demise. Can you survive Under the Table?

summary.핵심플레이: 매니저에 의해 몇 인치 크기로 줄어든 주인공이 되어 사무실을 탐험하고, 각 챕터마다 선택지를 고르며 거대한 인물들을 상대로 도망치거나 싸우거나 대화해 생존을 시도한다.
summary.특징: 동명의 인터랙티브 북을 각색한 작품으로, 남성 또는 여성 캐릭터를 선택할 수 있으며 8명의 주요 인물과 다수의 결말 경로, 1,000장 이상의 이미지와 20개의 미니 애니메이션 컷신을 포함한다. 잘못된 선택 시 캐릭터에게 잡아먹히는 등 다양한 실패 경로가 존재한다.

name: Museum No.9
input:
Bug reporting / Official Q&A / Optimization suggestions / Venting and communication
Official game community：

Welcome to the era of human civilization's the magical civilization where you will be reborn from the ashes, you will manage an 'Old World' museum. As the museum expands and delves deeper into the 'Old World,' what kind of life will you lead in the new world, and what kind of conclusion will you face...?

Free expansion + rich furniture system.You can choose any style to build your museum.

summary.핵심플레이: '구세계'의 유물을 다루는 박물관을 운영하며, 박물관을 확장하고 '구세계'를 더 깊이 탐구해 나간다.
summary.특징: 인류 문명 이후의 마법 문명 시대를 배경으로 하며, 자유로운 확장과 가구 시스템을 통해 원하는 양식으로 박물관을 꾸밀 수 있다.

name: Creatures Of War
input:
Electrifying Combat:
Unleash the power of your arsenal. Swiftly dodge your foe's attack and counter with a shotgun blast to the face. Scope in from distance and blast your enemy into ruin with a bolt action rifle. Flanked from two sides? Freeze your enemies in place with a cryogrenade and mow down the opposing enemies with an automatic 20MM grenade launcher. The combinations are endless.

Explore Ko'Verest Island:
Every biome that you'll visit is ruggedly unique and tough, bursting with new creatures, treasures, and secrets to uncover. But Be Warned: Some secrets are better off left alone.

Unravel The Truth:
Across the island's luscious landscape lies an expansive network of abandoned buildings. You have been sent in to investigate the island as well as the disappearance of Delta squad. As the fierce combat operative Mike Ludwig, it is up to you to uncover the tragic events that took place and to conquer its evils.

Ascend Your Weaponry:
Collect treasures and currency to fund weapon upgrades that will tear down even the biggest enemies. Sometimes all you need is a little extra firepower.
The Story:

Delta squad has been sent in to investigate the Satellite Images of a remote island in the Gulf of Terhana.

Sometime in the middle of the night, Delta Squad's helicopter went…. Missing. Fear is spreading that the helicopter was shot down. Their safety is now seriously in question. Mike Ludwig has been sent in to rescue any surviving members of Delta squad. During his stay, Mike hopes to unravel the mystery behind Ko'Verest island.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Mike Ludwig를 조작해 회피와 다양한 무기(샷건, 볼트액션 소총, 냉동 수류탄, 20MM 자동 유탄발사기 등)로 적과 전투한다. 보물과 화폐를 모아 무기를 업그레이드하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: Ko'Verest 섬의 서로 다른 바이옴을 탐험하며 버려진 건물과 비밀을 조사한다. 실종된 Delta 분대를 수색하고 섬에서 벌어진 사건의 진실을 밝혀 나가는 스토리를 담고 있다.

name: A Café Couple's Joyful Life of Resistance
input:
"UC Disease! A Café Couple's Joyful Life of Resistance" is an RPG game produced by 神聖田中帝国 and published by Hanabi games.

Meet Lize and Auran, the proud owners of Cava's cafe! Their life seems perfect, but suddenly Auran becomes the victim of an incident involving an unicorn and gets infected with Unicorn disease. Find a cure for Auran and explore the town of Pachi in this lightweight and exciting visual novel!

-
Jrpg

-
Puzzle-solving

-
Captivating story

summary.핵심플레이: 카페를 운영하는 Lize와 Auran을 중심으로 이야기를 진행하며, Pachi 마을을 탐험하고 퍼즐을 풀어 Auran의 치료법을 찾는다.
summary.특징: 유니콘 사건으로 Unicorn disease에 걸린 Auran의 치료를 찾는 스토리를 다루는 경량형 비주얼 노벨로, 神聖田中帝国이 제작하고 Hanabi games가 배급했다.

name: Point Perfect
input:
The planet is being attacked and it will take a bodaciously bad-ass cursor pilot to blast the scum to whence it came! Dodge, dip, duck, click and point your way to glory in the most gnarly retro-arcade death trap that you are likely to ever play! Point Perfect will put that "I'm a real PC gamer" attitude to the ultimate test and might make you cry a little in the process. But fear not young pilot, because with great challenge comes even greater glory and nerdy bragging rights! For a select few it will even mean graduating from the prestigious Point Perfect University of Aeronautics. Which of course includes a printable diploma that you can hang on your wall to make Mom proud!
Features

- Procedurally generated levels means no game is quite the same!

- Over 20 bosses that can evolve new attacks and patterns for you to adapt.

- 24 trophies to unlock as well as a secret game mode.

- Get trolled! Point Perfect will test you to the limit and make fun of you if you fail!

- Steam achievements

- Trading cards

summary.핵심플레이: 커서를 조종해 적을 피하고 클릭하여 공격하며 진행하는 레트로 아케이드 게임이다. 절차적으로 생성되는 레벨과 보스를 상대로 반응 속도와 정확도를 요구한다.
summary.특징: 매번 다르게 구성되는 절차적 생성 레벨과 새로운 공격 패턴으로 진화하는 20종 이상의 보스가 있으며, 24개의 트로피와 비밀 게임 모드, Steam 도전 과제 및 트레이딩 카드를 제공한다. 실패 시 플레이어를 놀리는 요소가 포함된다.

name: Distorted Echos
input:
Development Update, Extensive Changes

Massive Development Update: Jan 2024

- Co-op Multiplayer Support is being added to the game, at the current development roadmap players will be able to have a party of 3 people to co-op with

- Full Item Crafting System Has been Added to the game, Players now are able to Craft more advanced items from the primary items they find in the game. Crafting Can be conducted using different fabricators. Fabricators have different number of item slots depending on the type of fabricator. Over 70 new items have been added to the game and craft system, including different types of projectiles, Spears, Mines, build structures such as walls, Platforms, Stairs, Power generating items such as Fuels, Electric generators and many more.

- Full mining system has been added to the game, Players now Can mine resources to craft items

- Day/Night Cycle, Dynamic Weather System, Environmental Hazards and other Dynamic Environment elements have been added to the game, Players now have a clock indicating the current time of day. Realtime Sunset and sunrise with dynamic change of Day/Night visual Effects. Environmental Hazards Such as Sandstorm, Acid rain and Meteor shower have been added, As well as shelters to shield from such hazards

- Vehicles have been added to the game, Players are now able to use vehicles such as Hovercrafts to and Rover to navigate through the map.some vehicles require power, fuel and some can carry multiple players, hook other items, attach weapons and so on.

- Player Ability system has been added to the game, Player now can Slide, use jetpacks, extract minerals, Use scanner and have different types of close and long range attacks, with new weapons and new AI NPCs to fight with

The biggest Update so far is under development, Stay Tuned for more, more than 70 Items are to be added to the game. A list of the developed items will be released in a patch note soon.

About the Game
After crashing into an Alien planet called Yolk, You find yourself oblivious and left alone with your AI companion , Find your way through the unknown, discover the mysteries of Yolk and find out what happened to you and everyone else!

In this action-adventure experience, players find themselves stranded in an alien planet called Yolk,
The main objective of this game is to survive harsh threats of the Yolk and uncover the protagonist's lost memories, players will face numerous threats including Alien species ,Cyborgs, Drones, Anomaly entities, Corrupted Robots which once were used to serve human scientists on Yolk research stations. Moreover, there are numerous unknown mysteries and hidden threats waiting to be discovered.

summary.핵심플레이: 외계 행성 Yolk에 불시착한 주인공이 AI 동반자와 함께 자원을 채굴하고 아이템을 제작하며, 외계 생물·사이보그·드론·부패한 로봇 등의 위협에 맞서 생존하고 잃어버린 기억을 찾아 나선다.
summary.특징: 주야 순환과 모래폭풍·산성비·유성우 같은 환경 재해가 있는 동적 환경, 70종 이상의 제작 아이템과 채굴·제작 시스템, 호버크래프트·로버 등 탈것, 슬라이딩·제트팩·스캐너 등 플레이어 능력을 갖추고 있으며 최대 3인 협동 멀티플레이가 개발 중이다.

name: Bassline Sinker
input:
Bassline Sinker is a Shooter / Bullet hell that responds to your music.

This arcade shooter takes in any .mp3 / .wav file, the game then changes and reacts in real time to the audio. Your weapons, enemies and the environment all react differently to the music making every song flow differently in the game.

The game is set in an underwater seascape, with the player taking control of “Ruby” the manta ray. However, many other sea creatures also use the power of the music to fight against Ruby. Eels that surround her, angler fish that lure her in and Squids which shoot Ink bombs at her.

Bassline Sinker was made by a single Developer. Programming, Art, Design, Publishing were all done by Sean Fitzgerald. Fonts, SFX and preinstalled music were sourced from the public domain.
Key Features

- Everything reacts to the music playing.

- Support for both .mp3 and .wav files.

- Unlockable weapons.

- 50 Unlockable skins.

- Many enemy types.

- Several Boss enemies.

- Steam Achievements.

Adding Music
To add music to the game, you must navigate to the MyMusic folder and copy any music files to "Bassline_Sinker_Music".

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 만타가오리 'Ruby'를 조작해 적을 처치하는 아케이드 슈팅을 진행하며, 무기·적·환경이 재생 중인 음악에 실시간으로 반응한다. 뱀장어, 아귀, 잉크 폭탄을 쏘는 오징어 등 다양한 적과 여러 보스를 상대한다.
summary.특징: .mp3 및 .wav 파일을 불러와 곡에 맞춰 게임 요소가 실시간으로 변화하며, 해저를 배경으로 한다. 해금 가능한 무기와 50종의 스킨, 스팀 도전 과제를 지원하고 MyMusic 폴더에 파일을 복사해 음악을 추가할 수 있다.

name: 蘑菇庄园（Mushroom Manor）
input:
Mushroom Manor is a casual idle farm game that sits at the bottom of your screen, offering gentle company as you work or study.

In the manor, you can purchase mushroom spores and cultivate adorable, whimsical mushrooms. Each mushroom carries a unique meaning and brings with it a heartfelt blessing.

You can fertilize, water, and remove pests to care for them as they grow. Of course, you can also hire little sprites and install beehives to help you manage your mushroom garden.

🌟 Mushroom Introductions 🌟

-
Flamelight Mushroom: Good fortune always, and a heart that burns bright
The passionate fire within you never fades. Like the blazing glow of the Flamelight Mushroom, it drives away all gloom—each day is full of energy and courage, and everywhere you go becomes a warm little universe.

-
Twilight Shroom: Gentle dusk, serenity everlasting
The gentleness of twilight always surrounds you. Like the soft halo of the Twilight Shroom, it brings calm and healing every evening, filling life’s quiet corners with poetry and beauty.

-
Glimmercap: Sparkling thoughts, wisdom in hand
Even in dark corners, the Glimmercap’s gentle light shines your way. In loneliness, there is companionship; in confusion, there is clarity.

-
Shadowfungus: Secrets hidden, blessings revealed
Surprises abound in your life. Hidden joys bloom from the unknown, and in calm days, you stumble upon delightful wonders. Every exploration brings unexpected happiness.

-
Nightlight Mushroom: Companion of the night, peaceful dreams
You have a gentle harbor to rest in. When tired, there's a warm corner to lean on; when lonely, there's soft, adorable company. Every night is kissed softly by starlight.

-
Snowveil Cap: Snow sweeps the dust, immune to all ills
Your world is as pure as fresh snow. Worries are brushed away by icy threads, heat is dispelled by coolness, and you embrace life with a heart forever pure.

-
Thornshade Shroom: Through thorns to the stars
Protected by purple light and shielded by brambles, your armor is tenderness. You move forward without fear, yet never lose your warmth.

-
Crimson Pearl Mushroom: Honest heart, brilliance all around
You shine like a precious gem. Confidence lights your path, and your energy never fades. Whatever you do, it radiates dazzling brilliance.

-
Venomkiss Mushroom: Immune to harm, evil repelled
Your calm days hide a mischievous spark. Laughter and surprises never cease. Every moment is vivid and full of life.

-
Glassglow Shroom: Clear as crystal, loyal friends never part
Your life shines like the seven-colored brilliance of the Glassglow Shroom. Beauty in your eyes, light in your heart—what you see is gentle, and where you walk is smooth.

-
Silentbloom Fungus: Quiet as heaven’s song, blooming within
Inside you lies great strength. In solitude, you're not truly alone. In doubt, you find direction. The years leave you with only gentleness and resilience.

-
Frostveil Mushroom: Frost-honed will, blooming brilliance
You're as clear and composed as frost. In heat, you find coolness; in chaos, you find calm. Every step of your journey blooms with flowers and reveals new scenery.

-
Blazefeather Mushroom: Passion ablaze, soaring high
You're as fiery and free as a flame, soaring toward your dreams with passion that never dies. Every flight is a step toward your heart’s true desire.

-
Dreamweave Shroom: Dreams as silk, souls intertwined
Good luck weaves sweet dreams for you. At night, there's a soft dreamland to return to; by day, courage to lean on. Every morning brings renewed energy and luck.

-
Skyshade Cap: Endless blue sky, bold dreams await
The blue sky forever shields you. Everything you see is bright and hopeful. Worries drift away like clouds, and joy shines like eternal starlight.

-
Bluewave Mushroom: Walking the waves, boundless skies ahead
The ocean and stars gift you with a vast heart. You meet challenges with calm like waves and clarity like stars. Each step is steady and free.

-
Moontide Shroom: Love’s ties endure, hearts intertwined
Moonlight and lakewater nourish your soul—gentle as moonlight, enduring as flowing water. Life ripples with romance at every turn.

-
Charmkiss Mushroom: Naturally enchanting, turning heads everywhere
Mystical blessings follow you. Every attempt is touched with luck, and every effort is loved by magic. Wherever you go, opportunity finds you.

-
Stardew Cap: Stars as companions, a dazzling path ahead
The galaxy lights your journey. At night, stars guide your way; by day, courage protects you. Life is as radiant as the Milky Way, and every star is a shining dream.

-
Phantom Night Mushroom: Dazzling illusions, fortune ahead
You will break free from the ordinary. Life becomes a dream of delightful surprises—each turn brings new wonders, and every day is your most beautiful yet!

summary.핵심플레이: 버섯 포자를 구매해 심고, 비료 주기, 물 주기, 해충 제거로 버섯을 키우며 성장시킨다. 요정을 고용하거나 벌집을 설치해 버섯 정원 관리를 돕게 할 수 있다.

name: Nyric
input:
Prompt your world. Survive your creation. Discover your dream.

Nyric is a third-person survivalcraft where every session begins with a simple prompt—and ends with a dream you and your friends will never forget. Type a phrase to generate an entire chain of worlds and then explore it, survive its hazards, discover AI companions, and make tough choices about who you take with you … and who you leave behind.

From lava-choked ruins to crystal fields or just beautiful Mediterranean landscapes, Nyric creates fully-playable, unique realms from players answering one single question:

“How did your dream begin?”

Prompt. Survive. Discover. Thrive. Repeat.

Each Nyric session is a chain of dream realms shaped by your own words. Your goal is to survive long enough to keep moving forward—and wake up with a story worth telling.

-
Prompt: Start by entering a prompt. From that, Nyric will build a custom realm with its own hazards, climate, areas to discover, and unique Faebot companions.

-
Survive: Manage extreme weather, navigate alien terrain, and deploy your Faebots’ abilities to overcome threats.

-
Discover: Explore and find secret areas of your realm—graveyards, ruins, trash heaps, radioactive pits—and locate special Faebots hidden within.

-
Thrive: Build a base and establish a safe haven. Power your base with your companions. Open the portal to the next dream… and decide who you leave behind.

summary.핵심플레이: 프롬프트를 입력해 생성된 월드를 3인칭 시점으로 탐험하며, 기후와 지형 등의 위협을 관리하고 생존한다. 기지를 건설하고 Faebot 동료의 능력을 활용해 위협에 대처하며 다음 세계로 향하는 포탈을 연다.
summary.특징: 플레이어가 입력한 문구로 매 세션마다 지형·기후·위험 요소가 다른 월드가 생성되며, 이렇게 이어지는 여러 꿈의 세계를 진행한다. 각 세계에서 무덤, 폐허, 방사능 구덩이 같은 숨겨진 구역과 특수 Faebot 동료를 발견하고, 다음 세계로 갈 때 누구를 데려가고 남길지 선택한다.

name: BENDERMAN VR
input:
Dive into a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of gaming with BENDERMAN VR, an immersive virtual reality puzzle game that combines the charm of classic 2D pipe-building games from the 80s and 90s with the cutting-edge technology of today. Get ready to unleash your inner engineer as you tackle intricate piping challenges, racing against the clock to create the perfect connections before water comes rushing through!



Key Features:



🔧 Innovative VR Puzzles: Immerse yourself in a world where creativity and quick thinking are your greatest assets. With intuitive controls and lifelike interactions, you'll use a dynamic pipe bender or your strategic prowess to bend, twist, and shape pipes exactly the way you need them.



🌊 Race Against Time: The pressure is on! Each level presents you with a unique space and a complex piping puzzle. As you bend and twist pipes to create the connections, the clock is ticking. Complete your pipeline masterpiece before the water starts flowing, or brace for a watery disaster!



🔩 Collect Golden Wrenches: Put your puzzle-solving skills to the test and collect coveted golden wrenches scattered throughout the levels. Show off your expertise by finding hidden secrets and unlockable paths to earn extra points and rewards.



⏳ Stay Within the Pipe Limit: Think you've mastered the art of bending pipes? Think again! To earn maximum points, you'll need to demonstrate not only your creative engineering but also your resourcefulness. Stay under the set pipe limit to truly prove your mastery and earn the Pipe Picasso Ribbon.



🎮 Retro Aesthetic: Relive the glory of the past with our meticulously designed 80s and 90s retro style. From the graphics to the sound effects, BENDERMAN VR captures the essence of classic gaming, offering a delightful callback to the games that started it all.



Get ready to twist, bend, and craft your way to pipeline perfection in BENDERMAN VR! Whether you're a fan of old-school puzzle games, a VR enthusiast looking for a unique challenge, or simply someone who enjoys a dose of nostalgia, this game is designed to captivate and entertain. Are you up for the challenge? Can you keep the water at bay? The pipes are waiting, and time is ticking!



Join Virtual Dawn Games Discord server for more info about our releases and the chance to influence the development of our titles.

https://discord.gg/39pXGj2c93

summary.핵심플레이: 제한 시간 안에 파이프를 구부리고 연결해 물이 흐르기 전에 배관을 완성하는 퍼즐을 풀며, 각 레벨마다 주어진 공간에서 연결 경로를 만든다.
summary.특징: 80~90년대 2D 파이프 연결 게임을 VR로 재구성했으며, 레트로풍 그래픽과 사운드를 사용한다. 레벨에 숨겨진 황금 렌치를 수집하고 정해진 파이프 개수 제한 이내로 완성하면 추가 점수와 보상을 얻는다.

name: Block Sprawl
input:
Block Sprawl: A City Planner Deck Builder

Build your dream city from the ground up! Sprawl combines the classic, strategic fun of Tetris with the deep city-building mechanics inspired by Foundations of Rome and Urban Sprawl. Every decision matters, and every choice shapes your bustling metropolis in this single-player, deck-building strategy game.

Key Features:

-
Card-Driven Strategy: Draw Permit, Plot, and Action Cards to drive your city planning. Use Permits to construct CIVIC, RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, and INDUSTRIAL buildings, each with unique combinations and synergies.

-
Tetris-Like Building Challenges: Place buildings of varying shapes on a grid-based city map. Master the puzzle-like placement rules to maximize your city’s layout.

-
Dynamic Scoring System: Every turn matters! Points are calculated based on the adjacency bonuses, and prestige is awarded for completing rows and columns with aligned building types. Find the perfect balance to maximize your city's prestige.

-
Action Cards for Dynamic Play: Unlock powerful abilities that can trigger throughout your turn—from gaining extra coins to free placements and lingering effects that last multiple rounds.

-
Deep Choices and Urgent Challenges: You’re racing against an ever-growing list of demands. Every time you end your turn, adversarial effects impact your city, keeping you on your toes and making each choice count.

Plot, build, strategize, and expand in Sprawl, a unique blend of deck-building strategy, puzzle-solving, and city-building. Your city’s success lies in your hands. Will you create the next metropolis or end up sprawled out?

Wishlist now and prepare to reshape the skyline!

summary.핵심플레이: 허가·부지·행동 카드를 뽑아 그리드 기반 도시 지도에 다양한 형태의 시민, 주거, 상업, 산업 건물을 배치하며 도시를 확장한다. 인접 보너스와 행·열 완성을 고려해 배치를 최적화하고 매 턴 점수를 쌓는다.
summary.특징: 테트리스식 블록 배치와 덱빌딩 전략을 결합했으며, 행동 카드로 추가 자원 획득이나 무료 배치 같은 효과를 발동한다. 턴을 종료할 때마다 늘어나는 요구 사항과 방해 효과가 적용되는 1인용 게임이다.

name: Wondership Q
input:
Wondership Q, released as Airship Q for PS Vita, is a 2D action RPG with sandbox elements. You play as the protagonist of this story who’s suddenly been turned into a cat by a witch. Not only that, but now it’s your job to save your kidnapped brother. Fly through the air on your very own airship, solve mysteries, and craft until your heart’s content!



Development of Wondership Q started with just 3 people full of passion. Thanks to the support of many, this game gained successful crowd-funding at a service called Makuake in 2013, and from there it just kept growing and growing. Get ready to take yourself on an amazing adventure!



Features



Craft, Craft, Craft Away!

Creativity is the key to exploring and surviving this vast world. You’ll need to get really inventive to work your way out of some sticky situations. Let your imagination run wild!



Use the Natural World to Your Advantage

Rain falls, water flows, plants grow, and fire burns... Use your knowledge of the natural world as you run, jump, fly, dig, build, fight, and more! Your actions create a unique world you could never have imagined.



Enjoy Nostalgic Pixel Art

Wondership Q is full of gorgeous pixel art, reminiscent of classic and beloved retro games, but with modern gameplay.



Create Your Own Worlds!

Not only is there an RPG-like story mode, there is also a world creation mode where you can create your very own stages. Then, place start and goal flags in the world you’ve created in challenge mode! See if you can defeat your own imagination.

summary.핵심플레이: 마녀에 의해 고양이로 변한 주인공이 되어 자신의 비행선을 타고 하늘을 날며, 달리고 점프하고 파고 짓고 싸우며 세계를 탐험한다. 다양한 상황을 해결하기 위해 제작을 활용하고 납치된 형제를 구한다.
summary.특징: 비, 물의 흐름, 식물의 성장, 불의 확산 등 자연 요소를 활용하는 시스템과 레트로풍 픽셀 아트를 사용한다. RPG 스토리 모드 외에 직접 스테이지를 만들고 시작·목표 지점을 배치해 도전하는 월드 제작 모드를 제공한다.

name: ШП - ShP
input:
Incomprehensible interface errative puzzle game. No instructions!
This product includes 3 different puzzles.

Features:
- Native Windows Forms interface.
- The goal of each of these errative puzzle games is to set all the flags and then perform the final control activation, typically a scrollbar movement.
- All the flags are hinted in a message box which is shown by pressing a certain button in a previously unknown place.
- Every game has a way to close itself unexpectedly - this is a gameover and you have to restart it manually.
- Some controls reset your progress, but sometimes it is necessary to advance.
- In the end, the game also closes itself. There is only one way to finish each puzzle.
