Release: 28.07.2011 0:00 / 17.06.2011 21:31 (some kind of a time paradox)

Clicks to solve: ???

summary.핵심플레이: 안내 없이 낯선 인터페이스에서 숨겨진 버튼과 컨트롤을 조작해 모든 플래그를 설정한 뒤 스크롤바 이동 같은 최종 조작을 수행해 각 퍼즐을 해결한다. 일부 컨트롤은 진행을 초기화하며, 특정 조작 실패 시 게임이 갑자기 종료되어 수동으로 재시작해야 한다.
summary.특징: Windows Forms 기반 인터페이스를 사용하는 3종의 퍼즐로 구성되며, 각 퍼즐에는 해결 경로가 하나뿐이다. 완료 시 게임이 스스로 종료되고, ШП-7을 실행한 상태에서 ШП-8을 실행하면 ШП-87이 활성화되는 등 실행 조건에 따른 숨겨진 요소가 있다.

name: Fractured Blooms
input:
Game Description

Inspired by a true story.

Restore your neglected house to its former glory by growing crops, cooking delicious meals, learning new recipes, and taking care of its inhabitants in this psychological life sim!

Play as Angie, a girl who finds herself stuck in a time loop and a world that is soft and still. Every loop is a strategic game of resource management and discovery. Plan each day carefully to manage your food and stamina. Only by mastering your routine and finding ways around challenging tasks can you dig deeper into the blessed reality around you.

Something will shift with each new day. You’ll begin to notice. You’ll begin to remember. You’ll begin to see. You’ll begin to feel. Your actions matter, your actions always matter, and the cycle always remembers.

summary.핵심플레이: Angie를 조작해 방치된 집을 복원하며 작물 재배, 요리, 레시피 습득, 거주자 돌보기를 수행한다. 식량과 스태미나 등 자원을 관리하며 하루 일과를 계획하고, 반복되는 루프 속에서 과제를 해결해 나간다.
summary.특징: 시간 루프에 갇힌 세계를 배경으로 한 심리적 라이프 시뮬레이션으로, 매 루프마다 변화가 생기고 플레이어의 행동이 순환 속에 기억되어 이야기가 전개된다. 실화에서 영감을 받았다.

name: EPΘCH
input:
FEATURES:

Brave unforgiving dungeons, discover lost cities, and explore crumbling catacombs as you unravel the mysteries buried across EPΘCH's multiple play-throughs.

EPΘCH's world has been carefully crafted using a combination of environmental narrative and exposition to layer rich detail into every nook and cranny. The world is jam-packed with hidden content and recursive design to ensure that each playthrough is more rewarding than the last.

EPΘCH features an expansive hour and a half long OST comprising of 43 custom composed tracks; each meticulously crafted to enhance the experience of each zone and boss battle.

EPΘCH has a very deep customization system allowing you to create a unique character.

Prepare yourself; the challenges that await will certainly kill you many times. EPΘCH firmly believes in "tough but fair" design principles, where each death is intended to be a learning experience for the player.

If you do find yourself overwhelmed, EPΘCH's internet multiplayer functionality ensures that you will have no shortage of allies to brave the challenges that await within!

summary.핵심플레이: 던전과 지하묘지, 폐허가 된 도시를 탐험하며 세계에 얽힌 수수께끼를 풀어나간다. 반복 플레이를 전제로 하며, 여러 번의 죽음을 통해 학습하는 난이도 높은 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 환경 서사와 설명을 결합해 숨겨진 콘텐츠와 재귀적 구조를 담은 세계관을 제공하며, 43곡으로 구성된 약 1시간 30분 분량의 오리지널 사운드트랙과 깊이 있는 캐릭터 커스터마이징 시스템, 인터넷 멀티플레이 기능을 갖췄다.

name: Call of Farming : Together
input:
Call of Farming: Together is a farming simulation where you can create your own farm online with your friends.

You can mutually expand your farm either on the local network or in the lobby. It includes an inventory, crafts, buildings, growing plants, farm animals and much more.

İncludes everything you need in a farming simulation themed build. Add new items, structures, plants and animals, customize it according to your needs and have fun with your friends.

Lobby Server

The lobby server can be hosted online and helps players find each other and connect to a game rather than connecting directly by IP address.

Gameplay Features

- Controls: Mouse, Keyboard,

- Inventory system

- Crafting system

- Character Equipment

- Resource gathering

- Character traits (health, hunger, thirst...)

- Animal behavior (wandering, running away, chasing)

- Hunting and Fishing

- Farming (hoeing, irrigation, planting seeds and growing plants)

- Food and cooking

- Melee and Ranged attacks

- Product durability and food spoilage

- Storage boxes (chest)

- Domestic animals (chasing, attacking and digging behaviors)

- Level system and XP

- Bonus effects (Consumable or equipment).

- Heat, cold and heat sources.

- Customizable Actions

- Game clock, day/night cycle

- In-game chat

Art

- Animated characters (male and female)

- Animated animals (cow, sheep, chicken, pig, deer, bear, squirrel, bird...)

- Base material (wood, grass, rock, straw...)

- Gathering tools (hoe, scythe, axe, pickaxe, fishing rod,...)

- Food (fruits, apples, nuts, meat, fish, ...)

- Cooked foods (tacos, popcorn, bread...)

- Constructions (fences, barbecue, crate...)

- Environment (trees, bushes, rocks, ground patterns...)

- Agricultural plants (strawberry, pumpkin, pepper, tomato, wheat...)

- Town models (lamp, bench, houses, shop stand...)

- All 2D icons for interactive models

summary.핵심플레이: 자원을 채집하고 밭을 갈아 씨앗을 심고 작물을 키우며, 사냥·낚시·요리·제작과 건물 건설을 수행한다. 로컬 네트워크나 로비 서버를 통해 친구들과 함께 온라인으로 농장을 확장한다.
summary.특징: 인벤토리, 제작, 캐릭터 장비, 체력·허기·갈증 등 특성, 레벨과 경험치 시스템, 낮과 밤 순환, 게임 내 채팅을 포함한다. 소·양·닭·돼지·사슴·곰 등 애니메이션 동물과 다양한 작물, 도구, 건축물을 커스터마이즈할 수 있다.

name: Pretty Kitty Fuzzy
input:
Pretty Kitty Fuzzy is a fast paced "bullet-hell" shoot-em-up! Travel through nine imaginative stages and defeat the evil snake witch Anguis. With nostalgic graphics and an awesome soundtrack this game is the prettiest experience around!
STORY CAMPAIGN
Join Fuzzy on her adventure to defeat the evil snake witch Anguis through 9 intense stages with multiple endings!
HI-POINT HERO!
A score attack mode where you try to get the highest score you can in one shot. Think you have what it takes to be the Hi-Point Hero?
MEANIE MAYHEM
Meanie Mayhem is a Boss Rush mode for PKF! Revisit all of the boss fights you've encountered and get a high score. Try the many difficulties for the extra points!
LEADERBOARDS, EXTRAS AND MORE!
There are leaderboards to keep track of your high scores, unlockable skins, difficulties and endings to keep even the most hardcore players busy!

summary.핵심플레이: 9개의 스테이지를 진행하며 적을 처치하고 뱀 마녀 Anguis를 상대하는 탄막 슈팅으로, 스토리 캠페인 외에 점수 경쟁 모드와 보스 러시 모드에서 높은 점수를 노린다.
summary.특징: 복수의 엔딩이 있는 스토리 캠페인과 Hi-Point Hero, Meanie Mayhem 모드를 제공하며, 리더보드, 잠금 해제형 스킨, 여러 난이도 등 부가 요소를 포함하고 레트로풍 그래픽을 사용한다.

name: Peter World
input:
This is Peter World Game, a game similar to Mario World, which has a lot of

adventures, actions and good game-play.

Peter, a solitary character that you go through many adventures in

beautiful and great stages in a Pixel-Art open world.

We found the mule without head,

the werewolves, and many more terrible enemies ...

This is a fun game to play in your spare time, you will have a lot of fun,

besides contributing to a great game.



Peter World Beta ver 0.9.4

----------------------------------------------------

Help you to run the game for the first time

----------------------------------------------------

To Start A New Game,

enter your name in the Name field

and click the Start button.



To Load Saved Game

Select a NAME from the list of Saved Players

and click the Load button.



To Delete Saved Game

Select a NAME from the list of Saved Players

and click the Delete button.



Use Arrows keys to move the Peter

Use Up or W keys to open chests

F key to attack or to use selected item

Use keys from 1 to 5 to select weapons and attacks

Space key to Jump

Double Space key to double jump

F key to use selected item

Tab key to show/hide menu game

Use Mouse to navigate menu game

M key to show/hide game map

Esc to main menu

summary.핵심플레이: Peter를 조작해 여러 스테이지를 이동하며 점프와 이단 점프로 진행하고, 상자를 열고 무기와 아이템을 선택해 적을 공격한다. 이름을 입력해 새 게임을 시작하거나 저장된 게임을 불러오고 삭제할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 픽셀 아트로 표현된 오픈 월드를 배경으로 하며, 머리 없는 노새와 늑대인간 등 여러 적이 등장한다. 현재 베타 버전(0.9.4)으로 제공된다.

name: Dutch's Chickens
input:
Last night someone snuck into Dutch's house and made his chickens escape! Help him find all his chickens by guiding him through different puzzles of the game and collecting a bunch of cool abilities and gears such as:

- Mega-Boots!

- Jetpacks!!

- Climbing Gloves!!!

- BRICK SMASHER!!!!

- and... a Strawberry :)

Dutch's Chickens is an exploration game that challenges players to figure out how to find ways to access different areas and discover secrets. There are multiple ways to access certain areas, using different combinations of tools. A fun game for both those who want to just chill and relax, and the speed runners and players who like to break the game!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Dutch를 조작해 여러 퍼즐을 풀며 도망친 닭들을 찾고, 메가 부츠·제트팩·클라이밍 장갑·브릭 스매셔 등의 능력과 장비를 수집한다.
summary.특징: 여러 도구의 조합으로 특정 구역에 접근하는 다양한 경로가 있으며, 편하게 즐기는 플레이와 스피드런 등 게임을 파고드는 플레이 모두를 지원하는 탐험 게임이다.

name: Rolling Sun
input:
Rolling Sun takes advantage of the latest version of CRYENGINE, with best in class physics, lighting and water effects. Discover ancient magic as you guide your Sun Stone through lost Incan and Mayan civilizations.

Take control of a defeated Sun God trapped on Earth. Use the last of your powers to guide a stone across and ancient civilization, gaining power as you get closer and closer to your rival, the Moon God.

- Skills to unlock :

As you gain power, you'll gain such skills as double jump, mid-air dash, and more.

- Physics-based gameplay.

Take advantage of a living environment, powered by CryEngine physics, to reach your goals.

summary.핵심플레이: 태양신의 힘이 담긴 돌을 고대 문명을 가로질러 굴리고 이동시켜 목표 지점에 도달한다. 진행하며 이단 점프, 공중 대시 등의 스킬을 해금해 활용한다.
summary.특징: CRYENGINE의 물리·조명·물 효과를 사용하며, 물리 기반 환경을 활용해 잉카·마야 문명을 배경으로 라이벌인 달의 신에게 다가가는 이야기를 담았다.

name: Only Down: Into the Abyss
input:
Dive into the Epic Adventure of Only Down: Into the Abyss

Begin your journey atop the heavens, in celestial heights. But here, your quest is not to stay—but to descend. Why flee Paradise, you might ask? Because you're tired of serving the gods. Driven by a spirit of discovery, you set out to explore a world filled with traps and wonders, where every missed leap could cost you your life.

A Journey Through the Ages

The universe of Only Down is rich and complex. The further you descend, the more the eras unfold, and the more realistic the graphics become. Each level offers unique challenges:

-
Paradise: Start in the gods’ realm, bathed in divine light.

-
Historical Eras: Traverse Feudal Japan, Medieval Europe, the Wild West, and 20th-century skyscrapers.

-
Military Base and Soviet Era: Approach modernity with immersive mechanics, including vehicles.

-
The Darkness of Hell: End in a horrifying atmosphere where design and mechanics plunge into oppressive darkness.

Game Modes and Mechanics

The beginning of the game, bright and classic, contrasts sharply with its original and unsettling conclusion. The horror mechanics of the final section subvert expectations, turning your progress into a true descent into hell.

Every leap brings you closer to the unknown, every world pushes you to test your limits. From divine monotony to abyssal chaos, Only Down: Into the Abyss promises you an unforgettable adventure.

Descend… if you dare.

summary.핵심플레이: 천상에서 시작해 아래로 낙하하며 함정과 장애물이 있는 각 구간을 통과해 계속 하강한다. 점프에 실패하면 목숨을 잃을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 낙원에서 시작해 봉건 일본, 중세 유럽, 서부 개척 시대, 20세기 고층 빌딩, 군사 기지와 소비에트 시대를 거쳐 지옥으로 이어지며, 하강할수록 시대와 그래픽이 변화한다. 후반부에는 호러 요소와 차량 등의 메커니즘이 추가된다.

name: Shadows: Heretic Kingdoms
input:
Shadows: Heretic Kingdoms is the next chapter in the Heretic Kingdoms saga and takes place 20 years after the events of Kult: Heretic Kingdoms. It’s an epic adventure with challenging gameplay, a gripping storyline and enchanting graphics. In this isometric action RPG, the player takes on the role of the Devourer, a demon that swallows the souls of the dead and then brings them back into the mortal realm as his puppets. It's up to him to either thwart a major threat and save the world, or to plunge it into complete disaster…
Story

After four of the five members of a secret order known as Penta Nera were murdered, their souls were swallowed by a pack of Devourers. Since then, they move around the mortal realm as the puppets of the Devourers, as a demonic Penta Nera, and ravage the land in search of the essence of souls.
The fifth member of the order, bent on revenge, makes use of the only way to stop them and summons another Devourer: this one is different from his siblings. He can absorb multiple souls, but sometimes becomes more human or schizophrenic, the more souls he absorbs. He can stop the demonic Penta Nera and save the world, or he can plunge it into complete disaster...
Key Features Of Shadows: Heretic Kingdoms

- Extensive freedom of choice, affecting the course of the game

- Gripping storyline in a world full of myths, destinies and legendary creatures

- Two game worlds in one: Wander between the worlds and risk a glimpse into the dark shadow world, where you will also face enemies and solve mystic puzzles.

- One dark hero, 15 different characters: Devour the souls of your enemies and use a lot of different characters and combat styles.

- Complete a variety of diverse quests and face creatures in battle that you could only imagine in your worst nightmares!

- Huge number of fantastical creatures with unique fighting styles and challenges

- Unique party system

summary.핵심플레이: 아이소메트릭 시점에서 죽은 자의 영혼을 삼키는 데몬 Devourer를 조작하여, 흡수한 영혼을 꼭두각시로 되살려 다양한 캐릭터와 전투 스타일로 적과 싸우고 퀘스트를 수행한다.
summary.특징: Heretic Kingdoms 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 인간계와 어두운 그림자 세계를 오가며 적과 싸우고 퍼즐을 풀 수 있다. 영혼을 여러 개 흡수할수록 캐릭터가 인간적으로 변하거나 분열되며, 선택에 따라 이야기의 전개가 달라진다.

name: Wizavior
input:
“When all the planets in the galaxy succumb to the mysterious forces, only the most powerful of wizards can save their inhabitants and face the great evil behind this destruction. Resting in the crystal fields of Cristalia, the mighty Zavior is called back to action and is ready to face all types of danger to protect these innocent lives… or at least try.”

Wizavior is a 3D platformer game with arcade aspects, such as time based stages and an endless game mode game. With a fun narrative and memorable characters, you player will take the role of the mighty-but-retired wizard Zavior in a quest throughout multiple planets. Save each planet's inhabitants by collecting Energy Crystals that power up Zavior's powerful Spells!

-
Challenging platform mechanics;

-
Five unique planets to save + epic final challenge;

-
Weird aliens that you’ll grow to love;

-
Visually beautiful & strong narrative;

-
Unique and engaging soundtrack;

-
Evolving HUB that changes during the story;

-
Compelling story with more than 30 minutes of frame-by-frame animated cutscenes;

-
Collectables and achievements;

STORY MODE:

-
Help the wizard Zavior in his saga to save the inhabitants of Planets doomed to destruction!

-
5 Unique scenarios with multiple levels that have its unique set of hazards and challenges! + An epic final encounter!

-
A total of 33 different levels!

-
3-5 hours of gameplay

-
More than 30 minutes of 2D animated cutscenes

ARCADE MODE:

-
An endless sequence of stages

-
Increasing difficulty progression

-
A classic test of game and controls skill!

-
Scoreboard to keep track of your best runs!

summary.핵심플레이: 마법사 Zavior를 조작해 여러 행성의 스테이지를 진행하며, 에너지 크리스털을 모아 주민을 구하고 마법을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 5개 행성과 최종 도전으로 구성된 스토리 모드(총 33개 레벨, 30분 이상의 2D 애니메이션 컷신)와, 난이도가 상승하는 무한 스테이지 및 스코어보드를 제공하는 아케이드 모드로 나뉜다. 이야기 진행에 따라 변화하는 허브와 수집 요소, 도전 과제가 포함된다.

name: The book of commands : Lost Symbol
input:
...I'm lost in a dark place...
...I don't have any memories...
...I don't know anything...
...I want to get out of this place...
...What should I do?....

It's story about one girl who lost in unknown places. She just a small girl, But with the power of something like a miracle. The weak girl turned into a brave warrior. Now she needs to find a way to survive from here.

Overview
2D Action RPG Game from Limpage. "The book of commands : Lost symbol"
The player can level up, change class, change equipment, upgrade, craft item, setting skills. Do anything to finding a way to survive from the large dungeon and strong enemies.

Features
- One large dungeon - All maps in this game are connected. You will found a lot of things in the dungeon.

- Leveling - Defeat the enemies, gain EXP and get stronger!.

- Light beads - It's something you will see when to defeat an enemies. The little girl called it as "Soul". This thing will help you to survive this dungeon.
Red soul - use for craft item, upgrade EMBLEM, unlock skills or abilities.
Green soul - recovery life point (HP).
Blue soul - recovery mystic point (MP).
Yellow soul - recovery stamina point (EP).
Special soul - recovery HP,MP,EP

- The EMBLEM - a mysterious stone. Turn the weak girl into the warrior. Each EMBLEM has different power.

- Emblem upgrade - upgrade, unlock skill, ability of the EMBLEM for getting stronger.

- Item - You can get an item by craft, find treasure or drop from the enemies.
This game has 4 types of item Tool, Equipment, Material, Special (Key, EMBLEMs).

- Craft - you can craft items at the save point.

- Ending - this game doesn't have one ending... and after end will unlock something.

summary.핵심플레이: 기억을 잃은 소녀를 조작해 던전에서 적을 처치하며 레벨업하고, 장비 교체와 클래스 변경, 아이템 제작 및 강화를 진행하며 생존 방법을 찾는다.
summary.특징: 모든 맵이 연결된 하나의 큰 던전으로 구성되며, 적을 처치하면 나오는 색깔별 소울로 회복과 제작·강화를 하고, EMBLEM이라는 돌을 통해 능력과 스킬을 강화한다. 하나의 엔딩이 아닌 여러 결말이 존재하며 클리어 후 추가 요소가 해금된다.

name: Semko
input:
Set in a vast open world, Semko combines action-packed combat with creature collection. As you uncover the mysteries of ancient Obelisks, forge bonds with captured creatures who fight alongside you in strategic battles. Master an arsenal of weapons while exploring a world filled with emotional storytelling and challenging puzzles.

*Note: Semko is Work-In-Progress and is very early and subject to change - everything you see is not final.

Capture Creatures

Explore the Open World and find all kinds of Creatures to capture and fight along side you against other Creatures and Duelists.

Battle!

Befriend diverse creatures throughout your journey, each bringing unique abilities to combat. Command your companions in strategic battles against wild creatures and skilled duelists. Switch seamlessly between weapons - from swift daggers to mighty greatswords - while coordinating attacks with your newly found friends.

Fight with your Sword, Two-Hand Sword, Spear or Daggers:

Defend yourself with Shields!

Use your Bow!

Ancient Mysteries

Uncover the truth behind mysterious Obelisks scattered across the land. Solve intricate puzzles that guard their secrets while following a story filled with memorable characters, emotional moments, and unexpected twists.

Freedom

Move around as you wish.

-
Climb towering cliffs and structures

-
Soar through skies with gliding gear

-
Unlock flying mounts for aerial exploration

-
Unlock or rent mounts for ground exploration

Climb:

Glide:

Living World

Gather Mushrooms, Apples, Ores, Wood and other resources to make food, upgrade your equipment, prepare survival supplies or to fulfill quests.

summary.핵심플레이: 오픈 월드를 탐험하며 크리처를 포획하고, 이들과 함께 야생 크리처 및 결투사와 전략적으로 전투한다. 검, 양손검, 창, 단검, 방패, 활 등 여러 무기를 전환하며 동료 크리처의 공격을 조율한다.
summary.특징: 땅 곳곳에 흩어진 고대 오벨리스크의 비밀을 퍼즐을 풀며 밝히는 스토리를 진행한다. 절벽 등반, 글라이딩 장비, 비행 및 지상 탈것을 이용한 이동과 버섯·사과·광석·목재 등 자원 채집을 통한 제작·장비 강화가 가능하다. 현재 개발 초기 단계로 내용이 변경될 수 있다.

name: Epiko World
input:
About This Game

Epiko World is an action-packed multiplayer battle game that seamlessly blends mythological storytelling with futuristic combat. Step into a vibrant universe where legendary heroes and gods clash in dynamic battlegrounds inspired by cultures from around the globe. Whether you’re engaging in fast-paced PvP matches, teaming up in 3v3 battles, or hunting down epic Ravagers, Epiko World delivers an adrenaline-filled experience for gamers of all skill levels.

Key Features

Dynamic Gameplay Modes

-
PvP Duels: Face off against opponents in intense 1v1 battles.

-
3v3 Team Matches: Work together to dominate the battlefield in fast-paced strategic combat.

-
Free-for-All Chaos: Compete against up to seven players in a thrilling fight for supremacy.

-
Ravager Encounters: Hunt down powerful creatures within the arena for rare rewards and an edge in battle.

Mythology Meets Futurism

-
Play as gods, warriors, and futuristic heroes, each with unique abilities and weapons, blending ancient myths with cutting-edge technology.

-
Explore battlegrounds inspired by legendary locations such as Dwarka, Babylon, and Mayan temples, complete with dynamic weather and interactive terrain.

Customizable Heroes and Companions

-
Personalize your heroes with unlockable skins, weapons, and abilities to match your playstyle.

-
Summon powerful companions to assist in battle, offering tactical and magical advantages.

Progression and Rewards

-
Climb leaderboards and complete daily challenges to earn exclusive rewards.

-
Participate in global tournaments for a chance to win rare in-game items and claim your spot as a top competitor.

Cross-Ecosystem Integration

-
Bring your NFTs from Epiko Market to life, unlocking unique in-game benefits and customizations.

-
Connect your account through the Epiko Hub (coming soon), where gameplay activities and achievements will earn KARMA points for real-world and in-game rewards.

Why Choose Epiko World?

-
Immersive Storytelling: Dive into a world where every battle unfolds a story rooted in rich cultural myths.

-
Cutting-Edge Visuals: Experience stunning graphics, smooth animations, and vibrant environments.

-
Accessible and Competitive: Designed for casual players and hardcore gamers alike, with balanced gameplay and competitive features.

Prepare to unleash legendary heroes, conquer mythological realms, and forge your destiny in Epiko World! Will you rise to the challenge and claim victory? The battle awaits!!!

summary.핵심플레이: 1대1 PvP, 3대3 팀전, 최대 8인 프리포올 등 다양한 모드에서 대전하고, 아레나 내 Ravager를 사냥해 보상을 얻는다. 리더보드와 일일 도전 과제, 글로벌 토너먼트를 통해 아이템을 획득하며 순위를 겨룬다.
summary.특징: 신화와 미래 기술을 결합한 세계관으로 신, 전사, 미래형 영웅을 조작하며 Dwarka, Babylon, 마야 신전 등에서 영감을 받은 전장에서 싸운다. 스킨·무기·능력 커스터마이징과 전투 지원 컴패니언 소환을 지원하며, Epiko Market의 NFT 연동과 Epiko Hub를 통한 KARMA 포인트 시스템을 제공한다.

name: Rune Stones
input:
Rune Stones - An exciting 3D logic puzzle! A mysterious and enigmatic island opens before you, filled with puzzles that you have to solve!



The game features many interesting levels that will challenge your mind and thinking! Whether you can walk this path depends only on you!



Game Features:

- Lots of levels

- Convenient controls

- Physics

- Colorful graphics

summary.핵심플레이: 섬을 배경으로 한 여러 레벨에서 논리 퍼즐을 풀며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 3D 그래픽과 물리 요소를 활용한 퍼즐 구성이며 다수의 레벨을 제공한다.

name: Wizard Of Walls
input:
"Wizard Of Walls" is a top down dungeon/maze shooter with retro mechanics inspired by an arcade classic. You play a warrior with a laser gun and have to shoot all monsters. If you touch a monster or get shot by a monster, you die instantly (no health bar, no regeneration). Everything becomes faster and faster. Your goal is to survive as many dungeons as you can.

Multiplayer local, online and mixed

You can play coop or PvP with up to 4 players. Local multiplayer and online are combinable. For example, you can play together with 2 players on one machine and 2 players on another machine via internet. You can also invite your steam friends or join their lobbies.

Power-Ups

Collect power-ups within the dungeon. The blue ones make you run faster, the orange ones make you shoot faster

Spider Dungeons

Every 5th dungeon is a spider dungeon. A horde of fast moving spiders crawl around and try to drop eggs. If you don't shoot the eggs in time, 5 new spiders will be born.

Leaderboard

The leaderboard shows the top 100 single player warriors and the top 100 team scores in coop games (for 2, 3 or 4 players)

summary.핵심플레이: 레이저 총을 든 캐릭터로 던전을 돌며 모든 몬스터를 쏘아 처치하고, 몬스터에 닿거나 총에 맞으면 즉사하므로 최대한 많은 던전을 생존하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 체력 바나 회복 없이 시간이 지날수록 속도가 빨라지며, 파란색·주황색 파워업으로 이동·발사 속도를 높인다. 5번째 던전마다 알을 낳는 거미 무리가 등장하는 스파이더 던전이 나오고, 로컬·온라인·혼합 방식으로 최대 4인 협동 또는 PvP 플레이와 리더보드를 지원한다.

name: CastleGuard
input:
CASTLEGUARD

You're alone against an army ! Your task ? Reach the extraction point.

. Choose the right weapon, top up your ammo, infiltrate enemy land, and the carnage begins !
. Be more strategist than your adversary, head to head, surprise attack, or just run and shoot ? It's up to you !

STORY

You're a soldier without resources against a group of redoubtable mercenaries. Your final goal consist of retaking the castle of the hands of the enemy in sneaky and decimating their lines ! Take good points, you have to think before shooting ! But be careful they are everywhere.

GAMEPLAY

. Once appeared, grab your weapon.
. Keep an eye on the enemy.
. And cross the castle massacring them to the last !

summary.핵심플레이: 무기를 선택하고 탄약을 보충한 뒤 적진에 침투해 성을 가로지르며 적들을 처치하고 탈출 지점에 도달한다. 정면 대결, 기습, 이동 사격 등 방식을 선택할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 홀로 다수의 용병 집단에 맞서 적에게 점령된 성을 탈환하는 것을 목표로 하며, 발포 전에 전략적으로 판단하는 요소가 있다.

name: Capyverse Odyssey
input:
Play Free Demo

About the Game

Experience a fast-paced Roguelike as an enlightened capybara, where every decision shapes your journey. Discover new worlds, gain allies, and master unique abilities to save the capybara universe from looming threats. Face evolving challenges for a fresh, exhilarating playthrough as you explore, strategize, and unlock secrets in the multiverse.

You’ll step into the paws of Capy, the sharp-witted leader of a futuristic capybara civilization.

summary.핵심플레이: 카피바라 캐릭터 Capy를 조작해 여러 세계를 탐험하며, 동료를 모으고 고유 능력을 익혀 진행한다. 매 플레이마다 변화하는 도전에 대응하며 전략적으로 나아가고 비밀을 해금한다.
summary.특징: 멀티버스를 배경으로 한 카피바라 문명 세계관을 다루며, 플레이어의 선택이 여정에 영향을 미치는 로그라이크 구조를 갖는다.

name: Spiral to Despair
input:
Spiral to Despair is a blackjack style card game infused with RPG elements set in the depths of hell.

You will be facing demons across the hell to solve the mystery of your origin and unravel your story.

- Progress through story and clear dungeons by defeating monsters in the game of blackjack, loot items and valuables.
- Use potions and flasks in your encounters to enhance your abilities and stats.
- Enchant items, unleash legendaries and upgrade charms to get stronger.
- Unlock achievements by doing various tasks and progressing.

You can export your save to cloud server and access it from another devices and continue your adventure.

summary.핵심플레이: 블랙잭 방식의 카드 게임으로 몬스터를 처치하며 던전을 클리어하고 이야기를 진행한다. 아이템과 재화를 획득하고 포션과 플라스크를 사용해 능력치를 강화한다.
summary.특징: 지옥을 배경으로 악마들과 대결하며 주인공의 기원을 밝히는 스토리를 다루며, 아이템 인챈트와 부적 업그레이드, 세이브 파일의 클라우드 서버 저장 및 다른 기기 연동을 지원한다.

name: Morbolbo: Enter the Maze
input:
Morbolbo: Enter the Maze is a maze crawling adventure game where you take control of a dashing musketeer called Morbolbo and delve into a magical world filled with mazes that change every time you enter them. These mazes are always filled with piles of gold and treasures, but they're also guarded by clever traps and cunning enemies, who aim to stop you from making your way out of the mazes.
Key Features

- Procedurally generated mazes of different shapes and sizes

- A variety of enemies and traps to fight and avoid

- Spend your gold and unlock outfits, hats and weapons

EXPLORE A MAGICAL WORLD
Explore six different zones, each with their own unique combination of traps and enemies. Work your way through all of them and gain access to the ultimate treasure hidden away at the centre of the biggest maze.

UNLOCK NEW OUTFITS AND SILLY HATS
Complete challenges and achievements to unlock new outfits. Or spend the gold you've collected to upgrade and unlock new weapons and hats.

summary.핵심플레이: 머스킷총병 Morbolbo를 조작해 매번 다르게 생성되는 미로를 탐험하며 금과 보물을 모으고, 함정을 피하고 적과 싸워 미로를 빠져나간다.
summary.특징: 절차적으로 생성되는 다양한 크기와 형태의 미로가 있으며, 여섯 개의 구역마다 고유한 함정과 적 조합이 배치된다. 모은 금이나 도전 과제·업적 완료로 의상, 모자, 무기를 잠금 해제한다.

name: Empty Horizons
input:
Mireille Maiorano is the daughter of a wealthy Italian family, raised in an all girls' boarding school far away from the rest of society — until her monotonous life is thrown into disarray after the unexpected death of her father.



Left with nowhere else to go, Mireille is sent to live with her uncle in France — but the man who acts as her escort is the worst person imaginable for such a delicate job. Lyon is a tactless, careless Frenchman who only seems to care about telling stupid jokes and seducing older women, and Mireille hates him with every inch of her being.



At least, she would. She wants to. But life isn't always that simple.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Mireille의 이야기를 따라가며 전개되는 스토리를 읽고 진행한다.
summary.특징: 이탈리아 부유층 가정에서 여학교에 자란 Mireille가 아버지의 갑작스러운 죽음 이후 프랑스의 삼촌에게 보내지며, 호위를 맡은 프랑스인 Lyon과 얽히는 이야기를 다룬다.

name: GUNGRAVE VR
input:
The acclaimed GUNGRAVE series is reborn in VR!

Many years have passed since the war against the nefarious drug, SEED.
Mika Asagi lived a quiet life watching over the undead soldier Beyond the Grave (Grave, for short), who returned to his slumber.

Those halcyon days ended suddenly, as South City turned into a war zone torn apart by Orgmen, humans infected with SEED. Faced with the threat to the city, its people, and her own peaceful existence, Mika makes her decision.

"...Please lend me your strength once again, Beyond the Grave."

To restore hope to South City, Mika and Grave throw themselves into battle.

Featuring third-person and first-person perspectives for an intense take on VR action gameplay, experience combat as if you are really there!

Strategically use new skills such as the slow-motion "Reaper Time" to turn the tide of battle against hordes of enemies.
KEY FEATURES
Multiple Perspectives to Master
Fight through intense levels, with some taking place in free-moving third person and some in first person (both stationary and mobile). Each perspective offers new challenges for action gamers.

A Legendary Pedigree
GUNGRAVE VR showcases the return of character designer Yasuhiro Nightow (Trigun) and the original GUNGRAVE designers at RED Entertainment as advisers. Grave and Mika’s designs have been upgraded after 14 long years.

Kick Their Ass!
Play how you want with three difficulty levels: Normal, Hard, and Kick-Ass. Are you hardcore enough to take down the Orgmen in Kick-Ass mode?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Beyond the Grave를 조작해 SEED에 감염된 적 Orgmen 무리와 전투하며, 슬로모션 스킬 'Reaper Time' 등을 활용해 스테이지를 진행한다.
summary.특징: GUNGRAVE 시리즈를 VR로 재구성한 작품으로, 자유 이동형 3인칭과 고정·이동형 1인칭 시점이 스테이지별로 나뉘며 Normal, Hard, Kick-Ass 세 가지 난이도를 제공한다. 캐릭터 디자이너 Yasuhiro Nightow와 RED Entertainment의 원작 디자이너가 참여했다.

name: Puzzlehub: Businesswoman Hentai
input:
Puzzlehub - Businesswoman Hentai is an adult-only puzzle game.

You can choose from 6 different categories of businesswomen and access visuals in uniforms of your choice.

The categories include Nurse, Police, Lawyer, University, Maid, and Random.

In the game, Hentai girls from various professions will accompany you.
You Can Play With Just One Click.

Features

- There are 38 different visuals and characters featured in the game.

- Completed puzzles can be directly unlocked and viewed in succession.

- This game will allow you to spend productive time with beautiful Hentai girls and calming music.

summary.핵심플레이: 제공되는 이미지를 조각 퍼즐로 맞추며, 완성한 퍼즐을 해금해 연속으로 감상한다. 클릭 조작만으로 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 성인용 콘텐츠로, 간호사·경찰·변호사·대학·메이드·랜덤 등 6개 카테고리와 38종의 비주얼 및 캐릭터, 배경 음악을 포함한다.

name: The Squeal of the Pig
input:
The CEO of the biggest meat producing corporation is kidnapped by a cannibalistic serial killer that exclusively eats human flesh. The former fears being eaten, but the latter assures him he has other plans for him, including a special surprise.

Will he sit around and wait for the special surprise or fight back and escape?

"The Squeal of the Pig" is a psychological horror game featuring classic 2D pixel graphics.
Gameplay includes elements of survival horror with puzzles and decision-making that affects the plot, ending, and experience.

summary.핵심플레이: 납치된 주인공으로서 탈출을 시도하며, 퍼즐을 풀고 선택을 내려 진행한다. 플레이어의 결정이 전개와 결말에 영향을 준다.
summary.특징: 식인 연쇄살인범에게 납치된 육류 기업 CEO를 다루는 이야기를 2D 픽셀 그래픽으로 연출한다.

name: Top Down Zombies
input:
A fast-paced and intense top-down shooter, TDZ will have you sweating in no time.

Dash, sprint, and blast away endless hoards of Reddz - stay on your toes and lookout for your next loadout upgrade. Buy better weapons with the money earned from fallen Reddz, or open new areas of the map to explore - it's up to you.

Becoming increasingly faster and more powerful each round, the Reddz will easily overcome a player without sharp reflexes, a quick trigger finger, and/or some massive fire power.

Stand off against the Redd army by yourself or with up to 3 friends in local multiplayer split-screen!

Note: split-screen requires one controller for additional player.

summary.핵심플레이: 위에서 내려다보는 시점에서 대시와 스프린트로 이동하며 몰려오는 Reddz 무리를 처치한다. 처치로 얻은 돈으로 더 나은 무기를 구매하거나 맵의 새로운 지역을 개방한다.
summary.특징: 라운드가 진행될수록 Reddz가 점점 빠르고 강해진다. 로컬 화면 분할로 최대 4인까지 함께 플레이할 수 있으며, 추가 플레이어는 컨트롤러가 필요하다.

name: Wizards Of The West
input:
Please make sure to report all bugs found to our bugs to report channel in our discord server:
Before purchasing please know that this game is still being updated to a more complete version with more content and smoother gameplay so expect some issues whilst playing

About Wizards Of The West
Wizards Of The West or WOTW for short is a top-down shooting, boss fighting, loot gathering game where you will battle through 9 different bosses with loot you find throughout the game to try to uncover the secrets of who your father is and where you actually came from. Each boss will be challenging with their unique attacks and patterns trying to kill you as you approach them.

Features
Find loot and use it to make countless amounts of builds
Find all the secret endings to unlock the different cutscenes
Battle through bosses multiple times to try to get better scores

About Us
Wizards Of The West was created by 1 Developer for a college project over the school holidays that I had more fun with than I expected so I wanted to work more on the game and even release it. I've always enjoyed making games and felt it was time to get one out there for others to play. The game has been made with the help of some friends such as the music, logo, and voice acting. Hopefully, if you play this game you enjoy the time you spend in it and if you have any questions about WOTW then contact me and I'll try my best to help answer any inquiries you may have.

summary.핵심플레이: 탑다운 시점에서 총을 쏘며 9종의 보스와 전투하고, 게임 내에서 획득한 전리품으로 다양한 빌드를 구성한다. 보스를 반복 공략해 점수를 올리며 아버지의 정체와 자신의 기원에 관한 이야기를 추적한다.
summary.특징: 각 보스는 고유한 공격 패턴을 가지며, 여러 개의 숨겨진 엔딩을 발견해 서로 다른 컷신을 해금할 수 있다. 1인 개발자가 대학 과제로 시작해 제작한 게임으로, 지속적으로 콘텐츠가 업데이트되고 있다.

name: Cartoon Cagematch
input:
A top-down 6-weapon RogueLike game centred around cartoonish characters and funny-looking enemies.
Buy weapons to kill enemies. Gain buffs, and experience debuffs.
Find items based on your luck.
Survive!!!
Every single round is filled with randomness and much fun :)

Features

- 4 different characters

- Many different weapons

- Varieties of Buffs and Debuffs to gain

- 10 levels

- Increased difficulty

- Addictive :)

summary.핵심플레이: 탑다운 시점에서 무기를 구매해 적을 처치하며 생존한다. 버프와 디버프를 얻고 운에 따라 아이템을 획득하며 라운드를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 만화풍 캐릭터와 적이 등장하며, 4종의 캐릭터와 여러 무기, 다양한 버프·디버프, 10개의 레벨을 제공하고 난이도가 점차 상승한다. 매 라운드에 무작위 요소가 포함된다.

name: Tasty Blue
input:
Tasty Blue Sequel Released

The sequel to Tasty Blue is here! Check out Tasty Planet Forever:

About the Game
Tasty Blue is an underwater side-scrolling eat 'em up game. You start as a small goldfish with an insatiable appetite. After being overfed by your owner, you'll escape into the ocean and eat everything that you encounter. The more you eat, the bigger you get!

In addition to the goldfish, you'll also play as a dolphin and a shark. The dolphin starts off as an overworked aquarium star, forced to jump through flaming hoops for food. He escapes from captivity by eating his way through the aquarium and taking revenge on his trainer. The shark is the final playable character, an artificial fish created by scientists to save Earth's oceans. It uses self-replicating nano technology to consume everything in its path and convert their matter into its own. There's no telling how big this shark will get.

Levels
There are over 50 levels in the main story mode of the game. There are also 15 more challenging bonus levels to play after the main game has been completed.

Environments
There are three main environments to explore in the game: temperate, tropical, and arctic.

Difficulty
There are a wide range of difficulty levels to choose from. On the easiest difficulty enemies do virtually no damage. On the most challenging difficulty enemies will eat you and cause instant level failure.

Carnage Mode
Adjust the amount of blood that comes from your prey. This is off by default.

2-Player Local Coop
Two players can play side by side on the same computer. Options allow for split screen (horizontal or vertical) or shared screen (this provides more screen space but constrains the movement of players together).

Controller Support
Keyboard and mouse controls are supported in all modes.
On Windows, most controllers will work for the single player game. To use controllers in 2-player coop mode, both controllers need to be Xbox 360 or Xbox One controllers.
On Mac, PS3 and PS4 controllers are supported.

summary.핵심플레이: 수중 배경의 사이드스크롤 방식으로, 자신보다 작은 대상을 먹어치우며 몸집을 키우는 것이 핵심이다. 먹을수록 커져 점점 더 큰 대상을 먹을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 금붕어, 돌고래, 상어 세 캐릭터를 순차적으로 플레이하며, 온대·열대·극지 세 환경에 걸쳐 50개 이상의 스토리 레벨과 15개의 보너스 레벨을 제공한다. 난이도 조절, 피 표현을 켜고 끌 수 있는 카니지 모드, 2인 로컬 협동 플레이를 지원한다.

name: Red Vanilla 2
input:
I rushed into the room and found blood all over the floor. I thought I had made it on time. Our co-workers couldn't even hear what she was doing. The company failed her. The company failed all of us. Why did I not listen? How did I not see the signs?

Everything I've done and everything I've learned about her was all a front to make me believe she was happy. I wasn't supposed to be at home. I was supposed to be here, at work. I can't do this anymore. Please forgive me for this. I'll see you soon.

In this shoot 'em up mini game, destroy all 33 white blocks without getting hit by any of the black blocks. You have the ability to warp from one side of the field to the other, vertically and horizontally. The bullets you shoot warp vertically, but only warp into the field once. The ability to warp yourself and the bullets could be handy in difficult situations!

Features Include:

- Challenging Gameplay: Destroying all 33 memories isn't easy. One hit and its lights out!

- Completion Record: Every Survival Run completed is added to your Completed Runs score.

- Steam Leaderboards: Your total Completed Runs score is saved and ranked.

summary.핵심플레이: 검은 블록에 맞지 않으면서 33개의 흰 블록을 모두 파괴하는 미니 게임으로, 단 한 번만 피격당해도 실패한다. 플레이어와 총알이 필드를 상하좌우로 워프하는 기능을 활용해 진행한다.
summary.특징: 플레이어는 상하좌우로 워프할 수 있고 총알은 세로로 워프하되 필드에 한 번만 진입한다. 완료한 서바이벌 런은 누적 점수로 기록되며 Steam 리더보드에 순위가 저장된다.

name: 100 RUB: Operation Global Denomination
input:
After another wave of financial crisis, the people’s purses became empty. All cash is gone and money on banks accounts are under the threat. The government decided to make currency denomination and take away all that's left. Go to the government’s bank repository and take your money back! Collect coins, bills and keys to open the door for another level.
Don't allow them to rob you! Fill your purse with money!
Another crisis and inflation. But now, the money denomination is come!

Features:
Oldschool platformer.
Unique main hero - The Purse.
Piles of money.
Many dangerous saw and spike traps.
Simple and intuitive control.

summary.핵심플레이: 각 레벨에서 동전과 지폐, 다음 레벨로 넘어가는 문을 여는 열쇠를 모으며, 톱과 가시 등의 함정을 피해 진행한다.
summary.특징: 금융 위기와 화폐 개혁을 배경으로 정부 은행 저장소에서 돈을 되찾는다는 설정이며, 지갑을 주인공으로 삼은 올드스쿨 플랫포머다.

name: Berry Picker
input: A single-player clicker game that has you picking berries from a berry bush. Those berries can be processed and sold for coin using a cannon to ship your product. Upgrade your berry bush enough times to get some garden gnomes to employ. There's no limit to how much your berry bush can be upgraded.

summary.핵심플레이: 덤불에서 베리를 채집하고, 이를 가공한 뒤 대포를 이용해 출하하여 코인으로 판매한다. 덤불을 업그레이드하며 반복 진행한다.
summary.특징: 베리 덤불 업그레이드에 상한이 없으며, 일정 수준 이상 업그레이드하면 정원 노움을 고용할 수 있다.

name: Asphodelium
input:
Asphodelium is a melancholic slice-of-life boys love visual novel about your past confronting you.

Hazel is an ex-adventurer who's settled down with some of his previous guildmates after the adventure of a lifetime—taking down a doomsday cult that tried to end the world, but at the cost of killing their former guild leader who turned against them. Despite their adventure still haunting him months later, he's tried to move on. —That is until a man with the same face as their guild leader approaches him.

This is a story about cults and killing and killing cults. And being in love.

🔪 1 Obsessive Clingy Love Interest

Asphodelium follows the relationship between Hazel, the main character, and Aster, his sudden new roommate. Will love blossom between them, or will old habits die hard?

🪻 2 Main Paths To Walk Down

Depending on your choices, you may find yourself in branching paths. There's 2 main story lines to follow Hazel & Aster down with several smaller scene variations and different endings on each path.

💜 A Melancholic Romance Over 60,000 Words Long

Asphodelium has 60k+ words over both story lines and multiple endings for each, leading to lots of different ways Hazel & Aster's story can go.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Hazel의 이야기를 읽으며 선택지를 통해 분기하는 스토리를 진행하고, 새 룸메이트 Aster와의 관계를 전개한다.
summary.특징: 전직 모험가 Hazel이 자신들이 죽인 옛 길드 리더와 같은 얼굴의 남자를 만나며 벌어지는 남성 간 연애를 다룬다. 60,000단어 이상의 분량에 2개의 주요 스토리 라인과 여러 엔딩, 다양한 장면 변주가 포함된다.

name: Tentacles Party With Nuns
input:
This is a choice-based VN.

Carissa is the most beloved nun at the Cathedral of Saint Estelle.

One night, she has a dream about a witch being violated by the Templar Knights. When she awakens, she discovers that the atmosphere of the entire cathedral has become eerie.

It starts with herself losing her chastity to a tentacled creature resembling an octopus.

There are cases of serial dismemberment within the cathedral, people succumbing to bizarre forms of madness or committing inexplicable suicides, all accompanied by a faint sweet scent.

The entire cathedral is shrouded in an unknown fear.

The Cathedral of Saint Estelle has been cursed by a demon returned from hell. It is foreseen to be doomed in five days.

Through the friendship and communication between the characters Carissa and Betsy, players assist the protagonists in attaining a happy ending in this lifetime, while unraveling the mysteries of the past.

In this cathedral cloaked in darkness—demons, epidemics, war-wounded soldiers, forbidden potions, lurking serial killers, and the ancient taboo alchemy—much like destiny, these elements come together like a grand overture for a party that intricately link the past and present lives of the main characters.

Unravel the mysteries and curses, and embrace a new future.

◇

Carissa is the most beautiful nun and is famous in the area

She is very kind and helpful

But she's also often careless enough to screw things up

To her, Benson and Betsy are friends and like family.

Betsy is very smart and helps the cathedral solve various difficulties.

She also often helps the careless Carissa.

Betsy has complicated feelings for Carissa.

Although she is jealous of her, she cannot hate her.

She grew up in the same orphanage as Carissa, and she exists like Carissa's sister.

She is very good friends with Benson and Carissa and is secretly in love with Benson.

Benson is the adopted son of Bishop Carl

Handsome and knowledgeable, quite popular.

He is quite polite to everyone, but he also has a sense of distance because of it.

Benson often has inexplicable scars on his body.

He did not mention why. Only Betsy noticed this.

Benson has noticed Betsy's feelings for him, but his current attitude towards her is still the same as usual.

Good friends with Carissa and Betsy.

Bishop Carl is the leader of the cathedral.

He is a gambler and has a lot of gambling debts, so there have been a lot of rumors about him recently.

The mysterious woman who appeared in the cathedral one night seemed to be related to the devil and alchemy.

A man who came to the cathedral one night

Extremely obsessed with Carissa

The killer who committed quite a few serial dismemberment cases,

his cruelty is outrageous.

Smiling graffiti drawn with the victim's blood will be left at the crime scene,

and is known as the "Smiling Murderer" by the outside world.

Since the identity of the murderer cannot be determined,

there are currently only a few eyewitness testimonies,

Some said he was a "tall and thin young man" or a "man" wearing strange clothes and a mask.

There have been similar cases in the cathedral recently, could it be...?

summary.핵심플레이: 선택지 기반으로 진행되며, 플레이어는 수녀 Carissa와 Betsy 등 등장인물의 이야기를 따라가며 선택을 통해 결말에 도달한다. 성당에서 벌어지는 사건과 과거의 비밀을 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: 악마의 저주로 5일 안에 멸망할 것으로 예언된 Saint Estelle 성당을 배경으로, 악마와 연금술, 연쇄 살인, 전염병 등의 요소가 얽힌 어두운 세계관을 다룬다. 'Smiling Murderer'로 불리는 연쇄 살인범과 촉수 생물체 등 공포·성인 요소가 포함되어 있다.

name: Lust Horizon 🔞
input:
Lust Horizon🔞 – Where Strategy, Tactics, and Desire Collide in a Sizzling Card Battler!

Build your ultimate deck of fighters and spells, choose a champion with unique abilities, and challenge your rivals in thrilling tactical battles. Every turn is a critical decision—strike your enemy, power up your army, or unleash special skills. Defeat your opponent’s champion to claim victory! Win matches, unlock chests full of rewards, upgrade your cards, and climb the ranks to prove your dominance.
Game Highlights:
🔥 Unique Champions – each with special skills and bonuses.
⚔️ Tactical Battles – every move can turn the tide.
🎁 Reward System – collect chests, level up fighters, and expand your deck.
🏆 PvP & Campaign Mode – compete online or tackle story-driven challenges.
💋 Seductive Vibes – stylish characters and steamy moments spice up the gameplay!

Ready to conquer Lust Horizon🔞? Assemble your perfect deck and dive into the ultimate blend of strategy, tactics, and desire! 🔥

summary.핵심플레이: 파이터와 주문 카드로 덱을 구성하고 고유 능력을 가진 챔피언을 선택해 턴제 전투를 진행한다. 매 턴 공격, 병력 강화, 특수 스킬 사용 중 선택하며 상대 챔피언을 쓰러뜨리면 승리한다.
summary.특징: 승리 시 상자와 보상을 획득해 카드를 강화하고 랭크를 올리는 시스템을 갖추고 있으며, PvP와 스토리 기반 캠페인 모드를 제공한다. 성인 지향의 캐릭터와 연출이 포함된다.

name: Harolds Harem: The Neckoning
input:
Features:

7 colorful NPCs

8 unique locations

3 multiple endings

Pixel-illustration style

About the Game

Harold's Harem: A Visual Novel Where Falling in Love is the Ultimate Mission Failure!

Want to save the dimension?: DON'T FALL IN LOVE!

Can you complete your top-secret mission and save the world before time runs out, without letting Harold steal your heart?

In this comedic visual novel that parodies dating sims, you’ll step into the boots of a new recruit in a highly specialized Love Infiltration Unit, tasked with preventing global disaster. Time is ticking, and your mission is clear—uncover Harold’s secrets before it’s too late. But beware: falling in love with Harold is a mission failure.

Alongside a squad of quirky comrades, you’ll navigate through hilarious conversations, risky battles, and a series of increasingly absurd choices that will lead you down unpredictable paths. Your decisions will determine the fate of the world—and whether you end up in Harold’s arms, or running for your life.

Can you save the world and keep your heart intact? Or will Harold's charm break through your defenses? There is only one way to find out!

Features:

-
Colorful characters – Each with their own personalities

-
Eight unique locations – Explore vivid pixel-art environments that bring the world to life.

-
Multiple routes and 4 unique endings – Your choices matter. Will you be the hero or the heartbroken?

-
Humorous dating sim parody – It’s a military operation, not a romance. Or is it...?

-
Pixel-art style – A charming, retro aesthetic to match the ridiculousness of the story.

One thing is for sure: DON'T FALL IN LOVE WITH HAROLD.

summary.핵심플레이: Love Infiltration Unit의 신입 요원이 되어 대화와 선택을 진행하며 Harold의 비밀을 밝혀내는 임무를 수행한다. 선택에 따라 여러 경로와 엔딩으로 이어지며, Harold와 사랑에 빠지면 임무 실패로 처리된다.
summary.특징: 데이팅 심을 패러디한 코미디 작품으로, 7명의 NPC와 8개의 장소, 여러 갈래의 경로와 다중 엔딩을 제공한다. 픽셀 아트 스타일로 표현된다.

name: Journey to Earth
input:
You are an experienced astronaut in a powerful space program. However, due to an unexpected malfunction, you find yourself stranded in the middle of Pluto in space. Your only mission now is to return to Earth safely. But you run the risk of getting lost and dying in space. To survive, you must overcome challenges, manage limited resources, utilize your tools, and use your intelligence to find your way. Every choice you make will affect your chance of survival. You will encounter different adventures and creatures on each planet. Fight for survival in the depths of space without losing hope of returning to Earth

- Single Player

- Role Play game

- Captivating story

- Third Person

- Realistic Graphic

summary.핵심플레이: 명왕성 부근에 고립된 우주 비행사가 되어 지구로 귀환하는 것을 목표로 한다. 한정된 자원과 도구를 관리하고 각 행성에서 마주치는 도전과 생명체에 대응하며 생존을 이어간다.
summary.특징: 우주에서 조난당한 우주 비행사를 다루는 스토리 기반 싱글플레이 게임으로, 3인칭 시점과 사실적인 그래픽을 사용한다. 플레이어의 선택이 생존 가능성에 영향을 미친다.

name: Turnfall
input:
Every step could be your last.

Turnfall which is an arcade game, throws you into a grid-based adventure where danger lurks in every corner. Traverse trap-filled levels, dodge deadly enemies, and make split-second decisions that could mean survival — or death.

Each level is a tactical maze. Will you fight your way through or outsmart your foes and sneak past? The path is yours to choose — but there's no room for hesitation.

Weapons are your lifeline, but nothing lasts forever. Swords dull, shields break, and every hit counts. Scavenge for new gear and power-ups to stay one step ahead, because when your defenses fail, you're vulnerable.

Enemies are relentless, each with unique abilities and behavior. Some chase, others ambush — and all of them want you gone. Outsmart them with clever moves or run when things get tight. Sometimes retreat is the only way forward.

Features:
– Stylish, vibrant visuals
– Challenging, turn-based arcade gameplay
– Smart enemies with unique tactics
– Fragile gear and high-stakes choices

Test your instincts, plan every move, and survive the fall.

summary.핵심플레이: 격자 기반의 미로형 레벨을 이동하며 함정을 피하고 적을 상대한다. 매 턴 전투와 회피 중 선택하며, 무기와 방어구를 수집해 생존을 이어간다.
summary.특징: 턴제 방식으로 진행되며, 무기와 방어구는 사용에 따라 마모되거나 파괴된다. 적마다 추격이나 매복 등 고유한 행동 패턴을 가진다.

name: Combat Casino
input:
Step on to Casino Planet where everything is determined by Lady Luck! Spin the slots to determine your moves and show everyone who's the boss in this turn based roguelike RPG. Boost your Ego to unlock new classes and zones to explore!



Are you bored waiting for your queue to pop? Come on over to the Combat Casino where a run is 15-30 minutes with the oddball runs lasting a few hours. Don't worry though, there are no time limits so you can minimize and do something else if you need to. (or if you need to pay attention to the zoom call) I wanted to make something that I would want to play while waiting for some of my daily work-from-home downtime.

summary.핵심플레이: 슬롯머신을 돌려 나오는 결과로 자신의 행동을 결정하며 턴제 전투를 진행한다. Ego를 올려 새로운 클래스와 탐험 지역을 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 모든 것이 운으로 결정되는 Casino Planet을 배경으로 하며, 한 판은 15~30분 정도로 짧고 시간 제한이 없어 중간에 최소화하거나 다른 일을 병행할 수 있다.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Poop
input:
Attention! Some people could have attacks under the influence of the flashing images, even, if they have never had a diagnosis «epilepsy».

About:
The year 2020 practically killed all of humanity, and we decided to finish it off in 2021 by releasing an addictive multi-level platformer, namely "The Adventures of Mr. Poop", in which you have to overcome many challenges.
Game Features:

Not only the location will change from level to level, but also the gameplay itself. Get through the sewers, the sands of the Sahara, conquer Everest, and then fight back against the zombie horde.

You will have to make choices, on which the fate of the protagonist will depend. Think about every step you take, because there is no turning back.

Carefully explore the locations, so as not to miss a lot of hidden Easter eggs and secret levels!

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 레벨을 진행하며 장애물을 극복하고, 선택을 통해 주인공의 운명을 결정한다.
summary.특징: 하수구, 사하라 사막, 에베레스트, 좀비 무리 등 레벨마다 배경과 플레이 방식이 바뀌며, 숨겨진 이스터에그와 비밀 레벨이 배치되어 있다. 점멸하는 이미지에 대한 주의 문구가 포함되어 있다.

name: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
input:
《乌合之众》是一款中国本土题材的悬疑剧情游戏。
游戏背景

- 故事发生在一个架空的闽南陶瓷县城——乌山县。

- 自古以来，乌山上存在着一尊名为“弥陀”的大佛。关于这尊大弥陀像，坊间存在诸多传闻，有人甚至认为大弥陀像是活的。

- 2009年的某天，大佛突然凭空消失，一个横跨半世纪的惊天迷局也即将水落石出。

游戏剧情

- 这是一段现实主义的故事，却又充满了魔幻荒诞的色彩——因为它属于一个激荡的时代。

- 在悬疑与黑色幽默的层层编织中，乌山大佛消亡史堂堂开幕。

- 故事悬念迭起，险象环生，直到谜团揭开之前，真相始终扑朔迷离。

电影叙事

- 电影质感的画面与音乐设计，你将体验到一场中式美学盛宴。

- 漫画分镜框也将大量穿插在游戏中，为玩家带来别有韵味的氛围与流畅的游玩节奏。

多位角色

- 玩家将陆续扮演6名不同身份的角色，回到大佛消失前的一个月里，探寻弥陀消失之谜。

- 6名角色，6种迥然不同的性格、背景和生存之道。在弥陀慈悲低眉的注视下，他们的人生似乎早已注定，却又寓于无限可能之中。

轻度谜题

- 放心去试错——解谜既不为难玩家，也不拖延退款时间！

- 游戏以剧情为主，轻解谜交互为辅，一切设计皆为更好的体验服务。

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 서로 다른 신분을 가진 6명의 캐릭터를 차례로 조작하며, 대불이 사라지기 한 달 전 시점으로 돌아가 미타상 실종의 수수께끼를 탐색한다. 스토리 진행이 중심이고 가벼운 퍼즐 상호작용이 보조적으로 포함된다.
summary.특징: 가상의 민난 도자기 마을 우산현을 배경으로, 2009년 갑자기 사라진 '미타' 대불을 둘러싼 반세기에 걸친 미스터리를 다룬다. 영화적 화면과 음악, 만화식 분할 컷 연출을 사용하며 중국 본토 소재의 서스펜스와 블랙 유머를 결합한다.

name: super fight
input:
super fight is a Q cute cartoon style, which mainly focuses on competitive battle. Players can play 2V2 and 5V5 battles against each other, which is a Q cute version of competitive game.

Character setting: There are 22 characters in the game, and we release new characters from time to time. Each character has multiple active skills, and in match mode, the player can fight with the purchased game character. Game character positioning can be divided into sorcerer, warlock, Qi Qi, etc.; Different heroes have different stats and skills.

Items: The in-game equipment is divided into physical attack, spell attack, defense equipment, mobile equipment and field equipment. Players can buy advanced equipment according to the accumulated gold amount. Each player can buy a variety of equipment in the regular mode of battle.

Game mode: In sper fight 2V2,5V5 battles, a reasonable lineup can make the battle easier. There are multiple types of player division in the game. In group battles, each character is responsible for his own identity task, and reasonable placement of each character in each different position can make the development effect better. The division of labor between the upper and lower bounds is important. In position allocation, the top, middle and bottom three players are responsible for each pawn line and the enemies on the line, and can travel other routes to help their teammates in advantage games.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 2V2 또는 5V5 대전에서 각자 캐릭터를 조작해 상대 팀과 경쟁하며, 누적한 골드로 장비를 구매해 캐릭터를 강화한다. 상단·중단·하단 라인에 배치된 캐릭터가 각자의 역할을 수행하고 필요 시 다른 라인의 팀원을 지원한다.
summary.특징: Q버전 카툰 스타일의 경쟁 대전 게임으로, 소서러·워록 등 서로 다른 능력치와 스킬을 가진 22종의 캐릭터가 있으며 신규 캐릭터가 추가된다. 물리 공격, 주문 공격, 방어, 이동, 필드 장비 등으로 구분된 아이템 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Odra Online
input:
Odra Online – A Multiplayer Turn-Based Strategy in Gothic Fantasy Style. Enter a world of tactical battles where every move matters. With 83 unique units, 66 dynamic arenas, over 450 battle variations, ranked matches, tournaments, and co-op battles, there’s always room for new strategies.

FIGHT ON TACTICAL ARENAS

Feel the intensity of battle across 66 unique arenas, each with its own mechanics and ever-changing conditions.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 다양한 유닛을 지휘해 턴제로 진행되는 전술 전투를 벌이며, 랭크전, 토너먼트, 협동 전투 등 여러 모드에서 대전한다.
summary.특징: 고딕 판타지 스타일을 배경으로 하며, 83종의 유닛과 66개의 아레나, 450가지 이상의 전투 변형을 제공하고 각 아레나마다 고유 메커니즘과 변화하는 조건이 있다.

name: Puzzle - LINES AND KNOTS
input:
Logical puzzle game for meditation. The goal of the player is to assemble a puzzle consisting of nodes. Easy-to-grasp mechanics, swap hexagons with lines.
So I have few players left until Steam allows me to publish collectible cards (for this you need to have a minimum number of players)
▪ 100 Levels
▪ Achievements

I have other games:

summary.핵심플레이: 노드로 구성된 퍼즐을 맞추는 것이 목표이며, 선이 있는 육각형 타일을 서로 교환하여 퍼즐을 완성한다.
summary.특징: 명상을 콘셉트로 한 논리 퍼즐로, 100개의 레벨과 도전 과제를 제공한다.

name: Warring Winds
input:
WARRING WINDS is a story-rich multiplayer fighting game that takes place on an alternate history of earth where the winds of fate and the whims of the gods have intervened and brought magic to the world in a time of crisis. The royal tournament celebrating the miracle of wind magic gives meaningful context and emotional impact to the participating heroes you can choose to play and learn about. Through the heroes of Warring Winds you will experience love, mischief, nostalgia and coming-of-age adventure and more as you enjoy our lovingly crafted world and our unique characters with nuanced relationships.

Legends & Novella Mode: Learn of the legendary tale of Warring Winds, the story of how Koaku, the Lord of the Sky, intervened in the affairs of mortals and forever changed the course of history. Play as one of five primary characters as they participate in a celebratory tournament of friendship and peace between the Japanese and the Pacific Northwestern Natives of Tsukamish Village. Warring Winds’ story mode is fully voiced and is split across two acts celebrating a total of four cultures, with Act II to be released in 2026 (tentative) Novella mode allows for players who are interested in our cast and story story, but uninterested in the fighting gameplay, to experience our world without struggling with combat.

Competition Mode: Invite your friends to play or play with strangers in our assortment of engaging multiplayer game modes featuring an initial cast of 9 playable characters for Act I.

Glory Mode: Invite your friends, or face alone, legendary beasts in epic raid bosses and compare your performance to others on our online leaderboards.

Accessibility Mode: Play the game with various accessibility features that enable the visually-impaired to participate meaningfully in fighting encounters and the game’s rich story mode.

Training Mode: Use Warring Wind’s sophisticated Training & Accessibility Center to perfect your mastery of any character and all of the nuanced combat mechanics of Warring Winds.

Breeze, the humble and loyal son of the village merchant, a famed musician whose mastery of the flute has earned the love of village maidens and the powerful, and a little possessive, Chieftess Aurora. A reluctant fighter, he wields the tools of the trade, ranging from his childhood slingshot to his wooden bow and the flute he learned to play to earn Aurora’s heart. How naive was Breeze and unsuspecting he was that he would receive a spirit guide of his own, the less-than-loyal Kermi-tsu!

Chieftess Aurora, the fierce, selfless and beautiful leader of Tsukamish Village, who has come of age and must prove herself in the eyes of her adoring people. Her mastery of wind and aurora magic is unrivaled, except for her ancient ancestress and spitting image, Aura. She is a master of meditation and known for her profound spiritual powers which were such that the Owl Spirit Kiya-Kayu descended to earth to be her mentor in a time of looming crisis.

Kermi-tsu, the legendary frog and notorious trickster, the breaker of hearts and wielder of Cherry Bonsai, a divine staff. He broke the heart of the masterful samurai, Amorita, his beloved Amanita mushroom queen, through his affair with a woman with hair of gold. A known philanderer and a mischievous frog, what an irony it is that the Lord of the Sky assigned him to be the spirit guide to the eternally loyal Breeze.

Be careful not to encroach on the territory of little Keeku, the Badgerborn, whose birth was celebrated by an army of badgers who wandered into Tsukamish Village to celebrate her joining the sacred forest. With her mastery of nature and forest magic, and the ferocious sharpness of her claws, Keeku is beyond formidable, especially for her age. She’s territorial too, and is of the night, do not be the raccoon that visits her tree uninvited lest you risk facing her wrath and a fatal slash of her badger claws. Will she listen to her spirit guide, the patient Bear Spirit Blossom, with her maternal wisdom and her mastery of the ways of the forest?

A wise heart, sweet disposition, and immortal beauty define the loveliness of Lunaria, the Lunar Priestess who is the divine embodiment of the moon. Known for her myriad of lovers, and the occasional quarrel, the only fortune she cannot fully read is her own. But she has a lover’s heart, and as lovers tend to do, she finds herself smitten, this time with the mortal but incredibly mighty sumo champion, Rikishi. She may be gentle of disposition, divinely so, but don’t underestimate the power of her lunar magic, or her willingness to use her feminine charms and the occasional explosive rocket.

For seven years Rikishi held the title of the reigning sumo champion! Now he finds himself in the cozy employment of the Princess of Japan, for whom he serves as a loyal and trustworthy bodyguard. Beware the barrel of his chest, his mastery of fire breathing, and his willingness to ignite the occasional bottle of Sake in an explosive toss. This charming, handsome, and rugged fellow’s love affair with with Lunaria was, if unexpected, inevitable.

The cantankerous but undeniably wise Owl Spirit, Kiya-Kayu, the Guardian of the Gate for the Lord of the Sky, Koaku. Assigned to mentor Chieftess Aurora in her time of need, even Kiya-Kayu has his fickleness and complexities - he serves the lord, but he also stole his divine mountain herb, to partake with his old companion Kermi-tsu. How frequently Kermi-tsu teases Kiya-Kayu on account of his feathers which have come to know grayness as the timeless spirit ages through the eons!

Will the blind samurai Amorita, the scorned lover of Kermi-tsu, attain her vengeance and reclaim her honor? Her husband, her lover, the infamous Kermi-tsu, cheated on her and broke her heart. Once more she has descended to the Earth, which for many years she had abandoned in her heartbreak and misery. But this year, she will participate in the tournament honoring Koaku, and there is a frog whose life she intends to take. Will she succeed, or will she die in her former lover’s arms?

Last but far from least is the motherly, occasionally savage, and perpetually honey-seeking Bear Spirit, Blossom. With a flower on her head, and claws on her paws, Blossom is a juxtaposition of sweetness and ferocity, perhaps not so different from her little apprentice, Keeku. Loving and motherly, Blossom is truly the most nurturing of spirit guides, and takes pride in her work serving the Lord of the Sky, Koaku. You won’t catch her smoking stolen herbs of the sky, though you better lock up your stash of honey.

summary.핵심플레이: 9명의 캐릭터 중 하나를 선택해 온라인 또는 로컬 멀티플레이어 대전을 벌이고, Glory 모드에서 강력한 레이드 보스를 상대한다. 스토리 모드에서는 다섯 명의 주요 인물을 플레이하며 서사를 진행하고, Training 모드로 캐릭터와 전투 메커니즘을 연습할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 마법이 등장한 대체 역사 지구를 배경으로, 일본 문화와 태평양 북서부 원주민 등 여러 문화를 다루는 풀보이스 스토리 모드를 두 개의 막으로 구성한다. 전투 없이 이야기만 즐기는 Novella 모드와 시각 장애인을 위한 접근성 기능을 제공하며, 2막은 2026년 출시 예정이다.

name: Orbos
input:
Orbos is a 3rd person online multiplayer shooter with a focus on lite mechanics and quick matches.

Take control of a cute Mechanical Animal Companion Unit, often referred to as "Makus" or more commonly, "Orbos", because of their spherical shape. Play as one of 7 Orbos as they vie for dominance in up to 2 different arena style maps in one of 2 game modes.

Once built by technodruids for assisting research and harvesting a newly discovered crystal energy source, the forgotten robots now run amok in abandoned mines and outposts where resources are now dry.

Fast and frenetic, it's a fight to the finish to be the top bot.
Key Features

- 7 Playable Characters

- 2 Maps

- 2 Game Modes - Team Deathmatch; most kills wins! and Orbomb - A modified capture-the-flag game mode. Reach full health, then race to the center of the map to become overcharged, turning yourself into a ticking time bomb! Once in this state, race to the enemy base, as highlighted in the world, then detonate to score a point! First to 3 points, wins!

- Partial Controller Support (Can control characters with controller, no controller support for UI)

summary.핵심플레이: 7종의 구형 로봇 캐릭터 중 하나를 골라 아레나 맵에서 다른 플레이어들과 총격전을 벌인다. 팀 데스매치에서는 가장 많이 처치한 팀이 승리하고, Orbomb 모드에서는 체력을 가득 채워 과충전 상태가 된 뒤 적 기지로 이동해 폭발시켜 점수를 획득한다.
summary.특징: 테크노드루이드가 크리스탈 에너지 채굴과 연구 보조용으로 만든 기계 동물 로봇 'Makus'(Orbos)를 소재로 한다. 7종의 캐릭터, 2개의 맵, 2개의 게임 모드를 제공하며 부분적인 컨트롤러 지원을 포함한다.

name: Unders_core
input:
Join our discord community

About the Game

The Reimagined Deckbuilding Experience
The Underscore introduces unique mechanics to the genre, adding a new depth to tactical decisions.

- Plan multiple steps ahead and beat the odds: the game has minimal randomness within cards and character actions. No cards like “do 1 to 5 damage on a rainy day, no dodges, no random criticals”

- Card queue instead of draw pile: cards come in a predictable queue, you know how soon that much needed card will come into play

- New tactical opportunities: carefully balance your upgrades or minmax all the way

- Build two decks every run: build Exploration deck to navigate the world and Battle deck to survive the encounters

summary.핵심플레이: 카드로 덱을 구성해 세계를 탐험하고 전투를 치르며, 여러 수 앞을 계획해 전술적 결정을 내린다. 한 회차에서 탐험용 덱과 전투용 덱을 각각 구성한다.
summary.특징: 카드와 캐릭터 행동에 무작위 요소를 최소화하고, 뽑기 더미 대신 예측 가능한 카드 대기열 방식을 사용한다. 업그레이드를 조절하거나 극단적으로 최적화하는 선택지를 제공한다.

name: Flaskoman
input:
You have no name, no history, only identification number FLASK-157. One of numerous experiments of mysterious scientist. Perhaps among other test subjects, you are the first one, which gained ability to feel emotions and think. Can you demonstrate to your creator that you are not just a test subject? Each level is an experiment to test how you interact with technical liquids, to test your intellect. Press levers, activate transporting lines, and use liquids to activate various machines. Your empty head can turn the dangerous liquids into your instrument. Use your abilities to solve test chambers and earn your freedom!



Features:

-Scientist researches the characteristics of mysterious liquids, which you can use to interact with lab mechanisms. Use it to build your own path.

-Underground lab full of interactive and dangerous mechanisms: industrial presses, transporting lines and many others. Be careful!

-Sarcastic Scientist who comment your actions. Perhaps, his attitude will change, once he understands the level of your intelligence.

summary.핵심플레이: 실험실의 각 테스트 챔버에서 레버를 당기고 운반 라인을 작동시키며, 다양한 액체를 이용해 기계 장치를 활성화하여 퍼즐을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 이름 없이 식별번호 FLASK-157로 불리는 실험체가 되어 자유를 얻고자 하며, 산업용 프레스와 운반 라인 등 위험한 장치가 있는 지하 실험실을 배경으로 한다. 플레이어의 행동에 논평하는 과학자 캐릭터가 등장한다.

name: World of Cube
input:
World of Cube is a first-person puzzle game. Players can explore and solve puzzles and proceed to the next area. Simple puzzle mechanics and minimalist world design. Although the mechanics are simple, each area has its unique puzzle and its unique solution. There is no time limit, players can take their time to solve the puzzles.

There are various types of cube. Some types of cubes that can be interacted by player with are as follows:

- Movable Cube. A movable cube that can be moved on one fixed axis. It can be used to fill a gap of 2 cubes, so the player could walk through.

- Resizable Cube. A cube can be extended into a beam, but it cannot be moved. It also can be used to fill gaps in cubes.

- Pushable Cube. A movable cube, but it moved by pushing from one side and dealt damage when it hit certain objects.

- Detonatable Cube. A non-movable cube, just will explode when interacted by the player and deal damage to certain nearby objects.

- Advanced Movable Cube. Another movable cube, but its moving axis can be changed.

There are various objects which are attached to a movable cube and can be moved as moving any other movable cube. World of Cube also combined with a various of other puzzle mechanics, such as:

- Laser mechanic. A laser where it could unlock some stuff or deal damage when it hit a certain object. There is also a laser redirector, it could help the laser reach a farther spot. Some laser shooters and redirectors are attached to a movable cube, so the player can move them as moving any other movable cube.

- Match-3 mechanic. Some movable cube has a different design, like a plain cube with each different color. When it touches another cube with the same color, they will collapse.

Beware of enemies, avoid their attacks. Players could use surrounding objects to block their attacks, like cubes or shields. In some areas, players could fight them using surrounding objects, like a pushable cube.

summary.핵심플레이: 각 구역을 탐험하며 다양한 종류의 큐브를 이동·확장·밀기·폭파시켜 퍼즐을 풀고 다음 구역으로 나아간다. 시간 제한 없이 진행할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 이동·확장·밀기·폭파·이동 축 변경이 가능한 여러 큐브와 레이저 및 방향 전환기, 같은 색 큐브가 맞닿으면 사라지는 매치3 요소가 결합되어 있으며, 적의 공격을 큐브나 방패로 막거나 큐브를 이용해 맞설 수 있다.

name: Pyun Pyun Heart Throbbing Endless Love Bakery
input:
💖"Fall in love with me!"💖

You run a slow and steady bakery 🍞
It's not super popular, but you can't help but notice how cool the customers are🥺💖
The mean, but soft-hearted food critic. . . 🍽
The shy delivery person. . . 🥚
My childhood friend. . . 👀
And the cool and mysterious detective. . . 🔍

How can I choose?? 💗

Play as the new bakery owner in town! Make a name for yourself as you interact with these charming new characters! Or perhaps. . . familiar faces?

In this point-and-click visual novel, romance or befriend four lovable characters as you uncover the mysteries of the town you've moved into! Interact with the townsfolk on your days off and explore the town from Bonnie's Bakery in an exciting new way! Use your phone to interact with the love interests and play fun mini-games with them to earn more affection!

This game features many heart-throbbing things, such as:

- Four love interests to romance!

- A town to explore through the map!

- Cute hand-drawn art!

- Unlockable CGs!

- Fun ways to interact with your love interests!

- Several thrilling mysteries to investigate!

- Multiple endings!

summary.장르: 연애 시뮬레이션, 비주얼 노벨, 포인트 앤 클릭
summary.핵심플레이: 새로 이사 온 마을에서 빵집을 운영하며 네 명의 등장인물과 연애하거나 친구가 되고, 마을을 탐험하며 미스터리를 조사한다. 쉬는 날에는 마을 사람들과 교류하고 휴대폰으로 상대와 소통하거나 미니게임을 즐겨 호감도를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 네 명의 공략 대상, 지도로 탐험하는 마을, 손그림 아트, 해금 가능한 CG, 여러 미스터리 조사 요소와 멀티 엔딩을 갖춘 작품이다.

name: TheFoolish
input:
"The volcano is seven hundred miles square and ten thousand feet high. Foolish always thought about the volcano's fierceness and how it disturbed the people, so he decided to destroy it!"
So, the heaven was moved by Foolishes' piety and decided to send you to help Foolish destroy the volcano.
Volcano

The mood of the volcano is uncertain, and it will erupt every once in a while. Once it erupts, Yugong will be devastated. Please help the Foolishes.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Foolish들을 도와 화산을 파괴하는 것을 목표로 진행한다. 화산은 주기적으로 분출하며, 분출이 일어나면 Foolish들이 피해를 입으므로 이를 막아야 한다.
summary.특징: 화산을 무너뜨리려는 Foolish(우공)의 이야기를 바탕으로 한 세계관을 사용하며, 화산이 일정 간격으로 분출하는 시스템을 중심으로 전개된다.

name: RUNES Magica
input:
RUNES Magica is a 2D loglike magic action game.

You go on a journey as "Lunia," a girl wizard who lost her father to a false charge.
Defeat the knight king who has been the cause of everything and complete your revenge.
Game Features

■ Rune system
Lunia uses rune magic completed by her father.
Discover new runes through runes synthesis and use diverse spells.

summary.핵심플레이: 소녀 마법사 Lunia를 조작해 여정을 진행하며 룬 마법으로 적을 물리치고, 원인이 된 기사왕을 처치해 복수를 완수한다.
summary.특징: 아버지가 완성한 룬 마법을 사용하며, 룬 합성을 통해 새로운 룬을 발견하고 다양한 주문을 쓸 수 있는 룬 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: After School
input:
If you've ever dreamed of taking on your school teacher with your water gun, After School is for you! Play as a child in his playground in this dynamic third-person shooter!

- Confront numerous enemies with different behaviors!

- Collect cardboard boxes and craft powerful objects to survive the nightmare waves!

- Achieve the highest possible scores and beat the strongest competitors!

- Manage your water to survive as long as possible!

This game was made as part of the Ubisoft 2023 university contest. It was made in 10 weeks with the Arcade theme.
Thanks to our friends and family for playtesting and supporting us in this huge project! Also, a special thanks to:

- eSPACE for playtesting our game

- Centre Libourne kindergarden and the kids who made amazing drawings

- Ubisoft for organizing this contest

To enjoy After School, it's important to play it with a controller.

summary.핵심플레이: 놀이터의 아이가 되어 물총으로 다양한 행동 패턴을 가진 적들과 몰려오는 웨이브에 맞서 싸운다. 판지 상자를 모아 아이템을 제작하고 물을 관리하며 최대한 오래 생존해 높은 점수를 노린다.
summary.특징: 학교 선생님을 물총으로 상대한다는 아동의 시점과 놀이터 배경을 활용한 세계관을 갖추고 있으며, Ubisoft 2023 대학생 콘테스트의 아케이드 테마로 10주간 제작되었다. 컨트롤러 플레이를 권장한다.

name: Airplane Racer 2021
input:
Fasten your seatbelts and get ready for this realistic arcade styled flight game. Fly by yourself or in offline versus mode. Unlock new items and tracks as you progress. Play with your gamepad or your keyboard. Race with your opponents with weapons and shields. Follow up yourself on the leaderboard.



Features :



-Airplane controller



-Booster cooldown system



-Enemy AI



-Dogfight system with 5 weapons (machine gun, missiles, mines, shield and repair)



-Alternative routes



-Solo and Versus modes



-3 gameplay modes (Championship, Arcade and Time Trial)



-3 difficulty levels



-Local Leaderboard



-Unlock system: items or tracks unlock as you progress



-Countdown system

summary.핵심플레이: 비행기를 조종해 트랙을 달리며 상대와 경주하고, 기관총·미사일·지뢰 등 5종의 무기와 실드로 도그파이트를 벌인다. 부스터 쿨다운과 대체 경로를 활용해 순위를 겨룬다.

name: Awkward
input:
WISHLIST AWKWARD 2, OUR LATEST PARTY GAME!

About the Game

PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK
At the end of the 1800s the government declared a global ban on this legendary card game due to an increase in bar fights, divorces, and family feuds. It was political correctness gone mad.

Awkward is the ultimate test on finding out how well friends, couples, and family know each other. Using a keyboard (even for multiple players!) or a controller, players are asked to answer increasingly uncomfortable questions in secret, while their companions try to guess the outcome.
PLAY THROUGH THREE ROUNDS

- ROUND 1: A starter round with relatively normal questions. Do you prefer cats or dogs? Pineapple on pizza, yay or nay?

- ROUND 2: Slightly awkward questions, but nothing too strange. Hopefully. You can do this.

- ROUND 3: Definitely the most awkward questions. What part of your partner do you prefer, body or face? If you could only save the life of one, would you choose a 1-year-old or an 18-year-old?

Guess how the other player answered and get to the top of the leaderboard!

Whether you deduce correctly or incorrectly, games of Awkward help players see each other in a brand new light. And your opinion counts: each Awkward question will let you compare your vote to the rest of the world. Banned for over 120-years, Awkward is back, and you can now enjoy this controversial adult card game as a videogame.
QUALITY GAMEPLAY
Featuring the original banned questions, as well as all new content written by Danny Gallagher (Quiplash, Fibbage 2) and Joanna Haslam (Buzz! Quiz World, It's Quiz Time). One to six players can join in, with a huge selection of game modes on offer. Play cooperatively, as teams, competitively, or solo players can play alone to guess how the rest of the world fared with Awkward's controversial questions.
NOT JUST FOR LOCAL MULTIPLAYER
Awkward features innovative streaming technology which lets up to 500,000 concurrent viewers play along with you in your stream on Twitch! Thanks to the unique 'Live Show' technology, viewers can participate in the chat, without needing a mobile companion app or having to visit a special website. Your viewers have to guess what you think, and compete to get their names on the top of the leaderboard!

Awkward is the ultimate party game featuring over 5,000 fiendish questions. Do you dare to find out how well you really know each other?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 점점 불편해지는 질문에 비밀리에 답하고, 다른 참가자들은 그 답을 맞히려 시도하며 점수를 쌓는다. 세 개의 라운드를 거치며 질문의 수위가 점차 높아진다.

name: Toon Tumble
input:
"Toon Tumble" is a side-scrolling runner game with beautiful graphics. The game adopts a cartoon-style screen, and players need to jump continuously, pass through various organs and obstacles, and finally reach the end point.



In "Toon Tumble", players need to shuttle in a world full of organs and traps, explore different levels, solve various puzzles, and overcome various challenges. The level design in the game is unique, with various thrilling challenges and interesting gameplay, allowing players to constantly challenge themselves in the game and gain a sense of accomplishment and fun.



Let players experience different game fun in different environments. In addition to the scene changes, there are many different props and mechanisms in the game, allowing players to obtain different experiences and challenges during the parkour process.



The music and sound effects in Toon Tumble are also excellent, adding even more fun and atmosphere to the game. The music in the game has a strong sense of rhythm, which cooperates with the player's jumping, climbing and sprinting, making the whole game process more exciting and energetic.



In short, "Toon Tumble" is a very good side-scrolling parkour game, with exquisite graphics, unique level design, various scenes and props, rich achievements and music, etc., allowing players to constantly challenge themselves in the game Self, gaining a sense of accomplishment and having fun. Whether you are an old player who likes parkour games or a novice player who is interested in parkour games, you can find your own fun in "Toon Tumble".
