name: Planet after us
input:
The Planet After Us computer game is an RPG set in a 3D world. The game world is not very large and is designed for five hours of playthrough, although in fact the game can take much longer on the first playthrough. The game has several professions that you need to learn and upgrade in order to collect resources and transform them into goods for sale. You will also have to learn the profession of a key maker in order to open the locks of chests. And of course, the most important thing is the pumping of various skills for fighting with opponents. The main enemy in the game are robotic tanks that roam singly or in groups around the map. The game has a rather complex combat mechanics, each gun has penetration and three types of damage. At the same time, the armor of opponents can also have different thicknesses and other parameters, due to which you may not be able to penetrate it, or vice versa, you will crit with every shot. Therefore, you will have to collect complex sets of weapons to kill every serious enemy. A feature of the game world is the presence of a super-dense atmosphere, due to which the projectiles fly slowly and during the battle the enemy can dodge your shot, so that even a volley from four different guns at the same time can be carried out past the target. It is necessary to predict the position of the enemy in space and strike ahead of time, correctly calculating the trajectory.

The atmosphere of the game is generally relaxing, the opponents are not scary, even those areas where evil has settled, cemeteries with crucified skeletons look quite peaceful. Mostly a pleasant, pleasing to the eye beautiful landscape, strange trees, strange objects. What can I say this world was designed by robots.

The plot of the game is as follows, a young man from our world got into the world of the future called Human Park and he has to put his own order in it. Human Park is a park built by robots to remember people, it has houses and all the attributes of architecture that was in the era of people, but at the same time cars roam the world. However, not everything is safe in this world, in recent years some mafia bosses have appeared who have settled in black fortresses, and the robots themselves living in the Human park have become aggressive, it's time to put things in order here...

summary.핵심플레이: 3D 오픈 필드를 탐험하며 여러 직업을 배우고 성장시켜 자원을 채집·가공해 판매하고, 열쇠 제작으로 상자를 열며, 전투 스킬을 강화해 로봇형 전차 적들과 싸운다.

name: NULL Train
input:
Overview

NULL Train is a 2D pixel-art roguelike where you fight, adapt, and survive your way through an endless, procedurally-generated sci-fi train. Each train car is a new level — some filled with enemies, some with hazards, or strange physics like zero gravity.

Battle your way through, collect items to unlock permanent upgrades, and try to push further with each run. When you die, it’s back to the start — but with better gear, sharper reflexes, and a new strategy.

Design

-
Fast-paced side-scrolling combat with melee and ranged weapons

-
Jetpacks, energy swords, and futuristic gear to unlock

-
Randomized train cars: enemies, multi-floor layouts, gravity shifts

-
Permanent progression system: earn "ticket stubs" to unlock skills, weapons, and equipment

-
Gritty sci-fi pixel art style with atmospheric lighting and cinematic vibes

-
Designed for replayability, learning, and experimentation — every run is different

Localization

Currently available in English.
Localization into additional languages may come in a future update. Let us know which languages you'd like to see via the community hub!

name: Legend of Azcarth
input:
Game Description
Venture into ancient ruins in pursuit of an ancient power in order to stop the ones who kidnapped you and save the world from further corruption. Out of your element and surrounded by danger, who knows what you might find hidden in Azcarth, be it magic, friends, or even part of your own history.

Climb, grapple, and possess your way through Legend of Azcarth, an Indie third person adventure game made by a team of game design students at UCFs capstone Game Workshop course. Created over the course of two semesters from start to finish entirely from scratch, and now brought to steam to share with the gaming community that every member of the team came from.

Story
Legend of Azcarth is set in an alternate near future where the world, once full of magic long ago, has now fallen under the control of an oppressive mega corporation, Devcon. In their hunt to grow their power they discover the source of an ancient power, and in their efforts to obtain it for themselves they have kidnapped orphan Laudia, thinking she is but an insignificant orphan that happens to be in possession of a small shard of Azcath’s past. Little do they know she has more power in her than even she is aware of, and soon will discover for herself with the help of a new ghostly ally.

Key Features

Versatile Grapple Hook
Unique and flexible grappling hook with three unlockable abilities to help you maneuver through the world of Azcarth and keep your enemies at arm's length.

Enemy Possession
Use your new spiritual ally to take control of enemy guards and use them to your advantage to scout ahead and disable some of the many barriers in your path.

Hand crafted world
Three levels designed and built entirely with custom made assets, everything from the largest towers to the smallest stones made custom for this game. No asset flipping here.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 고대 유적을 탐험하며 등반, 그래플 훅, 적 빙의 능력을 활용해 이동하고 장애물을 통과한다. 그래플 훅은 세 가지 해금 가능한 능력을 가지며, 영적 동료를 통해 적 경비병을 조종해 정찰하거나 장벽을 해제할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 마법이 사라지고 거대 기업 Devcon이 지배하는 대체 근미래를 배경으로, 고대의 힘과 관련된 고아 소녀 Laudia의 이야기를 다룬다. UCF 게임 워크숍 캡스톤 과정의 학생 팀이 두 학기에 걸쳐 제작했으며, 세 개의 레벨과 모든 에셋을 직접 제작했다.

name: vivid/stasis
input:
EVERYTHING IS ABOUT TO CHANGE

vivid/stasis is a rhythm-mystery hybrid game that follows the fates of four girls as they get wrapped up in a mind-bending adventure involving organizations, mysterious disappearances, and the fourth dimension. The game ties together an emotionally intense interweaving storyline with varying levels of music-based gameplay... and more...?

In the rhythm game section of vivid/stasis, you'll find yourself facing various levels of difficulty, with many options for customizability to play the game your way. Whether you're a casual rhythm gamer just here to enjoy the story, or a hardcore rhythm game legend looking to find a new kind of challenge, there's a good chance you'll find it here. Between "Opening", "Middle", "Finale", and the extra-spicy "Encore" difficulty, players will be sure to find something fun for their skill level no matter their prior experience with rhythm games.

Unlike other traditional vertical-scrolling rhythm games, vivid/stasis introduces the concept of "Bumper Notes"; notes that take up two lanes. These notes can be hit with either of the keys assigned to the lanes it falls under, giving the game a unique playability with strictly four keys, despite the six types of possible notes.

The song list of vivid/stasis features well-known and prominent artists in the music game scene (Tanchiky, Camellia, Silentroom), but also shines light on a fair amount of lesser known producers (A-Saph, Lundy, Spehs, and many many more).

On July 21st, 2022, Tsuki Tasogare went missing after not coming home before her agreed-upon curfew.

An investigation was picked up, but after less than a day of little to no progress, her sister, Saturday, finds the lack of enthusiasm for finding her sister confusing, and gets impatient.

And so, she decides to look into it herself. Alongside her friends, Allison and Kotomi, Saturday hopes to uncover the secret behind her sister's strange disappearance... and isn't quite ready for what she discovers.

vivid/stasis' story spans multiple chapters and multiple game genres to tell a coming-of-age story about living with trauma from a young age, and what makes our feelings "real".

summary.핵심플레이: 세로 스크롤 방식의 리듬 게임을 플레이하며, Opening, Middle, Finale, Encore 등 여러 난이도와 커스터마이징 옵션 중에서 선택해 노트를 처리한다. 리듬 게임 구간 사이사이에 스토리가 전개된다.
summary.특징: 두 개의 레인을 차지해 양쪽 키 중 하나로 칠 수 있는 'Bumper Notes' 시스템을 도입해 네 개의 키만으로 여섯 종류의 노트를 처리한다. Tanchiky, Camellia, Silentroom 등 리듬 게임 음악가들의 곡을 수록하며, 실종 사건과 4차원을 소재로 네 소녀의 이야기를 여러 챕터에 걸쳐 다룬다.

name: Trolley Gold
input:
Do you want to collect all the gold in the world? The game Trolley Gold gives you this opportunity! In this game you have to get into the role of gold miners team. You control the two crew members who using uncomplicated mechanism drive the trolley. You need to catch the gold nuggets, which another friend of yours produces. He skillfully wields a pickaxe and never gets tired. Also you have other friends who are happy to help you with a variety of useful things, so that your team would be able to fulfill its main goal - to collect as much gold as possible. But it’s not so simple, throughout the game you will have to face many obstacles and enemies that with all the forces want to hinder you. Well, who said it would be easy? During the game you will visit several places around the globe and learn a lot of interesting things about the life of gold diggers.
Features Of the Game

- 5 original colorfully drawn locations

- Original enemies and obstacles throughout the game

- System of assessment of passing the level

- Realistic physics in the 2d world

- Fascinating and original gameplay

- Historical facts as the game progresses

summary.핵심플레이: 두 명의 광부 캐릭터를 조작해 트롤리를 움직이며, 곡괭이질하는 동료가 만들어내는 금 덩어리를 받아낸다. 장애물과 적을 피하면서 최대한 많은 금을 모으는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 세계 각지의 5개 지역을 배경으로 진행되며 2D 물리 시스템과 레벨 평가 시스템을 갖추고 있다. 게임 진행 중 금광 채굴과 관련된 역사적 사실이 제공된다.

name: Mystery Hotel: Hidden Objects
input:
🕵️ Step Into the Shoes of a Detective

Unravel the chilling mystery behind the walls of Hotel Noir, a once-peaceful retreat hidden in the highlands of Western Europe. Your arrival is quickly overshadowed by a shocking murder, and only you can uncover the truth.

🔍 Investigate, Interrogate, Trust No One

Dive into a classic detective adventure where every clue matters. Explore richly detailed environments, question suspicious characters, and piece together the evidence. Be careful who you believe, nothing is quite as it seems.

🎨 A Visual Feast for Mystery Lovers

Immerse yourself in colorful, hand-crafted scenes, smooth animations, and eye-catching 3D effects that bring the story to life. Whether you're solving puzzles or chasing leads, every moment is filled with atmosphere and intrigue.

🧩 Features That Keep You Coming Back

• Variety of gameplay including hidden object scenes, spot-the-difference challenges, logical puzzles, and object restoration
• Replayable scenes with new quests and collectible rewards
• Flexible experience with no time limits, plus bonus rewards for speed and accuracy

Ready to Crack the Case?

If you love immersive storytelling, clever puzzles, and atmospheric mysteries, Hotel Noir is calling. Sharpen your instincts, trust no one, and uncover what really happened.

Start your investigation today! The truth won’t wait.

summary.핵심플레이: 탐정이 되어 Hotel Noir에서 벌어진 살인 사건을 조사하며, 장면을 탐색하고 인물을 심문하며 단서를 모아 사건을 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: 숨은 그림 찾기, 틀린 그림 찾기, 논리 퍼즐, 사물 복원 등 여러 유형의 미니게임을 제공하며, 시간 제한이 없고 속도와 정확도에 따른 보너스 보상 및 재플레이 가능한 장면과 수집 요소가 포함된다.

name: Naval Battles Simulator
input:
„Not the battleships fight, but men”

Naval Admiral Józef Unrug (1884-1973) – the father of the Polish navy.



Battleship or Salvo? No, it’s much more!



Naval Battles Simulator is not an ordinary game: it is a tactical simulation of naval operations. NBS will throw you into the world of being a fleet commander in the most exciting battles on the water ever – the darkest times of World War II (1939-1945).

NBS gives you an unpatrolled opportunity to control the actions of your fleet.

With options based on real-world mechanics, you'll be able to control the fate of every single unit on the sea - from maneuvering the ship through the ammunition selection and finally to controlling your whole fleet.



Features:

* A multitude of battleships to choose from - feel like a real commander of a single vessel or even a whole fleet of the Second Republic of Poland, Third Reich or the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland!

* Enhanced tactical options - use well-known strategies to defeat your opponents or create your own ones!

* Advanced game mechanics that influence the player's actions – weather based on the historical data, the artificial intelligence of the opponent or even luck can thwart your plans!

* "Shipyard" mode, which gives you an opportunity to create your own fleet based on other sides of the conflict,

* The clear and legible layout, which allows for quick orientation in the heat of battle

* Archival radio snippets of BBC radio broadcasts and music to get you through the conflict!

* Featured story of the struggles of a Royal Navy sailor during the turmoil of war,

* Infinite hours of fighting at sea!



Prepare yourselves for a real sea adventure!

summary.핵심플레이: 제2차 세계대전(1939-1945) 해전을 배경으로 함대를 지휘하며, 개별 함선의 기동과 탄약 선택부터 전체 함대 운용까지 제어한다. 실제 전술을 사용하거나 직접 전술을 만들어 상대를 상대한다.
summary.특징: 폴란드 제2공화국, 제3제국, 영국의 함선을 선택할 수 있고 다른 진영 기반으로 함대를 구성하는 'Shipyard' 모드를 제공한다. 역사 데이터 기반 날씨, 상대 AI, 운 등의 요소가 작용하며 BBC 라디오 방송 아카이브 음원과 영국 해군 수병의 이야기를 담고 있다.

name: Particles of Reality
input:
This game is not for the light-hearted. This is not a happy, fluffy, feel-good game. Do not play this game if you are easily or moderately offendable.

Game Features:

-
Choose-your-own-adventure style dark, dramatic, violent, and adult otome visual novel.

-
Customize the main character's first and last name.

-
Four love interests! Yanderes galore! One of them is sort of normal...? (DLC adds an Alexander route.)

-
Warnings are available per route listing potentially triggering content. Proceed at your own risk.

-
Every choice you make drastically alters your future.

-
Over 500,000 words. 41 hours of content in 'Obsession' (with average reading speed of 200wpm), full of endless horrific fun.

-
10+ endings per route!

-
CG Gallery, including some meta images

-
5 CGs in Julian & Brandon's routes

-
9 CGs in Quinn's route

-
>10 CGs in Seb & Alex's routes

-
Bonus Content: Side Stories that reveal scenes from another perspective or outside of the main character's perspective (unlocked as you play)

-
Bonus Content: Mini Scenarios that explore histories and events in their lives for each character. (unlocked as you play)

-
Bonus Content: What-If Scenarios that explore wild alternatives, each with up to two endings. (unlocked as you play)

-
Walkthroughs available in game! No struggling how to figure out how to unlock a CG or side content

-
Choices that do not alter the ending are clearly marked. No trial-and-error required.

-
Optional censor settings. These slightly reduce the violent descriptions and skips graphic sex scenes. HOWEVER! These do not disable all adult-content or nudity.

-
Murder, torture, kidnapping, physical and emotional and verbal abuse, stalking, suicide, incest, and more!

-
No voiced dialog

Future Plans

Development for the sequel called 'Remembrance' began summer 2024, estimated release Q4 2025 (but subject to change).

Obsession - Summary:

Reality as we know it may be collapsing in on itself, because of one single human woman. The mysterious Guardians of Reality must investigate this matter urgently, determine the root cause, and either find a solution or destroy this segment of reality before things spiral out of control and the entire universe is destroyed!

But that's neither here nor there. This is a game about alternate universes and the alternative realities therein.

You play the main character of multiple versions (aka Routes) of multiple clusters of reality (aka Worlds, like Obsession!). The characters around you will always be the same people, but the worlds will vary wildly.

But... what does any of this have to do with you destroying reality?!

Characters:

You're a troubled, miserable, college student trying to live life on her own for the first time. You have two great friends, though they each have their flaws, and a brother, who you'd........... rather not talk about. Don't even ask about Mom & Dad. It's not pretty.

One day, a handsome stranger enters your life, and he doesn't want to leave. He likes you. He wants you. He needs you. He writes bad poetry about you. He is your soulmate. Your fate. Whether you like it or not. ... Do you like it... or not?

(DLC) Sebastian has a twin brother, who's lives a non-traditional hedonistic lifestyle. He cares about his brother a lot, and his brother wants you.

Julian is your co-worker. He's an asshole and a jerk, yet... on rare occasions, can also be very kind, respectful, and affection. He has a strange yet beautiful dragon tattoo that holds some special meaning to him. It's no secret that he likes you, but... he's hiding something. Something big.
Brandon is an external content patch. See the forums after release for more details.

You grew up with your brother in a house full of crime, pain, and trauma. Brandon was the only one who saw you, loved you, and protected you. Your parents kept you isolated, abusing and neglecting you while praising and supporting him... and while grooming him to takeover the mafia family and training him to be a skilled murderer, businessman, and assassin.

The more they tried to separate you, the closer you grew. You needed each other. Is it any wonder that the trauma brought you closer together in unhealthy ways?

Your best friend and roommate. He's gender-fluid, bisexual, carefree, happy, trustworthy, kind, loving, and a party animal. But... there's a lot of pain behind those eyes.

Disclaimer

This is the first game of a hobbyist writer/programmer. The artists who helped develop this game are freelancers of various skillsets, some being amateurs and some being professionals. This game was a personal passion project, not something from an official indie studio. Perfection was never the goal.

Artificial Intelligence

AI was not used in any way during development of this game.  All writing, sprites, and CGs were created by people and they are listed on the credits screen. Stock assets (or vector art from stock asset websites) were used for some background images.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 여성 주인공이 되어 선택지를 골라 이야기를 진행하며, 선택에 따라 스토리 전개와 결말이 달라진다. 4명의 공략 대상별 루트를 진행하고 각 루트마다 10개 이상의 엔딩을 볼 수 있다.
summary.특징: 살인, 고문, 납치, 학대, 스토킹, 자살, 근친 등 성인 및 폭력 소재를 포함한 다크 테마의 어드벤처로, 여러 대체 현실과 얀데레 캐릭터를 다룬다. 50만 단어 이상의 텍스트, CG 갤러리, 사이드 스토리와 What-If 시나리오 등 보너스 콘텐츠, 인게임 공략, 폭력·성 묘사를 일부 완화하는 검열 설정을 제공한다.

name: Castle survival
input:
Castle survival is a strategy building game with tower defense elements. The goal in this game is to destroy the enemy's castle and save yours.
Build the perfect defense with a mix of towers and different abilities. Create buildings that produce units. Each unit has its own parameters. Units automatically go to destroy the enemy castle, attack their enemies along the way.

In the game, you can improve:

- increased movement speed at the castle

- increased health

- increased damage

- increased armor

- creating discounts for buildings

- acceleration of the appearance of troops

- slowing down enemy units near the castle

But you can get them when you get a new level (except for damage and armor).
You can also improve the neighboring tower. If you improve it as much as possible, then a hero will emerge from it.

summary.핵심플레이: 타워와 능력을 조합해 방어를 구축하고 유닛을 생산하는 건물을 세운다. 생산된 유닛은 자동으로 적 성을 향해 이동하며 도중에 적과 교전하고, 목표는 적의 성을 파괴하고 자신의 성을 지키는 것이다.
summary.특징: 이동 속도, 체력, 데미지, 방어력, 건물 할인, 유닛 생성 가속, 성 근처 적 감속 등의 업그레이드를 제공하며 일부는 레벨업으로 획득한다. 인접한 타워를 최대치까지 강화하면 영웅이 등장한다.

name: French Crime Detective Game
input:
9 Investigations / 9 games in 1
French Crime reinvents detective game genre with a unique narrative and gameplay.
Video statements, interactive dialogues, photos of crime scenes and clues, interactive police interrogation videos… Unravel the story, collect evidence, conduct searches, find the murderers and their motive and make sure that justice is served.
You can play alone, with a friend on the same screen, or create a team and play together remotely.
CATCH THE KILLERS!
The woman who cried under water

A young woman is found dead with her veins slit in the middle of a swimming pool.
The case is quickly closed by the police: suicide.
Will you jump to the same conclusion?
#PreliminaryInvestigation
Duration ~30mins
Written by Niko Tackian
Forbidden Dinners

A great chef found dead with his head in his plate. The discovery of Raymond Fourrier's dead body by his employees plunged the restaurant world into mourning.
#Gourmandise #Captivating #Modern
Duration ~1h30
Written by Nicolas Lebel
Phantasm

“A product of fantasy that allows the subject to express and fulfill their more or less unconscious desires and impulses.”
#Lust #Thrilling
Duration ~1h30
Written by Franck Thilliez
Bikini Junkyard

Stan and Lollypop went to the junkyard for a photo shoot. The dead body wasn't on the agenda.
#Caricatural #Offbeat #So80's
Duration ~1h30
Written by Eric Oliva
A Star is Dead

Singing, dancing, acting: Enzo was full of talent. Unfortunately, he will never see Broadway.
#Bullying at school
Duration ~2h30
Written by Laura Trompette
Mortal Speed Dating

The body of a dead man was found in the historical center of Lyon, France. A sketchbook was found on his chest.
Find out who the victim is, discover who the sketchbook belongs to... And catch the murderer.
#Metoo
Duration ~4hrs
Written by Eric Oliva
Pilots

The first 3 investigations we produced.
Duration ~4hrs

Additional information

- Frech Crime is an online detective game. You must have a good internet connection.

- You will need to create an account on the French Crime platform. This account allows you to save your progress and play on other platforms (mobile, web) by having access to investigations purchased here.

- Cooperation mode: Chat with your team using the app of your choice! (WhatsApp, Skype, Discord, Zoom, Messenger, etc.)

- Contact: contact@frenchcrime.com

summary.핵심플레이: 영상 진술, 대화, 사건 현장과 단서 사진, 심문 영상 등을 통해 사건을 풀어가며 증거를 수집하고 수색을 진행해 범인과 동기를 찾아낸다. 여러 사건을 조사하며 사건을 해결하는 방식이다.
summary.특징: 9개의 개별 조사 시나리오로 구성되며 각 사건은 프랑스 작가들이 집필했고 소요 시간이 다르다. 혼자 또는 같은 화면에서 친구와, 혹은 원격 팀으로 협력해 플레이할 수 있으며, 진행 저장과 다른 플랫폼 연동을 위해 French Crime 플랫폼 계정과 인터넷 연결이 필요하다.

name: Robosoul
input:
Robosoul is a dynamic and innovative action-adventure game that combines old-school FPS action, two worlds to explore, strategic gameplay elements and stealth mechanic.

Discover a story about a family that set out to colonize the planet Pax-Animi. Play as Daniel, the son of two scientists who loses his mortal body and whose consciousness is transferred to the planet's mainframe network.

Robosoul is an easy to play but hard to master game.

You play as Daniel in a computer simulated world, from there, you can enter the real world as Robosoul, a powerful robot, to fight in the war against the shadow-aliens.

- Explore the real world and the simulation completely at your own pace, both worlds are different but are connected in many ways

- Overpower the enemy AI with your own army of robots and capture cores to gain energy and power the simulation

- Unlock gates to discover new areas, find new weapons and blueprints

- Find and use blueprints and recipes to craft, build and plant

- Unique technology, Robosoul is developed on the custom made WorldAxis3D engine

summary.핵심플레이: 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 세계에서는 Daniel로, 현실 세계에서는 로봇 Robosoul로 전환해 그림자 외계인과 전투를 벌인다. 게이트를 열어 새 지역을 탐험하고 무기와 설계도를 찾으며, 코어를 확보해 에너지를 얻고 로봇 군대를 운용한다.
summary.특징: 행성 Pax-Animi를 개척하려던 가족의 이야기를 배경으로, 죽은 육체 대신 의식이 행성 메인프레임에 전송된 Daniel을 다룬다. 서로 연결된 현실과 시뮬레이션 두 세계를 탐험하며, 설계도와 레시피로 제작·건설·재배가 가능하고 자체 제작 엔진 WorldAxis3D로 개발되었다.

name: Dysarmia
input:
Welcome to DYSARMIA. In this RPG you play as Astrid and Phoenix, two lovebirds who are separated by a meteor throwing them both on to the opposite person’s home planet. Your goal is to find the scattered bridge pieces to help bring our lovers back together. You will fight monsters, pets, and unidentified life forms in order to connect the bridge between the two back together.



features:



Talk to people in order to unlock clues to where the bridge piece is.

Dodge enemy attacks in an open world and fight back with your weapon.

Original art and soundtrack brimming with personality.

Character-rich cutscenes with a lot of personality.

Created by a team of four.

Escape.

Cats.

Talking Cats.

Bats and Scorpions.

Save your progress and come back later.

Survive, run away if you have to.

summary.핵심플레이: 두 주인공 Astrid와 Phoenix를 조작해 흩어진 다리 조각을 찾고, 오픈 월드에서 적의 공격을 회피하며 무기로 몬스터와 생명체를 상대한다. NPC와 대화해 다리 조각의 위치에 대한 단서를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 운석으로 서로 다른 행성에 떨어진 두 연인을 다시 이어주는 이야기를 다루며, 오리지널 아트와 사운드트랙, 캐릭터 중심의 컷신을 포함한다. 진행 상황 저장과 도주 요소가 있다.

name: Kramora's Shadow
input:
Explore five different worlds, fight their monstrous inhabitants and try to survive and find an ancient artifact to save the world from destruction.

For every game session, the game will create new environments full of challenges and surprises, populated with monsters and ancient magical artifacts.

There are ten different player classes, each one designed with a unique playing style. Some of them are combat-focused, others have access to magic spells in 4 different schools of magic while others must rely on their special martial skills to survive.

As you advance through the game, you will find over 40 different types of monsters with distinct skills and abilities, you will be able to charm them using magic spells and make them join your quest. By using some of the ancient magic found in the dungeon, you can unlock more advanced forms of their powers and skills.

The game keeps track of your adventures on its online server, sharing the in-game events with your friends in real time, maintaining a leaderboard of the most successful heroes as well as a graveyard of memorable characters which you can share in social media.

Ananias is a traditional turn-based "roguelike" adapted for modern players, it removes the cumbersome movement and complex commands while keeping all the features from the genre that make the games fun and enjoyable: turn-based combat, random level generation, and long term item strategy. These are among the things that make every adventure into the game unforgettable.

summary.핵심플레이: 턴제로 진행하며 다섯 개의 서로 다른 세계를 탐험하고, 몬스터와 싸우며 세계를 구할 고대 유물을 찾는다. 매 플레이마다 무작위로 생성되는 환경과 아이템을 활용해 생존한다.
summary.특징: 고유한 플레이 스타일을 가진 10개의 직업과 40종 이상의 몬스터가 있으며, 마법으로 몬스터를 매혹해 동료로 삼고 고대 마법으로 능력을 강화할 수 있다. 온라인 서버를 통해 플레이 기록과 리더보드, 기념 캐릭터 묘지를 실시간으로 공유한다.

name: Dominated By: Nerdy Childhood Friend
input:
1 Year after moving into the dorms at your new university, you're about to spend Christmas alone until your sadistic childhood friend barges in against your will and decides to sadistically bully you for her own pleasure and entertainment. Will you be able to endure her cruel torment?

Yuka-sensei makes a cameo at the end of the story

-
Full nudity H-Scenes

-
Approximately 8K words

-
Censored & uncensored mode

-
15 Character images

-
A gallery with uncensored CG's in the game

-
Kinetic Novel

-
All characters are over 21 years of age

summary.핵심플레이: 약 8,000단어 분량의 키네틱 노벨로, 정해진 이야기를 읽으며 진행한다. 대학 기숙사에서 크리스마스를 혼자 보내려던 주인공이 어린 시절 친구와 재회하는 전개를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 성인용 H씬과 전체 노출 묘사를 포함하며, 검열 및 무검열 모드를 지원한다. 15장의 캐릭터 이미지와 무검열 CG 갤러리가 제공되고, Yuka-sensei가 이야기 후반에 카메오로 등장한다. 모든 등장인물은 21세 이상으로 설정되어 있다.

name: Homeshift
input:
Story

Dire circumstances see Boy escaping from home with shady figures on his tail. Find your way back while avoiding capture - through caves, mountains and mysterious facilities.

Follow the road to a home where all might not be as it seems, all the while avoiding mishap and destruction, and the dangers of gambling.

Gameplay

Homeshift is a challenging 2D side scroller for experienced players and beginners alike. Expand your arsenal with items such as a Parachute, and carve ways through enemies with explosive consumables. Money is your best friend, while you experiment with various tools in your toolbox.

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 소년을 조작해 추격자를 피해 동굴, 산, 시설 등을 지나 집으로 돌아가는 길을 찾는다. 낙하산 같은 아이템과 폭발성 소모품 등 다양한 도구를 활용해 적을 상대하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 돈을 활용해 도구를 확장하고 실험하는 요소와 도박 관련 위험 요소가 포함되며, 겉보기와 다를 수 있는 집을 향해 나아가는 이야기를 다룬다.

name: Tranquility Base Mining Colony: The Moon - Explorer Version
input:
Update Notes

A major update will be released on July 20th. 2020
The update will fix the several "glitches" or dead-zones within the area. These dead-zones are areas in which the player is brought back to the Main Menu. If you have not saved your score you will lose any unsaved points. One of these dead-zones lies within the green radiation area northwest of the Starter Arena. Others are invisible. Because of this, we are lowering the price until the Update is released. Of course, anyone who purchases before the update will receive the update for free.
REMINDER: This is a very large exploration area. 17,000 sq. km, takes a large file. The download file unpacks to about 35 GB.

About the Game

Wanna' walk on the Moon?

Tranquility Base Mining Colony: The Moon - Explorer Version, is a Lunar Exploration Simulator. It is the Early Access version to our Tranquility Base Mining Colony: The Moon - Achiever Version, which is due to be released in July, 2021.

We've been working on the ACHIEVER version for three years now, and decided that since we've had so much fun running around the Moon for the last three years, that we'd share this experience with those fellow space-geeks who'd like to geek out, like us, and explore the Moon from this unique point of view that very few have ever experienced.

This is an open-world area that encompasses about 17,000 sq kilometers of lunar terrain around the Apollo 11 landing site. We've taken topographic data from NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Laser Altimeter (LOLA) which is mounted on the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) to create this 3d map for you to explore.

You and your character can view in first-person or third-person perspective as you explore:

- Begin at the the Starter Arena, along the southern rim of Moltke AC Crater as you learn the fundamentals of Jet-Packing in the Moon's low gravity environment.

- Explore Hypatia Rille and visit nearby Moltke A Crater and the highlands south of the Sea of Tranquility.

- Walk or Jet-pack down into the enormous Moltke Crater which is about 6 kilometers across.

- Head north to visit the Tranquility Base Lunar Reserve Visitor Center, gateway to the Apollo 11 landing site. Head further north to Collins Crater, or the east to see Armstrong Crater or to the far west to visit Aldrin Crater, all named after the Apollo 11 astronauts.

There is so much more to see and explore. You'll see just how beautiful the Moon actually is up close and personal, from the vast Sea of Tranquility to the highlands and mountains in the south.

View a picture map of the area:

Welcome to Tranquility Base Mining Colony: The Moon - Explorer Version. Enjoy your exploration!

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 또는 3인칭 시점으로 달 표면을 탐험하며, 저중력 환경에서 걷거나 제트팩을 사용해 크레이터와 지형을 이동한다.
summary.특징: NASA의 Lunar Reconnaissance Laser Altimeter(LOLA) 지형 데이터를 바탕으로 아폴로 11호 착륙지 주변 약 17,000 제곱킬로미터의 달 지형을 오픈월드로 구현했으며, Moltke 크레이터, Hypatia Rille, Tranquility Base 방문자 센터 등 실제 지명을 기반으로 한 지역을 탐험할 수 있다.

name: The Shafts of Damnation
input:
-
Descend into the forgotten shafts of an abandoned island. Whatever lurks below was meant to stay buried forever.

Be Smarter and Don't Get Caught.

Key Features:

-
Atmospheric Environment: Flickering lights, eerie soundscapes, and oppressive darkness.

-
Dynamic Threats: Monsters with unique behaviors stalk the player.

-
Immersive Storytelling: Story revealed through environmental clues and collectible notes.

-
Endgame Encounter: A dramatic showdown with the ultimate experiment deep within the shafts.

summary.핵심플레이: 버려진 섬의 갱도를 탐험하며 고유한 행동 패턴을 가진 몬스터에게 들키지 않고 아래로 내려간다. 환경 단서와 수집 가능한 메모를 통해 이야기를 파악한다.
summary.특징: 깜박이는 조명과 음향, 어둠으로 분위기를 조성하며, 갱도 깊은 곳에서 최종 실험체와의 대결로 마무리된다.

name: Shooter for Dummies
input:
Shooter for Dummies puts players in the perspective of a dummy. Play the most iconic FPS PvP maps: CTF, Team Deathmatch, Kill confirmed... where the winning is not the common goal: The dummy with less receiving damage wins! But don't worry dummies, you can punch players almost off the map!

Play in teams of 5 players to the different game modes:

- Capture the flag

- Team deatchmatch

- Rush

- Kill confirmed

- Conquest

- King of the hill

There are always 2 ways to finnish a map: by completing the map objectives, or after 5 minutes of game. Dummies, you are the target! Only you can score for your team, and also your health is the most important element on this game. Avoid taking damange, don't let the players attack you!

Players, you are not forgotten either. You will have access to a set of temporal bonus abilities both, to attack and protect the dummies... or the other players... Use of the 4 characters and demonstrate your FPS skills on this game changing experience.

Shooter for Dummies does never ends as it starts! Tactics and strategy will be more important than ever to win.

summary.핵심플레이: 5인 팀으로 나뉘어 Capture the flag, Team Deathmatch, Rush, Kill confirmed, Conquest, King of the hill 등 다양한 모드를 플레이한다. 팀의 더미가 데미지를 적게 받는 쪽이 승리하며, 더미만 점수를 낼 수 있어 더미의 체력을 지키는 것이 핵심이다.
summary.특징: 기존 FPS와 달리 승리 조건이 더미가 받는 피해를 최소화하는 것이며, 플레이어는 더미나 상대를 공격·보호하는 임시 보너스 능력을 사용한다. 맵은 목표 달성 또는 5분 경과로 종료되고, 4종의 캐릭터를 조작할 수 있다.

name: The Frosted
input:
The Frosted

Dive into a magical roguelite shooter filled with fast-paced combat and endless discovery. Play as Ursula, a fearless young girl exploring a mysterious enchanted world, where every run brings new challenges, powerful artifacts, and hidden secrets to uncover

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 소녀 Ursula를 조작해 마법 세계를 탐험하며 전투를 진행하고, 매 플레이마다 달라지는 도전과 아티팩트, 숨겨진 요소를 발견한다.
summary.특징: 마법적 세계관을 배경으로 한 로그라이트 구조로, 반복 플레이마다 다른 도전과 강력한 아티팩트, 숨겨진 비밀을 제공한다.

name: Hetepheres Tomb - Secrets of the Lost Queen
input:
In 1925, the Harvard University & Boston Museum of Fine Arts Expedition under George Reisner made one of its greatest discoveries at Giza:

Buried under sand, hidden among other tombs, lay the mysterious tomb G 7000X, which some believe was the final resting place of Queen Hetepheres I., mother of pharaoh Khufu.

Join the expedition that discovered this strange tomb and help them solve the mysteries that lay within.

Narrated by famous Egyptologist and Harvard Professor Peter Manuelian, you can visit a tomb that has been sealed shut for almost a century.

Uncover and restore some of the invaluable artifacts to learn about the researcher's work and how it continues till present times.

Modes

The game aims to not only be fun to play for individuals but also to be played in an educational contexts (schools, museums, ...).

Depending on how much time there is per person, you can choose between three modes*:

- Long: Relive the full history of the tomb (Playtime: ~30 min)

- Short: Focus on modern archeological work (Playtime: ~15 min)

- Exhibition: Only the final exhibition (Playtime: ~5 min)

* Each experience ends with players being able to explore the final exhibition.

summary.핵심플레이: 1925년 기자에서 발견된 무덤 G 7000X를 탐사하며 유물을 발굴하고 복원한다. 진행하면서 연구자들의 작업 과정과 무덤에 얽힌 수수께끼를 알아간다.
summary.특징: 이집트학자 겸 하버드 교수 Peter Manuelian의 내레이션으로 진행되며, 학교·박물관 등 교육 환경 활용을 고려해 약 30분, 15분, 5분 분량의 세 가지 모드를 제공한다. 각 모드는 최종 전시 관람으로 마무리된다.

name: The Tribe Game
input:
The Tribe Game is a story-driven roleplaying game where the player creates their own custom character and steps into a unique, atmospheric post-apocalyptic world where hope prevails, inspired by the classic cult-hit TV series, 'The Tribe'. Taking centre stage in the story, the player interacts with a large range of characters and 'tribes', each of whom is seeking to build a new world, and will help shape their lives and destinies. There are many diverse places to explore, quests to be accomplished, professions to level up, items and resources to be found, battles to be won, friendships to be made and adversaries to be challenged... as the player experiences all of the humour and unpredictable drama in the world of The Tribe - and tries to keep their own (and their tribe's) dreams alive.
Key Features

Interact with a large cast of Characters and Tribes!

Fate will make your character cross paths with many other survivors who are struggling to create a new world, including some familiar faces to those who have watched The Tribe TV series. For those new to The Tribe, your character will quickly discover who are the other protagonists of this world. Some will be friendly, some will be hostile, some in need, while others threaten the future of the already fragile world.

Explore a Post-Apocalyptic World (and be instrumental in creating a better future)

Travel through lots of contrasting, atmospheric locations... From the ghostly deserted Sectors of the city, to the suburbs... beyond the city to the woods and forests, to the beaches and coast... You will also need to go inside abandoned (or inhabited?) shops and buildings, including a large shopping mall...

Choose Your Own Look, Create Your Custom Character

Put yourself in the picture and make your character look like you, or somebody completely different from your imagination, using the customisable character creator. Choose from a range of combinations to select your own appearance, including hair styles, make up and markings, as well as costumes. It is also possible to completely change your look at regular points during the game as the story unfolds.

Profession Skills to Level and Items to be made or found

Level up your profession skills. Grow produce with your Farming skill. Find ingredients for recipes to create food and drink items with your Cooking skill. Use Tinkering to make items or weapons, as well as things you may need to trade over to others, or in order to complete a quest. Go Fishing. With your Tailoring skill, craft new clothing or 'armour' to enhance your character's stats. Forage and Scavenge locations for items or resources you and your tribe might require. And always be on the look out for unexpected danger or encounters.

Quests to Complete

Sometimes you will be given Quests by others. Have you got what it takes to achieve them? Keep track of your progress using your Quest Journal.
Special Features Included with The Tribe Game

The Tribe Game comes with some video content accessed from within the game, including::

- An exclusive message from Game Director Raymond Thompson (Creator of The Tribe and Executive Producer of The Tribe TV Series, as well as the writer of The Tribe Game!).

- A Character Art Evolution video showing the evolution of character designs from sketches to the finished article.

- A Promotional Video from The Tribe TV Series (and official books).

Atmospheric and Full Soundtrack featuring original (and orchestral) music

The Tribe Game includes an ambient audible experience, with locations featuring some of the sound effects from The Tribe TV Series. The game soundtrack also includes musical themes adapted for the game from the television series, some of it a full orchestral score performed by the New Zealand Symphony Orchestra.
Opening Cinematic

Before creating your character, a cinematic cut scene movie can be played, featuring animation and narration from actress Beth Allen (who played the iconic character Amber in The Tribe television series).

summary.핵심플레이: 커스텀 캐릭터를 생성한 뒤 다양한 장소를 탐험하며 여러 캐릭터 및 부족과 상호작용하고, 퀘스트를 수행한다. 농사, 요리, 제작(팅커링), 낚시, 재봉 등의 직업 스킬을 성장시키고 아이템과 자원을 채집·제작하며 전투를 치른다.
summary.특징: TV 시리즈 'The Tribe'를 기반으로 한 종말 이후 세계를 배경으로 하며, 캐릭터 외형을 게임 진행 중에도 변경할 수 있다. 게임 감독 Raymond Thompson의 메시지, 캐릭터 아트 진화 영상 등의 영상 콘텐츠와 뉴질랜드 심포니 오케스트라가 연주한 곡을 포함한 사운드트랙, 배우 Beth Allen의 내레이션이 담긴 오프닝 시네마틱을 제공한다.

name: Cubic Survivor
input: Cubic Survivor is an isometric action roguelike with a minimalist graphic style. Survive waves of enemies for as long as you can. Each kill of an enemy gives you experience points to level up your character. With each level, you get weapon upgrade points to unlock or upgrade weapons. New enemies appear every second, so the longer you live, the harder it is to stay alive.

summary.핵심플레이: 아이소메트릭 시점에서 몰려오는 적의 웨이브를 버티며 최대한 오래 생존한다. 적을 처치해 경험치를 얻어 레벨을 올리고, 레벨업 시 얻는 무기 업그레이드 포인트로 무기를 해금하거나 강화한다.
summary.특징: 미니멀한 그래픽 스타일을 사용하며, 매초 새로운 적이 등장해 생존 시간이 길어질수록 난이도가 높아진다.

name: Cibele
input:
Cibele is a game based on a true story about love, sex, and the internet.
You play as a 19 year old girl named Nina who has become close with a young man she met in an online game. Her relationship with him heats up, becoming more and more intimate with each phone call and private chat.

The game unravels in three acts.
The player plays as Nina, going into her online game, exploring her desktop, chatting with her friends and going about her daily life as she plays her online game. It is a narrative game which strives to help the player walk in Nina's shoes as she plays her online game, becoming more and more intimate with her lover as each act unfolds.

Features

- 3 full acts.

- Based on a true story.

- Multiple short films offer an intimate glimpse into Nina's life.

- A richly illustrated and scored game world to explore called Valtameri, with multiple maps.

- A fully interactive desktop that changes over the course of the game, offering a glimpse into Nina's life outside of her online game.

Recommendations and Notes

- The game takes about 1.5 to 2 hours to play through in full.

- It's recommended that you play it in one sitting.

- Headphones are recommended.

- The game is intended for mature audiences.

summary.핵심플레이: 19세 소녀 Nina가 되어 온라인 게임에 접속해 캐릭터를 조작하고, 데스크톱을 탐색하며 친구 및 온라인에서 만난 상대와 채팅한다. 세 개의 막이 진행되는 동안 Nina의 일상과 관계를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 실화를 바탕으로 하며, Valtameri라는 여러 맵으로 구성된 게임 세계와 게임 진행에 따라 변하는 상호작용형 데스크톱을 제공한다. 여러 편의 단편 영상이 Nina의 삶을 보여준다.

name: DOMiNi
input:
DOMiNi is a roguelike puzzle game that combines strategic placement of dominoes with a minimalist dungeon crawler experience. Connect dominoes to build paths, collect loot, and avoid deadly monsters as you progress through an increasingly challenging dungeon.

Features:

-
7 unlockable classes with different sets of rules and dominoes

-
21 procedurally generated levels, each one more difficult than the last

-
50+ tiles to discover, all with their own unique effects

-
50+ shop items to improve your runs

-
Strategic gameplay, where every move counts

-
Endless replayability

-
Permadeath

summary.핵심플레이: 도미노를 연결해 경로를 만들고, 전리품을 수집하며, 몬스터를 피해 던전을 진행한다. 매 이동마다 전략적 배치가 요구된다.
summary.특징: 각기 다른 규칙과 도미노를 사용하는 7개의 해금 가능한 클래스, 절차적으로 생성되는 21개의 레벨, 고유 효과를 가진 50종 이상의 타일과 50종 이상의 상점 아이템을 제공하며, 퍼머데스 시스템을 포함한다.

name: Liquor Store Simulator
input:
Liquor Store Simulator is a simulation game about developing your own store. You start your business in a small shop that you bought on credit.

At first, it won’t be easy—you’ll have to work at the checkout yourself, accept deliveries, keep records, and maintain order in the sales area. But hard work and smart decisions will help you turn a modest retail outlet into a thriving store with a wide selection and satisfied customers.

Management

Purchase goods, arrange retail equipment as you see fit.

summary.핵심플레이: 신용으로 구매한 작은 상점을 운영하며 계산대에서 응대하고, 배송을 받고, 기록을 관리하며, 매장 질서를 유지한다. 상품을 구매하고 판매 장비를 배치해 가게를 확장해 나간다.
summary.특징: 작은 상점을 점차 다양한 상품과 고객을 갖춘 매장으로 발전시키는 경영 요소를 중심으로 한다.

name: Voidnomicon
input:
Story:

The story is set in fantasy world full of ancient magic and fantastic beasts. During attempt of reclaiming the long lost "Voidnomicon" artifact the void monsters were released into the world! You need to find all the missing pages of "Voidnomicon" and use its power to save your companions and the world from destruction.

General Description:

Fantasy mixed with anime pixel graphic Action adventure 2d platformer "Metroidvania" game.

Playable character classes:

-
Multiple playable character classes to select from: Mage, Archer, Priest and Knight

-
Different abilities and playstyle for each playable character

-
Interconnected world map locations that lets you travel back and forth.

-
Fully hand drawn art. No AI used in any part of the game.

World:

Accessible location stretch from initial cemetary, through the city into further depths of the island. Each location has its own set of unique monsters and bosses to encounter.

Enemies

Monsters that you will encounter in the open world varies depending on their locations. Some of them are affected by void magic and others are still unchanged. There are undeads, ghosts, creatures of the night and beast monsters.

Bosses in the game represents monsters that were affected by void magic that corrupted them from the missing pages of "Voidnomicon" book.

summary.핵심플레이: 마법사, 궁수, 사제, 기사 중 하나를 선택해 서로 연결된 지역을 오가며 몬스터와 보스를 상대하고, 흩어진 'Voidnomicon'의 페이지를 찾는다.
summary.특징: 고대 마법과 환상종이 등장하는 판타지 세계를 애니메이션풍 픽셀 그래픽으로 구현했으며, 공허 마법의 영향을 받은 몬스터와 그렇지 않은 몬스터가 지역별로 다르게 배치된다. 모든 아트는 손으로 그렸으며 AI를 사용하지 않았다.

name: SEARCH ALL - SNAILS

summary.핵심플레이: 넓은 배경 안에 숨겨진 달팽이 100마리를 눈에 띄는 곳부터 잘 보이지 않는 곳까지 찾아낸다. 진행 중 언제든 중단할 수 있으며 결과는 자동 저장된다.
summary.특징: 배경에 애니메이션 요소가 포함되어 있고, 찾기 어려울 때 사용할 수 있는 힌트 기능과 배경 음악을 제공한다.

name: Snake Path
input:
OUR GAMES

Snake Path will drag you into a cycle of adventures in the spirit of classic arcade games. Collect fruits, avoid obstacles and enemies, grow to a huge size, compete with other players and learn all the secrets of the island!
Features:

- Classic game in a modern shell

- Advanced game modes

- 5 colorful locations

- Leaderboard

- Special abilities

- Mini-bosses

- Ability to watch a replay of the game and share it with your friends

Game modes:

- Classic game mode - crawl, collect apples, avoid obstacles and fight mini-bosses, collect keys and unlock new levels

- Hunger mode - you are a hungry snake, VERY hungry. Collect apples in the allotted time and get a reprieve

- Competitive mode - a mode for real snake lovers. Show what you can do and tell the world about it in the leaderboard

Locations:
Explore the island and all its biomes, visit the temple of the search for truth, crawl through the jungle, explore the pyramid, avoid an avalanche and try not to get burned in the mouth of a volcano!
Abilities:
Some apples can give you additional abilities, that you can use in critical situations:

- Invulnerability - use to crawl over an obstacle, dodge a stone or use the ability to fight a mini-boss

- Increased speed - who said snakes are slow? with this ability, you're making speed like a racing car!

- Slow down - use it in situations where you need to be extremely careful

Mini-bosses:
Do you want to open a new level? Fight with mini-bosses on the map and prove that you are worthy to learn all the secrets of the island
Replays:
All your gaming experience is saved and you can always look at how you played and reached an incredibly large size - use this feature to share the best moments with your friends

summary.핵심플레이: 뱀을 조종해 사과 등 과일을 모아 크기를 키우고 장애물과 적을 피하며, 미니보스와 싸워 열쇠를 모아 새로운 레벨을 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 클래식 모드, 제한 시간 내 사과를 모으는 헝거 모드, 리더보드 기반 경쟁 모드를 제공하며, 사원·정글·피라미드·눈사태·화산 등 5개 지역과 무적·가속·감속 등 특수 능력, 플레이 리플레이 저장 및 공유 기능을 포함한다.

name: Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator
input:
Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator combines this era's unforgettable wild west atmosphere with a modern game. This sniper game brings an innovative breath to the game world.



Are you ready to dominate your enemies through the eyes of a sniper on the dusty roads of the Wild West? Great graphics and realistic sound effects take gamers to a different period, namely the Wild West. Among the fps games, this game stands out with its atmosphere and concept.



There are two different modes in the game. The free mode, which is the first to appear, offers players complete freedom. In this mode, you can shoot as you wish, determine your strategy and eliminate the guards around you individually. While enjoying the freedom, you will also test your sniping skills.



Ten different levels are waiting for game lovers in the level selection mode. Your goal in this war game mode is to reach the desired target score within the specified time. Each level awaits you with its challenges and surprises. You can feel like a sniper and hit your targets accurately by making strategic moves.



This fps game, set in a wide terrain, aims to give its players a real sniper experience. You must find the best hiding place, accurately determine your target and neutralize your enemies with a single bullet.



The game's FPS perspective increases the sense of realism. This perspective makes the game more impressive and realistic, especially in the sniper games category. This perspective enriches the game's atmosphere, which makes you feel like you are there when you point at your enemies.



Sniping is a skill that requires strategy and tactics. Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator provides the perfect platform to test this skill at the highest level. This game, which rewards strategic thinking and quick reflexes, provides an ideal environment to improve your sniping skills.



If you are looking for a realistic sniper experience and want to experience it in the unique atmosphere of the Wild West, Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator is for you. This game aims to gain a solid place in the sniper and fps games category. Prepare your sniper rifle and embark on an unforgettable adventure in the Wild West!

summary.핵심플레이: 저격수 시점에서 서부 지형의 적을 조준해 사격하며, 은신처를 찾아 목표를 제거한다. 자유롭게 사격하는 프리 모드와 제한 시간 내 목표 점수를 달성하는 레벨 모드로 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 서부 시대를 배경으로 하며 프리 모드와 10개 레벨로 구성된 레벨 선택 모드를 제공한다. 1인칭 저격 시점을 통해 사격을 진행한다.

name: Hungrities
input:
Are you ready to start collecting new and adorable creatures?

⭐ Features:

+30 different creatures

4 different seasons

Day and night cycle: Day lasts 2 minutes, and night lasts 10 seconds (Cinematic)

Capture creatures by dragging them with the click and bringing them inside the farm

Dynamic: You control everything with your mouse

Visitors will react every time they see a creature

🛑 STOP the unruly creatures
📢 Bring order to your ranch! Click on the rowdy creatures so they stop fighting.

summary.핵심플레이: 마우스로 생물을 클릭해 드래그하여 농장 안으로 데려가 30종 이상의 생물을 수집한다. 소란을 피우는 생물을 클릭해 싸움을 멈추게 하고 목장의 질서를 유지한다.
summary.특징: 낮 2분, 밤 10초로 진행되는 낮과 밤 주기와 사계절이 존재하며, 생물을 본 방문객이 반응하고 모든 조작을 마우스로 수행한다.

name: Estate Agent Simulator
input: Estate Agent Simulator is a property buying, selling and renting game. Buy houses in the city, decorate them and increase their value. Earn income by advertising these houses for rent or for sale. Don't forget to use your bargaining skills!

summary.핵심플레이: 도시의 주택을 매입하고 꾸며 가치를 높인 뒤, 임대나 판매 광고를 내어 수익을 얻는다. 거래 시 흥정을 활용한다.
summary.특징: 부동산 매매와 임대를 다루는 부동산 중개 시뮬레이션으로, 주택 꾸미기와 가치 상승, 협상 요소가 포함되어 있다.

name: Brighter than Burning
input:
Story

A newborn rabbit is discovered in a world of reptiles and insects. A king is found lying in his own cold blood. The world is changing, and you have been entrusted by your ancestors to bring direction to the creatures in it.

Despite many side-scrollers lacking on plot and lore, Brighter than Burning presents a world of history, personality, and charm. Unravel what you--a rabbit--are doing in a world filled with cold-blooded creatures and discover that not everybody is who they first appear to be.

Gameplay

A fast-paced running-focused platformer inspired by classic side-scrollers. Gameplay includes sprinting through levels, jumping off enemies in the air, and avoiding various hazards. Brighter than Burning will present a number of different levels in a variety of worlds, including a hazy swamp, a village of stone, a forest filled with dinosaurs, and much more!

Art

The lush environments in Brighter than Burning are drawn by hand and inspired by the beauty of nature. Each animation is drawn traditionally frame-by-frame.

NOTE: All content on this page is in the  pre-alpha and/or concept stage and subject to change.

summary.핵심플레이: 빠른 속도로 레벨을 달리며 적을 밟고 점프하고 각종 장애물을 피해 진행한다. 안개 낀 늪, 돌로 된 마을, 공룡이 있는 숲 등 여러 세계의 다양한 레벨을 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 토끼가 냉혈 동물과 곤충의 세계에 등장하는 이야기를 다루며, 등장 인물이 처음 보이는 것과 다를 수 있다. 배경과 애니메이션은 손으로 프레임 단위로 직접 그려졌다. 현재 프리알파 또는 컨셉 단계로 내용이 변경될 수 있다.

name: Mei tales
input:
"Mei Tales" is a Chinese-style fantasy narrative card game. In the game, you can choose to play as one of several protagonists, seek companions, make critical choices, and embark on your own legendary journey.

Since the Great War between humans and demonkinds, the two races have coexisted peacefully for millennia. Humans built prosperous cities and lived harmoniously alongside demonkind. However, chaos suddenly erupts in Yongzhou City - a single stone that stirs a thousand waves. As plum blossoms begin to fall mysteriously, the relentless hand of fate starts manipulating events, leaving neither human nor demon untouched by the impending storm.

Rich Content

Huaxia - a vast world in the style of ancient China, where humans and demonkinds coexist and perceive each other. This world is full of secrets that you need to uncover. At each destination, you can choose to observe and listen, like falling petals ...... or embark on a shadowy path of theft or ambush to advance your story. Whether you choose to gain enlightenment through quiet understanding or shape your legend through cunning or cruelty, the tapestry of the land will respond to your every decision.

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 주인공 중 하나를 선택해 동료를 모으고 카드를 활용하며 이야기를 진행한다. 각 장소에서 관찰하고 듣거나 절도·매복 같은 방식을 택하는 등 선택에 따라 전개가 달라진다.
summary.특징: 인간과 요괴가 공존하는 고대 중국풍 세계 화하를 배경으로 하며, 인간과 요괴의 대전 이후 천 년의 평화가 깨지는 이야기를 다룬다. 플레이어의 선택이 이야기 전개에 반영된다.

name: Carbonflesh
input:
Jack, a bitter mastermind, wakes up from a coma that has weakened his mind and body but not his resolve.
They locked him up in a coffin on rails, and now its up to you, to show that you can haunt them even from this side of the grave.
Hack and take control of the relics of a time long past - a War saint-prison train, the living cemetery that is the mausoleum and finally the Temples occupied by the followers of the sycophant usurpers that reign unchallenged from up-high.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 혼수상태에서 깨어난 Jack을 조종해 유물화된 시설을 해킹하고 장악해 나간다. 레일 위의 관에 갇힌 상태에서 적들을 상대로 반격을 이어간다.
summary.특징: 전쟁 성인 감옥 열차, 살아있는 묘지인 영묘, 찬탈자 추종자들이 점거한 사원 등 과거의 유물들을 무대로 삼는다. 무력화된 육체에도 의지를 잃지 않은 주인공의 복수를 다룬다.

name: Quackdzilla: Pool Cleaning Simulator
input:
Feel the specific atmosphere and humor of the Pool Cleaning Simulator. Take on the role of a pool boy and discover what fate awaits you in Quackdzilla: Pool Cleaning Simulator

🦆Quackdzilla: Pool Cleaning Simulator🦆 is a free-to-play prologue of Pool Cleaning Simulator. The game aims to familiarize you with the topic of the full game, its atmosphere, humor, and the specifics of the work of a pool cleaner.

Inside you can play on 3 very different levels: Hotel Part 1, "Big Tommy" Part 1, and Part 3.

Welcome to Quackdzilla: Pool Cleaning Simulator. Relax, play, and have fun!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 수영장 청소부 역할을 맡아 수영장을 청소하는 작업을 수행한다.
summary.특징: Pool Cleaning Simulator 본편의 무료 프롤로그로, Hotel Part 1, "Big Tommy" Part 1, Part 3의 세 가지 레벨을 제공한다.

name: Abermore
input: Abermore is a first-person stealth RPG where players adopt the mantle of "The Unhanged Man", a legendary Robin Hood-esque figure in the strange and surprising city of Abermore, during the 18 days in a run up to a daring heist. Every campaign is unique, daisy chaining together robberies, across countless level variations. Each new day provides new stories to stumble into, spoils to sell on the Blackmarket, and potential collaborators to help you as you prepare for the ultimate score: "The Feast of the Lucky Few."

summary.핵심플레이: 'The Unhanged Man'이 되어 18일 동안 잠입해 절도를 반복하며, 획득한 전리품을 암시장에 팔고 최종 강도 계획을 준비한다.
summary.특징: Abermore라는 도시를 배경으로 하며, 매 캠페인마다 여러 절도가 연결되고 수많은 레벨 변형과 새로운 이야기, 협력자가 등장한다. 최종 목표는 'The Feast of the Lucky Few' 강도 계획이다.

name: iMemo
input: This is a puzzle game for the whole family. You assign the number of blocks and create a game field where you need to find paired images. Use the mouse to open the first image and then the second. If both pictures coincide, they remain open, otherwise they close back and you continue to search or remember where you came across the same ones. The number of attempts is unlimited, good training of visual memory.

summary.핵심플레이: 블록 수를 지정해 게임 필드를 만든 뒤 마우스로 카드를 뒤집어 짝이 맞는 이미지를 찾는다. 두 그림이 일치하면 열린 채로 남고, 다르면 다시 닫히며 위치를 기억해 계속 짝을 찾는다.
summary.특징: 시도 횟수에 제한이 없으며 시각적 기억력 훈련을 목적으로 하는 짝 맞추기 방식의 가족용 퍼즐 게임이다.

name: UBERMOSH
input:
"UBERMOSH is an arcade game about cutting bullets with a sword, in a gun-filled cyberpunk mosh pit."



Like a pinball table or a coin-op arcade machine, UBERMOSH was made to give you a shot of adrenaline in a couple of minutes. Each time you play a new level is generated for you to beat your score in 90 seconds.

summary.핵심플레이: 90초 동안 총알이 가득한 공간에서 검으로 총알을 베어내며 점수를 획득한다. 플레이할 때마다 새로운 레벨이 생성되어 이전 점수를 갱신하는 것을 목표로 한다.
summary.특징: 사이버펑크 배경에서 진행되며, 핀볼이나 아케이드 기기처럼 짧은 시간 안에 반복 플레이하도록 설계되었다.

name: Glaze 3D
input:
Glaze 3D is an easy and fun model repair and upgrade tool kit designed for hobbyist modelers looking to revamp old assets. Users will be able to generate creative textures, easily change materials, and export scenes as different file types.

Please leave us feedback about our product to help improve it by filling out this survey:

MAIN FUNCTIONALITIES:

- Display your scene using an advanced renderer.

- Use 20+ tools to edit and create textures including AI upscaling and noise texture generation.

- Update models to the industry standard material format (Principled BSDF) to enhance realism.

- Edit your scene so it can be imported accurately into your development engine of choice.

- Export high-res screenshots and videos of your scene to share with friends.

- Convert your model into the file type of your choice.

- Create 4 types of environment maps: cubemap, equirectangular, dual paraboloid, cross.

- Create cubemap textures from screenshots.

FEATURES TO COME:

- Upgrade models and textures to modern PBR workflows.

- Bake material textures including normal, light, and ambient occlusion maps.

- Edit models with a variety of mesh tools.

WHAT IS UNIQUE ABOUT OUR PRODUCT:

- A simple, user-friendly interface compared to other tools.

- It is fun for artists and creatives to transform old models into new creations.

- It has a higher range of model and texture files that it can import and export.

- It makes saving generated textures easy without needing a complex baking process.

SUPPORTED FILE TYPES:
Models: .obj, .fbx, .gltf, .dae, .3ds, and many more
Textures: .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .dds, .bmp, .tiff, .tif, .pbm, .ppm, .pgm
Video: .mp4, .mov, .divx, .avi, xvid, .mjpg, .x264, .wmv1, .wmv2

MODEL/TEXTURE CREATIVE COMMONS ATTRIBUTION:
