Vintage Metal Ashtray by Mattyew

summary.장르: 3D 모델링 및 텍스처 편집 도구, 애니메이션 및 모델링, 디자인 및 일러스트, 유틸리티
summary.핵심플레이: 기존 3D 모델을 불러와 20종 이상의 도구로 텍스처를 편집·생성하고, 재질을 변경하며, 원하는 파일 형식으로 변환·내보낸다. 씬을 렌더링해 고해상도 스크린샷과 영상으로 출력할 수 있다.
summary.특징: AI 업스케일링과 노이즈 텍스처 생성 기능을 제공하고, 모델을 Principled BSDF 재질 형식으로 갱신할 수 있다. 큐브맵·정방형·이중포물면·크로스 등 4종의 환경 맵을 만들 수 있으며, 다양한 모델·텍스처·영상 파일 형식의 입출력을 지원한다. 현재 얼리 액세스 단계이다.

name: Gear Path
input:
This is a small platformer Metroidvania-like game with exploring and power-ups.
It's perfect for playing while waiting for another game.
Please note that Gear Path is not an AAA project and it doesn't contain lootboxes.

I love creating small games with simple mechanics. I hope you'll like it.
If you found a bug or there's something wrong with the game, please contact me through Twitter or the forums.
Thanks for your time.
GooDCrafter

- Small nice game, perfect for playing while waiting for another one.

- 5 main and 6 bonus power-ups which will help you defeat Ancient Evil Robots.

- The game can be finished in less than an hour.

- Steam achievements (easy to get 100%).

- Doesn't contain lootboxes.

- Trading cards (plus emoticons and profile wallpapers)

- Steam Cloud.

- 4 enemy types,

- ~100 Ancient Evil Robots,

- 1 Princess,

- 11 Power-ups,

- 1 Hell dash,

- 1 Space Castle Station,

- 1 Hero,

- 5 Achievements,

- 0 Lootboxes,

- 1 EPIC BACKGROUND WITH NEBULA AND STARS.

summary.핵심플레이: 맵을 탐험하며 파워업을 획득하고, 이를 활용해 적 로봇들을 처치한다. 한 시간 이내에 완료할 수 있는 분량이다.
summary.특징: 5개의 메인 파워업과 6개의 보너스 파워업, 4종의 적, 약 100개의 로봇이 등장하며, Steam 도전 과제, 트레이딩 카드, Steam 클라우드를 지원한다. 룻박스는 포함되어 있지 않다.

name: Alchera
input:
During an operation, the steward, who is a soldier, stumbles upon a portal that was hidden at the end of the cave and used by wizards and wizards in ancient times. If you cast a spell according to a custom that sorcerers believe, you will have to pay a price. When the steward passes through the portal, he is cursed by the gods, gaining powers for other people to kill people for. He gave a piece of his soul as a price. When a piece of his soul was gone, he saw changes in his body.
Is Steward ready to survive in an age he doesn't know?
Game Mods
Story Mode
In an age unknown to Steward, join the adventure of surviving the gods and god soldiers and reaching the portal.
Huge open world
With an area of ​​16 kilometers, It Offers You Many Portals and Locations to Explore
Dynamic Weather
Weather Changes Randomly
Third Party Camera
There is only one camera angle
Loot Old Wizard houses
The spellbook from the wizard houses shows the location of the Portals and helps you to finish the game
Crafting and Skill tree
You can improve collectibles or craft new items
You can increase the level of Powers with spellbooks whose supernatural powers can be collected because they are cursed by god
Dynamic Battle System
You will feel the pleasure of the Game to the End with the Streamlined Battle system while you are fighting with god or god soldiers.

Are you ready to survive in an age you don't know?

summary.핵심플레이: 저주받아 초자연적 능력을 얻은 주인공으로 신과 신의 병사들과 전투하며, 마법사의 집을 탐색해 포탈을 찾아 게임을 진행한다. 수집품을 개선하거나 새 아이템을 제작하고 주문서로 능력 레벨을 올린다.
summary.특징: 고대 마법사들이 사용하던 포탈을 통과해 저주를 받는 설정으로, 약 16km 규모의 오픈 월드와 무작위로 변하는 날씨, 스킬 트리와 제작 시스템, 3인칭 전투 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Tower of Kalemonvo
input:
Reinforcements are not coming. Resupply is impossible. Your ascent begins.

Tower of Kalemonvo is a challenging dark fantasy Action RPG - following the slower pace and high tension seen in genre-defining classics like Diablo 1 and Throne of Darkness. Defeat wicked foes, grow stronger, gather whatever loot you can find, and tread lightly - as every encounter could be your last!

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 적을 처치하고 캐릭터를 성장시키며 아이템을 수집해 탑을 오른다. 모든 전투가 위험할 수 있어 신중하게 진행해야 한다.
summary.특징: Diablo 1, Throne of Darkness 같은 고전 작품의 느린 진행 속도와 높은 긴장감을 지향하는 다크 판타지 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 보급이나 지원 없이 탑을 상승하는 구조다.

name: Mistified
input:
‘Mistified’ is the debut game from SpiceBound Studios. A fiendishly tricksy grid based puzzle game where your presence in a strange land will guide the lost souls of creatures to a better place, or a worse one. Their fate is decided by your success or failure.

Solve 150+ expertly designed puzzles and dig deeper to uncover further challenges that will keep you puzzling as you forge ahead throughout this charming 2D world.

-
Traverse the world map by manipulating the Giant Maps pet rabbit

-
Use sounds, such as your own footsteps, to guide creatures out of harm's way and into salvation.

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 격자 기반의 퍼즐 150개 이상을 풀며, 발소리 같은 소리를 이용해 길 잃은 생명체들을 안전한 곳으로 인도한다. 플레이어의 성공과 실패에 따라 생명체들의 운명이 결정된다.
summary.특징: 2D 세계를 배경으로 하며, 거대한 지도 위의 토끼를 조작해 월드 맵을 이동한다. 소리를 활용한 퍼즐 해결 메커니즘을 갖춘 SpiceBound Studios의 데뷔작이다.

name: Leave Me Alone: A Trip To Hell
input:
Leave Me Alone is a game about guiding a fierce skater through geeky ’90s style locations. Fight monsters and mutants while performing mad skateboarding tricks.

- 21 Levels

- 15 Beautiful locations

- 24 Enemies

- 10 Bosses

- Unique fighting system

- Original soundtrack

Good art
Inspired by the best platform games of the late ‘90s, rendered with today's best technology. Unique locations change the mood from level to level.
Authentic Sound
Truly immersive audiovisual experience lets you dive into the world where monsters are as real as the rattle of your old skateboard rolling on the cracked asphalt.
Incredible Gameplay
Your hero gets more powerful as you go. The bosses get more cunning and difficult. Use your skills to make them Leave You Alone.

summary.핵심플레이: 스케이트보더를 조작해 스케이트보드 트릭을 구사하며 몬스터와 돌연변이를 상대로 싸운다. 레벨을 진행할수록 캐릭터가 강해지고 보스의 난이도가 올라간다.
summary.특징: 1990년대 후반 스타일의 배경을 무대로 21개 레벨, 15개 지역, 24종의 적과 10종의 보스가 등장한다. 스케이트보드 트릭과 결합된 고유의 전투 시스템과 오리지널 사운드트랙을 포함한다.

name: Robotex
input:
Life on Earth is unsustainable.



Humanity must seek a new home but the only planet found is very hostile.



You were sent on a expedition to slay the monsters inhabiting the surface of this planet. In this adventure you end up being the villain.



Game contains two basic controls, many puzzles and lots of guns and enemies.



(10 guns and more than 20 monsters)



The game is hard.

summary.핵심플레이: 행성 표면에 서식하는 몬스터를 처치하며 진행하고, 여러 퍼즐을 풀어 나간다. 조작은 두 가지 기본 조작으로 이루어진다.
summary.특징: 지구를 떠나 새 행성을 찾는 인류의 원정을 배경으로 하며, 플레이어가 결국 악당이 되는 전개를 담는다. 10종의 총과 20종 이상의 몬스터가 등장하며, 난이도가 높다.

name: Firelight Fantasy: Resistance
input:
Firelight Fantasy: Resistance is a thrilling third-person sword fighting game. Step into the role of Hakon, a relentless treasure hunter on a quest to uncover ancient artifacts and amass untold riches. Engage in intense battles against formidable foes and carve your path to glory.

ARTIFACTS OF LIGHT
Space explosions have spawned shards called Artifacts of Light. They are not very big, but they have a lot of energy. This power is enough to destroy several planets. Collect all the fragments and use this energy as you want - for the benefit of civilizations or however you may desire. it's up to you!

CONFRONTATION BETWEEN THE PAST AND THE FUTURE
The peculiarity is that the fragments reached the Earth at different intervals of time. How many such fragments, are still unknown, but it is assumed that most of
them reached the planet in the distant past. Different generations are trying to get these "gifts" from space, however, it’s never easy.

WITH SHIELD AND SWORD
Enough talk, it's time to get down to business and begin the search! This time you have to make your way through forests and fields under snow cover. But it is not enough to walk the path, you also need to resist the same hunters, like you, who crave the same.

GAME FEATURES:

- 6 Immersive Story-Driven Levels

- Thrilling Combat Encounters

- Diverse Arsenal and Attack Styles

- Authentic Souls-like Combat System

- Stunning Original Soundtrack

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Hakon이 되어 검과 방패로 적과 근접 전투를 벌이며, 눈 덮인 숲과 들판을 지나 유물을 찾아 진행한다. 같은 목표를 노리는 다른 사냥꾼들과 맞선다.
summary.특징: 우주 폭발로 생겨나 여러 시대에 걸쳐 지구에 도달한 '빛의 유물'을 둘러싼 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 6개의 스토리 기반 레벨과 소울라이크 전투 시스템, 다양한 무기와 공격 방식을 제공한다.

name: Die O'Clock
input:
"I finally found the clock, I think the hardest part is behind me..."

Enter this strange clock that promises to change your life. There's only one thing you need to do, complete its challenge.

Twelve keys are hidden, every step you make will get you closer to one of them... or to your end.

Die o' clock is a dark and disturbing escape room where your skills will be challenged. Explore each room and solve the puzzles before time catches up with you.

summary.핵심플레이: 각 방을 탐색하며 퍼즐을 풀어 숨겨진 12개의 열쇠를 찾고 제한 시간 안에 탈출을 시도한다.
summary.특징: 시계를 배경으로 한 어둡고 불안한 분위기의 방탈출 구성으로, 시간이 다가오기 전에 도전 과제를 완수해야 한다.

name: Over Tooned
input:
Over Tooned - An anime flavored GenX styled arcade racing game. The game is designed to be jump and go. There are no tutorials and no vehicles you have to unlock. Now with 66 vehicles with more on the way soon. Each vehicle has 104 different colors that you can freely choose from. We are starting with 40 race tracks (more to be added in future updates) and 10 explore tracks (Again more to be added in the future updates). All tracks and explore modes are randomly selected.

Just for fun we have include an Emoji System.

There are 4 Modes : 1:) Fully Automatic (This mode makes only the computer controlled cars and you can watch the races with an cool racing camera system we developed) 2:) Random Car (in this mode a race a random car in a random color against 9 computer controlled cars) 3:) Selected Car (in this mode you select a car in the garage and color it however you want and that is the car you race with against 9 computer controlled cars) 4:) Explore Mode (these modes you use the selected car or if have not selected a car you will use the default first car in its default color to run around and explore some outdoor environments and cities that we created to let you have some fun just driving around - this has no GUI (Graphical User Interface) so you can take screenshots of either the scenery or cool stunts you preform. The settings menu will tell you how to return to the main menu depending on what control set you choose).

The game controls are defaulted to the keyboard, please see the settings menu to see the supported controller options (ones that we have tested and know work) other controllers may be supported but have not been tested.

This game defaults to it's autonomous mode. This means the game's main menu starts with a 1 minute timer - if there has been no user input then it will randomly choose a race track and choose 10 computer controlled cars to race themselves. Once the race is over then the game will return to the main menu and start the timer over again. We do have a unique racing camera system setup that should allow you to enjoy the races even if you don't play.

Our computer controlled cars have a great many random variables. One such variable is their intelligence which is rolled at the beginning of every race. The computer controlled cars intellect controls how well they steer, how well the brake and how well the read curves and corners. Sometimes you will race really smart ones and sometimes you will wonder how they qualified to race in the first place. There is usually a good mix with the intellects on the track. There are 1100 racers. Each car is driven by 20-22 computer controlled races. When one of the computer controlled racers wins a race you will see a card pop up showing you who just won. The computer controlled races have a wide range of ethnic backgrounds, lifestyles, and looks.

There are three (3) distinct Racing Modes: Racing modes are default to Standard and are reset every time the game launches.

Cheesy Mode:
*Computer controlled cars have less intellect.
*Computer controlled cars have less control.
*Computer controlled have less acceleration.
*Though easier than Standard Mode you are not guaranteed to win.

Standard Mode:
*Computer controlled cars default configuration.
*Computer controlled cars have good intellect range.
*Computer controlled cars have good control.
*Computer controlled have good acceleration.

Psycho Mode:
*Computer controlled cars have more intellect.
*Computer controlled cars have more control.
*Computer controlled have more acceleration.
*For advanced drivers
*Intentionally difficult.

summary.핵심플레이: 랜덤 또는 직접 선택한 차량으로 9대의 컴퓨터 차량과 경주하며, 튜토리얼이나 잠금 해제 없이 바로 트랙을 달린다. 별도로 야외 환경과 도시를 자유롭게 주행하는 탐험 모드도 있다.
summary.특징: 애니메이션풍 스타일에 66종의 차량과 차량별 104가지 색상, 40개의 레이스 트랙과 10개의 탐험 트랙을 제공한다. 완전 자동 관람 모드와 난이도별 세 가지 레이싱 모드(Cheesy, Standard, Psycho), 이모지 시스템, 승자 표시 카드 등을 포함한다.

name: Ogo
input:
Ogo
Control Yin and Yang simultaneously through a challenging campaign full of varied levels with unique game mechanics. Skillful positioning decides on success and failure.
Your decision
Master powerful boss fights in the campaign or find relaxation in various endless game modes. Challenge yourself to beat your high score by taking risks, or play it safe and aim for flawless level completions.
Features:

- Unique gameplay

- Varied campaign

- Challenging boss fights

- Unlockable bonus levels

- Relaxing endless game modes

- High score system

- Achievements

summary.핵심플레이: 음과 양 두 요소를 동시에 조작하며 다양한 레벨을 진행하고, 위치 선정을 통해 목표를 달성한다. 캠페인에서 보스전을 진행하거나 엔들리스 모드에서 고득점을 노린다.
summary.특징: 캠페인, 보스전, 잠금 해제형 보너스 레벨, 엔들리스 모드, 하이스코어 시스템, 도전 과제 등을 포함한다.

name: Clarence Goes to the F&#%ING Store
input:
About the Game

A short, absurdist comedy choose-your-own-adventure game with a massive cast of bizarre characters, multiple endings, and a plethora of ways to be a generally unpleasant human being. Perform open-heart surgery! Rob an alien! Start the apocalypse! The choices--and consequences--are all yours! Seven zany endings await in this world of notebook-doodle visuals and wry humor!
"Oh no, Clarence, you're all out of Milk!"

Take on the role of Clarence in his heroic quest to go to the store and buy milk.
It's only a quick walk down the road; I'm sure a full cast of quirky characters definitely won't stop you along the way to inundate you with insane problems and an obtuse trading quest leading to seven unique endings!
...After all, what are the odds of that happening?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Clarence가 되어 우유를 사러 가게로 가는 여정에서 선택지를 골라 진행하며, 다양한 캐릭터가 제시하는 문제와 물물교환 퀘스트를 해결한다. 선택에 따라 일곱 가지 결말 중 하나에 도달한다.
summary.특징: 부조리한 코미디 톤과 노트에 낙서한 듯한 비주얼을 사용하며, 다수의 기이한 캐릭터와 여러 갈래의 결말을 포함한다.

name: Networm
input:
Netw0rm is an 80's sci-fi inspired action game in which the player takes on a number of large corporations as an anonymous hacker, selling or leaking stolen data files, syphoning credits from secret accounts and earning credibility amongst their peers.



They get to see the consequences of their actions as the news media reacts to the data they leak, then use their ill-gotten gains to purchase upgrades to their hardware, and install new ICE-breakers and tools to enable runs on bigger and more lucrative servers in the future.

summary.핵심플레이: 익명의 해커가 되어 대기업의 서버에 침투해 데이터 파일을 훔쳐 팔거나 유출하고, 비밀 계좌에서 크레딧을 빼돌린다. 얻은 자금으로 하드웨어를 업그레이드하고 새로운 ICE 브레이커와 도구를 설치해 더 큰 서버를 노린다.
summary.특징: 80년대 SF에서 영감을 받은 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 플레이어가 유출한 데이터에 뉴스 미디어가 반응해 행동의 결과를 확인할 수 있다.

name: Minebot expedition
input:
Minebot Expedition - you, as a robot, go on an adventure across the remains of civilization, collecting the most valuable thing left of it - emeralds. A man-made disaster has turned simple harmless bees into killer bees so powerful that only automatic systems and a handful of surviving robots from TechnoRot, an automated robot company, have survived. collect all the emeralds, deliver them to the warehouse of the technorot bypassing the killer bees. Be careful, some bees are especially dangerous! you have only one life to collect all the emeralds and deliver them to the warehouse.

Peculiarities:

- Graphics by DODO GamerY

- soundtrack by Uikilinsa

- an unforgettable post-apocalyptic adventure

- bosses

summary.핵심플레이: 로봇을 조작해 문명의 잔해를 돌아다니며 에메랄드를 수집하고, 킬러 벌을 피해 TechnoRot의 창고로 운반한다. 목숨은 하나뿐이며 모든 에메랄드를 모아 창고에 전달해야 한다.
summary.특징: 인재로 인해 벌이 킬러 벌로 변한 포스트 아포칼립스 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 특히 위험한 벌들과 보스가 등장한다. 그래픽은 DODO GamerY, 사운드트랙은 Uikilinsa가 맡았다.

name: Relgiros
input:
RELGIROS, a plateform game, tests your patience and determination as it paces up surmounting obstacles, to boost you with the adrenaline rush.

Through the game, the protagonist breezes through obstacles and traps, with a goal to prove worthy of the foresighted critical missions.

Will you dare take up the challenge staying calm through this exhilirating thrill ?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공을 조작해 장애물과 함정을 통과하며 스테이지를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 난이도 높은 장애물 극복에 초점을 맞춘 플랫폼 게임으로, 주어진 임무를 완수하는 것을 목표로 한다.

name: Glitchball
input:
Glitchball is a 2D Vaporwave party-game that's like soccer... but the ball kills you. To compensate use your shield and jetpack to ricochet the Glitchball, kill players, and score goals. Compete with your friends in this hectic, four-player party-game.

Use your jetpack and shield to deflect the incoming glitchball to score goals, kill players, and compete for dominance in a chilled out dead mall.
Key Features

- Use 360-degree dynamic shield controls to deflect the incoming Glitchball

- Maneuver through colorful levels using exhilarating jetpack based movement

- Grab power-ups to gain an advantage over your opponents

- Choose from 4 radical levels and 4 far-out characters

- Play: 1 vs. 1, 2 vs. 2, or even 1 vs. 3

- Experience the pastels and modern disillusionment of V A P O R W A V E

- Featuring NEW single-player mode. Don't even compete against anyone, just win!! *bullhorn sounds*

-

Are You Ready For Some G L I T C H B A L L ?

summary.핵심플레이: 제트팩으로 이동하며 방패로 날아오는 글리치볼을 튕겨내 골을 넣거나 다른 플레이어를 제거한다. 파워업을 획득해 상대보다 유리한 위치를 차지한다.
summary.특징: 공에 닿으면 죽는다는 규칙을 가진 2D 축구형 대전 게임으로, 최대 4인이 1대1, 2대2, 1대3 등으로 겨루며 싱글플레이 모드도 지원한다. 베이퍼웨이브 스타일의 파스텔 톤 배경과 4종의 레벨·캐릭터를 제공한다.

name: Rube Works: The Official Rube Goldberg Invention Game
input:
The first and only official Rube Goldberg puzzle game. Solve everyday problems in Rube’s trademark elaborate whimsical style by creating hilarious machines. Is pouring a glass of juice just too straightforward and boring? Try using a jack-in-the-box, magnifying glass, string and a cymbal-wielding friend to achieve your goal. The more creative your solution the better!

From award-winning designer David Fox, co-designer of the classic LucasArts graphic adventure games Zak McKracken and the Alien Mindbenders and Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Graphic Adventure as well as one of the first Lucasfilm Games titles, Rescue on Fractalus! plus SCUMM scriptor on Maniac Mansion.

Rube Works is widely adopted by a growing number of elementary and middle schools and is fast becoming one of the years favorite educational games. Aligned with CCSS (Common Core State Standards) and NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards), Rube Works is a standout app that effortlessly bridges the worlds of gaming and education.
Features

- Only official Rube Goldberg game, based on his original cartoons

- 18 Challenging Puzzles

- Beautiful Graphics

- Aligned with CCSS/NGSS

- Text in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish

More Reviews

- “…Electric Eggplant has done a great job converting Rube Goldberg’s work” —Pixelvolt

- “If you like building crazy contraptions, you’ll love this [game].” — c|net

- “Rube Works puts a fun twist on learning.” —Common Sense Media

- “A challenging and fun game that can also teach the user about physics and logic, while not appearing to be an educational [application]. Rube Works makes the iPad a great learning tool and I highly recommend this beautiful and well made [game].” —iPhone Life

- “Highly recommended!” —The iMums

- “There’s hardly a better game on Android than Rube Works right now” —AndroidSPIN

Also available for iPad, iPhone, iPod touch on the iTunes App Store and for Android on Google Play and the Amazon App Store.

More information at

Designed and Produced by Electric Eggplant. Engineering and Art by Kalani Games. Produced by Heirs of Rube Goldberg. (Originally published with Unity Games.)

ABOUT ELECTRIC EGGPLANT
Founded by David and Annie Fox in 1992, Electric Eggplant has consistently garnered kudos on its games, educational software, and books and apps for kids, tweens, and teens. David began his game design career in 1982 at Lucasfilm Games (LucasArts). During his decade there he helped invent the classic point-and-click graphic adventure genre. David is the Game Designer and Executive Producer on “Rube Works”.

ABOUT KALANI GAMES
Kalani Games is a game design & development studio in Austin, Texas. Founded by industry veteran, Kalani Streicher, Kalani Games has developed games for mobile, social and online platforms, pushing the boundaries of original, innovative and new game play experiences.

ABOUT HRG
HRG (Heirs of Rube Goldberg) is a family-run company led by Rube’s granddaughter, Jennifer George. Their mission is to raise awareness of Rube’s work and to license the intellectual property to appropriate entertainment and media partners who will remain true to the spirit of her grandfather’s legacy. HRG works in tandem with RGI (Rube Goldberg, Inc), the non-profit arm whose mission includes education outreach programs for students and tinkerers of all ages through Rube Goldberg Machine contests around the globe.

summary.핵심플레이: 일상적인 문제를 해결하기 위해 잭인더박스, 돋보기, 끈 등의 도구를 조합해 복잡한 연쇄 장치를 만들어 목표를 달성한다. 총 18개의 퍼즐이 제공된다.
summary.특징: 만화가 Rube Goldberg의 원작 카툰을 기반으로 한 공식 게임으로, 미국 교육 표준인 CCSS 및 NGSS에 맞춰 물리와 논리를 익히도록 설계되었다. 영어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어, 독일어, 스페인어 텍스트를 지원한다.

name: Arena Hero
input:
Fight your way through waves of unique enemies and evolving levels. Altering your character throughout battles in the arena by grabbing upgrades and pickups that change the way you fight throughout your battles.
Evolve your character your way
The arena will award you with item drops as you battle throughout, choose how you evolve and change throughout the battle with strange items that will change how you approach the next wave. Learn what items fit how you play and what works best for the fight ahead of you. Think ahead in an arena and decide to invest in stronger early game items, or try to aim to get the pieces of a powerful set to blast through the rest of your fight. You will need to make the most of what you find, so plan ahead accordingly!
Unique abilities and items as you progress
Unlock more specialized items and abilities as you make your way through the arenas, with unique items focused on different approaches in the arena. You'll be able to broaden your strategy and change your loadout based on the battle ahead, from defensive high health items, to energy based speed gear or even high risk luck based items.
The Arena turns against you
Strategic use of the arena and Hero positioning can allow you to make the most of the arena you find yourself on. You'll be able to use the gaps to your advantage to get dangerous enemies to fall off the arena, as you progress enemies will grow and turn this weakness into an advantage by gaining special abilities from the environment. As your enemies change the way they fight, you'll have to change up your strategy and how you use the arena environment to your advantage.
Gain new skills
As you gain reputation and skill fighting in the arenas, you'll be able to upgrade your skill set gaining better abilities and stats, allowing you to try different loadouts and strategies with ease. You'll be able to specialize your Hero as you progress in order to maximize your power in the way that you prefer to fight.
Unique Enhancers change up the Arena
Slaying special enemies will award you with unique specialized items - enhancers. Using enhancers you'll be able to drastically change the way the arena behaves and how you approach your battles. From super defensive enhancer abilities to high risk high reward, with some even adding unique special abilities to your hero, by mixing up different Enhancers you'll be able to experience battles on your own terms.

summary.핵심플레이: 아레나에서 밀려오는 적의 웨이브에 맞서 싸우며, 전투 중 획득하는 아이템과 업그레이드로 캐릭터를 성장시키고 전투 방식을 바꾼다. 획득한 아이템과 로드아웃을 다음 웨이브에 맞춰 조합·계획한다.
summary.특징: 방어형·속도형·운 기반 등 다양한 방향의 아이템과 능력으로 빌드를 특화할 수 있으며, 아레나의 지형과 캐릭터 위치를 활용해 적을 떨어뜨리는 전략이 가능하다. 특수 적을 처치하면 얻는 인핸서로 아레나의 동작과 전투 방식을 변경할 수 있고, 진행할수록 적도 환경을 이용한 능력을 얻는다.

name: PRINCIPIA: Master of Science
input:
Principia: Master of Science is a simulation game with the theme of European science in the 17th century.

Choose one of 12 real scientists from the era of Isaac Newton and proceed with your research.
There are six research topics: "Astronomy", "Physics", "Thermodynamics", "Biology", "Optics", "Mathematics".
Choose one topic (or more), perform experiments, make discoveries and submit your findings to the Royal Society of Sciences.
You can even belittle your rival scientists.

Fill and complete your own encyclopedia of inventions such as the "Pendulum clock" or "Reflecting telescope", or sketches like "Enlarged view of a cork" or "Enlarged view of a flea"!

It is a time when even the term "Science" did not exist.
Who can be the master of science?

Isaac Newton (1642〜1727)

A British physicist and mathematician. He is hailed as one of the Three Great Mathematicians. His first great discovery (the spectrum of light) was finding that white light was an amalgam of monochromatic light. Next, using his Universal Law of Gravitation, he successfully mathematically proved that planets move along elliptical orbits. The significance of this was explaining the movement of celestial and terrestial bodies under one law. The manuscript of his collective theories, 'Principia', took the world by storm, and Newton went on to obtain immutable fame. In 1705 he was knighted and known henceforth as 'Sir Isaac Newton'

Renowned invention: Newtonian telescope

Christiaan Huygens (1629〜1695)

A Dutch physicist and astronomer. His father was a government official affording him the highest standard of education. In 1655 he conceptualised a method of polishing lenses, which he demonstrated in action with the production of a high fidelity refracting telescope. Huygens valued quantitative observation leading him to invent the 'pendulum clock' in 1656, and the 'minimeter', capable of making measurements accurate within seconds, increasing the precision of observations. In the field of optics he opposed Newton's particle theory of light, asserting that it was instead a wave, but he went unacknowledged.

Renowned invention: Pendulum Clock

Gottfried Leibniz (1646〜1716)

A German mathematician and politician. It was said that he demonstrated talent in mathematics from a young age and was unparalleled in mental arithmetic. He advanced Pascal's calculator design, conceptualising one capable of multiplication and division. Additionally, he developed infinitesimal calculus during the same period as Newton did. There was severe discord between him and Newton et al. over priority rights for calculus. The notations for calculus used today are those Leibniz himself once used. In 1700 the Berlin Academy of Sciences was founded at the behest of Fredrick I of Prussia. Leibniz became its first president.

Renowned invention: Stepped reckoner

...and more characters!

This game is developed originally for the software contest held in 2000 as "PRINCIPIA".
Since then, all aspects of the game are improved including the system, graphics and sound. Also the current version has "Final theme", "Order of merit" and more. It is completely different to the original version.

The game follows actual history very closely, so you can also learn the history of science while you play the game.

All six songs were recorded in the studio by a real string quartet. These live performances suit the 17th century aesthetic very well.

If you are interested in Science, this will be a fun game for you!

summary.핵심플레이: 17세기 유럽 과학자 12명 중 한 명을 골라 천문학, 물리학, 열역학, 생물학, 광학, 수학 중 하나 이상의 연구 주제를 정하고 실험과 발견을 진행해 왕립과학회에 성과를 제출한다. 진자시계나 반사망원경 같은 발명품과 스케치를 모아 자신만의 백과사전을 채워 나간다.
summary.특징: 아이작 뉴턴 시대를 배경으로 실제 역사를 밀접하게 반영하며 과학사를 다룬다. 2000년 소프트웨어 공모전용으로 개발된 원작을 시스템, 그래픽, 사운드 등에서 개선한 버전으로, 현악 4중주가 스튜디오에서 녹음한 6곡의 음악과 '경쟁 과학자 폄하' 요소가 포함된다.

name: Watermelon Blocks
input: Watermelon Blocks is a puzzle game, with switch blocks, enemies and spikes. The game has 46 levels for you to venture out, its difficulty is gradual, but nothing that you cannot solve and have fun in this watermelon game.

summary.핵심플레이: 스위치 블록, 적, 가시가 배치된 스테이지를 풀어 나가며, 총 46개의 레벨을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 난이도가 점진적으로 상승하는 구성으로 되어 있으며 수박을 테마로 한다.

name: Overplay Crosshair
input:
Overplay Crosshair is a sleek, standalone overlay app designed for FPS players who value precision and control. It offers a streamlined way to customize, switch, and share crosshair setups with minimal effort, all without interfering with gameplay.

Custom Crosshair Designer – Build your perfect reticle with layered shapes, colors, opacity, and rotation.

-
Preset System with Keybind Switching – Instantly swap between loadouts mid-game using hotkeys.

-
Save/Load Codes – Share your crosshair builds with friends or the community in seconds.

-
Clipboard & Image Export – Copy your setup or generate a clean image for Discord, guides, or any other use.

-
Textured UI Panels – A visual identity that stands out from generic overlays — sleek, sharp, and modern.

-
Zero Input Lag – Designed for competitive play with minimal system impact.

Overplay Crosshair is completely free.
Want to support development? Grab the optional Supporter Pack DLC and help shape future features.

summary.핵심플레이: 레이어 기반 도형, 색상, 투명도, 회전 등을 조정해 커스텀 조준선을 제작하고, 게임 중 단축키로 프리셋을 즉시 전환한다.
summary.특징: 조준선 설정을 코드로 저장·공유하거나 클립보드·이미지로 내보낼 수 있으며, FPS용 오버레이 앱으로 별도 실행되고 입력 지연을 최소화하도록 설계되었다. 기본 무료이며 선택형 Supporter Pack DLC를 제공한다.

name: A Game About Flicking A Switch
input:
This is LITERALLY just a game about flicking a switch. It's in the title. You, in a room, four pale-green colored walls, stained carpet, and those funky ceiling tiles you definitely imagined punching out when you were a kid.



Are you looking for groundbreaking mechanics? There's one function in the game - you flick a switch.



Maybe award-winning graphics? Well, it is Unreal Engine 5. But let's be honest here, the engine is not in the slightest sense utilized to its highest ability in this game.



How about immersive story-driven gameplay? Nope. Not here. Unless you consider the story of you really reconciling with the fact you spent money to flick a virtual switch, when you and I both know you are most likely sitting in a room right now that has a few switches scattered around the walls. Have fun staring at your bank account later, wondering where it all went wrong as you dove helplessly into the immersive world of a 9x9x9 room with ONE SWITCH ON THE WALL FOR YOU TO INTERACT WITH.



Anyways, let's jump ahead to the key features:



There are none.



Depending on how you judge the "ending" of a game, or how you would quantify your sense of sanity in terms of time spent playing a game where you do absolutely nothing but stand in a single room flicking a single switch as time around you ticks on; endlessly disregarding any sense of desperation for it to slow down so that you may bask in the sanctity of joy for even a brief moment, until hopefully the power cuts out, or someone comes to your aide to end this troubling sense of self infliction -- It should take you around 1 - 30 minutes to complete the game.



Buy it, don't buy it. Totally your decision. This game will not keep you up at night, nor will it have you beckoning for more; but if for some reason it does butter your cups, douse your daisies in oil, or roll your drums, then I may consider you take some time away from gaming for a short period, or maybe the whole period.



I do not, in any sense of lacking the word, hope that you do not find, to any extent, any amount of enjoyment from this game.



Final note: The selected reviews above are totally not from ChatGPT. They are real, and so are the names of those who wrote them.

summary.핵심플레이: 방 안에서 벽에 있는 하나의 스위치를 켜고 끄는 것이 유일한 상호작용이다.
summary.특징: 창백한 녹색 벽과 얼룩진 카펫으로 이루어진 9x9x9 크기의 방 하나로 구성되며, Unreal Engine 5로 제작되었다. 판단 기준에 따라 약 1~30분 정도면 완료할 수 있다.

name: LAST CALL
input:
Rougelike Bodycam Horror



In the heart of a desolate city engulfed in a relentless zombie apocalypse, you stand as the last survivor of your wiped out team. Last Call thrusts you into the role of the ultimate survivor Korne akin to Hunk in Resident Evil 2's Extra Mode. But here, you're not just fighting to stay alive; you're fighting against the ticking clock of imminent nuclear annihilation.



A frantic distress call pierces the silence through your military communication device. A helicopter pilot, bewildered by your survival amidst the chaos, urgently informs you of the impending nuclear strike. Your only chance of survival lies on the (12th Floor) rooftop of the building. But to reach it, you must claw your way through hordes of undead horrors that roam the floors below.



Last Call blends the intensity of roguelike gameplay with the chilling atmosphere of brutal horror. As you ascend each floor, every step brings you closer to the rooftop sanctuary. But with each floor, the challenge escalates, and the stakes become higher. Do you have what it takes to survive the relentless onslaught of the undead and make it to safety before the clock runs out?



Choose wisely from a selection of three perks at the start of each round, each offering unique advantages to aid in your desperate struggle for survival. Whether it's enhanced weaponry, increased resilience, or tactical advantages, your decisions will shape your fate in this nightmarish journey.



Experience the horror firsthand with the innovative BODYCAM Gameplay, immersing you in the visceral terror of the apocalypse like never before. Every scream, every heartbeat, every desperate gasp for breath echoes through the darkness as you navigate the treacherous corridors and stairwells.



Will you emerge as the sole survivor, defying the odds and outwitting the encroaching doom? Or will you become just another casualty in the annals of the apocalypse? The clock is ticking, and every decision matters in Last Call: Last Survivor.





FEATURES:



Roguelike Immersion:

Embark on an ever-changing journey where every floor presents a new and unique challenge. With randomized layouts and dynamic elevator and lever positions, no two runs will ever be alike. Choose your path wisely as you ascend through the treacherous floors, each offering its own set of dangers and opportunities. With the chance to select a new perk in the elevator before each run, strategic decision-making becomes paramount in your quest for survival. Master all twelve floors to unlock the ultimate prize: escape via helicopter and secure your place as the last survivor in the face of impending doom.



Immersive Bodycam Experience:

Powered by Unreal Engine 5 and Direct X 12 Graphics, Last Call delivers unparalleled realism through its innovative Bodycam Vision. Dive into the heart-pounding action with visuals of the view of a Bodycam Footage.



Diverse Enemy Encounters:

Face off against a formidable array of adversaries, including five distinct types of mutated Infected, each equipped with special abilities that will test your skills to the limit. Beware of hordes of relentless zombies whose unpredictable behavior will keep you constantly on edge. Adapt or perish in the face of ever-evolving threats in this fight for survival.

summary.핵심플레이: 좀비 아포칼립스 도시의 건물 12층 옥상에 도달해 헬리콥터로 탈출하는 것을 목표로, 언데드 무리를 헤치며 층을 오른다. 각 라운드 시작 시 세 가지 퍽 중 하나를 선택하고, 무작위로 구성된 층 구조와 엘리베이터·레버 위치에 대응하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 보디캠 시점의 화면 연출을 사용하며, 특수 능력을 가진 다섯 종류의 변이 감염체와 좀비 무리가 등장한다. 층을 오를수록 난이도가 상승하고 핵 공격이라는 제한 시간 요소가 존재하며, Unreal Engine 5와 DirectX 12 기반으로 제작되었다.

name: Monsters of Kanji 2
input:
The sequel to MONSTERS OF KANJI raises the stakes. MARTY and his friends are on a new mission that will decide over the fate of the entire galaxy.

Find out the truth behind the events of MONSTERS OF KANJI.
Grow stronger and defeat dangerous bosses.
Discover tons of secrets on 8 completely different and unique planets.

And in the end... face the IRONASHI!

FEATURES

- No more vocabulary in this one, but there are 150 Monsters of Kanji now...

- All of which can be brought into your team, levelled up and upgraded with a simple yet addictive skill-system

- 8 huge planets to explore in whatever order you like

- No more random battles! All enemies can be seen on the field

- Emotional story that builds on the events of MONSTERS OF KANJI, but can also be experienced without knowing anything about the first game

- MARTY'S SUIT can be upgraded to give him new methods of traversing the game world. Jumping off ledges? Swimming through water?
Find out what new skills MARTY will be able to use!

- Choose how to develop MARTY with the new CLASS-SYSTEM

- Meet old friends in the game's hub area

- Over 20 hours of oldschool JRPG goodness

summary.핵심플레이: MARTY와 동료들이 8개의 행성을 탐험하며 150종의 몬스터를 팀에 합류시키고 레벨업·강화해 보스와 전투를 벌인다. 필드에 표시되는 적과 싸우며 스토리를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 전작 MONSTERS OF KANJI의 사건을 잇는 스토리를 다루며, 어휘 학습 요소는 제외되었다. 스킬 시스템과 클래스 시스템으로 캐릭터를 성장시키고, MARTY의 슈트를 업그레이드해 점프·수영 등 새로운 이동 방식을 얻으며, 순서 자유로운 행성 탐험과 약 20시간 분량의 콘텐츠를 제공한다.

name: 遥遥领先
input:
"Far Ahead" is a simulation business game, based on the three elimination, through research and development, generation, sales, management of four core operations step by step to develop your business, hire legendary managers, and eventually become an industry giant, write a "far ahead" business legend.
Research and develop products
Choose your main products from light industry, heavy industry, food, Internet and other industries, develop and sell them!
Operating enterprise
Small company step by step to become a giant in the industry!
Recruit staff
Hire legendary managers and let them work for you!

summary.핵심플레이: 제품을 연구개발하고 생산·판매·경영하는 네 가지 핵심 운영 단계를 진행하며 기업을 성장시키고, 매니저를 고용해 회사를 키운다.
summary.특징: 매치 3 방식을 기반으로 한 경영 시뮬레이션으로, 경공업·중공업·식품·인터넷 등 여러 산업 중에서 주력 제품을 선택할 수 있다.

name: Army Men RTS
input:
Army Men RTS brings you back to the days of staging battles with tiny plastic soldiers in your backyard...except these green soldiers carry out your every command!
Collect resources and build bases, vehicles, and entire platoons before the Tans can retaliate! The fun is fast and furious in this in-depth, pick-up-and-play battle!

- Intense RTS action: build structures, manage resources, and create battle tactics.

- Lead tiny troops through life-size environments from the backyard to the kitchen, and more!

- 3 gameplay modes: Campaign, Great Battles, and Multiplayer.

summary.핵심플레이: 자원을 수집하고 기지, 차량, 소대를 건설하며 적군인 Tans에 맞서 전투를 지휘한다. 구조물을 짓고 자원을 관리하며 전술을 짜는 실시간 전략 플레이가 중심이다.
summary.특징: 플라스틱 장난감 병사를 소재로 하며, 뒷마당과 부엌 같은 실제 크기의 생활 공간을 배경으로 전투가 벌어진다. 캠페인, Great Battles, 멀티플레이어의 세 가지 모드를 제공한다.

name: Embrace of the Downpour
input:
"Embrace of the Downpour" is a psychological horror experience set in a lonely apartment, where you play as Wesley Smith. In what could have been another calm evening, things take an unexpected turn. Will he live to see the next day?

Key features:

- Must be finished in one sitting.

- Contains jumpscares.

- Atmospheric graphics.

- Can be finished in about 30 minutes.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Wesley Smith가 되어 한 아파트를 배경으로 진행되는 이야기를 따라가며, 약 30분 분량의 플레이를 한 번에 완료한다.
summary.특징: 외딴 아파트를 무대로 한 심리 호러 연출과 점프스케어 요소, 분위기 중심의 그래픽을 사용한다.

name: Rhythm Stones
input:
Collaboration

Rhythm Stones has a collaboration with A Dance of Fire and Ice.

Check out the collaboration song in Rhythm Stones!

About the Game
Rhythm Stones is a 1 button 3D rhythm game that crosses moving stepping stones.

1. Cross the 3D stepping stones to the beat!

Rhythm Stones is a 3D rhythm game in which you cross the moving stepping stones to the beat. The stepping stones move in various types of 3D space; flat, cylindrical, spherical, and random!

summary.핵심플레이: 박자에 맞춰 버튼 하나로 움직이는 3D 징검다리를 건너간다.
summary.특징: 평면, 원통, 구체, 무작위 등 다양한 형태의 3D 공간에서 징검다리가 움직인다. A Dance of Fire and Ice와의 협업 곡이 포함되어 있다.

name: Tea Time
input:
Attention Tea Drinkers!
Bad guys have stolen the world's supply of tea and it's up to you to stop them!

Choose from two characters - Polly, an extroverted and excitable girl, and Esther, an introverted but loyal girl - each with two powers to choose from to assist you, to try to get the tea back. If you play your cards right, they might be joined by a third, unlockable character to boot!

This is a high-score focused game, in which you try to collect as many falling tea items as possible. You'll travel through five different stages, each with obstacles that will do their best to put a stop to you, either by keeping you from collecting items or by claiming enough of your lives to make you game over.

Aim for as high a score as possible, and submit your scores to the Leaderboards to see how you stack up against others!

summary.핵심플레이: 떨어지는 차 아이템을 최대한 많이 모아 높은 점수를 획득하며, 다섯 개의 스테이지를 통과한다. 각 스테이지에는 아이템 수집을 방해하거나 목숨을 잃게 하는 장애물이 있다.
summary.특징: 각각 두 가지 능력을 지닌 캐릭터 Polly와 Esther 중 선택할 수 있으며, 조건을 충족하면 세 번째 캐릭터를 해금할 수 있다. 획득한 점수를 리더보드에 등록해 다른 플레이어와 비교할 수 있다.

name: Daydream
input:
Daydream is a unique time based game set in the dreams of a child. Every world in the game features challenges in different environments and music to spice up the feel.

Dreams in this game provides a vast range of environments that range from a fairy tale theme to space gravity, burning forest to depth of ocean, colorful gates to zodiac signs! The end result will be a vivid, colorful memory of a young indie game.

Features:

- Guaranteed 60 FPS in entire gameplay.

In any case Direct X 2010 June redistributable is needed to work. This will prevent any struggle with crashes.

name: Alter Cosmos
input:
Special Offer

About the Game
"A must have for every point'n'click / comic book fan, inspired by Machinarium."
ALTER COSMOS
THE WAVES OF DISTORTIONS
ABOUT THIS PROJECT

Experience comic book style adventure with Aliencat in a world taken over by a global totalitarian system. Find a way through dangerous situations, gather your crew, find and prepare a ship and escape into cosmos – an infinitive space where everything is possible. Unlock the secrets of The Waves of Distortions.
MAIN FEATURES

• point and click adveture, science-fiction, horror, black humor
• oryginal 2d ilustrations, concept and script - by Zimzonowicz
• original music, futuristic posthardcore/rockabilly/surff/punk/funk created by talented multiinstrumentalist Przemysław Bielecki and Damian Zwoliński
BEHOLD THE ALIENCAT!
...mutated, dangerous, predator. Experimental hybrid of cat, human and genes of extraterrestrial race No. AX-221/Nostromo. An every day lazy glutton fond of beer and regenerative naps in peace and quiet...
STORY IN SHORT & GAMEPLAY

ONE OF THE MANY THEORIES CLAIMS THAT ONCE IN A FEW BILLION YEARS AN UNCANNY RADIATION EMERGES. IT'S SOURCE REMAINS UNKNOWN. SOME BELIEVE THIS OCCURRENCE MARKS AN END TO THEIR LABORIOUSLY CREATED CIVILIZATION. AN END TO THEIR DOMINATION. OTHERS TAKE IT FOR AN INVIGORATING IMPULSE OF UNKNOWN POWERS, A POSSIBILITY FOR ANOTHER STEP OF COSMIC EVOLUTION TO TAKE PLACE.
OF COURSE. THAT'S JUST A THEORY...

• Interactive adventure in a comic book style.
• Original visual design.
• Point-and-click to use objects.
• Collect and apply varied items.
• Hand-to-hand or ranged combat.
• Character dialogue interaction.
• Genre: Adventure. Platform: PC
INSPRATIONS

Films: Alien, Mad Max, The Walking Dead, Star Wars. Comic characters: Lobo, Batman, Aliens, Wolverine. Games: Machinarium.
ABOUT GRAPHICS AUTHOR

ZIMZONOWICZ [real name: Łukasz Samsonowicz]
Born in 1983 in Lubsko in Poland, obtained Masters in Fine Art in 2007. Comic artist, illustrator, painter and graphic designer. I find inspiration in every day life. I like horror and science fiction movies, comics, music hardcore punk and rock'n'roll.
ABOUT PYRAMID.GAMES

We are game development studio located in Lublin, Poland, City of Inspiration :) We create cutting-edge games for PC, mobile and web. Our team is a mix of developers, artists, designers and gamedev passionates. We love creating games we want to play.
GAME OVER IS JUST THE BEGINNING...

There is a comic book adaptation in the works which expands the Alter Cosmos world with new plots, characters and locations. This project is a beginning of a new adventure. And with your support we can make that happen!

input:

name: The Comeback Kingdom
input:
The Comeback Kingdom is a captivating blend of turn-based strategy, role-playing, and comedy. Step into a fantasy world where you are tasked with saving a kingdom in its time of need.

Key Features:

1. Intuitive Strategy Gameplay:

-
Combat: Easy to understand turn-based combat.

-
Strategy: Just mashing attack won't cut it. To deal massive damage you must utilize your magic and skills.

-
Exploration: Locations are easy to navigate and reward the player with valuable loot if they are willing to explore.

2. Engaging Role-Playing Elements:

-
Character Development: The hero and his companions experience tons of character growth along the journey.

-
Story-Driven Quests: Immerse yourself in a hilarious yet compelling storyline.

-
Cutscenes: In between combat you will be treated to many cutscenes that are both entertaining and crucial to the plot.

3. Immersive World:

-
Rich Lore: Discover the history and lore of a world filled with magic, mystery, and intrigue.

-
Varied Environments: Travel the kingdom to experience a multiple of diverse locations.

-
Mystery: Discover who or what is responsible for the turmoil your kingdom is under.

4. Replayability:

-
Second Playthrough: Read more into what the characters say on your second playthrough, now that you know the plot twist.

-
Built in Speedrun Challenge: Test your speed running abilities by choosing the speedrun option at the beginning. Five secret fast travel shortcuts are hidden in this mode to aid your record.

Additional Information:

Platforms: PC Genre: Strategy, RPG Developer: Byzantium Games Publisher: Byzantium Games Release Date: 10/21/24

The fate of the kingdom is in your hands. Will you restore it to its former glory or watch it crumble under the weight of your decisions? The choice is yours in The Comeback Kingdom.

summary.핵심플레이: 턴제 전투에서 마법과 스킬을 활용해 적을 상대하며, 지역을 탐험해 전리품을 획득한다. 스토리 중심의 퀘스트를 진행하고 전투 사이사이 컷신을 시청한다.

name: Dereliction
input:
Dereliction is a squad-based real-time Tactics game.

It requires a sophisticated mobile defence strategy for objective success.

Play the role of the commander.

You control an elite squad of mercenaries. Your mission, to take back a derelict space ship, the RASARRA. It has been infested with Dross, an aggressive race of alien bugs.



The objective of the game:

Get your soldiers from one side of the derelict space-ship to the other, moving from one airlock to the next.

There you rest, refuel, reload and prepare to meet your opponents in the next level.

Storm the ship, recover the command center, return power to the ship!



•REAL-TIME COMBAT

•500+ Enemies on Screen at once

•An advanced AI system for these enemies

•Dynamic combat that is different each play-through

•Control Time! Slow down the game speed to give orders faster

summary.핵심플레이: 용병 분대를 지휘해 우주선 RASARRA 내부에서 에어록을 차례로 이동하며 목표 지점까지 병력을 진격시킨다. 각 구간 사이에 병력을 정비·재보급하고 다음 전투를 준비한다.
summary.특징: 외계 생물 Dross에 점령된 우주선을 탈환해 지휘 통제소를 되찾고 전력을 복구하는 것이 목표이며, 화면에 최대 500명 이상의 적이 등장하고 게임 속도를 늦춰 명령을 내릴 수 있는 시간 조절 기능을 제공한다.

name: Fantasy Toonz: Embers of Creation
input:
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/fantasytoonz

The Great Creator Raist, being as bored as he was, created 12 demi gods to keep himself entertained. They soon became bored themselves so they created a world with all kinds of races to keep themselves entertained. Filled with jealousy, but fearing rebellion, Raist manipulated the races into a false religion to fight against the demi gods. Raist then suggested the demi gods give their children magic as a reward for their loyalty and to combat this new false religion that was threatening the will of the gods. When the demi gods realized that the Raist was the one behind the false religion, they took all the magic from their children and used it to destroy The Great Creator. Raist was destroyed and the embers of what was left smashed down upon the planet, shattering it into an untold number of pieces and destroyed most of the life on the planet.



After thousands of years the few survivors remaining gained in strength and number. Magic, it was discovered, still remained, but could only be used if embedded into objects such as weapons and armor. The children of the gods used these embedded magical items to rage war against one another. In order to restore peace the races agreed to use arenas as a form of mediation. It was discovered through ancient artifacts and lore that if the ashes of creation were to be merged again it would bring back the creator to answer for his misdeeds and allow magic to be used inherently by the children once again.



Some of these ancient artifacts were bones of the old races, still emanating with the original magic that they hold. You have been brought back to life through the use of these old bones. Still not able to inherently use the magic within yourself you must decide to simply live your new life with no memory of what you once were or to search out and discover the roots of your past. Will you help bring the ashes of creation together, regain your memories and former glory or do you fear the past and prevent a new Apocalypse when they try to bring The Great Creator back to life?



Features:

- Play as any race in the game.. Human, Golem, Imp, Lican, Spider, Dragon and more!

- Ever expanding world.. Use the advanced portal system to discover new, unknown lands of this fractures world.

- Build the individual parts of an item (ie.. blade, hilt, grip and pommel of a sword) using the materials you choose to create unique weapons and armor.

- Procedurally generated dungeons that get more difficult the deeper you go. Play as one of dungeon bosses against your friends in co-op mode.

- No limits as to how powerful you can become. Increase your damage and protection as high as you want.

- Build a camp, build a house, build a city, a castle or a kingdom. Hire NPCs to run your stores or guard the walls of your kingdom.

- Use powerful magic to combine fractures of the planet together and expand your land. Add new biomes from dark and spooky to sunny and fun.

- Ancient artifacts take the form of powerful weapons and armor. Upgrade them and use them before they become lost to time once again. Find them again and see how they have gained in power from the last player that wielded them. Co-op mode can make these artifacts powerful enough to defeat the gods of old.

- Your actions with each race is tracked and effects how they perceive you. Make them enemies and they will attack on sight, make them friends and enjoy the benefits of their society. Quests can be affected by your reputation with each of the races.

- Build multiple kingdoms as you transform into other races. Purchase homes or businesses and live with the enemy as a spy or integrate into their society as one of their own. Build your home underground with the Imps, high in the sky with the dragons or keep your feet planted firmly on solid ground.

- Dynamic storylines.. instead of simply reading a book or scroll and learning about the past the storylines are all dynamic and many will lead to powerful artifacts! Quests and stories dynamically change according to things that happen in the world and your reputation with the quest giver. For instance.. once an artifact has been found and lost again (after a specific period of time), the storyline pertaining to that artifact will change giving players a new chance to find that artifact.

summary.핵심플레이: 인간, 골렘, 임프, 라이칸, 거미, 드래곤 등 다양한 종족 중 하나를 선택해 절차적으로 생성되는 던전을 탐험하고, 무기와 방어구에 마법을 부여해 전투를 벌인다. 재료를 골라 검의 날, 손잡이, 그립, 폼멜 등 아이템의 개별 부위를 제작해 고유한 장비를 만든다.
summary.특징: 창조주가 파괴되어 조각난 세계를 배경으로 하며, 포털 시스템으로 새 지역을 탐험하고 마법으로 행성의 조각을 합쳐 바이옴을 추가해 영토를 확장할 수 있다. 각 종족과의 평판이 추적되어 퀘스트와 동적 스토리라인에 영향을 주며, 고대 유물은 시간이 지나면 사라졌다가 이전 사용자에 따라 강화된 상태로 다시 발견된다. 캠프, 집, 도시, 왕국을 건설하고 NPC를 고용할 수 있으며, 협동 플레이에서 던전 보스로 다른 플레이어와 대결할 수 있다.

name: 风之界限 the border of wind
input:
The Kingdom of Dorur, which originally lived on this land for hundreds of years, has always been a symbol of peace. "But these were brought to an end by a strange attack, and the assailant was believed to have completely eliminated the darkness. When the voice of the shadow reappeared, the city of the kingdom was in danger, and now he led the descendants of the hunter, Art, and his friends, to save all this."

· Sell items in special areas and buy and sell unwanted items on your body.

· Experience rich plot exploration and help others earn rich rewards.

· Buying the consumables you need is the best choice for ensuring safety during your journey.

Please remember to save your progress in a timely manner, as more treasures await discovery.

summary.핵심플레이: 헌터의 후예 Art와 동료들을 이끌고 왕국을 구하기 위한 여정을 진행하며, 지역을 탐험하고 스토리를 따라간다. 특정 지역에서 아이템을 사고팔며 필요한 소모품을 구입해 여정에 대비한다.
summary.특징: 수백 년간 평화를 유지하던 Dorur 왕국이 정체불명의 공격과 어둠의 위협에 처한 상황을 배경으로 한다. 탐험 과정에서 다른 이들을 돕고 보상을 얻으며, 진행 상황을 저장하고 숨겨진 보물을 발견할 수 있다.

name: Eggroll
input:
Roll the egg back into the nest in record time... without cracking!

Eggroll is a 2D platformer featuring amusing physics, original art on every level, and randomly generated jazz music!

Players control an egg, which can roll and jump - and crack!



24 levels to unlock each with a different theme

9 different player characters to unlock

Jazz generator makes endless variations of jazz music

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 알을 조작해 굴리고 점프하며 깨지지 않도록 둥지까지 최단 시간에 되돌려 보낸다.
summary.특징: 레벨마다 다른 테마와 아트가 적용된 24개의 스테이지, 해금 가능한 9종의 캐릭터, 무한한 변주를 생성하는 재즈 음악 생성기를 포함한다.

name: Flappy Butt
input: Flappy Butt is a game where you navigate up and down using only one button to propel into the air by using gaseous powers. Flap around whilst trying to dodge various pipes. Start out by dodging static pipes, and as you progress into higher levels, you will be introduced to harder-to-dodge moving pipes. There are 10 levels, with a scoreboard to show the top-tier Flappy Butt point collectors. After completing all 10 levels, restart playing Flappy Butt with a higher difficulty, requiring more points for each level. On your journey to flap as far as you can, you can also collect toilet paper to show off to other Flappy Butt players!

summary.핵심플레이: 버튼 하나로 캐릭터를 공중으로 띄우며 위아래로 이동해 파이프를 피한다. 정적인 파이프부터 시작해 상위 레벨로 갈수록 움직이는 파이프가 등장한다.
summary.특징: 총 10개 레벨과 상위 점수 수집자를 보여주는 점수판이 있으며, 10개 레벨을 완료하면 각 레벨에 더 많은 점수를 요구하는 높은 난이도로 다시 시작한다. 플레이 중 화장지를 모아 다른 플레이어에게 보여줄 수 있다.

name: Our Freedom: Prologue
input:
Step into the boots of William, an ordinary man shaped by extraordinary events—war, loss, and the fight for survival. From the ashes of tragedy, you emerge as a leader, guiding a band of survivors who’ve escaped a ruthless raid. Your mission is create a thriving settlement from the ground up and provide your people with homes, jobs, food, and security while preparing them to defend against looming threats.

Drawing inspiration from beloved RPGs of the 2010s and 2020s, this game delivers a cozy yet dynamic atmosphere you’ll want to return to time and again. With its rich storytelling and engaging mechanics, it’s the perfect blend of nostalgia and innovation.
PROLOGUE
Go through the prologue to understand the story and events that happened to the main character - William! Open world, interesting quests and unlimited sandbox are waiting for you.
BUILDING A SETTLEMENT
Start small and grow your settlement into a prosperous haven. Construct homes, farms, mills, mines, workshops, and fortifications while unlocking new buildings to meet the needs of your growing community. Strategic planning is crucial—prepare for expansion and ensure your people thrive.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 습격에서 살아남은 생존자들을 이끌며 집, 농장, 방앗간, 광산, 작업장, 방어 시설 등을 건설해 정착지를 확장하고 주민들에게 주거와 일자리, 식량, 안전을 제공한다. 오픈 월드에서 퀘스트를 수행하며 프롤로그의 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 전쟁과 상실을 겪은 주인공 William이 생존자 무리의 지도자가 되는 이야기를 배경으로 한다. 정착지를 처음부터 키워 나가는 건설·관리 요소와 오픈 월드 탐험, 샌드박스 플레이가 결합되어 있다.

name: Last Broadcast
input:
This is The Last Broadcast
Last Broadcast is an experimental narrative game set at a radio station at the end of the world. Players assume the role of D-Jay, a radio host, who is giving their last show as the sun turns red and the world burns down.
Key Features

- Immersive Fiction: Encounter three callers each with their different goals and concerns.

- Play Music: Choose from a selection of 15 musical artists to play within the radio station.

- Play at your own Pace: The story (and the apocalypse) continues at your pace.

summary.핵심플레이: 라디오 진행자 D-Jay가 되어 세 명의 발신자와 대화하고, 15명의 음악 아티스트 중에서 곡을 골라 방송에서 재생한다.
summary.특징: 태양이 붉게 물들며 세계가 종말을 맞는 상황의 라디오 방송국을 배경으로 하며, 이야기와 종말이 플레이어의 진행 속도에 맞춰 전개된다.

name: Hoverboy
input:
WARNING: this game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised.

Hoverboy is an interactive musical playlist showcasing music from Jesse Aidyn (full album), Multi-Memory Controller (1 song), and Ginger Breaker (1 song), where you get to explore different worlds and interact with the environment to the sound of a playlist. In part inspired by music visualizers, it is a highly experimental take on the concept of music videos.

Some primary features:

- A vastly different world for each one of the 11 available songs.

- Bright, colorful and intense visuals.

- Controls that vary from simple exploration to multiple simultaneous effects making.

- A control board showing what controls are available at all time.

Hoverboy was developed in part as a creative output and practical case study for a Master's research on the idea of experimentation in video games. The resulting thesis, titled L’expérimentation vidéoludique théorisée en arts, en sciences et en design, et pratiquée dans la création de l'album musical vidéoludique Hoverboy, is available online for free (in french only).

This game is entirely free. If, however, you would like to support the developer, you may do so by purchasing one of the DLCs (they do not add any content within the game!).

summary.핵심플레이: 11개의 곡에 맞춰 서로 다른 세계를 탐험하고 환경과 상호작용한다. 조작은 단순한 탐험부터 여러 효과를 동시에 만들어내는 방식까지 곡마다 다양하다.
summary.특징: 뮤직 비주얼라이저에서 영감을 받은 실험적 뮤직비디오 형태의 인터랙티브 음악 플레이리스트로, Jesse Aidyn 등의 음악을 담고 있다. 각 곡마다 별도의 세계와 밝고 강렬한 색감의 비주얼이 제공되며, 사용 가능한 조작을 표시하는 컨트롤 보드가 있다. 게임 내 콘텐츠를 추가하지 않는 후원용 DLC가 존재한다.

name: Chess Valley
input:
ALSO RECOMMENDED FOR YOU

ALSO RECOMMENDED FOR YOU

About the Game
In this game i created a new and fun way to play chess.
The game uses the original board, however, it contains only the black pieces
and some blocks that can serve to facilitate or hinder the game.
All white pieces are behind the board waiting for the king.
The king stands alone in front of the board where he must choose his first move,
and from there, the player must cross the entire board without being killed by the black pieces.

The Game was released with 25 /50 stages and now already has 50/50, all levels are working correctly.

this number may increase depending on the acceptance of the game.

The controls are simple and easy, basically the player control the king pressing the keyboard arrows or WASD, the player also change the cam pressing C on keyboard, after complete the challenge the game will change level automatically.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 킹 하나만 조작해 체스판을 가로질러 반대편까지 이동하며, 방향키나 WASD로 움직이고 C 키로 카메라를 전환한다. 흑 기물에게 잡히지 않고 판을 건너면 다음 단계로 자동 전환된다.
summary.특징: 기존 체스판을 사용하되 흑 기물과 이동을 돕거나 방해하는 블록만 배치한 변형 방식이며, 백 기물은 판 뒤에서 킹을 기다린다. 총 50개의 스테이지로 구성되어 있다.

name: Gloves On!
input:
Gloves On! is a boxing experience with realistic controls and a unique perspective of fighting games. Step in the ring with a fighter created by you or chosen between multiple options and fight a full match of boxing packed with adrenaline and action.

summary.핵심플레이: 직접 만들거나 선택한 파이터로 링에 올라 한 경기 분량의 복싱 시합을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 사실적인 조작과 격투 게임과는 다른 시점을 제공하는 복싱 게임이다.

name: Totality
input:
If you can’t travel to a total solar eclipse, bring the eclipse to you! Experience a complete total solar eclipse from start to finish. Feeling impatient? Speed up time or jump ahead. You can even pause time for extended totality! Want to stare at the sun without going blind? You can do that here. Just don’t do that with the real sun!



You can also view the eclipse through a pane of #14 welding glass or a pinhole projector.



Beyond the eclipse itself, the environment is designed to be very relaxing. Watch the day pass from sunrise to sunset and overnight under a clear, cloudless sky. Listen to the wind dynamically blow through the trees on top of a low mountain. Breathe, relax, and enjoy your time here.

summary.핵심플레이: 개기일식을 시작부터 끝까지 관찰하며, 시간을 빠르게 돌리거나 특정 시점으로 건너뛰고, 개기식 순간을 연장하기 위해 시간을 멈출 수도 있다. 태양을 직접 바라보거나 14번 용접 유리, 핀홀 프로젝터를 통해 볼 수 있다.
summary.특징: 낮은 산 위에서 일출부터 일몰, 밤까지 이어지는 구름 없는 하늘을 배경으로 하며, 나무 사이로 부는 바람 소리 등 편안한 환경 연출을 제공한다.

name: Lovebugz: An Anthro Insect Dating Sim
input:
Don't be afraid. These bug girls aren't here to hurt you (most of them, anyway). You're a human garbage man, but one fateful morning you accidentally ask a giant housefly out on a date. Play through a handful of bite-sized dates in this chapter-based visual novel world with point and click exploration elements.

Use point and click mechanics to explore an island, room by room, talking to an assorted cast of different bugs and humans (and crabs).

Date a handful of different bug girls, learn how they live their lives, and help them with their problems.

Choose from different choices that may determine how the date goes.

Play through a chapter-based storyline. New chapters will be released in the future.

A cute, cartoony art style.

Collectable candies!

summary.장르: 연애 시뮬레이션, 비주얼 노벨, 포인트 앤 클릭 어드벤처
summary.핵심플레이: 인간 청소부가 되어 섬을 방마다 포인트 앤 클릭 방식으로 탐험하고, 여러 곤충 및 인간 등장인물과 대화하며 곤충 소녀들과 데이트를 진행한다. 데이트 중 여러 선택지를 골라 진행 방향에 영향을 준다.
summary.특징: 챕터 기반으로 전개되는 스토리로 향후 새로운 챕터가 추가될 예정이며, 의인화된 곤충 캐릭터와 카툰풍 아트 스타일, 수집 가능한 사탕 요소를 포함한다.

FEATURES

No Censorship!: We've removed censorship from the images (we’ll add an option later to censor them as preferred).

Gallery: Fill an image album as you progress through the story and revisit the chapters you've completed.

Choose the Girl: Decide which girl to pursue as the story unfolds.

-
Flashback: Go back in the story at any time to change a decision or relive a moment.

-
Smooth Navigation: Choose whether text progresses automatically or skip it to reach your favorite part.

-
Immersive Audio: Including music, sound effects, voices, and "other effects." Adjust volume settings independently or mute everything.
