summary.특징: 클래식 아케이드 플레이와 현대적인 로그라이트 요소를 혼합하며, 1980년대 아케이드 감성을 재현하는 필터와 효과가 적용된 레트로 모드를 포함해 두 가지 시각 모드를 제공한다.

name: OS ROGUE
input:
About the Game

" " Ethan is a hacker who got trapped in his own computer by *InkA*, an AI (artificial intelligence). He has to survive into a virtual combat world created by *THOR*, and win in order to get back to his world . "

YOUR CHALLENGE !!!

OS ROGUE is a third-person roguelike shooter where the player must face waves of enemies in the futuristic cyberpunk world by using a variety of weapons and physical abilities.

Player will unlock abilities and earn resources to become more powerful. Battles alternative between waves off robots, epic boss battles and exploration to discovers secret room.

- *Discover Awesomes and unique levels.

- *Epic Fight against a bunch of final boss.

- *Use specials movements to dodge bullets .

- *Upgrade your game experience by customizing yours weapons , health skills etc

More features will be added later...

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 다양한 무기와 신체 능력을 사용해 밀려오는 적들의 웨이브와 보스전을 치르고, 숨겨진 방을 찾기 위해 탐험한다. 전투를 통해 능력을 해금하고 자원을 모아 무기와 체력 스킬 등을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 해커 Ethan이 AI에 의해 자신의 컴퓨터 속에 갇혀 가상 전투 세계에서 살아남아야 한다는 사이버펑크 설정을 배경으로 한다. 총알을 피하는 특수 이동 동작과 무기 커스터마이즈 요소를 포함한다.

name: Wood Shop Simulator
input:
Welcome to Wood Shop Simulator!

Chop down trees, master woodworking, and craft beautiful creations to sell at auction. Whether you're legally harvesting in the woods or risking it all in the city, your craftsmanship and reputation will determine your success. Upgrade your tools, hire skilled workers, and expand your workshop as you build a name for yourself in the world of fine woodworking.
Master Woodworking Skills
Start by chopping down trees and carrying the logs to your storage. Use blueprints from vendors to carve your logs with precision, maximizing accuracy for higher-quality pieces. Each crafted item is a testament to your skill.

summary.핵심플레이: 나무를 벌목해 통나무를 창고로 옮기고, 상인에게서 얻은 도면을 이용해 목재를 정밀하게 가공한다. 완성한 제품은 경매를 통해 판매한다.
summary.특징: 숲에서 합법적으로 벌목하거나 도시에서 위험을 감수하는 선택지가 있으며, 도구 업그레이드, 숙련 인력 고용, 작업장 확장을 통해 목공 사업을 키워 나간다. 가공 정확도가 제품 품질에 영향을 준다.

name: Emiline: The Ghost of White Willow
input:
It's 1944, D-Day a section of British paratroopers assault a gun emplacement German occupied France. But when a soldier mysteriously disappears, you enter an old manor house in search of the missing comrade, the horrors of its past begin to haunt the new occupants within its walls.

You play as Alfred Stuart a sergeant in the British Parachute regiment. Emiline: The Ghost of White Willow is a gripping VR survival horror game set in 1944, where players step into the boots of a British paratrooper who miraculously survives a harrowing landing in Normandy.

Whilst missing your unit, you must establish radio communication with the next section, you must navigate a sinister haunted house, desperately searching for a missing comrade. Unbeknownst to you, the vengeful spirit of Marrion, fuelled by a tragic love triangle with her husband and the maid Emiline, seeks to capture and exact revenge on the player, who she believes stole her prized gold, leading to a spine-chilling battle for survival and uncovering the house's dark secrets.

A gothic horror where love, betrayal and murder haunt every corner, the only way to survive is to embrace the darkness, face your fears, and grab your torch to reveal the truth.

summary.핵심플레이: 1944년 노르망디에 착륙한 영국 낙하산병 Alfred Stuart로서 저택을 탐색하며 실종된 동료를 찾고, 다음 부대와 무전 교신을 시도한다. 손전등을 사용해 어둠 속을 살피며 원혼을 피해 생존한다.
summary.특징: 고딕 호러 세계관으로, 남편과 하녀 Emiline 사이의 삼각관계와 잃어버린 금을 둘러싼 원혼 Marrion의 복수를 다루며 저택의 과거를 밝혀나간다.

name: Space Salvage: Ship Happens
input:
Pilot your Space Salvage Corporation pod through colorful interstellar crash sites, avoiding hazards and defeating enemy drones, to fulfill your corporate overlords' directives and earn a few credits.  Spend you earnings upgrading your pod and progress up the SSC ranks.

But be careful out there - ship happens!

summary.핵심플레이: 우주 잔해 회수 회사의 포드를 조종해 성간 충돌 현장을 이동하며 위험 요소를 피하고 적 드론을 처치하고, 회사의 지시를 완수해 크레딧을 획득한다. 벌어들인 크레딧으로 포드를 업그레이드하며 SSC 계급을 올린다.
summary.특징: 우주 잔해 회수 회사 소속으로 성간 충돌 현장을 무대로 하며, 포드 업그레이드와 계급 상승을 통한 진행 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: I Am Mouse
input:
Step into the paws of a tiny mouse in I Am Mouse, a charming and funny third-person adventure where you create your own path.

Fight, sneak, or explore freely through rich environments full of choices, secrets, and alternate routes.

Features:

-
Cute hero: just look at this mouse!

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 작은 쥐를 조작해 3인칭 시점으로 환경을 탐험하며, 전투하거나 잠입하거나 자유롭게 돌아다니는 방식으로 진행한다.
summary.특징: 선택지와 숨겨진 요소, 대체 경로가 있는 환경을 제공하며 플레이어가 스스로 경로를 만들어 나간다.

name: Project 1337: The Well
input:
You awaken in a brutalist bunker, there are no explanations, only metallic echoes and the sense that you are being watched, tested by hordes of alien creatures emerging from the shadows, attacking relentlessly. Each floor is a test designed to push your limits beyond endurance. You feel you are more than human, but why? For what purpose?

You are an experiment — a last resort, perhaps, or just another disposable piece in something much larger. But who put you here? And why does the world outside depend so much on what happens in this dark pit?

Your only way is up, facing increasingly relentless enemies, answers buried in dark depths, and one question that keeps echoing: what will happen if you fail?

Main Features:Immersive Environment: Explore a bunker designed with a unique aesthetic, creating an atmosphere of tension and mystery.

Strategic Arsenal: Use distinct weapons, each offering a unique approach to combat and suiting your playstyle.

Aiming Skill: The game is designed for players who value precision. Enjoy a responsive control system that makes every move and shot feel natural.

Fast-Paced Gameplay: Stay on the move and always alert! The fast-paced action keeps you engaged as you battle hordes of enemies to survive.

summary.핵심플레이: 벙커의 층을 위로 올라가며 밀려오는 외계 생명체 무리와 전투한다. 여러 종류의 무기를 사용해 조준과 이동 중심의 전투를 반복하며 생존한다.
summary.특징: 브루탈리즘 양식의 벙커를 배경으로 실험체가 된 주인공이 자신의 정체와 목적을 추적하는 세계관을 갖는다. 정밀 조준과 빠른 템포의 전투에 초점을 맞춘 조작 시스템을 제공한다.

name: Little Nightmares
input:
Special Edition

INCLUDES

-
Little Nightmares™

-
Little Nightmares™ Secrets of The Maw Expansion Pass

About the Game

The Little Nightmares series has been captivating millions of players worldwide since 2017. Now it’s your turn to try to survive the first entry in most charming horror series ever made.

Take on the role of Six, a lone child lost in a massive metal vessel known as the Maw, surrounded by dangerous, distorted versions of adults. You’ll need to do your best to escape in one piece or your fate will be worse than you ever dared dream.

OBSERVE YOUR SURROUNDINGS

You wake up in a damp, dark room. Your sole possession is a brass lighter. You have no memory of how you got here, but it’s clear that you are in danger. Only your keen eyes and quick wits can get you out in one piece.

summary.핵심플레이: 거대한 선박 Maw에 갇힌 아이 Six를 조작해 주변을 살피고 위험을 피하며 탈출을 시도한다. 라이터를 사용하고 왜곡된 성인들의 위협을 피해 이동한다.
summary.특징: Maw라는 금속 선박을 배경으로 하며 왜곡된 성인 형상의 존재들이 등장한다. Special Edition에는 본편과 Secrets of The Maw 확장 패스가 포함된다.

name: Type Galaxy
input:
Embark on the ultimate cosmic quest where your typing prowess holds the key to victory! Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled voyage through the stars in Type Galaxy, the definitive typing adventure that will leave your fingers itching for more!

Key Features:

- Journey Through the Cosmos
Blast off into the unknown and navigate through 30 mind-bending levels set against the backdrop of the awe-inspiring cosmos.

- Unleash Your Typing Skills
Get ready to put your fingers to the test with exhilarating typing challenges that will push you to the limit. It is a race against time as you strive to conquer each level and prove yourself as the ultimate typist.

- Immerse Yourself in the Soundtrack of the Stars
Lose yourself in the mesmerizing beats of 32 electrifying soundtracks that pulse with the rhythm of the universe.

- Command Your Spaceship with Precision
In Type Galaxy, your keyboard is your spaceship's control panel, and your typing skills are the key to victory.

- Ascend to Galactic Greatness
Rise to the challenge and become the master of the cosmos as you conquer each level and unlock new challenges along the way. With every victory, you'll inch closer to typing supremacy and solidify your place among the stars.

Prepare to embark on the typing adventure of a lifetime in Type Galaxy. With its stunning visuals, heart-pounding gameplay, and addictive soundtrack, this is one journey you won't want to miss. Get ready to blast off into a world of typing excitement and become the ultimate typist!

summary.핵심플레이: 키보드로 문자를 입력해 우주선을 조작하며 제한 시간 안에 타이핑 과제를 완료해 각 레벨을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 우주를 배경으로 한 30개의 레벨과 32개의 사운드트랙을 제공하며, 레벨을 클리어할수록 새로운 도전 요소가 해금된다.

name: Forsaken Flesh
input:
Forsaken Flesh is an unforgiving hardcore platformer game. Defeat souls with powerful bodies in search of 'keys' hidden all over the world to deal with increasingly powerful enemies, from abandoned tombs to royal palaces with kings.
Playable characters

Dragon Slayer is a powerful knight with the highest basic stamina, a wide range of basic attacks and a deadly blow that strikes a straight sword. Extensive basic attacks make it easy to defeat enemies in the air. Dragon Slayer can use the 'Dragon's Tears' item that can restore all stamina at every stage.

Great Thief is a sleek thief with normal basic stamina, basic attacks going straight, and a special attack wielding a wide range of swords ahead. With a wide range of special moves, you can easily defeat many enemies that are difficult to kill.

Kung Fu Master is a powerful martial artist that has the lowest basic stamina, the shortest basic attack range, but doubles the basic attack of other characters, and a special attack that emits energy waves of powerful damage spreading in all directions.

summary.핵심플레이: 세계 곳곳에 숨겨진 '키'를 찾아 적을 물리치며 진행하고, 캐릭터별 기본 공격과 특수 공격으로 강해지는 적들을 상대한다. 버려진 무덤에서 왕이 있는 궁전까지 다양한 스테이지를 돌파한다.
summary.특징: 기본 체력과 공격 방식이 다른 세 캐릭터(Dragon Slayer, Great Thief, Kung Fu Master)를 플레이할 수 있으며, Dragon Slayer는 각 스테이지에서 체력을 모두 회복하는 'Dragon's Tears' 아이템을 사용할 수 있다.

name: math is hard
input:
math is hard makes you put to the test your math skills and logical thinking, pushing blocks around the grid solving puzzles. Simple addition and subtraction won't always do the trick!

The game has planned over 50 levels. Going through locked doors or sliding on ice and using different combinations of operations (+, –, ×, ÷) you must reach the target value.

math is hard challenges both your head for numbers and your eye for strategy. Ready to prove that, with the right moves, math really isn’t so hard after all?

The game was originally created for and won the MiniJam 183: Calculations.

summary.핵심플레이: 격자 위에서 블록을 밀어 이동시키며 덧셈, 뺄셈, 곱셈, 나눗셈 연산을 조합해 목표 값에 도달하는 퍼즐을 푼다.
summary.특징: 50개 이상의 레벨이 계획되어 있으며, 잠긴 문을 통과하거나 얼음 위에서 미끄러지는 등의 요소를 활용한다. MiniJam 183: Calculations를 위해 제작되어 수상한 작품이다.

name: 因果律 Inside The Memory
input:
The trigger was an invitation letter I received from my uncle.

He was supposed to be an invited guest at the pension ``Mobius'', a lodging facility for young people, but when he saw something he had never seen before, a ``mystery'' began to unfold.

"Why don't I remember...?"

A ``mystery'' that happens to someone who was supposed to be an invited guest.

Please try to solve it by yourself.

A story where mysteries lead to more mysteries and a single trigger turns everything upside down

The mystery is revealed little by little, and just when you think you know the ending, one action you take changes everything.

Enjoy the chilling development and ending.

Also, depending on the choices you make, it may become a BL version, so you can enjoy a wide range of stories.

Using Live2D! Almost full voice during conversation! (Voices are in Japanese only)

Almost full voice during conversation. (Headphones (earphones) recommended) Move and speak with rich expressions using Live2D.

Mystery-solving gimmick balance with moderate difficulty level

There are mystery-solving and mystery scenes, so please have paper and pen (or notepad) ready before playing.

Play time

1 hour and 30 minutes per lap

Number of ends

6

Caution/Disclaimer

・Currently only available in Japanese.

・This game is fiction. It has no relation to any actual person, organization, incident, etc.

・There is no intention to encourage crime or murder.

- The author (Garnet Bloom / @shian_3rd / Causality Production Committee) will not be held responsible for any defects or troubles that may occur while playing this game.

summary.핵심플레이: 삼촌에게서 받은 초대장을 계기로 펜션 'Mobius'에서 벌어지는 수수께끼를 풀어나가며 이야기를 진행한다. 종이와 펜을 활용해 미스터리 장면과 수수께끼 풀이를 해결한다.
summary.특징: 플레이어의 선택에 따라 BL 버전을 포함해 총 6개의 엔딩으로 분기하며, Live2D와 일본어 음성으로 대화 장면을 연출한다. 1회 플레이 시간은 약 1시간 30분이다.

name: One Turret
input:
One Turret is a factory-building solo-tower-defense game with a large amount of crafting.

You construct large conveyor networks, craft complex bullet recipes, and keep your One Turret supplied as you fight back waves of the robot army. Play on various maps with different materials and bosses.

Assembly Lines!!

-
Smelt or Refine items to create brand new ones

-
Combine items to craft powerful bullets

-
Use the crafting hint to help figure out new combinations

Features

-
Map Builder to create and share your own maps!

-
Modding support for custom bullets, enemies, and buildings

-
The Index, a built-in wiki and crafting guide.

-
Revive the mechanical remains of your foes... and maybe have a friendly chat?!

summary.핵심플레이: 컨베이어 네트워크를 건설하고 아이템을 제련·정제·조합해 다양한 총알을 제작하며, 로봇 군대의 웨이브를 막기 위해 하나의 터렛에 자원을 공급한다. 맵마다 서로 다른 재료와 보스가 등장한다.
summary.특징: 조립 라인 기반의 크래프팅과 단일 터렛 방어를 결합했으며, 맵 제작·공유 기능, 총알·적·건물에 대한 모딩 지원, 내장 위키인 The Index, 크래프팅 힌트 등을 제공한다.

name: Swords of Edo Kinetic Novel
input:
Swords of Edo is a series of comic 'kinetic' visual novel stories.
Stories Included

Swords of Edo Issue 1
This first issue introduces the different members of the Justicars who serve Edo to protect the people from threats both externally and from within. Female Samurai warriors who will do whatever they need to, to protect the land.

Swords of Edo Issue 2
After the events of issue 1 Edo is in turmoil, when an unknown Ronin begins cutting a bloody swathe through the greatest city in Edo. Will he destroy Edo or can the Justicars prevent his dark purpose.

Swords of Edo Issue 3
The final part of the comic series, where the fate of Edo will be decided once and for all as two factions fight to take control of Edo once and for all.

summary.핵심플레이: 분기 없이 진행되는 키네틱 비주얼 노벨 형식으로 세 편의 만화식 이야기를 순서대로 읽어 나간다.
summary.특징: 에도를 배경으로 위협으로부터 백성을 지키는 여성 사무라이 집단 Justicars의 이야기를 다루며, 세 편에 걸쳐 낭인의 등장과 두 세력의 대립으로 에도의 운명이 결정되는 서사가 전개된다.

name: TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4
input:
The hero loved by millions worldwide, TY the Tasmanian Tiger™, is back! Join TY on an exciting new adventure in the great Aussie Outback. Use your wits and boomerangs to find hidden treasures, help the colorful locals, and uncover the mysteries of the land Down Under. Bush Rescue Returns!

Features

- 40 levels of adventures in the Australian Outback.

- Defeat enemies by freezing, zapping, and more with heaps of choice new boomerangs.

- Multiple game modes: Adventure, Time Attack, Turkey Chase, and Danger Arena.

- Challenge yourself with multiple game modes: Adventure, Time Attack, Turkey Chase, and Danger Arena.

- Cosplay as TY's friends in style with a metric ton of costumes.

The exciting new Bush Rescue Returns update includes:

- Full English voice-overs featuring an all-star cast you'll recognize as TY's old mates!

- Remastered and updated SFX and music

- Improved graphics and remastered extended cutscenes.

summary.핵심플레이: 오스트레일리아 아웃백을 배경으로 40개 레벨을 탐험하며 부메랑을 사용해 적을 얼리거나 감전시키는 등 다양한 방식으로 처치하고, 숨겨진 보물을 찾고 지역 주민을 돕는다.
summary.특징: Adventure, Time Attack, Turkey Chase, Danger Arena 등 여러 게임 모드와 다양한 의상을 제공하며, Bush Rescue Returns 업데이트로 영어 음성, 리마스터된 효과음·음악, 개선된 그래픽과 컷신을 포함한다.

name: Rescue Love Revenge
input:
Rescue Love Revenge is an exciting new action-adventure game with an epic story that will unfold as we release future and frequent updates.

RLR features an energetic style with addictive gameplay and challenging levels!

Unrequited Rescue

In Act 1 Chapter 1, we find our hero crossing treacherous terrain to Rescue girls in the high Alpine mountains, guarded by a band of bandana'd bandits. A second character known as The Grizzle makes his entrance in Chapter 2's desert environment. Chapter 3 will mark the beginning of episodic releases in a semi-regular fashion.

RLR's first chapters are a wild ride with unexpected storytelling, fun twitch gameplay, cutegore retro graphics, and addictive music. It's a funny style mixed with a twisted story surrounding timed jumps in a hardcore twitch runner full of secrets in each level. With chaotic combat reduced to simple gameplay, this mode that feels like racing can be challenging and at times a bit unforgiving.

Fortune's Fool

At its core, Rescue Love Revenge is a sandbox game set in The Old West with the first levels focused on having a retro style with auto-attacking and auto-running singleplayer gameplay where only jumping is key. That is only one realization of the game's components for creating experiences. The game will gradually expand and transition beyond the retro style to realistic and other styles, to full platformer and shooter controls, to couch multiplayer and scalable online play, to level editing and game modifications with extensive Steamworks integration.

During Early Access the default retro mode will receive updates adding new chapters beyond one and two with new custscenes and levels, upgrades to the level selection world map, the RLR runtime level editor, multiplayer and other new modes, and the slow build of the nextgen realistic open world sandbox sequel of sorts, almost like two games in one plus mods and episodes for tons of hours of overall gameplay.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 자동 이동과 자동 공격이 적용된 캐릭터를 조작하며, 타이밍에 맞춘 점프로 위험한 지형을 통과해 각 레벨에 갇힌 소녀들을 구출한다. 레벨마다 숨겨진 요소가 있는 트위치 러너 방식으로 진행된다.
summary.특징: 알프스 산맥, 사막 등 The Old West를 배경으로 챕터가 에피소드 형태로 공개되며, cutegore 레트로 그래픽과 뒤틀린 스토리를 결합했다. 얼리 액세스 동안 신규 챕터와 컷신, 레벨 에디터, 멀티플레이어, Steamworks 연동 모드 지원 등을 추가하고, 이후 사실적인 오픈월드 샌드박스 형태로 확장할 계획이다.

name: Mount And Sword
input:
Mount And Sword invites you into a mystical and perilous world, offering a single-player survival adventure that immerses you in a vast and visually stunning open world. Journey through diverse landscapes, from dense forests and treacherous mountains to ancient ruins and dark caverns.



Gameplay Features:

Choose Your Hero: Start your adventure by selecting one of four distinct characters, each with unique abilities and backstories. Whether you prefer a swift and agile rogue, a powerful and resilient warrior, a mystical mage, or a versatile ranger, Mount And Sword offers a playstyle for every type of player.



Combat & Strategy: Engage in dynamic and thrilling combat against a variety of enemies, ranging from mysterious creatures lurking in the shadows to powerful bosses that require strategic thinking and precise timing to defeat. Combine melee, ranged, and magical attacks, and leverage your character's special abilities to gain the upper hand in battle.



Open World Exploration: The world of Mount And Sword is vast and full of secrets. As you explore, you’ll uncover hidden paths, ancient artifacts, and lore-rich locations. The world is alive, featuring day and night cycles, weather effects, and a dynamic ecosystem that reacts to your actions.



Will you rise to become one of the greatest warriors in this world, or will the challenges prove too great? The fate of your character, and perhaps the world, lies in your hands.

summary.핵심플레이: 네 명의 캐릭터 중 하나를 선택해 근접, 원거리, 마법 공격과 특수 능력을 조합하며 다양한 적과 보스를 상대로 전투를 벌인다. 숲, 산, 유적, 동굴 등으로 이루어진 오픈 월드를 탐험하며 숨겨진 길과 고대 유물, 지역을 발견한다.
summary.특징: 로그, 전사, 메이지, 레인저 등 고유한 능력과 배경을 가진 네 캐릭터를 제공하며, 낮과 밤의 순환, 날씨 효과, 플레이어의 행동에 반응하는 생태계를 갖춘 싱글플레이어 오픈 월드를 배경으로 한다.

name: Grow Line Quest
input: Grow Line Quest is a game that combines dynamic battles, dungeon exploration, and captivating farming. In the game’s world, players dive into exciting adventures, battle enemies, and unlock new development opportunities with each cycle. Each new cycle presents a unique chance to improve your farm, discover rare artifacts, and enhance your character. Develop your farm, fight enemies, and explore the world of Grow Line Quest.

summary.핵심플레이: 적과 전투를 벌이고 던전을 탐험하며 농장을 운영한다. 각 사이클마다 농장을 개선하고 캐릭터를 강화하며 새로운 개발 기회를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 전투, 던전 탐험, 농사를 결합했으며, 반복되는 사이클을 통해 희귀 아티팩트를 발견하고 캐릭터와 농장을 발전시키는 구조를 갖는다.

name: Hunter's Legacy
input:
Trading Cards now live!

Any Trading Card collectors out there? Hunter's Legacy now has a full set of collectible Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, and Profile Backgrounds for you to collect! Cards will drop every thirty minutes and we'd love to know if you collect them all!

Available July 19th for $6.99!

If you’re eager for an awesome action-filled metroidvania platformer, you won’t have to wait long. Hunter’s Legacy is coming to Steam on July 19th at the super cool price tag of $6.99 USD!

That’s not all, though. After playing and playing through the game, we fell in love with a lot of the game’s music tracks. We feel that our talented musicians did a really amazing job, so we decided to have the entire soundtrack available as DLC for just $0.99 USD and will be available on the same day the game launches! Check out the soundtrack's store page here!

Demo the kitty!

Are you eager for some hardcore platforming action? You can download right away the public demo of the game! Yes, you can PLAY NOW!

This free public demo includes an hour of Ikki's adventure.

- Venture from Oma Forest to Lullaby Swamp in pursuit of the evil Morodir!

- Meet Iripur Town’s inhabitants!

- Experience the challenge of a boss fight!

- Acquire the game’s first upgrade!

We are very grateful to our fantastic community of followers who supported us on Steam Greenlight and allowed us to be here.

If you run a YouTube or Twitch channel, please get in contact with us! We have a special kit for you. ;)

Play the demo and leave us a comment! We'd love to get your feedback!

About the Game
Embark on a challenging quest with the great huntress of Un’Amak! Hunter's Legacy is a 2D Metroidvania platformer starring Ikki, a fierce cat who must save the kingdom of Iripur from the evil Morodir. The game features a non-lineal design where the focus is on exploration and combat in an open world filled with different characters, enemies, and collectibles.

- Slash your enemies with your mighty twin swords!

- Aim your bow and charge your attacks to deal even more damage!

- Roll out of the enemies’ way to counter-attack!

- Enemies come in many forms and sizes!

- Battle your enemies while you enjoy an adrenaline pumping soundtrack!

The level design in Hunter’s Legacy features a verticality that opens many traversing options for the player.

- Jump from platform to platform on the skies or reveal a path below the ground.

- Find the path to your next objective in a big connected world (hand-holding not included)!

- Find hidden secrets to purchase upgrades! Trust us, you’ll need them!

- Meet multiple characters that will aid you in your quest!

If you like what you see, please spread the word among your friends! Tell us what you’d like to see in the game, we welcome any comments or questions about our work. We are making this for you, the gamers, because we love this community more than anything else. For any further questions, please feel free to send an e-mail to hola@lienzo.mx, we'd love to stay in contact with you.

summary.핵심플레이: 고양이 캐릭터 Ikki를 조작해 쌍검과 활로 적과 전투하고, 회피 구르기로 반격하며, 연결된 오픈 월드를 탐험한다. 숨겨진 요소를 찾아 업그레이드를 구매하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: Un'Amak의 사냥꾼 Ikki가 악당 Morodir로부터 Iripur 왕국을 구하는 비선형 구조의 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 수직 이동성을 강조한 레벨 디자인과 다양한 형태의 적, 여러 조력 캐릭터가 등장한다.

name: Space Show edition 17
input:
Take possession of an over-armed spaceship to succeed in the Space Show challenges!
3 brands of equipment with very different philosophies:
Falcon industrie: agility and responsiveness
Wolf Tech: the most advanced technology for combat use
Rhino Corp: raw power.

Equip your ship with 5 of the 45 weapons available (Blaster, Rocket, Plasma, Electric...) customize it and adapt your weaponry to the situation.

During challenges, you'll have to attack enemy ships, withstand meteor showers, defend planet Earth by developing its passive defenses... And many more surprises await you.

The year is 2085, the year of the 17th Space Show.
It's the most watched reality show in the solar system: 32 billion viewers! The concept is simple: 13 million contestants compete against each other. Their agility, fighting skills and ability to implement an effective strategy will make the difference.

The winner will receive a "molecular reconstruction chip" giving him/her access to immortality.

summary.핵심플레이: 우주선을 조종해 45종의 무기 중 5개를 장착·커스터마이즈하며 상황에 맞게 무장을 구성한다. 적 우주선 공격, 유성우 대응, 지구 방어를 위한 패시브 방어 개발 등 다양한 챌린지를 수행한다.
summary.특징: Falcon industrie(기동성), Wolf Tech(첨단 전투 기술), Rhino Corp(순수 화력) 세 브랜드의 장비 체계를 제공한다. 2085년 태양계 리얼리티 쇼 '제17회 Space Show'를 배경으로, 우승자는 불멸을 얻는 설정이다.

name: Maze Art: Pink
input:
Maze Art: Pink - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music. The player controls the ball, which must find an exit to the portal.

FEATURES:



- 50 levels

- Beautiful art design

- Achievements

- Relax music

summary.핵심플레이: 공을 조작해 미로를 통과하여 출구 포털을 찾아 이동한다.
summary.특징: 미니멀한 아트 디자인과 편안한 음악을 갖춘 50개의 레벨과 도전 과제를 제공한다.

name: Claw Breaker
input:
Claw Breaker is an epic party fighting game full of scoops, snips, and salt. Beware, shouting and excitement may occur in this ultimate two-player claw-down of action-packed slashing and melee attacks.



Use a variety of cutting maneuvers while on the offensive -- scoop, snip, and even dirty tricks like the salty taunt. If you’re missing a claw, swap your strategy by collecting all of the starfish for a defensive victory!



Each stage holds different strategic formations offering new and exciting ways to find an advantage. Until you’ve taken both claws from your opponent, anything is possible. Ready, FIGHT!

summary.핵심플레이: 두 명의 플레이어가 대결하며 scoop, snip 등 다양한 절단 공격과 근접 공격을 사용해 상대의 양쪽 집게를 빼앗는 것을 목표로 한다. 집게를 잃으면 불가사리를 모아 방어적 승리를 노리는 전략으로 전환할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 2인용 파티 대전 형식으로, salty taunt 같은 도발 기술을 포함한다. 각 스테이지마다 서로 다른 전략적 구성이 있어 상황에 따라 다른 방식으로 우위를 찾을 수 있다.

name: The Backrooms Regret
input:
⚠️ Important:
Currently, only the prologue of the game is available, with an estimated playtime of 30 minutes.

Future chapters (Part 1 and Part 2) will be released as free updates for all existing players.
However, the price of the game will increase with each new release:

-
€3.99 when Part 1 is released

-
€5.99 when Part 2 is released

You are David Campbell. You remember nothing. All you know is that you’re trapped in an endless maze.

As you search for answers, a specialized organization in the Backrooms will offer help… sometimes. But this place doesn’t forgive the unprepared. If you want to survive, you’ll have to adapt.

A A first-person horror game that combines puzzles, intense chases, and an oppressive atmosphere. Every step could be your last, and every decision will determine whether you escape or remain trapped forever.

We’ve crafted a unique atmosphere to fully immerse you in the Backrooms. The tension never truly fades: there are moments of calm, but the feeling of being watched never disappears.

summary.핵심플레이: 기억을 잃은 주인공 David Campbell이 되어 미로 같은 공간을 탐색하며 퍼즐을 풀고 추격을 피해 탈출구를 찾는다. 선택에 따라 탈출 여부가 결정된다.
summary.특징: Backrooms 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 감시당하는 듯한 긴장감과 압박감 있는 분위기를 연출한다. 현재 약 30분 분량의 프롤로그만 이용 가능하며, 이후 챕터는 무료 업데이트로 제공된다.

name: Car Jump Challenge
input:
Jump over various obstacles to reach the finish line.
There are many challenging levels waiting for you.
Activate platform triggers to complete levels.
KEY FEATURES

- 2D platform arcade game

- 24 levels ready to be unlocked

- 2 cars with different parameters

- realistically behaving suspension of 2D vehicles

- moving platforms, sinkholes, barrels, crates, tunnels

- puzzles to solve to unlock levels

- challenging time limits prepared for the most persistent players

summary.핵심플레이: 차량을 조작해 장애물을 뛰어넘어 결승선에 도달하고, 플랫폼 트리거를 작동시켜 레벨을 완료한다. 일부 레벨에서는 퍼즐을 풀어 잠금을 해제한다.
summary.특징: 2D 차량의 서스펜션이 물리적으로 반응하며, 움직이는 플랫폼, 싱크홀, 배럴, 상자, 터널 등의 요소가 있다. 서로 다른 성능의 차량 2종과 24개의 레벨, 시간 제한 요소가 포함된다.

name: Hot Pig Jump!
input:
Story

In a certain world, God has been gradually eradicating all living creatures from the world,

for reasons unknown, using his divine authority.

The only surviving pig, in his solitude, vows to rebel against God.

The former living creatures are now just souls. Summoning their last bit of strength,

they present themselves to the pig as the path to God, entrusting their future to him.

Game Overview

Control the main character, a pig, and head upwards while jumping over objects in front of you.

This is a 3D action game in which you head upwards while avoiding flamethrowers along the way.

summary.핵심플레이: 돼지 캐릭터를 조작해 앞에 놓인 오브젝트를 점프로 넘고 화염방사기를 피하면서 위쪽으로 올라간다.
summary.특징: 신이 세계의 생명체를 소멸시키는 세계관에서 마지막으로 살아남은 돼지가 신에게 저항한다는 설정의 3D 액션 게임으로, 죽은 생명체들의 영혼이 신에게 이르는 길을 제시한다.

name: Nick
input:
Time to kick some ChristmASS.

Nick is a free VR survival shooter defense game. Built in the Unreal engine, this first-person, room-scale VR experience lets users take control of a variety of weapons and tools to fight off endless waves of evil robotic elves. As Santa, users must move around the environment to set up defenses and dodge attacks to beat back the onslaught. 'Tis the season!

KEY FEATURES:

- Step into Nick’s boots to make a last stand in this room-scale interactive VR experience.
- Hone your skills with the game tutorial.
- Select the level of difficulty from three options.
- Face crushing waves of deranged killer robo-elves each with different abilities.
- Use the “Santa’s Little Helper” suction gun alongside your trusty mallet to turn everything around you into a weapon.
- Board up windows to fortify your defenses between waves.
- Maintain your workshop’s energy source by collecting battery cells dropped by defeated elves to power the generator.
- Christmas Easter Eggs (oh, the irony) abound!
- Save the holidays. Well, you can’t... But you can hold out as long as possible.
- Nick is compatible with the HTC Vive

BACKGROUND:

The year is 2027. Civil unrest grips the North Pole. Santa Claus, a Rockefeller-ian captain of industry and a figure of hope and progress, has fallen on hard times. His once insurmountable manufacturing empire has given up massive ground to the dual-pronged threat of overseas production and digital distribution.

In order to keep up with a changing manufacturing landscape, Santa decided to automate his workshop by installing a mechanized, robotic production system led by an Artificial Intelligence named P.A.L. (Polar Algorithmic Computer). For the first few months, everything seemed copacetic. Then came an efficiency test… that Santa, by dint of being flesh and blood as opposed to mechanical marvel, inevitably failed. P.A.L. repurposed the once-peaceful robo-elf manufacturing arm into an army bent on assassination, and set out to wipe Santa from the face of the Earth. Why? To maximize profits, of course!

Enter Nick—Santa Claus’ badass survivalist alter ego. Nick’s on the run, evading and fighting P.A.L.’s robot forces as he traverses the Polar wasteland. Fueled by weapons-grade eggnog and righteous Christmas wrath, he's made it to his final outpost: a remote satellite workshop originally meant for experimental toy R&D. Here, Nick readies his defenses, makes peace with his maker and prepares to make his last stand in. That’s where you come in…

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 산타로서 룸스케일 VR 환경을 이동하며 로봇 엘프들의 연속되는 웨이브에 맞서 싸운다. 흡입 총과 망치 등 무기를 사용해 적을 처치하고, 웨이브 사이에 창문을 막아 방어를 강화하며 처치한 엘프가 떨어뜨린 배터리 셀을 모아 발전기에 전력을 공급한다.
summary.특징: 2027년 북극을 배경으로, AI P.A.L.이 로봇 엘프 군대를 이용해 산타를 제거하려 한다는 설정을 가진다. 세 가지 난이도와 튜토리얼을 제공하며 HTC Vive를 지원한다.

name: Ground Zero
input:
Ground Zero is a retro survival horror set in post-apocalyptic South Korea.

A devastating meteor impact has wiped out South Korea. 2 months later as the dust and lightning storms settle and the air becomes breathable, an elite Korean operative and her Canadian partner are sent to investigate. What waits for them in the foggy remains is more terrifying than they ever could have imagined…

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 메테오 충돌로 파괴된 대한민국의 잔해를 조사하며, 안개 낀 지역을 탐색하고 생존한다.
summary.특징: 포스트 아포칼립스 대한민국을 배경으로 한 레트로 스타일의 서바이벌 호러로, 한국 요원과 캐나다인 파트너가 재난 지역을 조사하는 이야기를 다룬다.

name: Deadman's Wonder: Chapter 1
input:
Journey down the rabbit hole into a Wonderland like you've never seen before~. Embark on a TwIsTeD retelling of the classic fairy tale "Alice in Wonderland".

Join Alice in this visual novel experience as you both try to survive this hellscape and unravel the mystery of who you are and what happened to the citizens of Wonderland.

Meet a colorful cast of characters while embarking through the woods!! You never know who is truly on your side. Maybe everyone or no one at all?

It's a long journey to the Hearts Palace... Can you survive long enough???

summary.핵심플레이: 앨리스와 함께 이야기를 진행하며 원더랜드에서 생존하고, 자신이 누구인지와 원더랜드 시민들에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지에 대한 미스터리를 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: 동화 '이상한 나라의 앨리스'를 변형해 재해석한 스토리로, 숲을 지나며 다양한 등장인물을 만나고 하트 궁전을 향해 나아가는 비주얼 노벨이다.

name: Amatarasu Riddle Star
input:
Story
Doumoto Takaya was bored.

One evening, he had taken up his childhood friend’s invitation to have a late-night picnic. He accepted, if only to subdue his boredom, and was encouraged to wish upon the shooting stars that were a common spectacle in the town of Hoshigino. During their picnic, a shooting star whisked across the sky and he hurriedly wished for “something fun and wondrous” to occur in his seemingly boring life.

To their surprise, stars began to trickle down from the sky and quickly turned into a full-fledged meteor shower. Rather than disappearing, the shooting stars seemed to have taken shape, aimed at Hoshigino, and enveloped it in a warm, bright light. Once the light dissipated, a single shooting star remained and barreled across the sky before ramming straight into the empty, nearby hill.

From the cloud of dust, Takaya and his chilldhood friend, Yua, discovered a rabbit-eared girl with white hair running straight for the town. Yua quickly chased after her, but rather than finding the rabbit-eared girl, they found something beyond their wildest imaginations...
Features

- 15+ Music Tracks

- 5 Adorable Main Character!

- A full-length visual novel with more than seven possible endings!

- Hundreds of CGs and variations!

- Moé-ify the stars!

summary.핵심플레이: 텍스트 기반 스토리를 읽으며 선택을 통해 전개와 결말을 진행한다. 여러 갈래의 선택에 따라 서로 다른 엔딩에 도달한다.
summary.특징: 별똥별에 소원을 빈 뒤 토끼 귀를 가진 소녀가 나타나는 이야기를 다루며, 5명의 주요 캐릭터와 7개 이상의 엔딩, 15곡 이상의 음악, 다수의 CG를 포함한다.

name: A Tale of Fortunate Lust
input:
A cute and explicit anime-style visual novel. You are the protagonist, and each episode depicts erotic events that unfold throughout your life. The story is linear, and as you progress, you'll encounter sliding puzzle games. Along the way, you'll have sex with various characters.

Episode #1

You ran into Gwen at the mall, and you started chatting like old times. Memories of your high school friendship came flooding back. As you caught up, you realized your old crush was still there. You mustered the courage to ask her out on a date, and to your delight, she agreed.

10-15m playthrough

Game Features

-
Peeking: Sneak a peek through the keyhole

-
X-Ray: See what's underneath clothes

-
Outfit Selection: Choose outfits for the model to keep

-
Choice Selection: Make decisions that lead to different paths or different sex images.

-
Puzzle Game: Slide and match puzzles as the main gameplay mechanic

-
Character Dialogues: Immersive and interactive conversations

-
Animations and Sound Effects: A ton of visual and auditory details to enhance the experience

-
Narrator and Character Voices: Fully voiced scenes for a more engaging story

Episode #2

You're stuck at work, and the monotony is getting to you. Your mind drifts to the waitress who gave you her number a couple of days ago. You cross your fingers, hoping that maybe you'll get the chance to have sex with her.

10-15m playthrough

Added Game Features

-
Penetration: Introduced a fapping and sex penetration mini-game.

-
Phone: Engage in text conversations with characters and receive explicit images.

Episode #3

During your lunch break, you take a walk in the park and receive some unexpected news. A stranger approaches to cheer you up and invites you on a small adventure.

15-20m playthrough

Added Game Features

-
Target Hit: Introduced a fast click target mini-game.

Episode #4

Having spent a few months with pregnant Gwen, you decide to take a short trip out of town before the baby's arrival. During your time at the beach, you encounter a new and spectacular woman.

15-20m playthrough

Episode #5

A new character appears in the protagonist's life. She is a shy gamer girl who recently moved into the same building. She might be hiding something under that skirt, perhaps a secret she's keeping tucked away.

10-15m playthrough

Characters [5 / 12]

I plan to create a total of 12 unique characters, each with distinct features and personalities. Each episode will introduce at least one new character, and some episodes may feature two or even have special character-focused content.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 시점의 선형 스토리를 따라가며 에피소드별로 등장인물들과의 성적 이벤트를 진행하고, 선택지를 통해 분기나 다른 이미지로 이어진다. 진행 중 슬라이드 퍼즐, 타깃 클릭, 삽입 미니게임 등을 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 애니메이션 스타일 일러스트와 음성이 포함된 성인 콘텐츠로, 열쇠구멍 엿보기, X-레이, 의상 선택, 휴대폰 문자 대화 등의 기능을 제공한다. 에피소드마다 최소 한 명의 새 캐릭터가 등장하며 총 12명의 캐릭터가 예정되어 있는 얼리 액세스 작품이다.

name: Behind The Kingdom
input:
OVERVIEW

Explore the vast outskirts of a strange and fantastical domain in Behind the Kingdom! As you navigate and discover hidden, winding paths in its huge interconnected map, you will gain abilities both magical and mechanical, giving you enormous freedom in how you choose to traverse the realm and engage in combat. In order to solve the Kingdom's mysteries, you'll need the help of its many outlaws & outcasts who may, in their exile, carry the soul of the realm after all.

GAMEPLAY

This is a 2D side-scrolling action game, featuring a large map with over 12 unique biomes and multiple possible critical paths to the end. Exploring the whole map will require seeking out the many types of movement upgrades, enhancements to your moveset that will completely transform your gameplay over the course of the adventure. Combat requires some patience and planning to learn each enemy's weakness, but once familiar, you can enjoy plenty of good old hack-and-slash as well, even while the encounters increase in complexity.

STORY

Within the Kingdom, things are increasingly stagnant, its populace ever more restless and violent, yet no one can point to a cause. Sandalwood's parents, both legendary adventurers, vanished trying to find answers. Sandalwood himself ended up exiled to the Backcountry, his memory fuzzy on the details of why. Trapped in a cursed and abandoned prison far from home, he set out to find his answers, which first meant exploring this deadly, strange land, which was much more inhabited than he'd been led to believe...

summary.핵심플레이: 2D 횡스크롤 방식으로 서로 연결된 넓은 맵을 탐험하며, 이동 능력 업그레이드를 획득해 진행 경로를 확장한다. 적의 약점을 파악하는 전투와 근접 공격 중심의 액션을 병행한다.
summary.특징: 12개 이상의 바이옴과 여러 갈래의 클리어 경로를 가진 대형 맵으로 구성되며, 마법적·기계적 능력을 얻어 이동 방식과 전투를 변화시킨다. 유배된 주인공 Sandalwood가 왕국의 미스터리를 풀어가는 이야기를 담았다.

name: Visitors: Marine Invasion
input:
Your father was a true fisherman, committed to his profession. Now you have grown up and it's time for you to carry on his hard work. The world has changed however, and all the fish who formerly lived here, have long ago abandoned this place.

The full moon is a time when evil wakes up and strange things begin to happen.

And only at this time do the fish come back, as well as those creatures that once lived here. Take your father's ship and go ahead, but remember – you are not the only one on the hunt.

- Catch fish to then sell it in the bay.

- Defend yourself from the ghosts of dead pirates.

- Repair a ship from damages inflicted by the drowned.

- Protect your spoils from pesky aliens.

- Buy enhancements for money earned from fish sales.

Reach the "Red Moon" day, and prove that you deserve to step into your father's shoes.

summary.핵심플레이: 아버지의 배를 타고 물고기를 잡아 만에서 판매하고, 그 돈으로 강화 요소를 구매한다. 밤 동안 유령·외계인 등의 적으로부터 배와 잡은 물고기를 방어하고 손상된 배를 수리한다.
summary.특징: 보름달이 뜨면 물고기와 과거의 생물들이 돌아온다는 설정을 바탕으로 하며, 죽은 해적의 유령, 익사한 자, 외계인 등이 등장한다. 최종 목표는 'Red Moon' 날에 도달하는 것이다.

name: Parisian Brasserie Simulator
input:
Roadmap

About the Game

【The demo now supports 1–4 player co-op】

Ready to dive into a colorful, surprise-filled adventure? Run your very own restaurant in the bustling heart of Paris — the most visited city in the world. Soak in the authentic Parisian atmosphere, with Haussmann-style buildings and stunning views of the Eiffel Tower, while embracing the charm of French cuisine. Create seasonal menus, optimize your staff, and boost customer satisfaction to turn your humble brasserie into a true Parisian institution!

As the owner of a cozy little restaurant tucked away on a lively Parisian avenue, your grand opening day is finally here. Carefully set up your space, arrange tables and chairs, order your first batch of quality ingredients, and craft a mouthwatering menu to win over your future guests. Once everything’s ready, open your doors and welcome your very first customers — your culinary journey begins now!

summary.핵심플레이: 파리에 위치한 레스토랑을 운영하며 테이블과 의자를 배치하고 식재료를 주문하며 메뉴를 만든다. 문을 열어 손님을 받고 직원을 관리하며 고객 만족도를 높인다.
summary.특징: 오스만 양식 건물과 에펠탑 전경을 배경으로 한 파리를 무대로 하며 프랑스 요리를 다룬다. 계절 메뉴 제작 요소가 있고 1~4인 협동 플레이를 지원한다.

name: Aisla
input:
Play as Aisla, a woman who wakes up with no memories in a complex on Mars.

Your objective is to explore the environments and discover who the character is and what situation she is in.



Key Features:



- Narrative Driven Adventure

- Cinematic Cutscenes

- Mind Map: Keep track of your discoveries

- Collectables Objects

- Licensed Indie Soundtrack & Original Soundtrack

- Hand-painted mixed with semi realistic visuals

summary.핵심플레이: 기억을 잃은 채 화성의 시설에서 깨어난 Aisla를 조작해 주변 환경을 탐색하고, 캐릭터의 정체와 처한 상황을 알아낸다. 오브젝트를 수집하며 발견한 단서를 정리한다.
summary.특징: 내러티브 중심의 진행에 시네마틱 컷신을 사용하며, 발견 내용을 추적하는 마인드 맵 시스템을 제공한다. 손으로 그린 그림과 반사실적 비주얼을 혼합했고 라이선스 인디 및 오리지널 사운드트랙을 사용한다.

name: Baseball Club
input:
Baseball club is finally here!

Pitcher-batter duels, cool items and upgrades to unlock, and most importantly - intuitive and engaging gameplay- this is the quick baseball game you’ve been waiting for!



In Baseball Club you can:

- Customize your character

- Unlock cool new equipment

- Set your diet (YES!)

- Practice your pitching and batting



… and most importantly

- Challenge opponents to batting and pitching matches



This is where all that you’ve learned and practiced will be put to the ultimate test.



Try to win against your opponent! Use your pitching skills to make your throw difficult to hit. Don’t let your opponent score. Then switch places and try to hit the ball pitched by your opponent as far as possible. The further it flies - the more points you get.



The more you win - the higher you climb up in the leagues. Play against tougher and tougher opponents and remain on top.

summary.핵심플레이: 투수와 타자의 대결을 중심으로, 투구로 상대의 타격을 어렵게 만들고 타격 시에는 공을 멀리 쳐 점수를 얻는다. 투구와 타격을 연습한 뒤 상대와 대결한다.
summary.특징: 캐릭터 커스터마이징, 장비 잠금 해제, 식단 설정 기능이 있으며, 승리를 통해 리그를 올라가며 더 강한 상대와 겨룬다.

name: Space Quiz
input:
Are you ready to conquer the universe?

Command your ships through the galaxy and lead the conquest of planets using your knowledge and cunning. An educative app that makes you learn something with a lot of fun.

Space Quiz is an spectacular quiz game that challenges your dexterity and your knowledge about topics like history, mathematics, literature and many more.

On this spatial adventure the main character is you
Conquer the galaxy with your knowledge, and think hard how to manage your ships. The educative game challenges you to an endless possible situations where you have to decide how to recollect resources or attack the enemy. Don't make any bad choice, protect your planets and decide what ships do you want to send to battle, the game won't let you feel safe!

These are the resources you need to dominate the universe: fuel, energy and minerals . With them you can do almost everything: recollect, buy, exchange... Plan yourself!

Besides, Space Quiz proposes you a lot of achievements that others players will be able to see that on your profile. Prepare your army!

We reward you if you help us with the user generated content network: interact, add, review or translate questions and invite your friends to play. Prove that you are the best and challenge with your knowledges on our community.

Play Space Quiz and conquer the universe! We guarantee you many entertaining and fun hours.
Features
Educative:
Try your knowledge out with more than 8000 questions!
There are many knowledge topics, we'll extend them...

Multilanguage:
Available in spanish and english languages

Challenge with the rest of players:
Challenge players from all the community using your knowledge

About the game:

- Learn while you are having fun

- Conquer individually against Artificial Intelligences or in multiplayer universes against other players

- Create your own questions

- Display your attack and defensive tactics

- Upgrade your ship's skills

- Buy and exchange resources

- Unlock the achievements to get your recognition

- Players ranking

summary.핵심플레이: 역사, 수학, 문학 등 다양한 주제의 퀴즈에 답하며 우주선을 지휘해 행성을 정복한다. 연료, 에너지, 광물 자원을 수집·구매·교환하고, 우주선을 강화하며 공격과 방어 전술을 운용한다.
summary.특징: 8000개 이상의 문제를 제공하며 스페인어와 영어를 지원한다. AI를 상대로 한 개인전과 다른 플레이어와의 멀티플레이어를 지원하고, 사용자가 직접 문제를 만들 수 있으며 업적과 플레이어 랭킹 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Youropa
input: When Youropa is torn apart, you must walk the walls in a strange fragmented city, in order to restore it and learn who you really are. A platform puzzle paint adventure about breaking rules, being upside down and thinking outside the box.

summary.핵심플레이: 벽과 천장을 걸어 다니며 조각난 도시를 이동하고 퍼즐을 풀어 도시를 복원한다.
summary.특징: 중력 규칙을 깨고 상하가 뒤바뀐 공간을 활용하는 플랫폼 퍼즐과 페인트 요소를 결합했다.

name: Dungeon Danger Traps
input:
Do you want to know if you are a good tomb raider? Dungeon Danger Traps will help you find out! And it will also allow you to prove everyone that you are also a first-class runner! But be careful, who knows where the road will lead if you choose the wrong path.

Leaderboards

Each race is reflected in the leaderboard and this will serve as proof of your skill!

Different ways to complete the levels

At the levels, you will meet forks, so you will have to choose which path is the best to get ahead of your rivals!

summary.핵심플레이: 던전 내부를 달리며 함정을 피하고 레벨을 완주한다. 갈림길에서 어떤 경로로 갈지 선택하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 각 레이스 기록이 리더보드에 반영되며, 레벨마다 여러 갈래의 경로가 있어 다른 방식으로 완료할 수 있다.

name: The White Door
input:
The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure

About the Game
Robert Hill wakes up in a Mental Health facility and suffers from severe memory loss. Follow the facility’s strict daily routine, explore his dreams and help him recall his memories.

summary.핵심플레이: 기억 상실을 겪는 Robert Hill을 조작해 시설의 정해진 일과를 따르고, 그의 꿈을 탐색하며 기억을 되찾도록 돕는다.
summary.특징: 정신 건강 시설을 배경으로 하며, 일상 루틴 진행과 꿈 탐색을 통해 인물의 기억을 회복해 나가는 구조를 갖는다.

name: Project Almighty
input:
Buzz

Release Day! Gameplay Notes:
The game is open ended, and it's a roguelike so if your character dies, they get deleted.
Be careful when starting a new character and you can also use your partner Bill to help with beginning enemies.
Even a powerful combination of powers still leaves your young character vulnerable to most enemies.
The controls are mouse all three buttons and Keyboard W,A,S,D there are also lots of little secrets.

Update Notes

If you are having trouble using the Flying Power, just Press "F" in-game instead of Pressing the Flight Button at the top left corner of the screen. Press "F" to Fly Press "F" again to land.

About the Game
Project Almighty

The code name for the Super Agent project, you've been unleashed on a corrupted town taken over by mobs of crazy criminals bent on ravaging, raiding, and causing mayhem. Can you answer the call for a hero? Take back the streets and homes of the terrified population frozen in fear.

You start by creating any character you can think up, experiment with different powers and abilities, and punch, blast, and blow up tons of bad guys. Design the look of your avenger of the weak.

Random Encounters!

Arcade combat with your custom Superhero! Find out the strengths and weaknesses of every type of hero!

Be careful because even a seemingly powerful Super can be defeated and overwhelmed!

Save Citizens!

Make 100's of different Superheroes!

Use your power to patrol the streets and to stop crime, beat down violent criminals in this sandbox town.

The town needs your hero to fight off endless gangs and monsters!

Protect the citizens!

summary.핵심플레이: 직접 만든 슈퍼히어로 캐릭터로 여러 능력과 어빌리티를 조합해 마을을 점령한 범죄자와 갱단, 몬스터를 주먹·발사·폭발로 물리치고 시민을 보호한다. 마우스 세 버튼과 W, A, S, D 키로 조작한다.
summary.특징: 캐릭터가 죽으면 삭제되는 로그라이크 방식의 오픈 엔드 구조이며, 외형과 능력을 자유롭게 설정해 수백 종의 히어로를 만들 수 있다. 랜덤 인카운터와 샌드박스 마을에서 아케이드식 전투가 진행되며, 'F' 키로 비행하고 다시 눌러 착지한다.

name: Canvas Legacy
input:
Canvas Legacy is a sandbox MMORPG with a fully player-driven economy, featuring open-world housing where all shops are run by players. Explore dungeons, fight bosses, participate in Kingdom wars and even become King yourself. Or just build your dream house and paint nice things.
Kingdoms
The world of Canvas Legacy is divided between two kingdoms. Each kingdom is ruled by a player monarch, who can set taxes and exercise the crown's sovereign rights.

A group of adventurers visiting the court to hold an audience with the King.
Open-world housing
Location, location, location. Any player can claim a plot anywhere on the map and build a house. Do you want to open a shop, become a farmer or breed pets? It's up to you.
Paint pixel art
By mixing mats into colors you can use your brush to paint the world. Awesome pixel art, graffiti or just advertising your shop. Anything goes; the world is your Canvas.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 오픈 월드에서 원하는 부지를 차지해 집을 짓고 상점 운영, 농사, 펫 사육 등을 하며, 던전 탐험과 보스 전투, 왕국 전쟁에 참여한다.
summary.특징: 세계는 두 왕국으로 나뉘며 각 왕국은 세금 설정 등 통치권을 행사하는 플레이어 군주가 다스린다. 모든 상점이 플레이어에 의해 운영되는 플레이어 주도 경제를 가지며, 재료를 섞어 만든 색으로 세계에 픽셀 아트를 그릴 수 있다.

name: Harem Hunter: Sex-ray Vision
input:
If you've ever worried about being reincarnated in a fantasy world without any special powers, don't worry! You can waste your time grinding your stats up OR you can drink one potion to power yourself up to OP levels!
*Luka does not claim any responsibility for any unseen side effects that may include: loss of life, limbs, senses, or gaining a unique ability that lets you see anyone's kinks, fetishes, sensitive spo- …wait what?!

That's right, after drinking a potion brewed up by the mini-mage Luka, our protagonist gains the ability: Sex-Ray Vision! Using this skill, he hunts down the hottest adventurers and successfully seduces them, adding them to his harem! Take your horny harem on all kinds of quests, from apprehending bandits to rescuing princesses. Just remember you might spend more time baby making then actually fighting!

- Translated version of the original Japanese Visual Novel

- Your whole harem is fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue

- Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants

- Hours of story content

- Audio including music and special effects

- Enhanced with character sprite animations

- Gallery and Scene selections

- 27 scenes of fucking your harem just right!

Harem Hunter: Sex-Ray Vision Is the English localization of a Visual Novel originally created by prolific Japanese developer Miel. We at Cherry Kiss aim to provide an authentic Japanese Visual Novel experience to gamers outside of Japan.

**PLEASE NOTE**
All characters described and visually represented in this game are over 18 years of age, and no actual, nor identifiable minor was used in the production of this game.

summary.핵심플레이: 스토리를 따라가며 등장인물을 공략해 하렘을 구성하고, 산적 체포나 공주 구출 등의 퀘스트를 진행한다. 갤러리와 장면 선택 기능으로 특정 장면을 다시 볼 수 있다.
summary.특징: 일본 개발사 Miel의 비주얼 노벨을 영어로 현지화한 작품으로, 일본어 음성과 HD 업스케일된 원화, 16:9 및 4:3 화면비, 캐릭터 스프라이트 애니메이션, 27개의 성인 장면을 포함한다. 물약을 마셔 상대의 취향을 파악하는 능력을 얻는 판타지 설정을 다룬다.

name: Lord of the Wilds
input:
In the wild lands, you are the last hope.

Lord of the Wilds is a game that combines strategy, construction, and survival elements. You will play as a exiled noble, starting from scratch to rebuild your domain in a war-torn wilderness, fending off threats from all sides, and ultimately becoming the ruler of this land.

Start from scratch, build a prosperous territory:

You begin in a land of ruins, surrounded by barren soil and crumbling remnants of the past. To survive, you must gather resources by hand and construct essential infrastructure. Lumber mills provide wood, mines allow you to extract precious ores, and farms become your source of food. As resources accumulate, you can plan the layout of your domain, build houses to attract settlers, establish barracks to train soldiers, and even open markets to boost economic prosperity. Every step requires careful calculation, as resource scarcity and harsh environmental conditions will constantly test your decision-making skills.

Fend off enemies, protect your people:

Dangers lurk everywhere in the wilderness. Rival lords eye your territory, seeking to annex it; orc tribes emerge from the mountains, burning and pillaging; undead legions awaken in the night, bringing death and terror. To survive, you must train soldiers and build a powerful army. Archers, cavalry, and infantry each have their strengths and weaknesses, and you must devise tactics based on your enemies' characteristics. At the same time, construct sturdy walls and towering arrow towers to defend against enemy attacks. Every battle is crucial—failure could mean the destruction of your domain, while victory will earn you precious resources and time.

Seek mystical powers, turn the tide of battle:

Deep within the wilderness lies ancient power. By building mage towers, you can recruit powerful wizards to study devastating spells. Fireballs can incinerate groups of enemies, ice magic can slow enemy advances, and summoning spells can bring powerful allies to your side. Meanwhile, constructing churches allows you to harness religious power. Devout priests can heal wounded soldiers, pray for divine blessings to boost army morale, and even summon angels to the battlefield. The combination of magic and faith will become the key to overcoming formidable foes.

Are you ready to face the challenge?

In Lord of the Wilds, you will face multiple challenges in resource management, territory planning, army command, and strategic decision-making. Every choice you make will shape your destiny. Will you become a benevolent ruler or a ruthless conqueror? Will you rely on technology and force, or will you turn to magic and faith? The choice is yours.

The Lord of the Wilds awaits your rise!

summary.핵심플레이: 추방된 귀족으로서 폐허가 된 땅에서 자원을 채집하고 제재소·광산·농장 등 기반 시설을 건설해 영지를 확장하며, 병사를 훈련시키고 성벽과 화살탑을 세워 적의 공격을 방어한다.
summary.특징: 라이벌 영주, 오크 부족, 언데드 군단 등의 위협에 맞서 궁수·기병·보병을 조합해 전술을 짜고, 마법사 탑에서 파이어볼·빙결·소환 마법을, 교회에서 치료·사기 증진·천사 소환 등 신앙의 힘을 활용할 수 있다.

name: Tales of Farhollow
input:
Tales of Farhollow is a player decision based adventure. You will go on a quest as a new adventurer in town, to help (or harm), the townspeople. Choose your decisions wisely, as they can help you or get you into trouble! Meet the eccentric townsfolk, who ceaselessly need help with their problems. Depending on how you interact with the people can give, or take away your precious resources. Be careful with them, as striking a good balance is the key to surviving in Farhollow!

Mysteries and Problems: Gradually discover the mysteries of the town and what plagues the townsfolk. Some of their problems can be solved simply, others take much more effort! Your decisions and resources will determine if you're able to save the town.

Sneak, Steal, and Fight: Its up to you what kind of adventurer you will be. Being a hero, a thief, or a liar are all ways you can play - how will you be?

summary.핵심플레이: 새로 마을에 온 모험가로서 퀘스트를 수행하며 주민들을 돕거나 해치는 선택을 한다. 선택에 따라 자원을 얻거나 잃으며, 균형을 유지해 마을에서 생존해야 한다.
summary.특징: 플레이어의 결정에 따라 마을의 미스터리와 주민들의 문제가 점차 드러나며, 영웅·도둑·거짓말쟁이 등 다양한 방식으로 잠입, 절도, 전투를 선택해 진행할 수 있다.

name: Little hidden city
input:
Do you think you are an astute observer — an experienced hidden-object-finder? Try one of the most difficult games of this genre: Little Hidden City! Here you will find tons of well-hidden objects in six different, very detailed and varied levels.

Beautifully designed, isometric view, tremendous fun — not just for fans of hidden-object games, but with lots of achievements which complement such an experience. What are you waiting for? Play Little Hidden City and find your luck!

- 6 big, challenging scenarios
- 101 achievements
- trading cards via Steam
- finder's reward and seeker’s frustration close together
- great fun for players at all ages
- "Where's the damn ball, fish, a bank, a car ...? !!!" - your standard phrase when playing in Little Hidden City

Trading cards*
*will be available after approval by STEAM

Emoticons*
*will be available after approval by STEAM

summary.핵심플레이: 아이소메트릭 시점으로 그려진 장면에서 숨겨진 사물을 찾아낸다.
summary.특징: 상세하게 묘사된 6개의 스테이지와 101개의 도전 과제, 스팀 트레이딩 카드를 제공한다.

name: Puppeteer's Curse
input:
It's a first-person horror room escape game. You have to solve puzzles in a dark atmosphere, avoiding monitors. Never get caught.

It's a place where you've been studying soul transfer for the rest of your life, and that's the wrong way to do it... "Free me from the curse."

To go up each floor, you must enter the correct ancient characters. You must find hidden keys and hints and open a box or safe.

The hidden space is distorted. Take a close look at the wall.

summary.핵심플레이: 어두운 공간에서 퍼즐을 풀며 각 층을 올라가고, 숨겨진 열쇠와 단서를 찾아 상자나 금고를 열고 올바른 고대 문자를 입력한다. 감시자에게 발각되지 않도록 피해야 한다.
summary.특징: 영혼 전이를 연구하던 장소를 배경으로 저주를 풀어야 하는 설정이며, 왜곡된 숨겨진 공간과 벽을 자세히 살펴야 하는 탐색 요소가 있다.

name: Laranga
input: Laranga is a life simulator with adventure elements. The action takes place on an isolated island. The leisurely pace of the game allows you to create biological interconnected communities and observe their development and evolution, simultaneously completing different tasks and struggling with emerging difficulties. Available 5 locations and more than 16 species of creatures.

summary.핵심플레이: 고립된 섬에서 생물들이 서로 연결된 군집을 만들고 그 발전과 진화를 관찰한다. 동시에 여러 과제를 수행하고 발생하는 어려움에 대응한다.
summary.특징: 느린 진행 속도를 가진 게임으로, 5개의 지역과 16종 이상의 생물이 등장한다.

name: The First Day
input:
The First Day is an Indie First Person Puzzle Solving Game.

It is your first work day at the soda company Paaraol. The place turns out to be very strange and isn't how it should be.
Use your new abilities to change the gravitational pull of objects to solve puzzles. You will find several tools that are supporting you, like Boxes, Buttons, Lasers, Quantum Machines, Teleporters and more. Use and combine them to puzzle your way through the Paaraol-Company.

All while you are going on a seamless journey to find the secrets behind your powers and battle your past.

- 64 unique Puzzles
- Change the gravitational pull of objects
- A seamless journey with no loading screens after the intro
- Walk on walls, floors and ceilings

- Use and combine many tools while solving puzzles like:
- Laser
- Projections
- Mirrors
- Beamer
- Floating Balls
- Switches
- Teleporter
- Boxes
- Laser Boxes
- Portal Boxes
- Turrets
- Barriers
- Freeze objects
- NPCs

summary.핵심플레이: 물체의 중력 방향을 바꾸는 능력을 사용해 퍼즐을 풀며, 벽·바닥·천장을 걸어 이동한다. 상자, 버튼, 레이저, 미러, 텔레포터, 양자 기계 등 여러 도구를 사용하고 조합해 총 64개의 퍼즐을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 소다 회사 Paaraol에 첫 출근한 인물이 이상한 회사 내부를 탐험하며 자신의 능력에 얽힌 비밀을 찾아가는 구성으로, 인트로 이후에는 로딩 화면 없이 이어지는 진행 방식을 갖는다.

name: Chocolate makes you happy: New Year
input:
Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps, treadmills, Christmas ornaments, snow globes, snowflakes and explosions.

The goal of the player is to keep the cookies on the chocolate bar for some time to pass the level.



In Chocolate makes you happy: New Year:

- 50 levels

- Explosions

- Jumpers

- Teleports

- Sweets

- Accelerators

- Traps

- Changing gravity

- Treadmills

- Christmas ornaments

- Snow globes

- Snowflakes

- Christmas art

summary.핵심플레이: 쿠키를 초콜릿 바 위에 일정 시간 동안 유지시켜 레벨을 클리어한다. 점퍼, 텔레포트, 가속기, 함정, 러닝머신 등 다양한 물리 요소를 활용한다.
summary.특징: 중력 반전, 폭발, 눈송이, 스노우 글로브 등 크리스마스 테마의 요소가 포함된 50개의 물리 퍼즐 레벨로 구성된다.

name: Push a Block
input: Push a Block is a puzzle game where you need to arrange the blocks on stage to reach the end. You can only move the blocks by moving into them, but if there is another block behind it, or something else doesn't let you move it, you'll climb it

summary.핵심플레이: 스테이지에 놓인 블록을 밀어 배치하며 목표 지점에 도달한다. 블록은 그 방향으로 이동해 밀어야 움직이며, 뒤에 다른 블록이 있거나 밀 수 없는 경우에는 블록 위로 올라간다.
summary.특징: 블록을 밀거나 올라타는 이동 규칙을 활용해 경로를 만드는 방식으로 진행된다.

name: Madlum
input:
Madlum's Vault is the ultimate prison, a labyrinth of suffering shaped by the unfortunate souls who inhabit it. Take control of one of these souls to fight through waves of vicious bullet hell, eviscerate all manner of demonic creatures and face your rivals head-on in fearsome boss battles.

The unfortunate souls.

summary.핵심플레이: 악마 같은 생명체와 적들이 쏟아내는 탄막 공격 속에서 전투를 벌이고, 몰려오는 적들을 처치하며 보스전을 치른다.
summary.특징: 수감된 영혼들에 의해 형성된 감옥 미로 'Madlum's Vault'를 배경으로, 그 안의 영혼 중 하나를 조작해 진행한다.

name: NRGeditor
input:
- Modular Featherlight Framework

Create Epic Visual Moments! Using a unique modular approach under the hood; only what you need is part of your App. No dependencies or external packages are required. NRG runs at full speed 100% natively on all supported platforms and produces output at a fraction of the size of any other solution out there!

- An Engine to Create Engines

NRG provides you specialized tools to gain direct access to low levels APIs through a thin comprehensive abstraction layer for you to start building on. Gain some serious re-usable skills by learning how to build from scratch state-of-the-art Games and Interactive Apps.

- Designed to be Customizable

Develop your Handbuilt 3D Engine with NRG and achieve better performance than any other all-in-one solutions out there. Written in pure C our Non-Linear Programmable Core can be accessed via Lua or directly in pure C/C++ and produce lightweight, lightning-fast native stand-alone executables.

- Programmable Rendering Pipeline

Use NRG to develop your very own Customized Rendering Graphics Engine tuned precisely for your project. Achieve better performance than the competition by creating your GPU rendering pipeline tailored specifically for your application's need and optimized for your targeted platforms.

- Build From the Ground Up

Built for rapid prototyping and to handle projects of any size, with NRG you can develop, code, build, profile and debug your App. on one or multiple platforms simultaneously in realtime. Once you App. ready you can publish it as a native C/C++ standalone executable or as an add-on for another external project.

Xena: Warrior Princess - Full Project (Source Code and Assets):

This mini game was created from scratch (renderer included) in 2 weeks by one
programmer and one artist for the Game Jolt Together Jam using NRG as a
development platform.

NRGstation Realtime Pathtracing DEMO - Full Project (Source Code and Assets):

NRGshowroom DEMO- Full Project (Source Code and Assets):

MicroBots - Full Project + Online Learning Sessions:

MicroLand - Full Project + Online Learning Sessions:

MicroKart - Full Project + Online Learning Sessions:

summary.핵심플레이: C 언어로 작성된 코어에 Lua 또는 C/C++로 직접 접근하여 3D 엔진과 렌더링 파이프라인을 직접 구축하고, 앱을 개발·코딩·빌드·프로파일링·디버그한다.
summary.특징: 의존성이나 외부 패키지 없이 필요한 모듈만 포함하는 모듈형 구조를 사용하며, 프로그래머블 렌더링 파이프라인을 통해 플랫폼별로 최적화된 네이티브 실행 파일이나 애드온으로 결과물을 출력한다. Xena: Warrior Princess, MicroBots 등 소스 코드와 에셋이 포함된 예제 프로젝트를 제공한다.

name: The Motorcycle
input:
A game where you are chased by a motorcycle. Based on a true story (only the park like map)
In this game, you need to collect five photos before you can escape the current map. Simple.
But be careful! One wrong step and you can end up drowing in the water with no help nearby, or get stuck in traps. And if you don't get unstuck quickly, she will find you!

-
-
-

summary.핵심플레이: 현재 맵을 탈출하기 위해 사진 다섯 장을 수집한다. 이 과정에서 물에 빠지거나 함정에 걸리지 않도록 이동에 주의해야 한다.
summary.특징: 오토바이에게 쫓기는 상황을 다루며, 함정에 갇히면 빠르게 벗어나지 못할 경우 추격자에게 발견된다. 공원 형태의 맵은 실화를 바탕으로 했다고 소개된다.

name: SPACE HUNT
input: SPACE HUNT - is a new cooperative shooter for two players in the style of sci fi. You are in a locked laboratory and you have no chance to get out... So grab your weapons and fight off waves of enemies! Single and cooperative game up to two people and endless gameplay!

summary.핵심플레이: 봉쇄된 연구소에서 무기를 들고 밀려오는 적들의 웨이브를 막아낸다. 혼자 또는 최대 2인이 함께 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 공상과학 배경을 바탕으로 2인 협동 플레이와 종료 없이 이어지는 웨이브 방식의 게임플레이를 제공한다.

name: Reboot Heroes
input:
Community

About the Game
Reboot Heroes combines the auto-battle combat of Backpack Battles with the strategic deckbuilding of Slay the Spire, and the team-building adventure of Final Fantasy.

- Build Your Team: Each run starts with one hero, you recruit 2 others by defeating them.

- Unique Heroes: Each hero has their own 100+ cards, not shared between Heroes!

- Powerful Elements: Combine elements to channel the powers of Wind, Darkness, Chaos and more.

- Hero Stats: Your Heroes grow in power as the game progresses, with a versatile stat system.

- Rewarding Creativity: Each run is unique, and discourages seeing the same builds over and over.

- Combine Strategies: Will your warrior be a Berserker, Samurai, Dark Knight or a mix between all?

- Endless Replayability: The scaling ranked mode is a challenge for even the best players.

summary.핵심플레이: 하나의 영웅으로 시작해 다른 영웅을 물리쳐 팀에 영입하고, 영웅별 카드와 스탯을 조합해 덱을 구성하며 자동 전투를 진행한다. 각 회차마다 팀을 새로 구성하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 영웅마다 서로 공유되지 않는 100장 이상의 고유 카드를 가지며, 바람·어둠·혼돈 등 원소를 조합해 능력을 발동한다. 전사를 버서커, 사무라이, 다크 나이트 등으로 특화하거나 혼합할 수 있고, 난이도가 상승하는 랭크 모드를 제공한다.

name: Chronicles of the Wolf
input:
The Beast is real—and it’s waiting for you.

In Chronicles of the Wolf, you’ll play as Mateo Lombardo, the last apprentice of the Rose Cross Order, on a quest to hunt the infamous Beast of Gévaudan. This dark and thrilling platforming adventure blends fast-paced combat, challenging exploration, and deep storytelling, making it a must-play for fans of the genre.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Mateo Lombardo를 조작해 Gévaudan의 야수를 추적하며, 전투와 탐험을 진행한다.
summary.특징: Rose Cross Order의 마지막 수련생이라는 설정을 배경으로, 플랫포밍과 전투, 탐험, 스토리 요소를 결합한다.

name: Genocode
input:
🧠 ABOUT THIS GAME

The Brain is under siege. The Body is dying. You are the last Chromosome.

A devastating virus known as Corona X has taken control of the central nervous system, turning the Brain into its personal evolution lab. From deep within the genetic code, a lone chromosome awakens — Chromon, the last hope in a collapsing world of flesh and memory.

As Corona X creates an army of advanced viral creatures, Chromon must venture through stylized, surreal environments representing the internal body — from corrupted neural networks to decaying organs — in a desperate race to free the Brain and stop total collapse.

You are small.
The virus is vast.
But resistance starts with one strand of code.

🧬 FEATURES:

-
Epic Bio-Sci-Fi Narrative
Uncover the dark mystery behind Corona X and its takeover of the brain.

-
Stylized Internal Worlds
Journey through visually striking environments inspired by the body’s organs and systems.

-
Combat Evolved
Battle intelligent viral enemies that adapt, mutate, and swarm.

-
Character-Driven Story
Fight alongside the White Knights, protect your loved ones, and ignite a revolution from within.

-
A New Kind of Hero
You’re not a soldier. You’re a Chromosome. But you just might be the cure.

⚔️ Free the Brain. Save the Body.
Wishlist now and join the internal revolution.

💥 The fight is just beginning.

Wishlisting now powers the resistance. Hit that green button and be part of the internal revolution.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 마지막 염색체 Chromon을 조작해 신체 내부를 탐험하며, 적응하고 변이하며 무리 짓는 바이러스 적들과 전투를 벌인다.
summary.특징: Corona X라는 바이러스가 뇌와 중추신경계를 장악한 세계를 배경으로 하며, 손상된 신경망과 부패한 장기 등 신체 내부 기관을 형상화한 환경을 무대로 한다. White Knights와 함께 싸우는 서사 중심의 진행이 포함된다.

name: 拂晓之诗Dawn's Poem
input:
A sci-fi otome AVG game where players will uncover the truth of the events by solving puzzles and making choices that trigger different endings.

In the year 2380, after humanity experienced the rebellion of the super AI Phoenix, civilization regressed by nearly a century. The use of mechanical intelligence was globally banned. Humanity turned its hopes for the future towards life sciences that could modify their own genes.

Two years later, without your knowledge, you were chosen by the AI Phoenix as a "Spark." During your involvement in a military operation in Kanteya City, you clashed with a red-haired interstellar pirate leader and a mysterious black-haired man. Your frequent activities exposed you to the undercurrents, and multiple factions, engaged in overt and covert struggles, reached out to you. Some wanted to extinguish you, others sought to claim you for themselves, and some even hailed you as the dawn of a new world.

With your mother's mysterious death, your father's demise in the stars, and your friends being innocently affected, who should you align with next, and where should you head?

summary.핵심플레이: 퍼즐을 풀고 선택지를 고르며 이야기를 진행하고, 선택에 따라 서로 다른 엔딩을 이끌어낸다.
summary.특징: 슈퍼 AI Phoenix의 반란 이후 기계 지능 사용이 금지되고 유전자 개조 생명과학이 발전한 2380년대를 배경으로 하며, 플레이어는 Phoenix에게 '스파크'로 선택되어 여러 세력의 얽힌 갈등 속에서 관계를 맺어나간다.

name: Lovely NGO
input:
feature

▶ Proportional projection of CG background to draw map objects.

▶ Localized subtitles create situations that are most consistent with real-life dialogue and the      use of local dialects.

Story summary

Angel is an ordinary third-year college girl. Because she is usually too careless, it is difficult to find a job in a good NGO. She can only go to some unusual places for internships.And to make matters worse, because too many subjects were failed, she needed to retake them, could not even make up the normal working hours, so she had to agree to work as a "sex volunteer" for the organization to earn extra hours.

"At worst, it's just a handjob for people in need!" Angel thought simply.

However, what she doesn't know is that in the future, in addition to cases of applying for sex volunteers, there will be more people around her who will need her "services".

future plans

This is the first work of our team. It cannot be said to be very mature, but it is definitely 100% attentive.Because our team insists on providing plot descriptions that are most relevant to local culture, we do not currently provide multi-lingual subtitles due to insufficient team manpower and budget.

If we have spare capacity in the future, our team will work hard to provide more high-quality works and expand into other languages. Thank you for your support and understanding.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Angel이 NGO에서 인턴 및 '성 자원봉사자'로 활동하며 다양한 인물들과의 상황과 대화를 진행하는 스토리 중심 플레이.
summary.특징: CG 배경을 비례 투사해 맵 오브젝트를 그리며, 현지 문화와 방언을 반영한 로컬라이즈드 자막으로 대사를 구성한다. 현재 다국어 자막은 제공되지 않는다.

name: D.W. Dagger: Chapter One
input:
A noir first-person murder mystery set in a gloomy 1947 Pacific Northwest city. Play as the renowned Detective D.W. Dagger to help solve his latest case. A violent murder, a possible suicide, and a handful of suspects.

Can you deduce what happened?

----

As the first case in the upcoming series, test your deductive reasoning skills to piece together the truth of a new violent crime.

Taking inspiration from video games like "Gone Home" and "What Remains of Edith Finch," as well as the board game classic "Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective," you follow the narrative told through evidence found within the crime scene. As the lead detective, you must find suspects, determine which evidence helps your case and which hurts it, and ultimately, determine who committed the gruesome act.

This is a small, first case to give players an idea of what the larger series entails. It takes around 30-45 minutes to finish, depending on your detective skills! There is no randomized evidence or alternate paths, so once you complete it, that's it.

----

Original Soundtrack by Corey Teply

summary.핵심플레이: 탐정 D.W. Dagger가 되어 범죄 현장에서 증거를 수집하고, 사건에 도움이 되는 증거와 방해가 되는 증거를 구분하며 용의자를 조사해 범인을 추론한다.
summary.특징: 1947년 태평양 북서부의 어두운 도시를 배경으로 한 느와르풍 살인 미스터리로, 증거를 통해 이야기가 전개된다. 무작위 요소나 분기 없이 진행되며 약 30~45분 분량의 시리즈 첫 사건이다.

name: Fairy Bubble
input:
The fairies have been arrested and the magical world is threatened;

You must free all the fairies by popping the bubbles that trap them.

To free them you must throw your magic balls in the bubbles that hold the fairies.

When you free all the fairies on the island a magic crystal will appear, throwing a magic ball on it will transport you to the next island.

As you progress you will gain new magic balls, pay attention to your magic balls as they work differently.

Yellow balls have normal gravity and bounce when hitting the ground.

Red balls have no gravity and do not need a lot of force to throw them

Blue balls are to teleport you with them you can walk around the islands and castle

Green balls are special bombs to defeat the enemy

After freeing all the fairies and defeating the enemy you will take control of the magical world and explore all the islands, if you dare you can see the magical world from the top.

Travel on this fun and challenging adventure.

summary.핵심플레이: 마법 공을 던져 요정을 가둔 거품을 터뜨려 요정을 풀어주고, 섬의 모든 요정을 해방하면 나타나는 마법 크리스탈을 맞혀 다음 섬으로 이동한다.
summary.특징: 진행하면서 노란색·빨간색·파란색·초록색 등 각기 다르게 작동하는 마법 공을 얻으며, 중력 유무, 순간이동, 적을 처치하는 폭탄 등의 기능으로 섬과 성을 탐험한다.

name: Bunker Defense
input:
Tower defense is back, and it's better than ever!
MULTI-PLAYER

You can play Bunker Defense with your friends in an online 2-4 player co-op mode. Combine the towers and abilities of different commanders for powerful combos!
KEY FEATURES

- Bunker Defense is a tower defense game. Waves of enemies attack your base, and you must defend it by building different kinds of defense towers and cannons.

- A top-down strategy game.

- Suitable challenges are provided for all skill and equipment levels by different difficulty levels.

- Maze building without juggling!

- A single-player mode is included.

- An online multi-player co-op mode for 2-4 players is included.

- There are multiple different commanders for the player to choose from, each having their own defenses and abilities.

- Defenses and tactics can be improved with different abilities and items.

- Looting and crafting.

- Unlockable special defenses.

- Lots of different kinds of enemies.

- Boss fights!

- Decent graphics with a modern game engine.

- Lots of content. Contains both hand-crafted and generated levels.

- Lots of depth with different commanders and commander builds, different special enemies, different items, different strategies, resource management, etc.

- Great soundtrack!

summary.핵심플레이: 밀려오는 적의 파도로부터 기지를 지키기 위해 방어 타워와 대포를 건설하고, 미로형 방어선을 구성하며 적을 막아낸다. 능력과 아이템으로 방어와 전술을 강화하고 자원을 관리한다.
summary.특징: 여러 사령관 중 선택해 각자의 고유 방어 시설과 능력을 활용하며, 2~4인 온라인 협동 모드와 싱글플레이를 지원한다. 수제작 및 생성형 레벨, 루팅과 제작, 해금 가능한 특수 방어, 다양한 적과 보스전을 포함한다.

name: The Construct
input:
“The Construct” is a classical top-down view adventure indie game. The gameplay mixes retro-like gameplay mechanics with modern features and a spectacular atmosphere and mysterious storyline. The game features an approximetly 2-3 hours long main story line with a constant variety in level design and cinematic elements, several bonus maps to unlock, numerous steam achievements, trading cards, emoticons, badges and profile backgrounds to collect, and after completing the story for the first time, the real hardcore skillgamers can choose to complete it for a second time on hard mode, that offers numerous changes in level design and a highly increased difficulity. With all of the above claculated it takes around 5-6 hours to 100% complete the game.



The game can be played using both a controller or mouse and keyboard. It features full controller support, but first you must enable your controller at the options tab in the main menu of the game.

summary.핵심플레이: 탑다운 시점에서 스토리라인을 따라 레벨을 진행하며, 약 2~3시간 분량의 메인 스토리와 잠금 해제 가능한 보너스 맵을 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 레트로풍 메커니즘에 시네마틱 연출과 스토리를 결합했으며, 스토리 클리어 후 레벨 디자인이 변경되고 난이도가 높아지는 하드 모드를 제공한다. 컨트롤러와 마우스·키보드를 모두 지원하고, 스팀 도전 과제·트레이딩 카드·이모티콘·배지·프로필 배경 수집 요소가 있다.

name: Dead Space™ 2
input:
In Dead Space™ 2, you join Isaac Clarke, the Systems Engineer from Dead Space, as he wakes up three years after the horrific events on the USG Ishimura. The Ishimura was a Planetcracker-class starship besieged by grotesque reanimations of its dead crew, known as “Necromorphs.”

After unearthing a strange artifact known as the Marker, Isaac finds himself on the Sprawl, a giant space station in orbit around Saturn. Unable to remember how he got here and plagued with demented visions of his dead girlfriend Nicole, he must survive another nightmarish outbreak of Necromorphs as he fights his way towards an answer he hopes will end all the chaos.

Key Features:

- Tear through space with full 360 degree movement.

- Wield a set of devastating tools to bring the terror to space. Impale Necromorphs into the walls with the Javelin, use improved telekinesis to turn limbs into deadly weapons, plant powerful dismembering trip mines, or create a hull-breach to suck a group of monsters out into space.

- Fire up Isaac’s suit boosters to rocket around in zero gravity like never before. Explore the depths of the Sprawl and encounter new weightless combat and physics-based puzzles with full 360⁰ movement.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 아이작 클라크가 되어 우주 정거장 Sprawl에서 Necromorph와 맞서 싸운다. 다양한 도구와 무기를 사용해 적을 절단하고, 무중력 환경에서 이동하며 물리 기반 퍼즐을 해결한다.
summary.특징: USG Ishimura 사건 3년 후를 배경으로 토성 궤도의 우주 정거장 Sprawl에서 진행된다. 360도 완전 이동과 부츠터를 이용한 무중력 전투, 죽은 연인 Nicole의 환영 등 서사 요소를 포함한다.
