summary.특징: 제공된 설명에는 Discord, Twitter, Reddit, TikTok 등 커뮤니티 채널 안내만 포함되어 있으며, 게임 자체에 대한 세부 정보는 제시되지 않았다.

name: MINDFIELD
input:
Warning: Some scenes contain violence and death, and may not be suitable for all viewers. Viewer discretion advised.

As long as the scars remain unhealed, the fight isn't over.

After returning from his latest mission abroad, John undergoes a profound transformation. Haunted by the trauma of his recent experience, he finds that he is no longer the person he once was, and this change is evident not only to him but also to those in his life. Though he has developed techniques to bury these painful memories deep within, they persistently resurface, threatening to consume him. In order to break free from this torment, John is compelled to confront the ghosts of his past and make a pivotal decision.

Will he find the strength to make the correct choice?
VR EXPERIENCE
Abstractly exploring and depicting the invisible impacts of altered mental health, MINDFIELD is an immersive experience focuses on how John, an army veteran, has his life altered by his post-traumatic stress disorder. The audience will delve inside his memories, transported to the core of the emotional rift he experienced during a more chaotic time of war. Will John be able to open up about his past to a loved one, freeing himself partially from the burden he bears? Or will he remain stuck in this loop of hopelessness?

The person that can determine John's fate... is you!
ADDRESSING POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER
The film's objective is to sensitize the viewer towards how PTSD can influence the experience of daily life, making them a witness of imagery depicting the character's inner state of turmoil, as well as exposing them to a painful memory of trauma. The film searches to evoke empathy, but also to provoke a questioning towards traumatic experiences, their impacts and the healing process.

summary.핵심플레이: 군 참전 용사 John의 기억 속으로 들어가 그의 과거와 심리 상태를 탐색하며, 그가 트라우마를 털어놓을지 여부를 결정하는 선택을 한다.
summary.특징: 외상 후 스트레스 장애가 일상에 미치는 영향을 추상적 영상으로 표현한 VR 몰입형 작품으로, 참전 경험에서 비롯된 정신적 고통과 치유 과정을 다룬다. 폭력과 죽음 묘사가 포함된다.

name: Sex Clicker

summary.핵심플레이: 화면의 캐릭터를 클릭해 돈을 벌고, 그 돈으로 각종 업그레이드와 도우미(소녀, 인형, 공장 등)를 고용해 더 많은 돈을 자동으로 생산한다. 게임을 최소화한 상태에서도 수익이 쌓인다.
summary.특징: 성적 요소를 소재로 한 방치형 클리커로, 다양한 업그레이드를 어떻게 분배하는지 계산하며 수익을 늘리는 방식을 사용한다.

name: Blindsighted
input:
A Different Kind of Platformer
Blindsighted has the player explore levels not by sight but by touch and memory. Dying is common, but you'll remember the lay of the land each time. Learn from your mistakes!
Game Features
Originally conceived for a Game Jam as nothing more than a demo, Blindsighted is now a full game!

Features:

- Lots of unique gameplay mechanics

- Minimalist, but captivating visuals

- Controller support

- 4 original pieces of music

- More than one level! (12 base levels, bonus levels added all the time.)

- Level select with best times and best deaths

- Optional timer and death counters

- Accessibility features

summary.핵심플레이: 시각이 아닌 촉각과 기억에 의존해 레벨을 탐색하며, 반복적인 죽음을 통해 지형을 익혀 나아간다.
summary.특징: 미니멀한 비주얼과 게임 잼에서 시작된 구조로, 12개의 기본 레벨과 추가 보너스 레벨, 최고 기록·사망 횟수를 보여주는 레벨 선택, 선택형 타이머와 사망 카운터, 접근성 기능, 컨트롤러 지원, 4곡의 오리지널 음악을 포함한다.

name: Wind Up
input:
Let's enter the wonderful world of Wind Up! In this haunted castle, you will get suspicious of each other as clockwork dolls. Here you will experience——
※Day-Night Cycle
The day is clockwork dolls' home field, while the night is the stage of the imposters. Judge the situation to gain advantages for your team.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 태엽 인형이 되어 유령이 나오는 성에서 서로를 의심하며, 낮과 밤의 상황을 판단해 자기 팀에 유리한 행동을 한다.
summary.특징: 낮은 태엽 인형에게 유리한 시간이고 밤은 사칭자의 무대가 되는 낮-밤 순환 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Base One
input:
Base One is a base building management strategy game with an RPG twist. After a large wormhole tears the moon apart and causes unprecedented levels of natural disasters, the Earth Global Union create the "Solution" space exploration program in order to explore the wormhole for a new home. As a member of the "Solution" program, it is up to you to expand the fleet, find valuable minerals and new planets to inhabit - and maybe even save the Earth from ecological destruction!

- Take command of the EGU fleet of space stations located in unexplored corners of space.

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 우주 정거장 기지를 건설하고 관리하며, 함대를 확장하고 광물과 거주 가능한 행성을 탐사한다.
summary.특징: 웜홀로 달이 부서지고 대규모 자연재해가 발생한 이후, 새로운 거주지를 찾기 위한 'Solution' 우주 탐사 프로그램의 일원으로서 EGU 우주 정거장 함대를 지휘하는 세계관을 배경으로 한다. 기지 건설 관리에 RPG 요소가 결합되어 있다.

name: Exista!
input:
"Exista!" is a game about discoveries, fears, and the desire to find your place in the world. The story begins in Lost Islands, a place made up of floating islands, created after a catastrophic event that altered the planet's gravity and left the sky perpetually dark. You live in this world as a young person dreaming of exploring these mysterious islands, driven by a desire to prove yourself to your family.

The game follows your entire life. From the innocence and curiosity of childhood, through the challenges and responsibilities of adulthood, to the dilemmas and reflections of old age. Each phase brings new obstacles and choices that impact the protagonist and those around them. However, throughout your journey, one constant presence accompanies you: Death. At first, it seems harmless, almost like a distant shadow, but its presence grows until you must face it head-on.

"Exista!" is not just an adventure game. It is an experience about understanding the value of time, confronting your fears, and leaving a legacy in a world perpetually teetering on the edge of the unknown. While exploring ancient ruins, facing wild creatures, and rebuilding parts of your village, you will also uncover secrets about Lost Islands and the civilization that came before you.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공의 유년기부터 노년기까지 생애 전체를 따라가며 떠 있는 섬들을 탐험하고, 고대 유적을 조사하며 야생 생물과 마주하고 마을의 일부를 재건한다. 각 인생 단계마다 주어지는 선택이 주인공과 주변 인물에게 영향을 준다.
summary.특징: 재앙으로 행성의 중력이 바뀌고 하늘이 영원히 어두워진 뒤 생겨난 부유하는 섬 'Lost Islands'를 배경으로 한다. 여정 내내 '죽음'이라는 존재가 동행하며 점차 그 존재감이 커지고, 이전 문명과 섬에 얽힌 비밀을 밝혀 나간다.

name: Gargouti Simulator
input:
Open your humble food stand in a lively Algerian neighborhood and begin your journey into the world of traditional street food!

In Gargouti Simulator, you play as the owner of a small local food shop deep in the heart of an authentic Algerian neighborhood. Your mission? Cook up beloved street dishes like Karantika, French fry sandwiches, and omelettes — all while dealing with quirky customers, tight timing, and the chaotic charm of everyday life.

This isn’t just a cooking game — it’s an immersive slice-of-life experience where you’ll explore Algerian food culture, manage your shop, and climb your way to becoming the true King of the Gargouti.

🧾 Key Features:

-
🏘️ Authentic Algerian atmosphere: Inspired by real neighborhoods, with local signs, decor, and casual street vibes.

-
🍴 Discover traditional food: Prepare Karantika, French fry sandwiches, omelettes, and more!

-
😂 Quirky customer interactions: Get praised — or roasted — based on your performance.

-
🛠️ Realistic tools and appliances: Use grills, spatulas, gas stoves, soda fridges, and sauce bottles.

-
🎶 Local music and sound design: Adds a vibrant and immersive Algerian flavor.

Can you keep up with the rush, satisfy your customers, and make your little shop the pride of the neighborhood?

Test your skills and experience the everyday flavor of Algerian street life in Gargouti Simulator!

summary.핵심플레이: 알제리 동네의 작은 노점 주인이 되어 카란티카, 감자튀김 샌드위치, 오믈렛 등 길거리 음식을 조리하고 손님을 응대하며 가게를 운영한다.
summary.특징: 실제 알제리 동네에서 영감을 받은 간판·장식과 현지 음악을 배경으로 하며, 그릴·스패출러·가스레인지·음료 냉장고·소스병 등의 도구를 사용해 손님과 상호작용한다.

name: STORAGE FULL
input:
The Distort Ocean has risen — and it's nearly swallowed the entire world.

Cities. Forests. Mountains. All gone beneath the tide.

Only the Scuba Species — amphibious lifeforms adapted for both land and sea — stand as humanity’s last hope.

They alone can dive deep enough to destroy The Wields, the true source of this creeping catastrophe... before it’s too late.

---

🕹️ WHAT IS STORAGE FULL?

STORAGE FULL is a 2D side-scrolling action game with a vibrant cartoon-inspired art style that shifts between bright and somber tones based on the environment.

You’ll play as Zuum, a Scuba Species operative equipped with two mysterious powers that affect enemies — and the battlefield — in radically different ways:

• Buffer: Uplift your enemies with pride and dignity… causing them to walk away peacefully and leave behind healing energy.

• Nerfer: Strip away their sense of self-worth — turning them into volatile vessels of self-destruction that explode violently upon defeat.

Whether you choose compassion or force, every decision shapes how you survive... and how much you lose along the way.

---

🎮 CURRENT FEATURES (EARLY ACCESS)

✓ 3 fully playable stages with unique environments and boss battles

✓ Central base zone for upgrades, mission prep, and NPC interaction

✓ 10+ story-driven NPCs with lore, quests, and branching conversations

✓ Upgrade system to enhance speed, stealth, and special abilities

✓ Enemy Codex to track The Wields and uncover world lore

✓ Save/load system

✓ Original soundtrack and full SFX design carried over from the demo

---

🔮 PLANNED FEATURES FOR FULL RELEASE

• 15 total stages — with new environments, mechanics, and bosses

• Expanded storyline with deeper lore about the Distort Ocean

• Additional NPCs, side quests, and moral branching paths

• Multiple endings based on gameplay decisions

• Enhanced visual polish and environmental storytelling

• No full voice acting — the story is delivered through immersive, expressive dialogue

---

🤝 WHY EARLY ACCESS?

We believe in building STORAGE FULL together with our community.

Early Access lets us test new mechanics, tune the difficulty, and shape the story direction based on what resonates most with real players.

You’re not just helping us — you’re helping the ocean remember what it means to fight back.

---

Swim with mercy. Strike with force.

The ocean is full — but you might be fuller.

summary.핵심플레이: Scuba Species 요원 Zuum을 조작해 스테이지를 진행하며 적을 상대하고, 업그레이드와 미션 준비, NPC 상호작용을 수행한다. 적을 평화롭게 물러나게 해 회복 에너지를 얻는 Buffer와, 적을 폭발하는 상태로 만드는 Nerfer 두 능력을 선택해 전투한다.
summary.특징: Distort Ocean에 세계 대부분이 잠긴 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 환경에 따라 밝은 톤과 어두운 톤이 전환되는 카툰풍 2D 그래픽을 사용한다. 얼리 액세스 기준으로 3개 스테이지와 보스전, 업그레이드 시스템, 적 도감, 저장/불러오기를 제공하며 정식 출시 시 총 15개 스테이지와 다중 엔딩 등이 계획되어 있다.

name: On Roads Between
input:
On Roads Between is currently in ALPHA and will not be released until complete. Free demos will be available forever but will have limited cross-play with the final game.

Monsters are attacking New Zealand, and the newspaper is paying good money for photos. Grab a camera, a couple mates and your high-school car, to be the first to capitalize on it.

On Roads Between is a co-op horror game set in 1980s New Zealand with a unique papercraft art-style. Drive anywhere from the top of the North Island to the bottom of the South to capture anomalies and Lovecraftian horrors on fresh film.

On Roads Between features a massive map (won't be in demo, still squashing bugs,) where you can drive from town to town. Restock and replenish your items in the small towns before venturing out into the native bush to get paid. Keep your car topped up and repaired, just in case you need a quick getaway.

You can drive almost anywhere, and where you can't, you can hike. Keep in mind that you drop your items when you die, so don't go too far from you camp.

Camps are how you respawn friends, save progress and pass the time. This is the 1980s, so you have to pass time by playing instruments, sports and maybe a few pranks on your friends. Remember, time flies when you're having fun.

Soon enough, night will fall. And with it, monsters and anomalies will be more common. Get your cameras ready, and hope you have enough spare film to catch them all. And don't worry if a Scuttler or a Merchant takes you out. You can still help your friends from beyond the grave.

With your new found dough, put together the slickest outfit you can. Stick stickers all over your character to build a unique look. Yes, I know what you guys will do with this feature, and you can disable seeing other's custom costumes. Please don't make me regret adding this.

Also, I am going to look into making the stickers tradable, with a foil and aging system. Keep an eye out for rare stickers, because you might be the only one in the world to have it.

summary.핵심플레이: 1980년대 뉴질랜드에서 친구들과 차를 타고 마을을 이동하며 이상 현상과 괴물을 카메라 필름에 담아 사진을 팔고 돈을 번다. 마을에서 아이템을 보충하고 차량 연료와 수리 상태를 관리하며 야생 지역으로 나가 촬영한다.
summary.특징: 페이퍼크래프트 아트 스타일과 러브크래프트풍 공포 요소를 사용하며, 북섬 끝에서 남섬 끝까지 이어지는 대규모 맵을 차량과 도보로 탐험한다. 캠프에서 부활·저장·시간 보내기를 하고, 사망 후에도 친구를 도울 수 있으며, 스티커로 캐릭터 외형을 꾸미는 커스터마이징 기능이 있다.

name: Mathletics
input:
Mathletics is a fast-paced math game about collecting values to complete objectives. Add, subtract, and strategize your way through handmade math-based puzzles in the campaign, or brave different 'Events' and 'Powerups' as long as you can in 'Endless'!

Features:

-
24 handmade levels across 5 themes

-
'Endless' mode, where you collect numbers until you make a mistake

-
Powerups and Events inspired by school supplies

-
Customizable game settings so you can decide how you want to play

summary.핵심플레이: 수를 모아 더하고 빼며 목표 값을 완성하는 수학 기반 퍼즐을 푼다. 캠페인의 제작된 레벨을 진행하거나, 실수하기 전까지 최대한 오래 버티는 엔들리스 모드를 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 5개 테마에 걸친 24개의 수작업 레벨과 엔들리스 모드를 제공하며, 학용품에서 영감을 받은 파워업과 이벤트, 조정 가능한 게임 설정을 갖췄다.

name: ATV Simulator VR
input: ATV Simulator VR is the ultimate ATV driving experience for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Operate your own ATV with simple controls in a free-range forest map with jumps, turns and exploration opportunities. Have a casual drive, go for jump after jump, or enjoy the pleasant scenery.

summary.핵심플레이: HTC Vive와 Oculus Rift용 VR 환경에서 간단한 조작으로 ATV를 운전하며, 숲 맵을 자유롭게 탐험하고 점프와 코너 주행을 한다.
summary.특징: 점프와 회전 구간이 있는 오픈형 숲 맵을 배경으로 하며, 캐주얼한 드라이빙과 풍경 감상을 지원한다.

name: You Better Run
input:
🎮 Welcome to the Most Explosive Game Night Ever!

You and your friends were just vibing on a peaceful island evening… until chaos struck. Someone found a bomb hidden in the attic—and instead of calling for help, they went completely bonkers and tried to stick it on your back!

That’s when everything changed.
This isn’t just game night anymore… this is You Better Run.

💣 Run. Dodge. Betray. Repeat.
Things are about to blow up—literally.

🔗 LAN MULTIPLAYER MADNESS
Gather your crew on a local network and jump into non-stop fun! Perfect for parties, game nights, or just burning bridges with your closest friends.

🧪 WILD ABILITIES & CHAOTIC COMBOS
Strategize (or just spam) your way to victory with absurd power-ups that turn the tide in seconds:

-
🔥 Molotov Cocktail – Light it up and block the path!

-
❄️ Ice Freeze – Chill your enemies, then dash past them!

-
☣️ Toxic Gas – Leave behind a nasty surprise.

-
💨 Dash – Outrun, outplay, outlast.

🐔 THE ANGRY CHICKEN RETURNS
Oh, and did we mention the chicken? Yeah… try not to tick it off. It will slow you down.

Survive the madness, betray your friends, and become the last one standing.

Welcome to You Better Run—the island where friendship meets frenzy.

summary.핵심플레이: 등에 붙은 폭탄을 다른 플레이어에게 넘기며 도망치고 방해하는 술래잡기식 대전을 반복하고, 마지막까지 살아남는 것을 목표로 한다.
summary.특징: LAN 로컬 멀티플레이를 지원하며, 화염병·얼음·독가스·대시 등의 능력과 플레이어를 방해하는 화난 닭 요소가 등장한다.

name: Evil Soul
input:
When a life dies, his soul goes through the Death River. Ferryman will take souls to their homeland.Ferryman likes collecting powerful souls. He offers to bring the soul back to life as a half-evil, if the soul trade him with a half of his soul.
There are 6 Evil Lords in the hell and they have been observing powerful souls in living world. Evil Lords kill whoever they like to recruit and lead their souls to the hell.
However, some talent people, hero or villian, got killed by Evil Lords. They choose to turn to half-evil and revenge to Evil Lords.

· Top-down view rpg game with roguelike features.

summary.핵심플레이: 탑다운 시점에서 캐릭터를 조작하며 전투를 진행하고, 로그라이크 요소를 통해 반복 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 죽은 자의 영혼이 반쪽 악마로 되살아나 6명의 악마 군주에게 복수하는 세계관을 배경으로 한다.
